attributes.description: Date and time when this WIP lot record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: lot_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this WIP lot record was created in the MES system, marking the start of lot tracking.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the lot or batch. Human-readable unique code used for tracking and traceability across the shop floor and in MES systems.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the WIP lot. Indicates whether the lot is released for production, actively in process, on hold, completed, scrapped, or cancelled.
attributes.references: MES Manufacturing Execution System, SAP PP Production Order Status

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this WIP lot that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: original_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number of the original lot if this is a rework or split lot. Maintains traceability to the source lot for genealogy purposes.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Production priority level assigned to this lot. Determines scheduling precedence and resource allocation on the shop floor.
attributes.references: APS Advanced Planning and Scheduling, MES Scheduling

attributes.name: production_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when physical production of this lot began at the first operation. Used for lead time and cycle time calculation.
attributes.references: MES Shop Floor Control, Lean Manufacturing Metrics

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Project identifier if this lot is being produced for a specific engineering or customer project. Used for project-based manufacturing tracking.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot requires quality inspection before proceeding to the next operation or before final goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Management, APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning

attributes.name: quantity_completed
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of material that has successfully completed all operations in the routing and is ready for goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP PP Goods Receipt, MES Production Reporting

attributes.name: quantity_in_process
attributes.description: Current quantity of material actively being processed at the current operation. Represents material that has not yet completed the current step.
attributes.references: MES Manufacturing Execution System, WIP Tracking

attributes.name: quantity_on_hold
attributes.description: Quantity of material in this lot that is currently on hold pending quality inspection, engineering review, or other disposition decision.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Management, NCR Non-Conformance Report

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Total quantity of material originally planned to be produced in this lot as specified in the production order.

attributes.name: quantity_scrapped
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of material that has been rejected or scrapped due to quality defects or process failures during production.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Management, SPC Statistical Process Control

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is a rework lot created to reprocess previously rejected or non-conforming material.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Management, CAPA Corrective and Preventive Action

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which this lot is scheduled to complete all operations and be available for goods receipt. Used for capacity planning and delivery commitment.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Scheduling, APS Advanced Planning and Scheduling

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the primary reason for any scrapped quantity in this lot. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.
attributes.references: SPC Statistical Process Control, CAPA Corrective and Preventive Action

attributes.name: serial_number_profile
attributes.description: Serial number profile code indicating whether and how individual units within this lot are serialized for traceability.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the production shift during which this lot is currently being processed. Used for shift-level performance reporting.
attributes.references: MES Shop Floor Control, OEE Overall Equipment Effectiveness

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating if this lot represents special stock such as consignment, project stock, or customer-owned material.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Management Special Stock

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Storage location or staging area code where this WIP lot is currently physically located within the plant.
attributes.references: SAP WM Warehouse Management, WMS Warehouse Management System

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields in this lot record (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters).
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, SAP Material Master UOM

products.name: production_downtime_event
products.description: Downtime event capturing a planned or unplanned production stoppage at a work center or line. Records start/end timestamps, duration, downtime category (breakdown, planned maintenance, changeover, material shortage, quality hold, operator absence), root cause code, and responsible department. Critical input for OEE availability calculation, TPM analysis, and changeover time (SMED) tracking. Sourced from SCADA alarm logs and MES downtime tracking (e.g., Siemens Opcenter).
products.reference: SCADA Downtime Event / MES Downtime Record

attributes.name: production_downtime_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production downtime event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: alarm_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.alarm_definition. Business justification: Root‑cause analysis links downtime events to the specific alarm definition that triggered them, required for OEE loss reporting.

attributes.name: asset_work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the maintenance work order created to address the downtime event. Null for non-maintenance related downtime.

attributes.name: ecn_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.ecn. Business justification: Downtime root‑cause analysis often references an engineering change notice; linking enables systematic CAPA tracking.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific equipment or machine that experienced downtime. Links to equipment register.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Captures the exact plant location of each downtime event, required for safety incident analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: primary_production_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the maintenance technician or operator assigned to resolve the downtime event. Links to employee master data.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production order that was interrupted by this downtime event. May be null for unplanned stoppages outside scheduled production.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: DOWNTIME COST ATTRIBUTION: Downtime events are allocated to the owning project for KPI dashboards and project profitability analysis.

attributes.name: safety_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.safety_incident. Business justification: Downtime root‑cause analysis links downtime events to recorded safety incidents for safety performance reporting.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production shift during which the downtime event occurred. Links to shift schedule master data.

attributes.name: tertiary_production_recorded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operator or technician who initially recorded this downtime event. Links to employee master data.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center or production line where the downtime occurred. Links to the work center master data.

attributes.name: alarm_code
attributes.description: SCADA or DCS alarm code that triggered the downtime event. Used to correlate downtime with specific equipment faults.

attributes.name: alarm_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the SCADA alarm that initiated the downtime event.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the downtime event record. Pending indicates awaiting supervisor review, approved indicates validated, rejected indicates disputed or incorrect entry.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the downtime event record was approved by a supervisor or manager.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes about the downtime event from operators, technicians, or supervisors.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for production loss value (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: downtime_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the downtime event: breakdown (unplanned equipment failure), planned_maintenance (scheduled PM), changeover (product/tool change), material_shortage (feedstock unavailable), quality_hold (production stopped for quality issue), operator_absence (staffing gap).

attributes.name: downtime_event_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the downtime event, typically generated by MES or SCADA system.

attributes.name: downtime_reason
attributes.description: Operator or supervisor entered reason for the downtime event. Free-text field capturing immediate observed cause.

attributes.name: downtime_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime was planned (scheduled maintenance, changeover) or unplanned (breakdown, material shortage, quality hold).

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the downtime event in minutes. Calculated as the difference between end_timestamp and start_timestamp, or current time if still ongoing.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when production resumed after the downtime event. Null if downtime is still ongoing.

attributes.name: impact_on_oee
attributes.business_glossary_term: Impact on Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) Percentage
attributes.description: Calculated percentage impact of this downtime event on the work center or line OEE for the shift or day. Expressed as percentage points lost.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this downtime event record is currently active. False indicates the record has been logically deleted or superseded.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this downtime event is part of a recurring pattern at this work center or equipment. True if similar events have occurred within the past 30 days.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this downtime event record was last updated. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: mttr_minutes
attributes.description: Mean time to repair for this type of downtime event, calculated from historical data. Used for benchmarking and performance tracking.

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether automated notifications were sent to supervisors, maintenance team, or management when this downtime event occurred.

attributes.name: preventive_action
attributes.description: Description of preventive measures implemented to avoid recurrence of this type of downtime event.

attributes.name: production_loss_units
attributes.description: Estimated quantity of production units lost due to this downtime event. Calculated based on standard cycle time and downtime duration.

attributes.name: production_loss_value
attributes.description: Estimated financial value of production lost due to this downtime event. Calculated using standard cost per unit and production loss units.

attributes.name: recorded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this downtime event record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: recurrence_count
attributes.description: Number of times this type of downtime event has occurred at this work center or equipment within the past 30 days. Used for chronic loss identification.

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken to resolve the downtime event and restore production.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Department accountable for resolving the downtime event: production (operator-related), maintenance (equipment repair), quality (inspection/testing), materials (supply chain), engineering (design/process), operations (planning/scheduling).

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the downtime event. Typically references a root cause taxonomy maintained in the CMMS or MES system.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the root cause analysis findings for this downtime event.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Business impact severity of the downtime event: critical (full line stoppage, safety risk), high (major capacity loss), medium (partial degradation), low (minor impact).

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the shift during which the downtime occurred. Used for daily OEE reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System that originated this downtime event record: MES (Siemens Opcenter), SCADA (Aveva), ERP (SAP PP), CMMS (Maximo), or Manual (operator entry).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this downtime event in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the downtime event began. Captured from SCADA alarm logs or MES operator entry.

products.name: production_goods_receipt
products.description: Goods receipt event recording formal completion and stock posting of finished or semi-finished goods produced against a work order. Captures GR document number, posting date, material, plant, storage location, received quantity, batch number, and movement type (101). Sourced from SAP PP/WM (MIGO). This is the production domain's handoff point — it triggers inventory update in the inventory domain and signals work order completion. Does NOT own ongoing stock balances (inventory domain owns those).
products.reference: SAP PP Goods Receipt (MIGO / Movement Type 101)

attributes.name: production_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production goods receipt event. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for the production activity. Used for cost allocation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production operator or technician who confirmed the goods receipt on the shop floor. Used for accountability and performance tracking.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Connects goods receipt to the receiving plant location, supporting traceability and inventory valuation per site.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lot or batch number assigned to the received goods for traceability and quality control purposes.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the finished or semi-finished good that was received. Links to the material being produced.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.mrp_run. Business justification: Goods receipts are posted as a result of an MRP run; linking enables receipt verification against the originating run in the Goods Receipt Reconciliation report.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_line. Business justification: Replace string line code with a proper foreign key to the production line entity for referential integrity.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_work_order. Business justification: Link goods receipt to the work order it finalizes, enabling traceability from receipt to production work order.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: PROJECT INVENTORY RECEIPT: Goods receipts are linked to the project to reconcile received materials against project budgets.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.shift. Business justification: Replace string shift identifier with a foreign key to the shift entity, allowing accurate shift‑level reporting.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Goods receipt records need the SKU to validate received quantity against the product master and enable downstream inventory updates.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location within the plant where the received goods were posted to inventory. Links to warehouse storage location.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Goods receipt must record the supplying vendor to enable invoice matching and supplier performance tracking.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned to the received goods for traceability. May be system-generated or manually assigned based on batch management configuration.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: The production confirmation number from the MES or ERP system that triggered this goods receipt. Links shop floor execution to inventory posting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this goods receipt record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Reference number from the physical delivery documentation or packing slip accompanying the goods. Used for reconciliation with physical documents.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods receipt document was created or initiated. May differ from posting date in cases of backdated transactions.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the goods receipt was posted. Used for monthly financial closing and reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the goods receipt was posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The unique document number generated by the ERP system for this goods receipt transaction. This is the business identifier used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt document. Indicates whether the receipt has been successfully posted, reversed, cancelled, or is awaiting quality inspection.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The quality inspection lot number created for this goods receipt if quality inspection is required. Links to quality management inspection results.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this goods receipt record was last updated in the data warehouse. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code that classifies the type of inventory transaction. For production goods receipts, typically 101 (goods receipt to stock) or 131 (goods receipt from production order).

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the operator or warehouse personnel regarding the goods receipt. Captures exceptions, observations, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: order_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity originally planned to be produced on the work order. Used to calculate yield and completion percentage.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods receipt was posted to inventory in the ERP system. This is the accounting-effective date for inventory valuation.

attributes.name: posting_user
attributes.description: The system user ID who posted the goods receipt transaction in the ERP system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Identifies the specific production version (combination of BOM and routing) used to manufacture the goods. Used for process traceability and costing.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received goods must undergo quality inspection before being released to unrestricted stock. Drives QM workflow.

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the goods were physically received and confirmed on the shop floor or warehouse. Captures the real-world event time for production completion.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of finished or semi-finished goods received and posted to inventory. Measured in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: The material reservation number that was created for the work order and fulfilled by this goods receipt. Links production output to material planning.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction if this goods receipt was reversed. Provides audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this goods receipt has been reversed or cancelled. Used to filter active vs. reversed transactions in reporting.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing the goods receipt (e.g., quantity error, wrong material, quality issue). Used for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material scrapped or rejected during the production run that resulted in this goods receipt. Used for yield calculation and quality analysis.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating if the goods receipt is for special stock types such as consignment, project stock, or sales order stock. Affects inventory valuation and availability.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: The type of stock to which the goods were received. Unrestricted stock is available for use, quality inspection stock is awaiting QA approval, blocked stock cannot be used.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the received quantity is expressed (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters). Must match the material master base UOM.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Classification code used for split valuation of materials when the same material is valued differently based on procurement type or quality grade.

attributes.name: vendor_batch_number
attributes.description: External batch number from a supplier or contract manufacturer, if the goods receipt is for subcontracted production. Used for external traceability.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of good output relative to the total input or planned quantity. Calculated as (received_quantity / order_quantity) * 100. Key OEE component.

products.name: bom_consumption
products.description: Component material consumption record capturing the actual goods issue of raw materials and components from inventory to a work order during production execution. Tracks component material number, planned vs. actual issued quantity, variance quantity, unit of measure, storage location, batch number, and backflush indicator. Enables actual vs. planned BOM consumption variance analysis for cost control and material planning feedback. Sourced from ERP goods issue postings (e.g., SAP movement type 261) and MES backflush events.

attributes.name: bom_consumption_id
attributes.description: Primary key for bom_consumption

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shop floor operator who performed or confirmed the material consumption. Enables accountability and labor tracking.

attributes.name: engineering_bom_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific BOM line item that defines the planned component requirement. Links actual consumption to engineering BOM specification.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality inspection lot if the component underwent inspection before consumption. Links consumption to quality control records.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the component material consumed from inventory. Identifies the specific raw material, sub-assembly, or component issued to production.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent work order for which materials were consumed. Links consumption to the manufacturing execution context.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Material consumption entries need the SKU to roll up costs and efficiency metrics to the final product.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location or bin within the warehouse from which material was picked. Provides granular inventory tracking.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse from which the component material was issued. Identifies the physical storage facility.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The actual cost per unit of the component material based on moving average price or FIFO/LIFO valuation. Reflects real inventory valuation at consumption time.

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of component material issued from inventory to the work order. Represents the real consumption recorded via goods issue or backflush.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumption was automatically backflushed by the MES system upon work order confirmation (true) or manually posted (false).

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number of the component material consumed. Enables traceability for quality control, recall management, and shelf-life tracking.

attributes.name: consumption_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or special instructions related to the consumption event. Captures operator notes and exception details.

attributes.name: consumption_status
attributes.description: Current status of the consumption record: posted (finalized in ERP), pending (awaiting confirmation), reversed (cancelled), cancelled (voided), confirmed (validated by supervisor).

attributes.name: consumption_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consumption event: planned (per BOM), unplanned (ad-hoc issue), scrap (defective material), rework (reprocessing), or sample (quality testing).

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which the material consumption cost is allocated. Used for internal cost accounting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consumption record was first created in the data warehouse. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY). Ensures consistent financial reporting across global operations.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration or shelf-life date of the consumed component material. Critical for perishable materials, chemicals, and time-sensitive components.

attributes.name: goods_issue_number
attributes.description: The ERP-generated document number for the material goods issue transaction. Typically corresponds to SAP movement type 261 for production consumption.

attributes.name: goods_issue_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the material goods issue transaction was posted in the ERP system. Represents the official consumption event time.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consumption record was last updated in the data warehouse. Tracks data change history for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Three-digit SAP movement type code indicating the nature of the goods issue. Common values: 261 (goods issue to order), 262 (reversal of 261).

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: The routing operation sequence number at which the component was consumed. Links consumption to the specific production step in the routing.

attributes.name: original_goods_issue_number
attributes.description: If this is a reversal transaction, the goods issue document number of the original transaction being reversed. Enables audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of component material planned to be consumed according to the BOM specification and work order quantity. Basis for variance analysis.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the consumption transaction was posted to the general ledger. May differ from goods issue timestamp for period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumed component required quality inspection before use (true) or not (false). Supports quality assurance compliance tracking.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for the consumption or variance. Examples: normal production, rework, quality testing, engineering change, process improvement.

attributes.name: reservation_item_number
attributes.description: The line item number within the material reservation document. Provides granular linkage to the specific reserved component.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: The ERP reservation document number that allocated the material to the work order. Links consumption to the material requirements planning reservation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents a reversal of a previous goods issue (true) or an original consumption posting (false). Used for correction and adjustment tracking.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of component material scrapped or wasted during production. Subset of actual quantity representing non-conforming or damaged material.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the component if serialized inventory control is used. Provides unit-level traceability for critical components.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: The shift during which the material was consumed (e.g., day shift, night shift, weekend shift). Supports shift-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: The standard cost per unit of the component material at the time of consumption. Used for cost variance calculation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of the consumption transaction (actual quantity multiplied by actual unit cost). Represents the financial impact of the material issue.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for all quantity fields (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters, M for meters). Must align with material master base UOM.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between actual and planned consumption quantity (actual minus planned). Positive values indicate over-consumption; negative values indicate under-consumption.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Specific code explaining the root cause of consumption variance when actual differs from planned. Used for continuous improvement and cost control analysis.

attributes.name: vendor_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned by the component supplier. Enables upstream traceability to vendor quality records and certificates of conformance.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the work center or production resource where the component was consumed. Enables cost center allocation and capacity analysis.

products.name: resource_tool
products.description: Production resource and tool (PRT) master representing jigs, fixtures, molds, dies, NC programs, and specialized equipment required during routing operations but not consumed in production. Tracks PRT number, type, description, plant, usage quantity per operation, calibration status, next calibration date, and availability status. Enables tool availability checks during scheduling and capacity planning. Maintenance lifecycle details are owned by the asset domain; this entity owns the production-scheduling view of tool readiness. Sourced from ERP PRT master (e.g., SAP PP).

attributes.name: resource_tool_id
attributes.description: Primary key for resource_tool

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Tools are calibrated and allocated per component type; linking supports tool‑component compatibility and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment register in the asset management domain if this production resource tool is also tracked as a capital asset. Links to Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) for maintenance lifecycle details.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record if this production resource tool is also managed as an inventory item (e.g., consumable cutting tools). Links to inventory domain for stock tracking.

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tool custodianship assigns a responsible employee, required for Tool Calibration and Maintenance schedule.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: Tool Allocation process requires exact stock location of each tool; the Tool Management report joins resource_tool with stock_location to show current location.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Tool assets are procured from vendors; linking enables warranty management and supplier performance monitoring.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production line where this production resource tool is primarily assigned. Used for capacity planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase or fabrication cost of the production resource tool in the specified currency. Used for capital expenditure (CapEx) tracking and asset valuation.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the production resource tool was acquired or placed into service. Used for depreciation calculations and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: calibration_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the most recent calibration certificate issued by the calibration laboratory. Used for quality audit trails and traceability.

attributes.name: calibration_interval_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days between calibration events for this production resource tool. Used to automatically calculate next calibration due date.

attributes.name: calibration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production resource tool requires periodic calibration to maintain measurement accuracy and quality compliance. True = calibration required; False = no calibration needed.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Current calibration compliance status. Current = within calibration interval; Due = approaching calibration date; Overdue = past calibration date and blocked from use; Not Applicable = calibration not required for this tool type.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production resource tool record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the acquisition cost (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: current_usage_cycles
attributes.description: Cumulative number of production cycles or operations this production resource tool has performed to date. Used to calculate remaining useful life and trigger replacement.

attributes.name: drawing_number
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering drawing or Computer-Aided Design (CAD) model that defines the production resource tool design. Links to Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.

attributes.name: expected_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful life of the production resource tool in years. Used for depreciation calculations and replacement planning.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the production resource tool was last calibrated. Used to calculate next calibration due date and track calibration history.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production resource tool record was last updated. Used for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) who produced this production resource tool. Used for spare parts sourcing and technical support.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer (OEM) part number or model number for this production resource tool. Used for procurement and technical documentation.

attributes.name: maximum_usage_cycles
attributes.description: Maximum number of production cycles or operations this production resource tool can perform before requiring replacement or refurbishment. Used for preventive maintenance planning.

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next calibration event. Used for preventive maintenance planning and tool availability forecasting. Tool may be blocked from use if this date is exceeded.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional operational information, special handling instructions, or historical context for this production resource tool.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility where the production resource tool is physically located and managed. Aligns with ERP plant master data.

attributes.name: prt_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the production resource tool (jig, fixture, mold, die, NC program, or specialized equipment). Used for scheduling, capacity planning, and shop floor control.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Resource Tool Master

attributes.name: prt_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production resource tool by functional category. Determines usage patterns, calibration requirements, and scheduling logic.

attributes.name: resource_tool_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the production resource tool, including its purpose, specifications, and operational characteristics.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Resource Tool Master

attributes.name: resource_tool_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production resource tool. Determines availability for scheduling and capacity planning. Available = ready for use; In Use = assigned to active work order; Maintenance = under repair; Calibration = undergoing calibration; Retired = no longer in service; Quarantine = blocked pending quality review.

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Current engineering revision level of the production resource tool design. Used to track Engineering Change Orders (ECO) and Engineering Change Notices (ECN).

attributes.name: safety_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current safety certification. Tool may be blocked from use if this date is exceeded.
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: safety_certification_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the current safety certification or inspection certificate. Used for regulatory compliance and audit trails.
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: safety_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production resource tool requires safety certification or inspection per Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) or other regulatory requirements. True = certification required; False = no certification needed.
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific production resource tool instance. Used for asset tracking and warranty management.

attributes.name: technical_specification
attributes.description: Detailed technical specifications of the production resource tool, including dimensions, tolerances, materials, and performance characteristics. Used for engineering and quality control.

attributes.name: usage_quantity_per_operation
attributes.description: Standard quantity of this production resource tool required per routing operation. Used for tool availability checks during scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: usage_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the usage quantity (e.g., EA for each, SET for set, HR for hour). Aligns with ISO standard UOM codes.

products.name: run
products.description: Production run entity representing a continuous execution campaign on a production line or work center, potentially spanning multiple work orders for the same or similar products. Captures run number, production line, start timestamp, end timestamp, total planned quantity, total actual quantity, total scrap quantity, overall yield rate, number of work orders included, and run status (active, completed, cancelled). Sourced from Siemens Opcenter MES campaign/run management. Enables campaign-level performance analysis beyond individual work orders.

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Primary key for run

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials used for this production run, defining the component structure and recipe.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for whom this production run is being executed, applicable for make-to-order scenarios.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary equipment or machine asset assigned to execute this production run.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary material or product being manufactured in this production run.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Run‑level reporting and profitability analysis need a direct reference to the originating sales order.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: FK to production.production_line

attributes.name: sales_order_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_intake. Business justification: Run scheduling dashboards rely on the originating sales order intake to allocate runs; the FK replaces the redundant sales_order_number field.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: FK to production.shift

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Each production run must reference the SKU to calculate yield, OEE, and cost per product.

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Run supervision links a supervisor employee to each production run for accountability in Run Efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Production runs need supplier reference to calculate cost, quality impact, and compliance per material batch.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or storage location where finished goods from this run are received.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost incurred for this production run, including material, labor, and overhead costs.

attributes.name: actual_finish_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the production run execution was completed or terminated.

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: Total actual quantity produced during this run, representing the sum of good output across all work orders.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the production run execution began on the shop floor.

attributes.name: availability_percentage
attributes.description: Equipment availability during the production run, calculated as (operating time / planned production time) * 100.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number assigned to the output of this production run for traceability and quality tracking purposes.

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Campaign or project code associated with this production run, used for grouping related runs for reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this production run record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all cost and financial values in this production run.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this production run record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the production run, capturing operational observations, issues, or special instructions.

attributes.name: oee_percentage
attributes.description: Overall Equipment Effectiveness metric for this production run, calculated as availability * performance * quality, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: performance_percentage
attributes.description: Equipment performance efficiency during the production run, calculated as (actual output / target output) * 100.

attributes.name: planned_finish_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the production run is planned to complete execution.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Total planned production quantity for this run across all included work orders.

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the production run is planned to begin execution.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this production run for scheduling and resource allocation purposes.

attributes.name: quality_percentage
attributes.description: Quality rate during the production run, calculated as (good units / total units produced) * 100.

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material sent for rework or reprocessing during this production run.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the production routing or process sequence followed during this run, defining the operations and work centers.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the production run campaign, externally visible and used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production run indicating its operational state.
attributes.references: Siemens Opcenter MES Shop Floor Control

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production run indicating the purpose or nature of the execution (standard production, pilot run, rework campaign, validation run, trial batch, or extended campaign).

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of scrap or rejected material generated during this production run.

attributes.name: scrap_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Overall scrap rate for the production run, calculated as (scrap quantity / (actual quantity + scrap quantity)) * 100.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit for this production run based on the costing model and BOM.

attributes.name: takt_time_minutes
attributes.description: Target production rate or takt time for this run, representing the available production time divided by customer demand, measured in minutes per unit.

attributes.name: throughput_rate
attributes.description: Average throughput rate achieved during the production run, measured as units produced per hour.

attributes.name: total_cycle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total cycle time for the production run, representing the sum of all processing time across all operations, measured in minutes.

attributes.name: total_downtime_minutes
attributes.description: Total unplanned downtime during the production run, measured in minutes.

attributes.name: total_setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total setup and changeover time for the production run, measured in minutes.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields in this production run (e.g., EA, KG, L, M).

attributes.name: work_order_count
attributes.description: Number of individual work orders included or consolidated within this production run campaign.

attributes.name: yield_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Overall yield rate for the production run, calculated as (actual quantity / (actual quantity + scrap quantity)) * 100.

products.name: production_line
products.description: Production line master entity representing a named, configured manufacturing line within a plant, composed of an ordered set of work centers and machines. Captures line code, line name, plant, line type (assembly, machining, fabrication, painting, testing), design throughput rate (units/hour), takt time target, number of stations, automation level (manual, semi-automated, fully automated), and current operational status. The SSOT for production line configuration used in scheduling, OEE reporting, and capacity planning.
products.reference: SAP PP Production Line / MES Line Master

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production line. Primary key for the production line master entity.

attributes.name: control_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.control_system. Business justification: Line configuration & maintenance uses a specific control system; OEE and maintenance reports require linking line to its control system.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Production line overhead is budgeted and reported per cost center; the link supports line‑level cost reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee responsible for supervising operations on this production line.

attributes.name: historian_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.historian_config. Business justification: Performance analytics and historical data retrieval require linking each line to its historian configuration.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Needed to associate each production line with its plant location for capacity planning and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that last modified this production line master record.
attributes.references: Data Governance Audit Trail, Access Control

attributes.name: network_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.network_segment. Business justification: Cybersecurity compliance and network topology reports need to know which network segment each line resides in.

attributes.name: work_center_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center group that this production line belongs to for capacity planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: actual_oee_percentage
attributes.description: Most recent calculated Overall Equipment Effectiveness percentage for this production line based on actual performance data.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation implemented on the production line, ranging from manual operations to fully automated lights-out manufacturing.
attributes.references: IEC 62443 Industrial Automation and Control Systems Security

attributes.name: capacity_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production line is identified as a bottleneck or capacity constraint in the manufacturing process requiring special attention in scheduling.
attributes.references: Theory of Constraints, Advanced Planning and Scheduling (APS)

attributes.name: changeover_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time from last good piece of previous run to first good piece of new run, including setup and stabilization time.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the production line was first commissioned and put into operational service.
attributes.references: Asset Lifecycle Management, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production line master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_time_seconds
attributes.description: Actual average time required to complete one production cycle on this line. Used to compare against takt time for performance analysis.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this production line master data originated or is synchronized.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM Master Data Management, Data Lineage

attributes.name: design_throughput_rate
attributes.description: Theoretical maximum production rate of the line measured in units per hour under ideal conditions. Used for capacity planning and OEE calculations.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh_per_unit
attributes.description: Average energy consumption in kilowatt-hours required to produce one unit of output on this production line. Used for energy management and cost analysis.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production line is subject to environmental compliance monitoring and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, EPA Environmental Protection Agency

attributes.name: erp_work_center_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) Work Center Code
attributes.description: Corresponding work center code in the ERP system for integration with production planning and costing modules.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Planning Work Center

attributes.name: last_major_upgrade_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major upgrade or modernization performed on the production line equipment or control systems.
attributes.references: Asset Lifecycle Management, CapEx Capital Expenditure Tracking

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production line master record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: layout_diagram_url
attributes.description: Reference URL or document path to the physical layout diagram or CAD drawing of the production line configuration.
attributes.references: CAD Computer-Aided Design, PLM Product Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: line_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the production line used across MES and ERP systems. Externally-known identifier for scheduling, capacity planning, and shop floor control.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Planning, Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: line_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the production line for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production line based on its primary manufacturing function. Determines the type of operations performed on this line.

attributes.name: mes_line_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this production line in the Manufacturing Execution System used for shop floor control and production tracking.

attributes.name: mtbf_hours
attributes.description: Average time between equipment failures on this production line, used for reliability analysis and preventive maintenance planning.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability and Maintenance Data, TPM Total Productive Maintenance

attributes.name: mttr_hours
attributes.description: Average time required to repair and restore this production line to operational status after a failure event.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability and Maintenance Data, TPM Total Productive Maintenance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or operational considerations specific to this production line.

attributes.name: number_of_stations
attributes.description: Total count of work stations or process steps configured on this production line. Defines the line configuration and complexity.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the production line indicating availability for production scheduling and capacity planning.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 Key Performance Indicators for Manufacturing Operations Management

attributes.name: planned_availability_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Total hours per day that the production line is scheduled to be available for production, excluding planned maintenance windows.

attributes.name: planned_decommission_date
attributes.description: Planned date for decommissioning or retirement of this production line from active service.
attributes.references: Asset Lifecycle Management, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether output from this production line requires mandatory quality inspection before release to inventory.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, SAP QM Quality Management

attributes.name: safety_certification_required
attributes.description: List of safety certifications or compliance requirements applicable to this production line based on the products manufactured and jurisdictional regulations.
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health, ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, CE Marking

attributes.name: scada_system_tag
attributes.business_glossary_term: SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) System Tag
attributes.description: Unique tag identifier in the SCADA system used to monitor and control this production line in real-time.
attributes.references: Aveva SCADA Process Control, IEC 61131 PLC Programming

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average time required to change over the production line from one product or batch to another, including tooling changes and adjustments.
attributes.references: SMED Single-Minute Exchange of Die, ISO 22400

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Operating shift pattern configured for this production line defining daily operational hours and crew rotation.

attributes.name: standard_operating_procedure_url
attributes.description: Reference URL or document path to the standard operating procedures governing operation of this production line.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, Document Management

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Target time interval between completion of successive units, calculated as available production time divided by customer demand. Critical metric for lean manufacturing and production scheduling.

attributes.name: target_oee_percentage
attributes.description: Target Overall Equipment Effectiveness percentage for this production line, representing the goal for availability, performance, and quality combined.

attributes.name: throughput_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the throughput rate indicating how production output is quantified for this line.

products.name: work_order_allocation
products.description: Represents the allocation of production work orders to sales order lines. Each record links one production_work_order to one order_line and captures allocation-specific data such as quantity, status, and timestamps.. Existence Justification: A production work order can be allocated to multiple order lines, and a single order line can be fulfilled by multiple work orders when production is split across runs. Planners actively create, update, and delete allocation records that capture allocated quantity, status, and timestamps, making the allocation a managed business entity.

attributes.name: work_order_allocation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work Order Allocation - Work Order Allocation Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the work_order_allocation association

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work Order Allocation - Order Line Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the order line

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work Order Allocation - Production Work Order Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the production work order

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the order line that this work order is allocated to produce

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the allocation (e.g., Pending, Confirmed, Completed)

attributes.name: allocation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the allocation was created or last updated

products.name: work_center_group
products.description: Master reference table for work_center_group. Referenced by work_center_group_id.

attributes.name: work_center_group_id
attributes.description: Primary key for work_center_group

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical location or plant where the group operates.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.plant. Business justification: Work center groups are defined within a plant; linking to plant provides hierarchy and enables plant‑level reporting.

attributes.name: capacity_per_hour
attributes.description: Maximum production capacity of the group expressed in units per hour.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center associated with the group.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the group record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: default_shift_length_minutes
attributes.description: Typical length of a shift for the group in minutes.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the work center group becomes operational.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the work center group is retired or no longer valid (nullable).

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: External code or tag used to identify the group across systems.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the work center group.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Category that defines the primary purpose of the group (e.g., production, maintenance).

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group is the default selection for new work orders.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the group manager.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the manager responsible for the group.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the group manager.
