attributes.description: Number of stakeholders who have formally acknowledged receipt and understanding of this ECN. Used to track distribution completion.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether recipients must formally acknowledge receipt and understanding of this ECN. True = acknowledgement tracking enabled; False = informational only.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_target_count
attributes.description: Total number of stakeholders required to acknowledge this ECN before it can be marked as fully distributed.

attributes.name: affected_drawing_count
attributes.description: Total number of engineering drawings, Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models, or technical documents affected by this ECN.

attributes.name: affected_part_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct part numbers or Bill of Materials (BOM) items affected by this ECN.

attributes.name: affected_product_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or narrative of product lines, families, or platforms impacted by this ECN. Used for scoping and impact analysis.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the ECN was formally approved for release by the designated approver or change control board.

attributes.name: bom_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ECN requires changes to one or more Bill of Materials (BOM) structures. True = BOM changes required; False = no BOM impact.

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Primary category of the engineering change. Design = product design modification; Material = material substitution; Process = manufacturing process change; Documentation = drawing/spec update; Specification = requirement change; Supplier = vendor change.

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the engineering change being communicated, including technical modifications, affected components, and implementation instructions.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification and rationale for the engineering change, including root cause, customer requirements, regulatory compliance, or quality improvement drivers.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the ECN was closed after successful implementation and acknowledgement by all required stakeholders.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, instructions, or clarifications related to the ECN implementation, distribution, or acknowledgement process.

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost impact estimate (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: cost_impact_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total cost impact of implementing this ECN, including material, labor, tooling, and inventory disposition costs. Positive values indicate cost increase; negative values indicate cost savings.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ECN record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers must be notified of this ECN due to form, fit, function, or regulatory changes. True = customer notification required; False = internal only.

attributes.name: distribution_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured text of roles, departments, or individuals who must receive and acknowledge this ECN (e.g., Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering).

attributes.name: ecn_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the engineering change notice, typically formatted as ECN-NNNNNN. Used for external communication and tracking across systems.

attributes.name: ecn_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ECN. Draft = being prepared; Released = approved for distribution; Distributed = sent to stakeholders; Acknowledged = recipients confirmed receipt; Closed = implementation complete; Cancelled = voided.

attributes.name: ecn_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ECN based on urgency and scope. Standard = normal process; Urgent = expedited review; Emergency = immediate action required; Field Change = affects deployed products; Design Improvement = enhancement.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the engineering change becomes effective and must be implemented in production, procurement, and quality systems.

attributes.name: erp_sync_status
attributes.description: Status of synchronization of this ECN to downstream Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (SAP S/4HANA). Pending = awaiting sync; Synced = successfully transmitted; Failed = sync error; Not Required = no ERP impact.

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the engineering change was fully implemented across all affected systems and processes.

attributes.name: inventory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ECN affects existing inventory, requiring disposition decisions (scrap, rework, use-as-is). True = inventory action required; False = no inventory impact.

attributes.name: mes_sync_status
attributes.description: Status of synchronization of this ECN to Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for shop floor implementation. Pending = awaiting sync; Synced = successfully transmitted; Failed = sync error; Not Required = no MES impact.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ECN record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: plm_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this ECN in the source Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system (Siemens Teamcenter). Used for system integration and traceability.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level for implementation of the ECN. Critical = safety/regulatory; High = customer impact; Medium = quality improvement; Low = documentation only.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ECN affects regulatory compliance, certifications, or safety approvals (UL, CE, ISO). True = regulatory review required; False = no regulatory impact.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when the ECN was officially released and approved for distribution to affected stakeholders.

attributes.name: revision_from
attributes.description: The previous revision level of the affected item(s) before this ECN takes effect. Used to track revision transitions.

attributes.name: revision_to
attributes.description: The new revision level of the affected item(s) after this ECN is implemented. Represents the target state.

attributes.name: routing_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ECN requires changes to manufacturing routings or process plans. True = routing changes required; False = no routing impact.

attributes.name: supplier_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether external suppliers must be notified of this ECN due to purchased part changes or specification updates. True = supplier notification required; False = internal only.

products.name: engineering_revision
products.description: Revision history record for a component or assembly, capturing each discrete revision state managed in PLM. Tracks revision label (A, B, C or 01, 02), lifecycle state (in-work, released, obsolete), release date, superseded revision, release authority, change justification summary, linked ECO, and effectivity window. Provides full revision lineage for traceability, regulatory compliance, configuration audits, and as-designed vs as-built reconciliation. Supports multi-level revision schemes (major/minor) and parallel branch revisions for variant management.

attributes.name: engineering_revision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the revision record. Primary key for the revision entity.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Reference to the component or assembly that this revision applies to. Links to the master component record in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Customer‑specific revisions (e.g., custom part revisions) are tracked per customer_account for change management.

attributes.name: ecn_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) that communicates this revision to stakeholders. Links the revision to the change notification process.

attributes.name: eco_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Order (ECO) that authorized and governs this revision. Links the revision to the formal change management process.

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_revision_engineering_revision_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer revision that supersedes this revision. Establishes the revision lineage chain for traceability and configuration management. Null if this is the current active revision.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Component revisions are often triggered by updates to regulatory requirements; the FK records the governing regulation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this revision was formally approved by the release authority. Distinct from release date, represents the approval event in the workflow.

attributes.name: cad_file_reference
attributes.description: Reference path or identifier to the Computer-Aided Design (CAD) model file associated with this revision in the Product Data Management (PDM) or PLM system.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM - Document Management, ISO 16792 Digital Product Definition

attributes.name: ce_marking_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether CE marking (European Conformity) is required for this revision. True indicates CE marking is mandatory for European market release.

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Classification of the reason for the revision change. Categorizes the business driver behind the Engineering Change Order (ECO). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: design_improvement|cost_reduction|quality_issue|regulatory_compliance|customer_request|obsolescence|manufacturing_improvement|safety_enhancement — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_impact_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the impact magnitude of this revision on form, fit, function, quality, cost, or schedule. Critical indicates significant impact requiring extensive validation, low indicates minimal impact.
attributes.references: APQP - Change Management, FMEA Failure Mode and Effects Analysis

attributes.name: change_justification
attributes.description: Business justification and summary description of why this revision was created. Captures the rationale for the design change, improvement, or correction.

attributes.name: configuration_baseline
attributes.description: The configuration baseline identifier that this revision belongs to. Used for configuration management and as-designed vs as-built reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 10007 - Configuration Management, MIL-STD-973 Configuration Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this revision record was first created in the PLM system. Provides audit trail for record creation event.

attributes.name: dfm_analysis_completed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether Design for Manufacturability (DFM) analysis has been completed for this revision. True indicates DFM review is complete and findings are incorporated.
attributes.references: APQP - Design for Manufacturability, Lean Manufacturing Principles

attributes.name: dfmea_completed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) Completed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) has been completed for this revision. True indicates DFMEA is complete and risk mitigation actions are defined.

attributes.name: drawing_number
attributes.description: The engineering drawing number associated with this revision. Links the revision to the formal technical drawing documentation.
attributes.references: ASME Y14.35M - Revision of Engineering Drawings, ISO 5457 Technical Product Documentation

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this revision ceases to be effective and is superseded or obsoleted. Defines the end of the effectivity window. Null indicates the revision is currently effective with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this revision becomes effective for manufacturing, procurement, and engineering activities. Defines the beginning of the effectivity window.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Configuration Management, APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) or similar export control designation for this revision. Used to determine export licensing requirements and trade compliance.
attributes.references: US Export Administration Regulations (EAR), International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)

attributes.name: interchangeability_code
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision is interchangeable with previous revisions. Fully interchangeable means drop-in replacement, form-fit-function means functionally equivalent, retrofit required means modification needed, not interchangeable means incompatible.
attributes.references: ASME Y14.35M - Revision of Engineering Drawings, MIL-STD-31000 Technical Data Packages

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The human-readable revision identifier following organizational revision scheme (e.g., A, B, C or 01, 02, 03). Represents the discrete revision state of the component.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Document and Data Control, ASME Y14.35M Revision of Engineering Drawings

attributes.name: lifecycle_state
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revision within the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) workflow. In-work indicates active development, in-review indicates pending approval, approved indicates ready for release, released indicates production-ready, obsolete indicates no longer valid, superseded indicates replaced by newer revision, frozen indicates locked for reference. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_work|in_review|approved|released|obsolete|superseded|frozen — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Document Control, Siemens Teamcenter PLM - Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: mass_production_approved
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this revision has been approved for mass production. True indicates all validation activities are complete and production release is authorized.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this revision record. Provides audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this revision record was last modified. Provides audit trail for the most recent update event.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or detailed description of changes made in this revision. Provides supplementary context beyond the change justification summary.

attributes.name: pfmea_completed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) Completed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) has been completed for this revision. True indicates PFMEA is complete and process controls are established.

attributes.name: ppap_level
attributes.description: The PPAP submission level required for this revision (1-5). Level 1 is warrant only, Level 5 is full submission with samples. Null if PPAP is not required.

attributes.name: ppap_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submission is required for this revision. True indicates customer or regulatory requirement for PPAP documentation.
attributes.references: AIAG PPAP-4 - Production Part Approval Process

attributes.name: prototype_test_date
attributes.description: The date when prototype testing was completed for this revision. Null if prototype testing has not been performed.

attributes.name: prototype_tested
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a physical prototype of this revision has been built and tested. True indicates prototype validation is complete.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this revision complies with REACH regulation for chemical substances. True indicates compliance with EU chemical safety requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory compliance assessment for this revision. Indicates whether the revision meets applicable regulatory requirements (ISO, IEC, UL, CE, OSHA, EPA).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Compliance Obligations, IEC 61131, UL Certification, CE Marking

attributes.name: release_authority
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, role, or committee that authorized the release of this revision. Captures the approval authority for traceability and compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Document Control, 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: release_authority_role
attributes.description: The organizational role or title of the release authority (e.g., Chief Engineer, Engineering Manager, Change Control Board). Provides context for the approval level.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date when this revision was officially released for production use. Represents the business event timestamp when the revision transitioned to released state.

attributes.name: revision_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revision indicating the magnitude of change. Major revisions represent significant design changes, minor revisions represent incremental improvements, patch revisions represent corrections, branch revisions represent parallel variant development, and prototype revisions represent pre-release experimental versions.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this revision complies with Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) directive. True indicates the design meets RoHS material restrictions.

attributes.name: specification_document
attributes.description: Reference to the technical specification document that defines the requirements and characteristics for this revision.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Document Control, Siemens Teamcenter PLM - Document Management

attributes.name: ul_certification_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether Underwriters Laboratories (UL) product safety certification is required for this revision. True indicates UL certification is mandatory for market release.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or engineer who created this revision record in the PLM system. Provides audit trail for record creation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Document Control, 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

products.name: dfmea
products.description: Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis record per AIAG/VDA FMEA methodology. Captures DFMEA number, scope (system, subsystem, component), failure mode, failure effect, failure cause, current design controls (prevention and detection), severity/occurrence/detection ratings, RPN, Action Priority (AP) per VDA method, recommended corrective/preventive actions with responsible engineer, target/completion dates, action status, evidence references, and revised ratings after action closure. Supports APQP deliverables, PPAP evidence packages, and continuous improvement tracking within the design engineering workflow.
products.reference: DFMEA / Design FMEA (AIAG VDA FMEA Handbook)

attributes.name: dfmea_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DFMEA record. Primary key for the DFMEA analysis document.

attributes.name: apqp_project_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) Project ID
attributes.description: Reference to the parent APQP project under which this DFMEA is conducted. Links to APQP project master.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: A DFMEA evaluates a specific component's failure modes; the FK provides direct association for risk analysis reports and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: DFMEA analysis costs are tracked against cost centers to monitor quality improvement spending.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: DFMEA analyses requested by a customer require linking to the customer_account to tie risk assessments to that customer.

attributes.name: dfmea_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality manager or engineering director who approved the DFMEA. Links to employee master. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: dfmea_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design engineer or engineering manager responsible for implementing the recommended action. Links to employee/workforce master.

attributes.name: dfmea_team_lead_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the engineer or quality professional leading the DFMEA team. Responsible for facilitating the analysis and ensuring completeness. Links to employee master.

attributes.name: ppap_submission_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Submission ID
attributes.description: Reference to the PPAP submission package that includes this DFMEA as a required deliverable. Links to PPAP submission master.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: DFMEA analyses are required for safety‑related regulations; linking records the applicable regulation.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or component being analyzed in this DFMEA. Links to the product master in PLM system.

attributes.name: action_priority
attributes.description: Action Priority classification per VDA FMEA methodology. Determined by severity and occurrence/detection combination using the AP matrix. High = immediate action required, Medium = action should be taken, Low = action may be considered.

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the recommended action in its lifecycle. Open = not started, In Progress = work underway, Completed = action finished, Verified = effectiveness confirmed, Cancelled = action no longer required.

attributes.name: action_taken
attributes.description: Detailed description of the actual corrective or preventive action that was implemented. Documents what was done to address the failure mode.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the recommended action was completed and verified. Null if action is still open or in progress.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: Date when the DFMEA analysis was originally conducted or last updated. Represents the business event timestamp for the analysis session.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the DFMEA document was formally approved by the quality or engineering authority. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DFMEA record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: current_detection_controls
attributes.description: Design verification and validation controls currently in place to detect the failure mode or cause before release (e.g., design reviews, prototype testing, Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) analysis, Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP&R)).

attributes.name: current_prevention_controls
attributes.description: Design controls currently in place to prevent the failure cause from occurring (e.g., design rules, standards, simulations, Design for Manufacturability (DFM) guidelines, redundancy).

attributes.name: customer_requirement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to specific customer requirements, specifications, or standards that drive this DFMEA analysis (e.g., customer FMEA requirements, industry standards, regulatory requirements).

attributes.name: design_phase
attributes.description: The phase of the product design lifecycle when this DFMEA was conducted. Concept = early ideation, Preliminary = initial design, Detailed = final design, Validation = testing phase, Production = manufacturing release.

attributes.name: detection_rating
attributes.description: Numerical rating (1-10) representing the likelihood that current design controls will detect the failure cause or mode before release to production. 10 = almost certain not to detect, 1 = almost certain to detect. Based on AIAG-VDA detection criteria.

attributes.name: dfmea_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) Number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the DFMEA document. Human-readable unique number assigned per organizational numbering convention.

attributes.name: dfmea_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DFMEA document. Draft = under development, In Review = undergoing team review, Approved = formally approved, Active = in use, Superseded = replaced by newer revision, Obsolete = no longer applicable.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Order that triggered this DFMEA update or that resulted from DFMEA findings. Links to ECO master in PLM system.

attributes.name: evidence_reference
attributes.description: Reference to supporting evidence, documentation, or test results that validate the action effectiveness (e.g., test report number, Engineering Change Order (ECO) number, validation protocol ID). Used for Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) evidence packages.

attributes.name: failure_cause
attributes.description: The root cause or mechanism that leads to the failure mode. Describes why the failure occurs (e.g., design deficiency, material weakness, tolerance stack-up).

attributes.name: failure_effect
attributes.description: The consequence or impact of the failure mode on the customer, end user, or downstream operations. Describes what the customer experiences.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: The manner in which the design item could potentially fail to meet the intended function. Describes how the failure manifests.

attributes.name: item_function
attributes.description: The intended function or purpose of the design item being analyzed. Describes what the item is supposed to do under normal operating conditions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DFMEA record was last updated in the system. Audit trail for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to this DFMEA entry. Captures team discussion points, assumptions, or contextual information.

attributes.name: occurrence_rating
attributes.description: Numerical rating (1-10) representing the likelihood that the failure cause will occur during the design life. 10 = very high probability, 1 = remote probability. Based on AIAG-VDA occurrence criteria.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Detailed description of the recommended corrective or preventive action to reduce severity, occurrence, or improve detection. May include design changes, additional testing, or enhanced controls.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this failure mode could result in non-compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., UL, CE, OSHA, EPA). True = regulatory impact.

attributes.name: revised_action_priority
attributes.description: Recalculated Action Priority per VDA methodology after action implementation. Should show improvement (e.g., High to Medium). Null if action not yet completed.

attributes.name: revised_detection_rating
attributes.description: Updated detection rating (1-10) after corrective action implementation. Should decrease (improve) if detection controls were enhanced. Null if action not yet completed.

attributes.name: revised_occurrence_rating
attributes.description: Updated occurrence rating (1-10) after corrective action implementation. Should decrease if prevention controls were improved. Null if action not yet completed.

attributes.name: revised_rpn
attributes.description: Recalculated Risk Priority Number after action implementation: Revised S × Revised O × Revised D. Used to measure risk reduction effectiveness. Null if action not yet completed.

attributes.name: revised_severity_rating
attributes.description: Updated severity rating (1-10) after corrective action implementation. Typically severity does not change unless design function is modified. Null if action not yet completed.

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Revision level or version of the DFMEA document. Incremented when significant changes are made to the analysis (e.g., A, B, C or 1.0, 2.0).

attributes.name: rpn
attributes.description: Risk Priority Number calculated as Severity × Occurrence × Detection (S × O × D). Used in traditional AIAG FMEA methodology to prioritize risks. Range: 1-1000.

attributes.name: safety_related_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this failure mode has safety implications for the end user or operator. True = safety-related failure mode.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the design scope being analyzed, including boundaries, assumptions, and exclusions.

attributes.name: scope_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level at which the DFMEA analysis is performed: system (top-level product), subsystem (major assembly), component (individual part), or interface (interaction between elements).

attributes.name: severity_rating
attributes.description: Numerical rating (1-10) representing the seriousness of the failure effect on the customer. 10 = hazardous without warning, 1 = no effect. Based on AIAG-VDA severity criteria.

attributes.name: special_characteristics_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this failure mode relates to a special characteristic (critical or significant product/process characteristic requiring additional controls). True = special characteristic involved.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the recommended action should be completed. Used for tracking and accountability in APQP timeline.

products.name: dfm_analysis
products.description: Design for Manufacturability analysis record evaluating a component or assembly design against manufacturing process constraints. Captures DFM analysis number, reviewed component revision, manufacturing process scope (machining, casting, stamping, PCB assembly), identified DFM issues, severity classification, recommended design modifications, estimated cost impact of non-conformance, analyst, review date, and disposition status. Feeds back into ECO initiation when design changes are required.
products.reference: DFM Analysis / Design for Manufacturability Review

attributes.name: dfm_analysis_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DFM analysis record. Primary key.

attributes.name: dfmea_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Related Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) ID
attributes.description: Reference to a related DFMEA record if the DFM analysis is linked to a design failure mode assessment.
attributes.references: DFMEA Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing engineer or DFM analyst who performed the analysis.

attributes.name: engineering_revision_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific component or assembly design revision being evaluated for manufacturability.

attributes.name: related_pfmea_fmea_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Related Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) ID
attributes.description: Reference to a related PFMEA record if the DFM analysis is linked to a process failure mode assessment.
attributes.references: PFMEA Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: DFM FEEDBACK: Supplier feedback on manufacturability is captured to drive design iteration decisions.

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the DFM issue was resolved or closed.

attributes.name: affected_feature
attributes.description: Specific design feature, dimension, tolerance, or characteristic that is causing the manufacturability concern.

attributes.name: alternative_solution
attributes.description: Alternative approaches or workarounds if the recommended design modification is not feasible (e.g., process change, tooling investment, supplier change).

attributes.name: analysis_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the DFM analysis, typically following organizational numbering convention (e.g., DFM-000012345).

attributes.name: analysis_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DFM analysis trigger or purpose (e.g., initial design review, design change review, cost reduction review).

attributes.name: analyst_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturing engineer or DFM analyst who conducted the review.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the DFM analysis disposition or recommended action was formally approved.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether formal approval is required before implementing the recommended design modification.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved the DFM analysis disposition or recommended action.

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost impact (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DFM analysis record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dfm_issue_detail
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific manufacturability issues, constraints, or risks identified during the analysis.

attributes.name: dfm_issue_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the identified DFM issues or concerns with the current design.

attributes.name: disposition_rationale
attributes.description: Justification or reasoning for the disposition decision (e.g., why design change is required, why accepted as-is).

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current status of the DFM analysis: open (pending review), under_review (being evaluated), design_change_required (ECO initiated), accepted_as_is (no change needed), closed (resolved), cancelled (no longer applicable).

attributes.name: eco_initiated
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether an Engineering Change Order was initiated as a result of this DFM analysis.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the ECO initiated to address the DFM findings, if applicable.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_impact
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the DFM issue if not addressed, including increased manufacturing cost, scrap, rework, or yield loss.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_savings
attributes.description: Projected cost savings if the recommended design modification is implemented.

attributes.name: impact_on_lead_time
attributes.description: Assessment of how the DFM issue or recommended change affects manufacturing lead time.

attributes.name: impact_on_quality
attributes.description: Assessment of how the DFM issue or recommended change affects product quality and conformance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DFM analysis record was last updated.

attributes.name: manufacturing_process_scope
attributes.description: Primary manufacturing process or processes being evaluated in this DFM analysis (e.g., machining, casting, stamping, PCB assembly). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: machining|casting|stamping|forging|injection_molding|pcb_assembly|sheet_metal_fabrication|welding|additive_manufacturing|assembly|multi_process — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: manufacturing_site
attributes.description: Manufacturing facility or site where the component will be produced, relevant to the DFM analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to the DFM analysis.

attributes.name: part_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the component or assembly being analyzed.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The part number of the component or assembly under DFM review.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the DFM analysis for resolution: urgent (immediate action), high (near-term action), medium (planned action), low (monitor).

attributes.name: process_constraint
attributes.description: Description of the manufacturing process constraint or limitation that the design violates or challenges (e.g., tool access, tolerance capability, material flow).

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Product line or family to which the component belongs (e.g., automation systems, electrification solutions).

attributes.name: recommended_design_modification
attributes.description: Proposed design changes or modifications to resolve the DFM issue and improve manufacturability.

attributes.name: review_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DFM analysis was completed and documented.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the DFM analysis was performed.

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Design revision level of the component at the time of DFM analysis (e.g., A, B, C, Rev 01).

attributes.name: risk_priority_number
attributes.description: Calculated risk priority number based on severity, occurrence, and detection ratings (typical FMEA methodology applied to DFM).
attributes.references: FMEA Failure Mode and Effects Analysis

attributes.name: severity_classification
attributes.description: Severity level of the identified DFM issue: critical (cannot manufacture), major (significant cost/quality impact), moderate (manageable impact), minor (low impact), informational (observation only).
attributes.references: FMEA Failure Mode and Effects Analysis

attributes.name: supplier_feedback
attributes.description: Input or feedback from manufacturing suppliers or contract manufacturers regarding the design manufacturability.

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the DFM issue should be resolved or design change implemented.

attributes.name: tooling_requirement
attributes.description: Description of any special tooling, fixtures, or equipment required to manufacture the design as-is or with the recommended modification.

products.name: engineering_specification
products.description: Engineering specification document record defining technical requirements, performance criteria, material standards, and acceptance criteria for a component, assembly, or system. Captures specification number, revision, specification type (material, functional, interface, environmental, safety), applicable standards (IEC, ISO, UL, CE), scope description, approval status, and linked components. Serves as the authoritative technical requirements baseline for design validation and supplier qualification.

attributes.name: engineering_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the engineering specification document record. Primary key.

attributes.name: author_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Specification author is tracked for regulatory compliance and change‑traceability in the specification control process.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Specification applies to a component; adding component_id FK normalizes the relationship and removes the denormalized linked_component_ids list.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Customer‑specific specifications are maintained for contract compliance; linking to customer_account enables specification‑customer mapping.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Specifications are authored to meet particular regulatory standards; linking ties each spec to its governing requirement.

attributes.name: superseded_by_specification_engineering_specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specification that supersedes this specification. Null if this specification is still current. Supports specification revision history and traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control and Change Management

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: SPECIFICATION CONTROL: Supplier‑specific specifications are linked to the responsible supplier for qualification and audit reporting.

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Specific criteria and test methods used to determine whether a component or assembly meets the specification requirements. Defines pass/fail thresholds for inspection, testing, and validation activities.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, PPAP (Production Part Approval Process), APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning)

attributes.name: applicable_standards
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of industry, regulatory, and international standards that this specification must comply with (e.g., IEC 61131, ISO 9001, UL 508, CE Marking, ANSI standards). Critical for design validation, supplier qualification, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission), ISO (International Organization for Standardization), UL (Underwriters Laboratories), CE Marking, ANSI (American National Standards Institute)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the specification was formally approved and released for use. Key milestone in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) workflow.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the specification document: draft (initial creation), in_review (under engineering review), approved (released for use), obsolete (no longer valid), or superseded (replaced by newer revision or specification).

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized individual who approved the specification for release. Part of the document control and approval workflow.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason for the most recent change to the specification. Captures the business or technical justification for the revision, supporting change traceability and audit requirements.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level of the specification document: public (no restrictions), internal (internal use only), confidential (business-sensitive), or restricted (highly sensitive, limited access). Governs access control and distribution policies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the specification record was first created in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Records Management, Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: design_authority
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineering team, department, or individual responsible for the technical content and maintenance of this specification. Serves as the point of contact for specification-related questions and change requests.

attributes.name: dfm_analysis_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Design for Manufacturability (DFM) analysis has been completed for this specification. DFM analysis ensures that the design can be efficiently and cost-effectively manufactured.
attributes.references: DFM (Design for Manufacturability) Best Practices, APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning)

attributes.name: dfmea_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document link to the Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) associated with this specification. DFMEA identifies potential failure modes in the design and their effects on product performance and safety.
attributes.references: DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning)

attributes.name: document_format
attributes.description: File format of the specification document (e.g., PDF for released documents, DOCX for drafts, DWG for CAD drawings, STEP/IGES for 3D models, XML for structured data exchange).
attributes.references: ISO 10303 STEP Standard, ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: document_location
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference where the full specification document is stored. Typically points to a location in Siemens Teamcenter PLM Document Management or a shared engineering repository.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, Siemens Teamcenter PLM Document Management

attributes.name: ecn_number
attributes.description: Engineering Change Notice (ECN) number associated with the notification of the change to this specification. ECNs communicate approved changes to stakeholders and trigger updates to related documentation and systems.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Change Management, Siemens Teamcenter PLM Change Management

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Engineering Change Order (ECO) number associated with the most recent change to this specification. Links the specification to the formal change management process and provides traceability to the reason for the change.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Change Management, Siemens Teamcenter PLM Change Management

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the specification becomes effective and mandatory for use in design, procurement, and manufacturing activities. Aligns with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) release workflows.

attributes.name: environmental_conditions
attributes.description: Specified environmental operating conditions and limits, including temperature range, humidity, vibration, shock, altitude, and exposure to chemicals or contaminants. Critical for environmental-type specifications.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, IEC 60068 Environmental Testing

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code indicating the primary language of the specification document (e.g., ENG for English, DEU for German, FRA for French). Supports multi-language engineering documentation in global manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: material_standard
attributes.description: Specific material standard or grade required for the component or assembly (e.g., ASTM A36, SAE 304, ISO 898-1). Applicable primarily to material-type specifications.
attributes.references: ASTM International, SAE International, ISO Material Standards

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who last modified the specification record in the PLM system. Tracks responsibility for the most recent change.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the specification record was last modified in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. Tracks the most recent update to the record for audit and change tracking purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Records Management, Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or clarifications related to the specification. Captures supplementary information that does not fit into other structured fields.

attributes.name: obsolete_date
attributes.description: Date when the specification was marked as obsolete or superseded. Null if the specification is still active.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control and Records Management

attributes.name: performance_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed performance requirements and acceptance criteria that the component, assembly, or system must meet. Includes quantitative metrics such as load capacity, operating temperature range, voltage ratings, cycle life, and reliability targets.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 Requirements Engineering, IEC 61131 PLC Standards

attributes.name: pfmea_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document link to the Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) associated with this specification. PFMEA identifies potential failure modes in the manufacturing process and their effects on product quality.
attributes.references: PFMEA (Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning)

attributes.name: prototype_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a prototype must be built and validated before the specification is approved for production use. Supports the Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) workflows.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning), PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Current revision level of the specification document, typically alphanumeric (e.g., A, B, C, 01, 02). Incremented with each approved change through the Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Engineering Change Notice (ECN) process.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control and Change Management

attributes.name: safety_requirements
attributes.description: Safety-related requirements and compliance criteria, including electrical safety, mechanical safety, functional safety, and hazard mitigation measures. Applicable to safety-type specifications and critical for certification.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, IEC 62443 Industrial Cybersecurity, UL Safety Certification, CE Marking

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope, applicability, and boundaries of the specification. Defines what is covered and what is explicitly excluded from the specification requirements.

attributes.name: specification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the specification document, typically following organizational numbering conventions. Externally-known unique code used for reference in engineering documentation, supplier communications, and design reviews.

attributes.name: specification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specification document by its primary purpose: material (material properties and composition), functional (operational requirements), interface (connection and integration standards), environmental (operating conditions and environmental compliance), safety (safety requirements and certifications), or performance (performance criteria and benchmarks).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 Systems and Software Engineering Requirements

attributes.name: supplier_qualification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether suppliers must undergo formal qualification and approval before being authorized to supply components or materials meeting this specification. Supports supplier management and procurement processes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Supplier Management, PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: Standardized test method or procedure reference used to verify compliance with the specification (e.g., ASTM test methods, IEC test standards, internal test procedures). Links to quality inspection plans and validation protocols.
attributes.references: ASTM International, IEC Testing Standards, ISO 17025 Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the specification document that clearly identifies the component, assembly, or system being specified.

attributes.name: tolerance_specification
attributes.description: Dimensional, geometric, and functional tolerances specified for the component or assembly. Defines acceptable variation ranges for critical dimensions and characteristics, supporting Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Statistical Process Control (SPC).
attributes.references: ISO 286 Tolerances and Fits, ASME Y14.5 Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the design validation was completed. Null if validation is not yet complete. Key milestone in the product development lifecycle.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the design validation and verification activities for this specification: not_started (validation not yet initiated), in_progress (validation activities underway), completed (validation successfully completed), or failed (validation did not meet acceptance criteria).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Design Verification and Validation, APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning)

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who created the specification record in the PLM system. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

products.name: design_review
products.description: Formal design review event record capturing structured gate reviews conducted during the product development lifecycle (PDR, CDR, PRR, TRR). Tracks review type, review date, reviewed item/assembly, attendees, gate decision (pass, conditional pass, fail), gate criteria checklist results, linked APQP phase, and embedded action items (description, category, assignee, due date, status, resolution). Provides the audit trail required for ISO 9001 design and development verification and APQP phase gate closure.
products.reference: Design Review / PDR / CDR / PRR (ISO 9001 Clause 8.3.4)

attributes.name: design_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the design review event. Primary key for the design review record.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.3.4 Design and Development Controls

attributes.name: chairperson_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Design review chairperson is required for governance minutes and compliance sign‑off tracking.

attributes.name: control_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the control plan reviewed or approved during this design review. Links design review to quality control planning.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Design review effort costs are charged to cost centers for accurate project cost accounting.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Design reviews often include customer stakeholders; linking design_review to customer_account records participation and decisions.

attributes.name: dfmea_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) ID
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the DFMEA document reviewed or updated during this design review. Links design review to formal risk analysis.

attributes.name: fmea_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) ID
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the PFMEA document reviewed or updated during this design review. Links design review to process risk analysis.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Design Review governance requires linking each review to its governing project for compliance tracking and gate decision reporting.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent engineering project or APQP project under which this design review is conducted.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Design reviews verify compliance with regulatory requirements; the FK records which requirement is being reviewed.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: DESIGN REVIEW: Supplier participation is recorded to satisfy compliance and capture supplier‑driven design changes.

attributes.name: action_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of action items generated from the design review. Used for tracking review effectiveness and closure metrics.

attributes.name: action_items
attributes.description: Structured list of action items generated during the design review, typically stored as JSON or delimited text. Each action item includes description, category, assignee, due date, status, and resolution.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the design review was formally approved by management or designated authority. Represents gate closure date.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal management approval is required to close this design review gate. True=approval required, False=no approval required.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who provided formal approval for the design review gate closure. Typically a senior engineering manager or program manager.

attributes.name: apqp_phase
attributes.description: APQP phase to which this design review is linked. Phase 1=Plan and Define, Phase 2=Product Design and Development, Phase 3=Process Design and Development, Phase 4=Product and Process Validation, Phase 5=Launch Feedback and Corrective Action.

attributes.name: attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of individuals who attended the design review meeting. Used for quorum validation and meeting effectiveness metrics.

attributes.name: attendee_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or semicolon-separated list of attendee names who participated in the design review. Provides audit trail of review participants.

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: List of regulatory, safety, and industry compliance requirements evaluated during the design review (e.g., UL, CE, IEC 61131, ISO 9001). Stored as delimited text or JSON.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015, IEC Standards, UL Certification Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Overall compliance status of the design against applicable regulatory and industry requirements as assessed during the review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this design review record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5.3 Control of Documented Information

attributes.name: criteria_fail_count
attributes.description: Number of gate criteria that received a fail status during the review. Indicates areas requiring corrective action before gate closure.

attributes.name: criteria_na_count
attributes.description: Number of gate criteria marked as not applicable for this specific review. Used to adjust compliance calculations.

attributes.name: criteria_pass_count
attributes.description: Number of gate criteria that received a pass status during the review. Used to calculate gate compliance percentage.

attributes.name: design_maturity_level
attributes.description: Maturity level of the design at the time of review. Concept=early ideation, Preliminary=initial design, Detailed=fully specified, Final=pre-release, Released=production-ready.

attributes.name: design_validation_status
attributes.description: Status of design validation activities (customer/user testing) at the time of the design review. Indicates whether design meets intended use requirements.

attributes.name: design_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of design verification activities (testing, analysis, inspection) at the time of the design review. Indicates whether design meets specified requirements.

attributes.name: document_references
attributes.description: List of supporting documents reviewed during the design review (e.g., CAD drawings, specifications, test reports, FMEA documents). Stored as delimited text or JSON with document IDs and titles.

attributes.name: ecn_number
attributes.description: Engineering Change Notice number associated with this design review, if the review was triggered by or resulted in an ECN. Links design review to change notification process.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Engineering Change Order number associated with this design review, if the review was triggered by or resulted in an ECO. Links design review to change management process.

attributes.name: gate_criteria_checklist
attributes.description: Structured checklist of gate criteria evaluated during the review, typically stored as JSON or delimited text. Each criterion includes pass/fail/NA status and comments.

attributes.name: gate_decision
attributes.description: Final decision outcome of the design review gate. Pass=approved to proceed, Conditional Pass=approved with conditions/action items, Fail=not approved, Deferred=decision postponed pending additional information.

attributes.name: gate_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal gate decision was rendered. May differ from review_date if decision was deferred or required additional deliberation.

attributes.name: meeting_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the design review meeting in minutes. Used for resource planning and meeting effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: meeting_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the design review meeting was conducted (e.g., conference room, site name, or virtual meeting platform).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this design review record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5.3 Control of Documented Information

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next design review or follow-up review. Used for planning subsequent gate reviews in the product development lifecycle.

attributes.name: open_action_item_count
attributes.description: Number of action items from this design review that remain open/unresolved. Used to track gate closure readiness.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal design review meeting was conducted. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the review gate.

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the design review event, typically following organizational numbering convention (e.g., DR-2024-001234). Used for external reference and traceability.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the design review event. Tracks whether the review is scheduled, actively being conducted, completed, cancelled, or postponed.

attributes.name: review_summary
attributes.description: Executive summary of the design review outcomes, key findings, and recommendations. Provides high-level overview for stakeholders.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of design review gate conducted. PDR=Preliminary Design Review, CDR=Critical Design Review, PRR=Production Readiness Review, TRR=Test Readiness Review, FDR=Final Design Review, MDR=Manufacturing Design Review.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Phase Gate Process

attributes.name: reviewed_item_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the item, assembly, or product being reviewed. Provides human-readable context for the reviewed design.

attributes.name: reviewed_item_number
attributes.description: Part number, assembly number, or product identifier of the item/design being reviewed. Links to the engineering item under evaluation.

attributes.name: reviewed_item_revision
attributes.description: Revision level of the item/design being reviewed at the time of the design review (e.g., A, B, C, Rev 01). Ensures traceability to specific design iteration.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_summary
attributes.description: Summary of design risks identified during the review, including risk severity, mitigation plans, and residual risk levels. Links to DFMEA/PFMEA where applicable.
attributes.references: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) Reference Manual

products.name: engineering_project
products.description: Engineering project master record representing a discrete R&D or product development initiative. Captures project code, project name, project type (new product development, product improvement, platform, cost reduction), program phase (concept, development, validation, launch), target launch date, project manager, budget allocation, priority, and linked product family. Serves as the organizing entity for all engineering deliverables, prototypes, and design reviews within a development program.

attributes.name: engineering_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the engineering project record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Projects are budgeted to specific cost centers for expense tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: engineering_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary engineering facility or R&D center where the project work is being performed.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Each engineering project references a budget record for approved spending limits and forecasting.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Capital project expenditures are captured via internal orders for capex tracking and settlement.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business unit or division that owns and funds the engineering project.

attributes.name: primary_engineering_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee responsible for managing and delivering the engineering project.

attributes.name: product_family_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product family or platform that this engineering project is developing or enhancing.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Project revenue and profitability are reported to profit centers for segment performance reporting.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Required for Capital Project Integration Report linking engineering project to overall project schedule, enabling consolidated status and cost tracking across engineering and project management.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Projects are often launched to achieve compliance with a new or updated regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: Project Execution tracks the main stock location for on‑site inventory used by the engineering project.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Engineering projects track a lead supplier for budgeting, risk assessment, and contract governance.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse. Business justification: Project Planning assigns a primary warehouse for storing project‑specific materials and components.

attributes.name: actual_launch_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the engineering project completed and the product was launched to production or market.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved the engineering project for execution.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the engineering project was formally approved for execution.

attributes.name: budget_allocated_amount
attributes.description: Total budget amount allocated to the engineering project for all development activities and resources.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting) Project Budget

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the project budget amounts.

attributes.name: budget_spent_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of budget spent to date on the engineering project.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Strategic rationale and business case for undertaking the engineering project, including expected ROI and market drivers.
attributes.references: Project Management Institute (PMI) Business Case Standards

attributes.name: capex_opex_classification
attributes.description: Financial classification of the project budget as capital expenditure, operational expenditure, or a mix of both.

attributes.name: collaboration_partners
attributes.description: List of external partners, suppliers, or research institutions collaborating on the engineering project.

attributes.name: complexity_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (1-10) representing the technical and organizational complexity of the engineering project.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the engineering project record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: design_methodology
attributes.description: Engineering design and development methodology being applied to the project.

attributes.name: design_review_count
attributes.description: Number of formal design reviews conducted during the engineering project lifecycle.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Design Review Process

attributes.name: dfm_analysis_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Design for Manufacturability analysis has been completed for the engineering project.

attributes.name: dfmea_completed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) Completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis has been completed for the engineering project.
attributes.references: DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) Standards

attributes.name: eco_count
attributes.description: Total number of Engineering Change Orders issued during the engineering project.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the engineering project was officially closed or completed.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the engineering project record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the engineering project record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: patent_application_count
attributes.description: Number of patent applications filed as a result of innovations developed in the engineering project.

attributes.name: pfmea_completed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) Completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis has been completed for the engineering project.
attributes.references: PFMEA (Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) Standards

attributes.name: ppap_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Production Part Approval Process is required for the engineering project deliverables.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority ranking assigned to the engineering project for resource allocation and scheduling decisions.

attributes.name: program_phase
attributes.description: Current lifecycle phase of the engineering project within the product development process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|feasibility|design|development|validation|launch|production|closed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Phase Gate Process

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the engineering project for identification and tracking across systems.

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the engineering project objectives, scope, and deliverables.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the engineering project describing the initiative or product being developed.

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the engineering project indicating its execution state.

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engineering project based on its strategic purpose and scope.

attributes.name: prototype_count
attributes.description: Number of physical or digital prototypes developed as part of the engineering project.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_scope
attributes.description: List of regulatory standards and certifications that the engineering project must comply with (e.g., ISO 9001, CE, UL, IEC 61131).
attributes.references: ISO 9001, IEC Standards, CE Marking, UL Certification

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment level for the engineering project based on technical complexity, schedule, and resource constraints.

products.name: certification_requirement
products.description: Engineering certification and regulatory compliance requirement record defining the mandatory certifications, standards, and approvals a product or component must achieve before market release. Captures requirement code, applicable regulation or standard (CE, UL, IEC 61131, IEC 62443, RoHS, REACH), target market or region, certification body, required test type, estimated lead time, cost estimate, and current compliance status. Drives certification planning within engineering projects and links to prototype test activities.
products.reference: Product Certification Requirement / Regulatory Compliance Record

attributes.name: certification_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the certification requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific component requiring certification, if applicable at component level.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Certification activities incur costs that must be allocated to the responsible cost center for compliance budgeting.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Certification requirements may be driven by a specific customer’s market; linking captures customer‑driven compliance needs.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Certification requirements are derived directly from specific regulatory requirements; the FK captures that source.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or component that requires this certification.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Product Data Management

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: CERTIFICATION: The supplier responsible for meeting a certification requirement is linked for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: test_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prototype test activity linked to this certification requirement.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount

attributes.name: actual_start_date

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date

attributes.name: certificate_number

attributes.name: certification_body

attributes.name: certification_body_accreditation

attributes.name: certification_priority

attributes.name: certification_type

attributes.name: compliance_status

attributes.name: cost_currency_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: ecn_number

attributes.name: eco_number
