attributes.name: planned_maintenance_hours
attributes.description: Total hours consumed by scheduled preventive maintenance activities during the measurement period. Excluded from unplanned downtime but included in total non-productive time for OEE availability component calculation.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant code identifying the manufacturing facility where the asset is installed. Used for site-level reliability benchmarking and OEE rollup.

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this reliability record, formatted as RR-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used for cross-system referencing and audit traceability in Maximo and SAP PM.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this reliability record. 'draft' = under calculation; 'active' = current approved record; 'superseded' = replaced by a revised record; 'archived' = historical retention only.

attributes.name: reliability_tier
attributes.description: Criticality-based reliability tier assigned to the asset for this period. P1 = mission-critical (highest priority); P2 = production-critical; P3 = important; P4 = standard; P5 = non-critical. Drives maintenance strategy selection (predictive vs preventive vs run-to-failure) and spare parts stocking levels.
attributes.references: ISO 55001; ISO 14224; NIST SP 800-82; TPM Methodology

attributes.name: replacement_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reliability analysis for this period has triggered a capital replacement recommendation for the asset. True = replacement recommended based on Weibull end-of-life analysis or sustained P1 degradation trend. Feeds CapEx planning.
attributes.references: ISO 55001; IFRS/GAAP IAS 16; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: total_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative unplanned downtime hours for the asset during the measurement period, including all failure-induced stoppages. Used as the primary input for MTTR and availability calculations. Source: Maximo and Opcenter MES.

attributes.name: total_failures
attributes.description: Total count of confirmed failure events recorded for the asset during the measurement period. A failure is defined as any unplanned stoppage requiring corrective maintenance. Source: Maximo work order history.

attributes.name: total_scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the asset was scheduled for production during the measurement period, excluding planned shutdowns and holidays. Denominator for availability percentage calculation per SEMI E10 standard.
attributes.references: SEMI E10; ISO 14224; OEE Industry Standard

attributes.name: total_uptime_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative operating hours during which the asset was available and running during the measurement period. Used as the primary input for MTBF and availability calculations. Source: Maximo and Aveva SCADA.

attributes.name: trend_direction
attributes.description: Directional indicator of reliability performance trend compared to the prior measurement period. 'improving' = MTBF increasing / MTTR decreasing; 'stable' = within control limits; 'degrading' = MTBF declining; 'critical' = threshold breach requiring immediate action.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this reliability record (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, SCD Type 2 processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 55001; Informatica MDM; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: weibull_beta
attributes.description: Weibull distribution shape parameter (beta) fitted to the failure time data for this asset during the measurement period. Beta < 1 indicates infant mortality; beta = 1 indicates random failures; beta > 1 indicates wear-out. Used for predictive maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: IEC 60300-3-1; ISO 14224; MIL-HDBK-217; ReliaSoft Weibull++ Standard

attributes.name: weibull_eta
attributes.description: Weibull distribution scale parameter (eta), also known as the characteristic life, expressed in hours. Represents the time at which 63.2% of the asset population is expected to have failed. Used for replacement interval optimization.

attributes.name: weibull_gamma
attributes.description: Weibull distribution location parameter (gamma), representing the failure-free operating period in hours before the onset of failures. Nullable when a two-parameter Weibull model is applied (gamma = 0).

attributes.name: weibull_r_squared
attributes.description: Coefficient of determination (R²) for the Weibull distribution fit to the failure data. Values closer to 1.0 indicate a better fit. Used to validate the reliability model quality before using parameters for maintenance planning.

products.name: capex_asset_record
products.description: Capital expenditure asset register record tracking the financial lifecycle of capitalized equipment assets, including acquisition cost, capitalization date, asset class, depreciation method (straight-line, declining balance), useful life years, accumulated depreciation, net book value, disposal date, and disposal proceeds. Integrates with SAP FI-AA (Fixed Assets) module and supports CapEx vs OpEx classification for financial reporting.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Fixed Asset / IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant Equipment

attributes.name: capex_asset_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital expenditure asset record. Primary key for the asset register tracking capitalized equipment and infrastructure investments.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: CAPEX: Capital asset records need a cost‑center link for asset capitalization and depreciation tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or manager responsible for the asset. Used for asset custody tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased. Links to procurement and accounts payable systems.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master, Procurement Standards

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized to date since capitalization. Contra-asset account that reduces the gross book value to calculate net book value.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Accumulated Depreciation, GAAP Balance Sheet Presentation

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total original cost of acquiring the asset including purchase price, delivery, installation, and any costs necessary to bring the asset to working condition. Represents the capitalized value on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Initial Measurement, GAAP CapEx Accounting

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was acquired or purchased. Used as the starting point for asset lifecycle tracking and may differ from capitalization date.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment, GAAP

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the asset type for reporting and analysis. Broader classification than asset class code. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production_equipment|facility_infrastructure|transportation|computer_equipment|furniture_fixtures|land|buildings|leasehold_improvements — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: Classification code defining the type of capital asset (e.g., machinery, buildings, vehicles, computer equipment, production equipment). Determines depreciation rules and financial treatment per SAP asset class hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Class Configuration, IAS 16, IFRS

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the capital asset including make, model, specifications, and purpose. Used for asset identification and reporting.

attributes.name: asset_group_code
attributes.description: Grouping code for related assets that function together as a unit (e.g., production line, SCADA system). Used for impairment testing and cash-generating unit analysis.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Cash-Generating Units, ISO 55000 Asset Grouping

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the capitalized asset. Used across SAP FI-AA (Fixed Assets) module, maintenance systems, and financial reporting. Also known as asset tag or asset code.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master Data, ISO 55000

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capital asset. Determines whether depreciation is active and whether the asset appears in operational asset registers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|in_service|under_construction|retired|disposed|transferred|impaired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was placed in service and capitalized on the balance sheet. Depreciation begins from this date. Critical for financial reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: IAS 16, GAAP Fixed Asset Accounting, SAP FI-AA

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset acquisition cost met the company capitalization threshold policy. Assets below threshold are expensed as OpEx rather than capitalized as CapEx.
attributes.references: GAAP Capitalization Policy, CapEx vs OpEx Classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this asset record (acquisition cost, accumulated depreciation, net book value).

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to calculate periodic depreciation expense. Straight-line is most common for manufacturing equipment. Method is determined by asset class and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Depreciation, GAAP Depreciation Methods, SAP FI-AA Depreciation Key

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was disposed of, sold, scrapped, or retired from service. Marks the end of the asset lifecycle and triggers gain/loss calculation.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the asset was disposed. Determines accounting treatment and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Derecognition Methods, Asset Disposal Policy

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Amount received from the sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal (proceeds minus net book value at disposal).

attributes.name: impairment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the asset has been tested for impairment and an impairment loss has been recognized. True if impaired, false otherwise.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Impairment of Assets, GAAP Impairment Testing

attributes.name: impairment_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total impairment loss recognized when the recoverable amount of the asset falls below its carrying amount. Reduces net book value.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering this asset. Used for risk management and claims processing.

attributes.name: last_depreciation_date
attributes.description: Date when depreciation was last calculated and posted for this asset. Used to track depreciation run schedules and ensure accurate period-end financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Posting, GAAP Period-End Close

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this asset record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Data Governance Audit Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Detailed physical location of the asset within the plant or facility (e.g., building, floor, room, production line). Used for asset tracking and maintenance work order dispatch.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the equipment manufacturer or Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM). Used for warranty tracking, spare parts sourcing, and maintenance support.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or designation for the asset. Used for technical specifications, spare parts identification, and maintenance procedures.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the asset value on the balance sheet. Also known as carrying amount.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Carrying Amount, GAAP Net Book Value

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility where the asset is physically located. Used for asset tracking, maintenance planning, and site-level reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Plant Master Data, ISO 55000 Asset Location

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number under which the asset was procured. Provides audit trail to procurement documentation and invoice matching.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order, Procurement Audit Trail

attributes.name: revaluation_amount
attributes.description: Fair value amount determined at revaluation date. Difference between revalued amount and carrying amount is recognized in revaluation surplus or profit/loss.

attributes.name: revaluation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent asset revaluation if the revaluation model is used instead of the cost model. Applicable under IFRS when fair value can be reliably measured.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Revaluation Model, IFRS Fair Value

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Used in depreciation calculations to determine depreciable base (acquisition cost minus salvage value).

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer. Used for warranty claims, service history tracking, and asset identification.

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method used for tax reporting purposes. May differ from book depreciation method. MACRS is common in the US for tax purposes.
attributes.references: IRS MACRS Depreciation, Tax Accounting Standards

attributes.name: tax_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Useful life in years used for tax depreciation calculations. May differ from book useful life based on tax regulations.
attributes.references: IRS Asset Class Life, Tax Depreciation Tables

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful economic life of the asset in years over which depreciation will be calculated. Determined by asset class, industry standards, and regulatory guidelines.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Useful Life, MACRS Tax Depreciation Tables

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or vendor warranty expires. Used for maintenance planning and cost management decisions.

products.name: inspection_event
products.description: Formal equipment inspection event record capturing scheduled and ad-hoc inspections including safety inspections, regulatory compliance inspections (OSHA, UL, CE), and quality-related equipment audits. Stores inspection type, inspector identity, inspection date, checklist results, pass/fail outcome, findings count, corrective action required flag, and next inspection due date.
products.reference: Maximo Inspection / SAP QM Inspection Lot

attributes.name: inspection_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the inspection event record in the asset management domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: asset_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Maximo work order under which this inspection was executed, linking the inspection event to the broader maintenance or compliance work order lifecycle.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Work Order; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: checklist_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized inspection checklist template used for this inspection event. The checklist defines the specific inspection points, acceptance criteria, and measurement requirements applicable to the asset type and inspection type.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Inspection Checklist; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial cost center responsible for the inspection activity. Used for CapEx/OpEx cost allocation of inspection labor and any remediation costs identified during the inspection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center; IFRS/GAAP CapEx/OpEx Classification

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical asset, equipment, or facility infrastructure component that is the subject of this inspection event (e.g., CNC machine, PLC, robotic cell, HVAC unit).
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Asset Record; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plant, facility, or shop floor location where the inspected asset is installed. Supports geographic and site-level compliance reporting and maintenance planning.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Location Record; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: primary_inspection_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce record of the qualified inspector or technician who performed the inspection. Supports traceability and certification validation per OSHA and ISO 9001 requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker Record; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.2 Competence

attributes.name: product_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_certification. Business justification: Inspection events verify product certification status; the FK enables inspection reports to reference the authoritative certification record.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Inspections are scheduled as part of project quality‑assurance activities.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: INSPECTION SCHEDULING: inspections are triggered by a particular regulation; recording the requirement links the event to compliance obligations.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: External inspection agencies are contracted; the link is required for audit traceability and regulatory reports.

attributes.name: tertiary_inspection_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor, quality manager, or authorized approver who reviewed and formally approved the inspection results. Required for regulatory compliance inspections and safety-critical equipment per ISO 9001 and OSHA requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; ISO 45001:2018; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection results were formally reviewed and approved by the authorized approver. Establishes the official close of the inspection event for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: asset_operational_status_at_inspection
attributes.description: The operational state of the asset at the time the inspection was conducted: running (in active production), shutdown (powered down for inspection), standby (idle but available), or under_maintenance (already in a maintenance window). Relevant for OEE downtime attribution and safety compliance.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; Aveva SCADA; ISO 55001:2014

attributes.name: capa_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number
attributes.description: The externally visible CAPA or NCR reference number raised in the quality management system as a result of this inspection's findings. Populated when corrective_action_required is True. Enables cross-system traceability between inspection events and quality corrective actions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance or safety certificate issued as a result of this inspection expires. Populated only when certificate_issued is True. Drives certificate renewal scheduling and regulatory compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: UL Certification Standards; CE Marking Directive; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: certificate_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a compliance certificate, safety certificate, or inspection certificate was issued as a result of this inspection event (True) or not (False). Relevant for UL, CE, and ISO certification inspections.
attributes.references: UL Certification Standards; CE Marking Directive; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more findings from this inspection require a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) to be initiated. When True, triggers CAPA workflow creation in the quality management system per ISO 9001 Clause 10.2.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inspection event record was first created in the system, establishing the audit trail entry point. Distinct from inspection_date which records when the physical inspection occurred.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5 Documented Information; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of findings classified as critical or safety-critical, requiring immediate corrective action before the asset may return to service. Supports OSHA compliance reporting and safety escalation workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: downtime_caused
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection event caused a production downtime event (True) or was conducted without interrupting production (False). Used for OEE downtime attribution and production loss reporting.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; Siemens Opcenter MES; OEE Industry Standard

attributes.name: downtime_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration in minutes of production downtime directly attributable to this inspection event. Populated only when downtime_caused is True. Feeds OEE availability calculations and production loss reporting.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; Siemens Opcenter MES; OEE Industry Standard

attributes.name: external_audit_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier assigned by an external regulatory body, certification authority, or third-party auditor for inspections conducted as part of an external audit program (e.g., OSHA inspection citation number, UL audit reference, ISO certification audit ID). Nullable for internal inspections.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; UL Certification; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.2

attributes.name: findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct findings, deficiencies, or non-conformances identified during the inspection event. A finding may span multiple checklist items; this field captures the consolidated count used for CAPA prioritization and NCR generation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.217; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Free-text narrative summary of the key findings, deficiencies, and observations recorded during the inspection. Provides the qualitative context for the quantitative findings_count and supports CAPA root cause analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; Maximo Asset Management — Inspection Remarks

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the inspection was physically performed. This is the principal real-world event date used for compliance reporting, regulatory submissions, and maintenance history analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: inspection_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from inspection start to completion. Derived from start and end timestamps at source but stored as a business fact for resource utilization reporting, labor cost estimation, and inspection planning benchmarks.

attributes.name: inspection_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the inspector completed all inspection activities and closed the event. Combined with start timestamp to derive inspection duration for resource planning.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Inspection Record; Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: inspection_interval_days
attributes.description: The prescribed frequency interval in calendar days between successive inspections of this asset, as defined by the preventive maintenance plan, regulatory requirement, or manufacturer specification. Used to calculate next_inspection_due_date.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — PM Frequency; ISO 55001:2014; OEM Maintenance Specifications

attributes.name: inspection_method
attributes.description: The primary technique used to conduct the inspection: visual (physical observation), functional_test (operational test of equipment), measurement (dimensional or parametric measurement), non_destructive_testing (NDT methods such as ultrasonic or thermographic), or document_review (records and certification review). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visual|functional_test|measurement|non_destructive_testing|document_review|combined — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5; ANSI/ASNT Standards; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the inspection event, used in regulatory submissions, audit trails, and cross-system references (e.g., INSP-2024-000123). Aligns with Maximo inspection record numbering conventions.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Inspection Record; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Overall pass/fail result of the inspection event: pass (all checklist items met), fail (one or more critical items failed), conditional_pass (minor findings with corrective action required but asset may continue operating), or incomplete (inspection not fully executed).
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; UL Certification Standards; CE Marking Directive

attributes.name: inspection_scope
attributes.description: Indicates the breadth of the inspection performed: full (all checklist items evaluated), partial (subset of items evaluated due to access or time constraints), or spot_check (random sampling of key items). Affects the validity weight of the inspection outcome for compliance purposes.

attributes.name: inspection_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the inspector began the inspection activity on-site. Used for duration calculation, shift alignment, and OEE downtime impact analysis.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Inspection Record; Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the inspection event: scheduled (planned but not started), in_progress (inspector on-site), completed (results recorded), cancelled (inspection voided), or overdue (past due date without completion). Drives maintenance scheduling and compliance dashboards.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Inspection Status; ISO 55001:2014

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection by its business purpose: preventive (scheduled TPM), safety (OSHA/facility safety), regulatory_compliance (UL, CE, ISO certification), quality_audit (QM equipment audit), condition_based (triggered by sensor/SCADA alert), ad_hoc (unplanned), or acceptance (new asset commissioning). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preventive|safety|regulatory_compliance|quality_audit|condition_based|ad_hoc|acceptance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Maximo Asset Management — Inspection Type

attributes.name: inspector_certification_number
attributes.description: The professional certification or qualification number of the inspector, confirming their authority to conduct this type of inspection (e.g., OSHA-certified safety inspector, UL-authorized auditor, ISO lead auditor credential). Required for regulatory compliance evidence.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; UL Certification; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.2; ISO 45001:2018

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified inspector or technician who performed the inspection. Stored for audit trail and regulatory evidence purposes. Classified as confidential as it is an employee business record.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.2; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Workday HCM

attributes.name: inspector_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for the inspector's additional observations, recommendations, or notes that do not constitute formal findings but provide context for maintenance planning and asset condition assessment.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Inspection Remarks; ISO 55001:2014

attributes.name: items_failed
attributes.description: Count of checklist line items that did not meet acceptance criteria during this inspection. Drives findings count reporting, CAPA initiation thresholds, and regulatory non-conformance escalation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: items_passed
attributes.description: Count of checklist line items that met acceptance criteria during this inspection. Together with total_checklist_items and items_failed, provides the raw data for compliance rate reporting without pre-aggregating the metric.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inspection event record was most recently modified, supporting data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5 Documented Information; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next inspection of this asset must be completed, as determined by the inspection interval, regulatory requirement, or inspector recommendation. Drives the preventive maintenance scheduling engine in Maximo.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — PM Schedule; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant code identifying the manufacturing facility where the inspected asset resides. Used for cross-system reconciliation between Maximo and SAP PM/QM modules and for plant-level compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module — Plant; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: The governing body or certification authority whose standard applies to this inspection (e.g., OSHA, ISO, IEC, UL, CE, EPA, NIST, ANSI, IPC). Used to filter and group compliance inspections for regulatory reporting dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OSHA|ISO|IEC|UL|CE|EPA|NIST|ANSI|IPC|NONE — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA; ISO; IEC; UL; CE Marking; EPA; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; ANSI; IPC

attributes.name: regulatory_standard
attributes.description: The specific regulatory or certification standard under which this inspection was conducted (e.g., OSHA 29 CFR 1910, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, UL 508A, CE Directive 2006/42/EC, IEC 62443). Mandatory for compliance inspections to support regulatory reporting and audit evidence.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ISO 9001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; UL Standards; CE Marking Directive; IEC 62443

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned to the inspection outcome based on the severity and nature of findings: critical (immediate safety or production risk), high (significant risk requiring prompt action), medium (moderate risk with planned remediation), or low (minor or no risk). Drives escalation and prioritization workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 45001:2018 Clause 6.1; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; FMEA Methodology

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date for this inspection as generated by the preventive maintenance schedule or regulatory compliance calendar. Compared against inspection_date to measure schedule adherence.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — PM Schedule; ISO 55001:2014 Clause 6.2

attributes.name: total_checklist_items
attributes.description: Total number of inspection checklist line items evaluated during this inspection event. Used as the denominator for compliance rate calculations and inspection completeness metrics.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Inspection Checklist; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1

products.name: calibration_record
products.description: Instrument and measurement equipment calibration record tracking calibration events for gauges, sensors, PLCs, and precision measurement tools. Captures calibration date, calibration standard used, as-found reading, as-left reading, tolerance limits, pass/fail result, calibration interval, next due date, and certifying technician. Supports ISO 9001 measurement system compliance and SPC instrument traceability.

attributes.name: calibration_record_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each calibration record event. Primary key for the calibration_record data product.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5 — Monitoring and Measuring Resources

attributes.name: asset_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Maximo work order under which this calibration activity was planned and executed. Enables traceability from calibration event back to maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Work Order Object; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5

attributes.name: calibration_standard_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reference standard or master gauge used to perform the calibration. The reference standard must itself be traceable to national or international measurement standards (NIST/SI).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 6.4; NIST Traceability Policy; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5.2

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP cost center responsible for the calibration activity. Used for OpEx allocation of calibration labor and external service costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling) — Cost Center; IFRS/GAAP OpEx classification

attributes.name: device_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.device_registry. Business justification: Calibration records are tied to the calibrated device, needed for Calibration Management and Compliance audit reports.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical instrument, gauge, sensor, PLC, or precision measurement tool that was calibrated. Links to the asset master record in Maximo Asset Management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; Maximo Asset Management — Asset Object

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plant, facility, or functional location where the instrument is installed and where the calibration was performed. Supports site-level compliance reporting and geographic traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; Maximo Asset Management — Location Object; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: primary_calibration_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualified technician or metrologist who performed and certified the calibration. Must hold documented competency for the instrument type per ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 17025 personnel qualification requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 6.2; Workday HCM — Worker

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Calibration activities are tied to project milestones for equipment commissioning.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: CALIBRATION COMPLIANCE: each calibration activity is performed to satisfy a defined regulatory standard, requiring a reference to that requirement.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Calibration activities are performed on specific instrument models; linking to SKU provides traceability for compliance and performance reporting.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Calibration labs are external suppliers; linking supports compliance and lab‑performance tracking.

attributes.name: adjustment_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the adjustment or corrective action applied to the instrument during calibration (e.g., zero offset correction, span adjustment, sensor replacement). Populated only when adjustment_made is True.

attributes.name: adjustment_made
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical adjustment or correction was applied to the instrument during this calibration event. True if the instrument was adjusted; False if it was verified only. Drives downstream impact assessment for prior measurements.

attributes.name: as_found_error
attributes.description: The calculated deviation of the as-found reading from the reference value (as_found_reading minus reference_value). Stored as a business fact to support drift trend analysis and SPC instrument capability studies without requiring recalculation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6; ANSI Z540.3; SPC (Statistical Process Control) methodology

attributes.name: as_found_reading
attributes.description: The measured value of the instrument at the start of the calibration event, before any adjustment is made. Used to assess instrument drift, determine if prior measurements were valid, and support SPC instrument traceability analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6; ANSI Z540.3

attributes.name: as_left_error
attributes.description: The calculated deviation of the as-left reading from the reference value (as_left_reading minus reference_value). Confirms residual error after adjustment and is used for measurement uncertainty budgets.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6; ANSI Z540.3; GUM (Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement)

attributes.name: as_left_reading
attributes.description: The measured value of the instrument at the conclusion of the calibration event, after any adjustment or correction has been applied. Confirms the instrument is within tolerance before being returned to service.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6; ANSI Z540.3

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the calibration activity was physically performed. This is the principal business event date used for certificate issuance, compliance records, and next-due-date calculation.

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next calibration must be completed, calculated from calibration_date plus the calibration_interval. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5.2; Maximo Asset Management — PM Schedule

attributes.name: calibration_interval_days
attributes.description: The approved recalibration frequency expressed in calendar days. Used to compute calibration_due_date and to schedule preventive maintenance in Maximo. Determined by instrument criticality, historical drift, and manufacturer recommendations.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5.2; Maximo Asset Management — PM Frequency; ANSI Z540.3

attributes.name: calibration_lab
attributes.description: Indicates whether the calibration was performed by an internal calibration lab, an externally accredited laboratory (ISO/IEC 17025), an external non-accredited service provider, or the OEM service team.

attributes.name: calibration_method
attributes.description: The documented calibration procedure or method reference used (e.g., internal procedure number, NIST traceable method, manufacturer procedure). Ensures repeatability and traceability of the calibration process.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.2; NIST Handbook 150; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5

attributes.name: calibration_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the technician to record observations, anomalies, special conditions, or additional context about the calibration event not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: calibration_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable unique identifier for this calibration event, used on calibration certificates and quality records. Format: CAL-{ASSET_CODE}-{SEQUENCE}.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Overall result and lifecycle status of the calibration event. 'pass' indicates the instrument is within tolerance; 'fail' triggers quarantine and CAPA; 'conditional_pass' indicates marginal acceptance with restrictions; 'out_of_tolerance' indicates as-found deviation requiring adjustment.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6; ANSI Z540.3

attributes.name: calibration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the calibration event by trigger or purpose. 'initial' is performed on new instruments; 'periodic' is routine scheduled calibration; 'after_repair' follows maintenance; 'unscheduled' is triggered by suspected drift or incident.

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record initiated as a result of a calibration failure or out-of-tolerance finding. Links the calibration event to the quality management corrective action workflow.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) process; SAP QM

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the calibration certificate was formally issued and signed. May differ from calibration_date if review and approval occur after the physical calibration activity.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The official certificate number issued upon successful calibration, as printed on the calibration certificate. Used for document control, quality records management, and regulatory audit evidence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this calibration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record retention tracking.

attributes.name: environmental_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage recorded at the time and location of calibration. Required environmental condition documentation per ISO/IEC 17025 for humidity-sensitive instruments.

attributes.name: environmental_temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Celsius recorded at the time and location of calibration. Environmental conditions can affect measurement accuracy and are required to be documented per ISO/IEC 17025.

attributes.name: external_lab_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Accreditation body certificate number for the external calibration laboratory (e.g., A2LA, NVLAP, UKAS accreditation number). Validates the laboratory's ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation status.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 6.6; ANSI Z540.3; A2LA/NVLAP accreditation requirements

attributes.name: external_lab_name
attributes.description: Name of the external calibration service provider or accredited laboratory, when calibration_lab is 'external_accredited' or 'external_non_accredited'. Used for supplier qualification and audit trail.

attributes.name: instrument_tag
attributes.description: Plant or facility tag number assigned to the measurement instrument per ISA-5.1 instrumentation standards (e.g., TI-101, PT-205). Used for shop floor identification and P&ID cross-reference.
attributes.references: ISA-5.1 Instrumentation Symbols and Identification; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the measurement instrument or device being calibrated. Drives applicable calibration procedures and tolerance standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gauge|sensor|transducer|transmitter|analyzer|controller|plc|cnc_probe|torque_wrench|caliper|micrometer|thermometer|pressure_meter|flow_meter — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: measurement_parameter
attributes.description: The physical or process parameter being measured by the instrument (e.g., temperature, pressure, flow, voltage, torque, dimension, weight). Determines the applicable calibration standard and tolerance regime.

attributes.name: measurement_uncertainty
attributes.description: The expanded measurement uncertainty (k=2, 95% confidence) associated with the calibration result, expressed in the same unit as measurement_unit. Required for ISO/IEC 17025 accredited calibration certificates.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure applicable to as_found_reading, as_left_reading, reference_value, and tolerance fields (e.g., °C, bar, mA, mm, Nm, V, kg). Must conform to SI units per ISO 80000.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 (SI Units); ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6; NIST SP 811

attributes.name: out_of_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether the instrument has been placed out of service as a result of this calibration event (e.g., due to a fail or out-of-tolerance result). When True, the instrument must be quarantined and a CAPA initiated before return to service.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) process; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: prior_measurement_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether measurements taken by this instrument since its last calibration may have been affected by the out-of-tolerance condition found. Required for product conformity risk assessment when a calibration failure is detected.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5.2; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6; APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning)

attributes.name: reference_value
attributes.description: The true or nominal value against which the instrument reading is compared during calibration. Established by the reference standard and used to compute as-found and as-left errors.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6; NIST Handbook 44; ANSI Z540.3

attributes.name: standard_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number of the reference standard used during calibration, establishing the NIST/SI traceability chain. Required for ISO/IEC 17025 compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 6.4.7; NIST Traceability Policy; ANSI Z540.3

attributes.name: technician_certification_number
attributes.description: The qualification or certification number of the technician who performed the calibration, as issued by an accredited body (e.g., ASQ, NIST, internal competency register). Required for ISO/IEC 17025 personnel traceability.

attributes.name: technician_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified technician who performed and certified the calibration. Captured as a denormalized field on the calibration certificate for regulatory traceability even if the technician record changes.

attributes.name: tolerance_lower_limit
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable deviation from the reference value for the instrument to be considered in calibration. Expressed in the same unit as measurement_unit. Falling below this limit results in a fail or out-of-tolerance status.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; ANSI Z540.3; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6

attributes.name: tolerance_upper_limit
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable deviation from the reference value for the instrument to be considered in calibration. Expressed in the same unit as measurement_unit. Exceeding this limit results in a fail or out-of-tolerance status.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; ANSI Z540.3; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this calibration record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change detection in the Databricks Silver Layer ingestion pipeline.

products.name: asset_warranty
products.description: Equipment warranty coverage record tracking OEM and extended warranty terms for purchased assets, including warranty type (parts, labor, full coverage), warranty start date, warranty expiration date, OEM vendor reference, covered components, claim submission process, and remaining warranty value. Enables warranty claim identification before issuing paid work orders and supports RMA processing for failed components under warranty.

attributes.name: asset_warranty_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the asset warranty record. Primary key for the asset_warranty data product.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical asset or equipment covered by this warranty record. Links to the asset master in Maximo Asset Management.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Asset Master; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Warranty obligations are managed per project for capital assets.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original purchase order under which the asset was procured, establishing the warranty entitlement basis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order; SAP Ariba Procurement

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or warranty service provider responsible for honoring warranty claims. Links to the vendor/supplier master.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba — Supplier Master; Maximo Asset Management — Vendor

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: The actual date the warranty was formally activated with the OEM or warranty provider. May differ from start_date if activation requires registration or commissioning sign-off.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Activation; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: claim_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the OEM or warranty provider's claim contact. Used for formal claim submission and correspondence.

attributes.name: claim_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated contact person at the OEM or warranty service provider for submitting and tracking warranty claims.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Contact; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: claim_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the OEM or warranty provider's claim contact. Used by maintenance teams to initiate warranty service requests.

attributes.name: claim_response_sla_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Warranty Claim Response Service Level Agreement (SLA) Days
attributes.description: The contractually committed number of business days within which the OEM or warranty provider must respond to a submitted warranty claim. Supports SLA monitoring and vendor performance management.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty SLA; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: claim_submission_process
attributes.description: The prescribed method for submitting warranty claims to the OEM or warranty provider. Guides maintenance technicians and procurement teams on the correct claim channel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: online_portal|email|phone|field_service_dispatch|rma_process|written_notice — promote to reference product if additional channels are needed]
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Claim; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Defines the service delivery model under the warranty. 'on_site' means the OEM/vendor dispatches technicians to the facility; 'depot_repair' means the asset is sent to a repair center; 'return_to_factory' means the asset is returned to the manufacturer; 'remote_support' means coverage is provided via remote diagnostics; 'parts_only' means only replacement parts are shipped.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: covered_components
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific components, assemblies, or subsystems covered under this warranty (e.g., 'Motor, gearbox, and control panel electronics'). Supports claim eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the warranty record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and compliance with ISO 9001 record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management — Record Control; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary values in this warranty record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or path to the warranty certificate, contract document, or terms and conditions stored in the document management system (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter PLM document ID or file path).
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Document Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: duration_months
attributes.description: Total duration of the warranty coverage expressed in months. Used for warranty planning, asset lifecycle analysis, and CapEx budgeting for post-warranty maintenance.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Duration; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: excluded_components
attributes.description: Free-text description of components, failure modes, or conditions explicitly excluded from warranty coverage (e.g., 'Wear parts, consumables, damage from improper use'). Critical for claim rejection analysis.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Exclusions; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the warranty coverage ends. After this date, maintenance and repair costs are borne by the asset owner. Critical for triggering paid work orders and evaluating RMA eligibility.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty End Date; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: expiry_alert_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the warranty expiration date that an alert should be triggered to notify asset managers and procurement teams. Enables proactive extended warranty procurement or maintenance budget planning.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Alerts; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: extended_warranty_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OEM or vendor offers an extended warranty option for this asset upon expiration of the current warranty. True = extension is available; False = no extension offered.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: labor_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether labor costs for warranty repairs are covered under this warranty. True = labor is covered; False = labor costs are borne by the asset owner.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Coverage; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: last_claim_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent warranty claim submitted under this warranty record. Supports warranty activity monitoring and vendor SLA tracking.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Claims; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: maintenance_provider_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies restrictions on who may perform maintenance without voiding the warranty. 'oem_only' = only OEM technicians; 'certified_partner' = OEM-certified service partners; 'any_provider' = no restriction; 'internal_allowed' = internal maintenance team is permitted.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Conditions; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: maintenance_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maintenance Required to Maintain Warranty Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty requires adherence to a prescribed maintenance schedule to remain valid. True = warranty is voided if maintenance intervals are not followed per OEM specifications.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Conditions; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: max_claim_value
attributes.description: The maximum monetary value of claims that can be submitted under this warranty over its lifetime. Caps the total financial exposure covered by the OEM or warranty provider.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Value; IFRS/GAAP Asset Accounting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional warranty terms, special conditions, exceptions, or operational notes not captured in structured fields (e.g., 'Warranty void if coolant is not replaced every 6 months').

attributes.name: oem_vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or third-party warranty service provider. Retained as a denormalized reference for reporting and claim correspondence without requiring a vendor master join.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Vendor; SAP Ariba Supplier Management

attributes.name: oem_warranty_reference
attributes.description: The OEM's internal warranty registration or reference number used when submitting claims directly to the manufacturer's warranty portal or service desk.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Contract; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: parts_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether replacement parts costs are covered under this warranty. True = parts are covered; False = parts costs are borne by the asset owner.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Coverage; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: preventive_maintenance_covered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether scheduled preventive maintenance activities are covered under the warranty terms. True = PM is covered; False = PM costs are excluded. Relevant for Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) planning.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: remaining_warranty_value
attributes.description: The residual monetary value available for future warranty claims, calculated as max_claim_value minus the total value of claims already submitted and approved. Supports CapEx and OpEx planning.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Value; IFRS/GAAP Asset Accounting

attributes.name: rma_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failed components under this warranty are eligible for Return Material Authorization (RMA) processing. True = RMA can be initiated; False = RMA not applicable under this warranty.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty; SAP S/4HANA MM Returns

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this warranty record in the originating operational system (e.g., Maximo warranty record ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and lineage.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Data Lineage; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the warranty coverage becomes effective. Typically aligned with the asset commissioning date, installation date, or purchase date as defined in the warranty terms.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Start Date; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: total_claimed_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative monetary value of all warranty claims submitted against this warranty record. Used to track warranty utilization and compare against max_claim_value.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Claims; IFRS/GAAP Asset Accounting

attributes.name: total_claims_count
attributes.description: The total number of warranty claims submitted against this warranty record to date. Supports vendor performance analysis and warranty utilization tracking.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Claims; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty can be transferred to a new asset owner in the event of asset sale or reassignment. True = warranty is transferable; False = warranty is non-transferable.

attributes.name: travel_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether travel and transportation costs for on-site warranty service are covered. True = travel is covered; False = travel costs are borne by the asset owner.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the warranty record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management — Record Control; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: usage_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty terms are based on asset usage metrics (e.g., operating hours, cycles, mileage) in addition to or instead of calendar time. True = usage-based terms apply.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: usage_limit_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Warranty Usage Limit Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the usage-based warranty limit (e.g., 'hours' for operating hours, 'cycles' for production cycles). Applicable only when usage_based_flag is True.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: usage_limit_value
attributes.description: The maximum usage quantity (e.g., operating hours, production cycles, kilometers) allowed under the warranty before coverage expires. Applicable only when usage_based_flag is True.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Usage Limit; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: warranty_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the warranty agreement (e.g., 'Standard OEM 2-Year Parts and Labor Warranty', 'Extended Full Coverage Plan').

attributes.name: warranty_number
attributes.description: Externally-known warranty certificate or contract number issued by the OEM or warranty provider. Used for claim submission and correspondence with the vendor.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Contract; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: warranty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the warranty record. 'active' indicates coverage is in force; 'expired' indicates the warranty period has ended; 'pending' indicates awaiting activation; 'voided' indicates warranty was invalidated (e.g., unauthorized modification); 'suspended' indicates temporarily on hold.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Status; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: warranty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warranty coverage scope. 'parts_only' covers replacement components only; 'labor_only' covers service labor only; 'full_coverage' covers both parts and labor; 'extended' is a purchased extension beyond OEM terms; 'limited' covers specific components or failure modes; 'manufacturer' is the standard OEM warranty.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Warranty Type; ISO 9001 Quality Management

products.name: asset_certification
products.description: Regulatory and safety certification record for equipment assets, tracking certifications required for legal operation including pressure vessel certification, electrical safety certification (UL, CE), crane and lifting equipment certification, and explosion-proof (ATEX) certification. Stores certification type, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, certificate number, and renewal action status.
products.reference: UL / CE Marking / OSHA Equipment Certification

attributes.name: asset_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each asset certification record. Primary key for the asset_certification data product.

attributes.name: asset_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Maximo work order associated with the certification inspection, renewal activity, or corrective action. Links certification events to maintenance execution records.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Work Order Management; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: COMPLIANCE: Certification activities incur costs that must be charged to the responsible cost center.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee or asset manager responsible for managing the certification lifecycle, including renewal coordination and regulatory compliance. Links to Workday HCM workforce record.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 5.3; ISO 45001:2018; Maximo Asset Management; Workday HCM

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical equipment or asset for which this certification applies. Links to the asset master record in Maximo Asset Management.

attributes.name: product_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_certification. Business justification: Asset certifications derive from product certifications; linking supports regulatory compliance dashboards and audit trails.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Certifications are required for assets within specific projects to meet compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: CERTIFICATION MANAGEMENT: each asset certification must be tied to the specific regulatory requirement it fulfills for audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: atex_certificate_number
attributes.description: Specific ATEX (Atmosphères Explosibles) certificate number issued by a notified body for explosion-proof equipment. Null for non-ATEX assets. Required for operation in hazardous areas under EU Directive 2014/34/EU.

attributes.name: ce_marking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset bears CE marking, confirming conformity with applicable European Union health, safety, and environmental protection standards. True = CE marked; False = not CE marked.
attributes.references: CE Marking Directive; EU Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC; Low Voltage Directive 2014/35/EU

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Externally-issued unique certificate number assigned by the certifying authority. Used for regulatory traceability and audit purposes (e.g., UL certificate number, CE declaration reference, ATEX certificate number).
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; UL Certification; CE Marking Directive 2014/35/EU; ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Drives compliance dashboards, renewal workflows, and legal operation eligibility checks. 'active' = valid and in force; 'expired' = past expiry date; 'suspended' = temporarily withdrawn by authority; 'revoked' = permanently cancelled; 'pending_renewal' = renewal in progress.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; Maximo Asset Management — Certification Lifecycle

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Category of regulatory or safety certification applicable to the asset. Classifies the certification domain for compliance tracking and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pressure_vessel|electrical_safety|crane_lifting|explosion_proof|fire_safety|environmental|machinery_safety|electromagnetic_compatibility|energy_efficiency|occupational_safety — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU; IEC 61131; UL Standards; ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; CE Marking Directives

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for obtaining or renewing this certification, including inspection fees, testing fees, and notified body charges. Expressed in the local currency. Supports CapEx asset register and OpEx maintenance cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; IFRS/GAAP; CapEx/OpEx Classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the certification_cost amount (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Required for multi-currency financial reporting.

attributes.name: days_to_expiry
attributes.description: Number of calendar days remaining until the certification expires, calculated from the current date to expiry_date. Negative values indicate the certification is already expired. Used for compliance dashboards and renewal prioritization. Note: This is a pre-computed convenience field stored at ingestion time for reporting performance; the authoritative calculation is expiry_date minus current date.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; Maximo Asset Management — Compliance Reporting

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or path to the scanned certificate document stored in the document management system (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter PLM document ID or SAP DMS reference). Enables direct retrieval of the physical certificate for audit purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Document Management; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: document_storage_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the certificate document stored in the enterprise document management or lakehouse storage layer. Supports paperless audit and compliance review.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Document Management

attributes.name: equipment_category
attributes.description: ATEX equipment category indicating the level of protection required (Category 1 = very high protection for Zone 0/20; Category 2 = high protection for Zone 1/21; Category 3 = normal protection for Zone 2/22). Null for non-ATEX certifications.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and the asset is no longer legally authorized to operate under this certification. Null indicates an open-ended or lifetime certification. Drives automated renewal alerts and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: hazardous_zone_classification
attributes.description: ATEX/IECEx hazardous area zone classification applicable to the certified equipment (e.g., Zone 1 for gas/vapour explosive atmospheres, Zone 21 for dust explosive atmospheres). Null for non-ATEX certifications.
attributes.references: ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU; IECEx IEC 60079; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.307

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the physical inspection, audit, or test was conducted by the certifying authority or inspector as part of the certification or renewal process.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: inspector_license_number
attributes.description: Official license or accreditation number of the inspector or inspection body, confirming their authority to issue or validate the certification. Required for regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code; ISO/IEC 17020

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified inspector or auditor who conducted the certification inspection on behalf of the issuing authority or notified body.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was formally issued or granted by the issuing authority. Represents the start of the certification's validity period.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; Maximo Asset Management — Certification Record

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body, notified body, or certification organization that issued the certificate (e.g., 'Underwriters Laboratories (UL)', 'TÜV Rheinland', 'Bureau Veritas', 'Lloyd's Register', 'OSHA', 'CE Notified Body NB 0044'). Critical for audit and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: UL Standards; CE Marking Directive; ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU; ISO/IEC 17065; OSHA

attributes.name: issuing_authority_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the issuing authority operates (e.g., 'USA', 'DEU', 'GBR'). Supports multi-jurisdictional compliance management.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; CE Marking Directive; ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Functional location or area code within the plant where the certified asset is installed (e.g., 'PLANT-A/LINE-3/PRESS-01'). Aligns with Maximo functional location hierarchy for maintenance and compliance management.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management — Functional Location; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is legally mandatory for the asset to operate (True) or is a voluntary/optional certification (False). Mandatory certifications trigger compliance holds if expired.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; CE Marking Directives; ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory inspection or re-certification audit. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling and compliance calendar management in Maximo.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Maximo Asset Management — Preventive Maintenance

attributes.name: nonconformance_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any Non-Conformance Report (NCR) or Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) raised in connection with a failed or conditional certification inspection. Links to the quality management system for corrective action tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; SAP S/4HANA QM — NCR/CAPA; CAPA Process

attributes.name: operation_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset has been placed on an operational hold due to an expired, suspended, or revoked certification. True = asset must not be operated; False = no hold in effect. Integrates with MES shop floor control to prevent unauthorized use.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Siemens Opcenter MES — Shop Floor Control; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: pressure_rating_psi
attributes.description: Maximum allowable working pressure in pounds per square inch (PSI) as certified for pressure vessel or piping equipment. Null for non-pressure-rated assets. Critical for ASME and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code Section VIII; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.169

attributes.name: previous_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number of the immediately preceding certification record that this record renews or supersedes. Enables certification history chain traceability for audit and regulatory review.
