attributes.description: Secondary address line (building, suite, floor) of the network node facility.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for throughput capacity (e.g., 'units', 'pallets', 'tons', 'cubic_meters').

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Quality and compliance certification status of the node (e.g., 'ISO 9001', 'ISO 14001', 'ISO 45001', 'IATF 16949').

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the network node is located.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code associated with the network node for accounting and budgeting purposes.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the network node location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the network node record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date when the network node became or will become operational in the supply chain.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date when the network node was or will be decommissioned or removed from the supply chain (null for active nodes).

attributes.name: erp_plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or facility code in the ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system (SAP S/4HANA plant identifier).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the network node record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the node location in decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from order placement to delivery from this node to downstream nodes.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the node location in decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: moq_minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required for procurement or production at this node.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity (e.g., 'units', 'pallets', 'lots').

attributes.name: network_tier_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier position in the multi-tier supply network (0=owned plant, 1=tier-1 supplier, 2=tier-2 supplier, 3=tier-3 supplier, etc.).

attributes.name: node_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification of the node (e.g., 'automation_assembly', 'electrification_production', 'smart_infrastructure_fabrication', 'tier_1_supplier', 'tier_2_supplier', 'tier_3_supplier').

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the network node by its primary function in the supply chain topology.

attributes.name: operating_days_per_week
attributes.description: Number of operating days per week for the network node (typically 5, 6, or 7).

attributes.name: operating_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Standard daily operating hours of the network node facility.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the network node in the supply chain.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership model of the network node facility.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the network node facility address.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact for the network node.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary business contact or site manager for the network node.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary business contact for the network node.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Business-defined geographic region or market area (e.g., 'EMEA', 'APAC', 'Americas', 'Europe', 'North America').

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Categorical risk classification of the node based on supply chain vulnerability assessment.

attributes.name: risk_exposure_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk assessment score for the node based on geopolitical, operational, financial, and supply continuity factors (scale 0-100, higher = higher risk).

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the network node location.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_cubic_meters
attributes.description: Total warehouse or storage capacity of the node in cubic meters.

attributes.name: supplier_performance_rating
attributes.description: Performance rating score for supplier nodes based on OTD (On-Time Delivery), quality, and compliance metrics (scale 0-100).

attributes.name: supports_cross_docking
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node supports cross-docking operations (direct transfer from inbound to outbound without storage).

attributes.name: supports_kitting
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node supports kitting or assembly operations (combining multiple components into a kit).

attributes.name: supports_postponement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node supports postponement strategies (delaying final product configuration until customer order).

attributes.name: throughput_capacity_units_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum daily production or handling capacity of the node measured in standard units (e.g., units, pallets, tons).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the node location (e.g., 'Europe/Berlin', 'America/New_York').

attributes.name: transit_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average transportation lead time in days from this node to primary downstream nodes.

products.name: sourcing_rule
products.description: Defines the complete sourcing logic, lot-sizing constraints, and MOQ parameters for each material-plant-supplier combination. Specifies preferred suppliers, make-vs-buy decisions, split sourcing percentages, sourcing priority, applicable date ranges, Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ), maximum order quantity, lot size rounding values, fixed lot sizes, order quantity constraints, MOQ negotiation history, and planner-approved exceptions. These rules directly govern how MRP generates planned purchase requisitions or production orders and enforce procurement cost optimization through lot-size calculations. Managed in SAP MM and Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.
products.reference: SAP MM - Source List / Quota Arrangement

attributes.name: sourcing_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sourcing rule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record that this sourcing rule applies to. Links to the material being sourced.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this sourcing rule is applicable. Links to the plant master.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Sourcing rules must enforce vendor compliance with specific regulations; procurement policy reports reference regulatory requirement IDs.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Sourcing rules are defined per SKU to manage make‑or‑buy, allocation percentages and supplier contracts.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor from whom the material is sourced under this rule. Links to the supplier master.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total demand allocated to this sourcing rule when split sourcing is configured. Used for quota arrangements and multi-supplier strategies.

attributes.name: automatic_po_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether MRP is authorized to automatically convert planned orders to purchase orders without manual intervention for this sourcing rule.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this sourcing rule record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sourcing rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard price and other monetary values in this sourcing rule.

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for any exceptions or deviations from standard sourcing policies, such as emergency procurement, single-source justification, or temporary supplier changes.

attributes.name: fixed_lot_size
attributes.description: Fixed quantity that must be ordered when this sourcing rule is applied. MRP will generate orders in exact multiples of this lot size.

attributes.name: gr_processing_time_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Goods Receipt (GR) Processing Time in Days
attributes.description: Number of days required for goods receipt processing, inspection, and put-away after material arrives at the plant. Included in total procurement lead time.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard trade terms defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, insurance, and risk transfer in international transactions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Specific location or port associated with the Incoterms designation, defining the point of delivery or risk transfer.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this sourcing rule record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sourcing rule record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_moq_negotiation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Negotiation Date
attributes.description: Date when the MOQ was last negotiated or reviewed with the supplier, used to track contract refresh cycles and renegotiation schedules.

attributes.name: lot_size_rounding_value
attributes.description: Rounding increment for order quantities. MRP will round calculated requirements up to the nearest multiple of this value to align with packaging or production batch constraints.

attributes.name: lot_sizing_procedure
attributes.description: SAP lot-sizing procedure code defining how MRP calculates order quantities: EX (lot-for-lot), HB (fixed lot size), FB (replenish to maximum), PD (period lot size), WM (weekly lot size), MB (monthly lot size).

attributes.name: make_or_buy_indicator
attributes.description: Strategic decision indicator specifying whether the material is manufactured in-house (make), procured externally (buy), or both options are available.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered in a single purchase requisition or production order under this sourcing rule, based on supplier capacity or production constraints.

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity negotiated with the supplier or defined by production constraints. MRP will not generate orders below this threshold.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments providing context, special instructions, or historical information about this sourcing rule.

attributes.name: order_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which orders are placed with the supplier (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, M for meter). Must be convertible to base UOM.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Code representing the negotiated payment terms with the supplier, defining due dates, discounts, and payment schedules.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Expected lead time in calendar days from order placement to goods receipt for this material-plant-supplier combination. Used by MRP for backward scheduling.

attributes.name: planner_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sourcing rule has been reviewed and approved by the material planner or supply chain manager for use in MRP runs.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator marking this supplier as the preferred source for the material-plant combination. Used to prioritize sourcing decisions when multiple suppliers are available.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity unit to which the standard price applies. For example, if price_unit is 100, the standard_price represents the cost per 100 units.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing group or buyer responsible for managing procurement activities under this sourcing rule.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing organization responsible for negotiating and executing procurement under this sourcing rule.

attributes.name: quota_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sourcing rule is part of a quota arrangement where demand is split across multiple suppliers based on allocation percentages.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code identifying this sourcing rule for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the sourcing rule for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sourcing rule indicating whether it is active and available for MRP, temporarily blocked, awaiting approval, or expired.

attributes.name: sourcing_priority
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the preference order when multiple sourcing rules exist for the same material-plant combination. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: sourcing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sourcing method: external procurement from supplier, in-house production, subcontracting, stock transfer between plants, or consignment arrangement.

attributes.name: standard_price
attributes.description: Standard negotiated unit price for the material from this supplier, used for cost estimation and procurement planning. Excludes taxes and freight.

attributes.name: supply_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of supply chain risk associated with this sourcing rule, considering supplier reliability, geopolitical factors, lead time variability, and single-source dependency.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date from which this sourcing rule becomes effective and can be used by MRP for procurement planning.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date after which this sourcing rule is no longer valid and will not be considered by MRP. Null indicates indefinite validity.

products.name: supply_safety_stock_policy
products.description: Defines safety stock parameters and reorder point policies for each material-plant combination, including safety stock quantity, safety days of supply, service level target, reorder point, maximum stock level, and the calculation method (static, dynamic, statistical). Captures the business rules governing buffer stock levels to protect against demand variability and supplier lead time uncertainty. Managed in SAP MM material master planning data.
products.reference: SAP MM - Material Master MRP Data (MM02)

attributes.name: supply_safety_stock_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the safety stock policy record.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for which this safety stock policy is defined.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Safety‑stock policies are applied per SKU to meet service‑level targets and calculate reorder points.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Safety‑stock policies are often defined per supplier to reflect reliability and lead‑time variability, required for accurate buffer calculations.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and criticality: A (high-value, tight control), B (moderate-value), C (low-value, loose control).

attributes.name: average_daily_demand
attributes.description: Mean daily consumption or usage rate of the material, used as input for reorder point and safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine safety stock levels: static (fixed quantity), dynamic (demand-driven), statistical (based on demand variability and service level), or manual (user-defined).

attributes.name: coverage_profile
attributes.description: Six-character code referencing a time-phased coverage profile used in advanced planning systems for dynamic safety stock calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock policy record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: criticality_code
attributes.description: Business criticality rating indicating the impact of stockout on operations: critical (production stoppage), high (significant disruption), medium (moderate impact), low (minimal impact).

attributes.name: demand_variability_coefficient
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand fluctuation (coefficient of variation or standard deviation) used in statistical safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this safety stock policy becomes active and is used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this safety stock policy expires or is superseded by a new policy. Null indicates an open-ended policy.

attributes.name: holding_cost_percent_annual
attributes.description: Annual inventory carrying cost as a percentage of material value, including warehousing, insurance, obsolescence, and cost of capital.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock policy record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this safety stock policy was reviewed and validated by supply chain planning.

attributes.name: lead_time_variability_days
attributes.description: Standard deviation of supplier lead time in days, used to account for supply uncertainty in safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: lot_size_rule
attributes.description: SAP lot-sizing procedure code: EX (Lot-for-Lot), HB (Replenish to Maximum), FX (Fixed Lot Size), WB (Weekly Lot Size), MB (Monthly Lot Size).

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: The upper inventory limit for this material-plant combination, used to prevent overstocking and optimize working capital.

attributes.name: minimum_stock_level
attributes.description: The lower inventory threshold below which stock should not fall under normal operating conditions.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this safety stock policy record.

attributes.name: moq_minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The smallest order quantity that can be procured from the supplier, constraining replenishment order sizes.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the MRP controller responsible for exception management and planning parameter maintenance.

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: MRP procedure type that determines how material requirements are planned: PD (MRP), VB (Manual Reorder Point), VM (Forecast-Based Planning), VV (Time-Phased Planning), R1 (Reorder Point Planning), R2 (Replenishment Planning).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next review of this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from order placement to material receipt, used in reorder point calculation.

attributes.name: planner_code
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the supply chain planner or buyer responsible for managing this material-plant combination.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the manufacturing or distribution plant where the safety stock policy applies.

attributes.name: policy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for planners to document special considerations, assumptions, or business rules governing this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety stock policy: active (in use), inactive (not applied), suspended (temporarily disabled), under_review (pending approval).

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: SAP procurement type indicator: E (In-house production), F (External procurement), X (Both).

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered, calculated as safety stock plus demand during lead time.

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled reviews of this safety stock policy to ensure continued relevance and accuracy.

attributes.name: rounding_value
attributes.description: Quantity increment to which replenishment orders are rounded (e.g., round to nearest pallet quantity).

attributes.name: safety_days_supply
attributes.description: Number of days of average demand that the safety stock quantity is intended to cover.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The buffer stock quantity maintained to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty, expressed in base unit of measure.

attributes.name: safety_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days added to the planned delivery lead time as a time buffer to account for supply uncertainty.

attributes.name: service_level_target_percent
attributes.description: The target probability of not experiencing a stockout during the lead time, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 for 95% service level).

attributes.name: special_procurement_key
attributes.description: Two-digit SAP code indicating special procurement scenarios such as subcontracting, consignment, stock transfer, or third-party processing.

attributes.name: stockout_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Estimated cost impact per unit of stockout, including lost sales, expediting costs, and production disruption, used in economic safety stock optimization.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the specific storage location within the plant where safety stock is maintained.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which safety stock quantities are expressed (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter).

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: Demand variability classification: X (stable demand), Y (moderate variability), Z (highly variable or sporadic demand).

products.name: risk_register
products.description: Records identified supply chain risks associated with materials, suppliers, supply network nodes, or geographic regions. Captures risk type (single-source dependency, geopolitical, capacity constraint, quality issue, natural disaster), risk severity, probability of occurrence, potential supply impact (quantity and duration), mitigation actions, and risk owner. Supports supply risk management and business continuity planning for the industrial manufacturing supply chain.

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Primary key for risk_register

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.capa. Business justification: CAPA actions are linked to the risks they mitigate; the risk register stores the CAPA identifier for each risk to enable corrective‑action tracking.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Supply‑risk assessments often consider key customers; linking risk records to customer accounts supports risk dashboards and mitigation planning.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific material or component affected by this supply risk. Links to the material master data in SAP MM.

attributes.name: ncr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.ncr. Business justification: Risk Management process requires associating each identified risk with its related Non‑Conformance Report (NCR) to trace root cause and corrective actions.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Risk register references a network node by name; replace with FK to network_node for proper relationship and eliminate redundant string column.

attributes.name: primary_risk_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier associated with this supply risk. Links to supplier master data in SAP Ariba or SAP MM vendor master.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Required for Risk Register to capture compliance risk per regulatory requirement; risk management reports tie each risk to a specific regulation.

attributes.name: risk_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee responsible for monitoring and managing this supply risk. Links to employee master data in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: safety_function_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.safety_function. Business justification: Links supply‑side risk records to safety instrumented functions, essential for the Safety Risk Assessment matrix used in compliance audits.

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_contract. Business justification: Risk register tracks supply risks that affect active service contracts (Contract Risk Management report).

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Risk registers track supply‑chain risks at the SKU level for mitigation planning.

attributes.name: alternative_supplier_identified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an alternative or backup supplier has been identified and qualified for this material or component. True indicates alternative supplier is available.

attributes.name: assessed_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment (severity, probability, impact analysis) was completed, supporting risk management process compliance.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply risk was closed or resolved, indicating the risk is no longer active or applicable.

attributes.name: contingency_plan
attributes.description: Detailed contingency or backup plan to be activated if the risk materializes and primary mitigation strategies fail, supporting business continuity.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk register record was first created in the system, supporting audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application where this risk record originated (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM, SAP Ariba, manual entry), supporting data lineage and integration traceability.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Level of management escalation required for this risk: none (no escalation), manager (department manager), director (functional director), vp (vice president), executive (C-level), or board (board of directors).

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this risk requires escalation to senior management or executive leadership due to severity or strategic importance. True indicates escalation is required.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact in the base currency if the risk materializes, including potential revenue loss, additional costs, or penalties.

attributes.name: financial_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY).

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) where the supply risk is located or originates, supporting regional risk analysis and business continuity planning.

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply risk was first identified and recorded in the risk register, supporting risk lifecycle tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: impact_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the potential supply impact quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters, M for meters).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk register record was last updated or modified, supporting change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent review or reassessment of this supply risk, ensuring risk information remains current and accurate.

attributes.name: lead_time_impact_days
attributes.description: Estimated increase in procurement or production lead time (in days) if the risk materializes, used for Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and Advanced Planning and Scheduling (APS) adjustments.

attributes.name: mitigation_cost
attributes.description: Estimated or actual cost to implement the mitigation strategy, used for cost-benefit analysis and budget planning.

attributes.name: mitigation_cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the mitigation cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY).

attributes.name: mitigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the mitigation action plan: not started (planned but not initiated), in progress (actively being implemented), completed (mitigation actions finished), on hold (temporarily paused), or cancelled (mitigation plan abandoned).

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: Detailed description of the mitigation actions and strategies planned or implemented to reduce the likelihood or impact of the supply risk.

attributes.name: mitigation_target_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the mitigation actions, used for project management and risk reduction tracking.

attributes.name: moq_impact
attributes.description: Change in Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) requirements if the risk materializes and alternative sourcing is required, impacting inventory planning and working capital.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review or reassessment of this supply risk, supporting proactive risk management and governance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, comments, or observations related to this supply risk, supporting collaboration and knowledge sharing among risk management teams.

attributes.name: potential_impact_duration_days
attributes.description: Estimated duration in days that the supply disruption could last if the risk materializes, used for business continuity and recovery planning.

attributes.name: potential_supply_impact_quantity
attributes.description: Estimated quantity of material or product that could be impacted if the risk materializes, measured in the base unit of measure (UOM) for the material.

attributes.name: probability_of_occurrence
attributes.description: Likelihood that the supply risk will materialize within the planning horizon: very high (>80% probability), high (60-80%), medium (40-60%), low (20-40%), or very low (<20%).

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the risk domain: supplier (vendor-related risks), material (raw material availability or price volatility), logistics (transportation and distribution risks), regulatory (compliance and legal risks), demand (demand volatility or forecast accuracy), or technology (obsolescence or system failures).

attributes.name: risk_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the supply risk following the pattern AAA-NNNNNN where AAA represents risk category and NNNNNN is sequential number.

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the supply chain risk including context, potential triggers, and business impact scenarios.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score based on severity and probability, typically ranging from 0 to 100, used for risk prioritization and resource allocation decisions.

attributes.name: risk_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the supply risk based on potential business impact: critical (severe operational disruption or financial loss), high (significant impact), medium (moderate impact), or low (minimal impact).

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply risk: identified (newly discovered), assessed (analysis complete), active (currently impacting operations), mitigated (actions taken to reduce impact), closed (risk no longer applicable), or monitoring (under continuous observation).

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the supply chain risk for quick identification and reporting.

attributes.name: risk_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply chain risk by its nature: single-source dependency (sole supplier risk), geopolitical (trade restrictions, sanctions, political instability), capacity constraint (supplier unable to meet demand), quality issue (supplier quality failures), natural disaster (floods, earthquakes, pandemics), or financial instability (supplier bankruptcy risk).

attributes.name: safety_stock_recommendation
attributes.description: Recommended safety stock quantity to buffer against this supply risk, used for inventory policy adjustments and working capital planning.

products.name: planning_exception
products.description: Records supply planning exceptions and alerts generated by MRP or APS when supply and demand are out of balance. Captures shortage alerts, excess stock warnings, rescheduling recommendations, cancellation proposals, expedite flags, and lead time violations. Each exception includes type, severity, affected material and plant, exception quantity, recommended action, planner assignment, resolution status, and aging days. Drives the daily exception-based planning workflow — the primary screen supply planners work from each morning in SAP PP/MM and Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.

attributes.name: planning_exception_id
attributes.description: Primary key for planning_exception

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the supply planner assigned to resolve this exception. Used for workload balancing and accountability tracking in exception management workflow.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the MRP run that generated this exception. Links exception to the planning cycle and parameters that produced it.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Planning exceptions can be triggered by regulatory constraints; exception logs record the regulatory requirement causing the deviation.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Exceptions reference the SKU master to identify which product’s plan deviated and requires corrective action.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Exception reports require the responsible supplier ID for root‑cause analysis and corrective action tracking, a standard practice in manufacturing exception management.

attributes.name: aging_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days since the exception was first detected. Used to identify stale exceptions requiring escalation or management attention. Calculated as current date minus exception_detected_timestamp.

attributes.name: available_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The current available stock (unrestricted use stock minus allocated quantities) for the material at the plant. Used to assess whether existing inventory can partially mitigate the exception.

attributes.name: business_impact_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business impact if the exception is not resolved (e.g., production line stoppage, customer order delay, revenue at risk, contractual penalty exposure). Used for prioritization and escalation decisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this exception record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for data lineage and audit trail. Distinct from exception_detected_timestamp which is the business event time.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost impact (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY). Aligns with SAP FI financial reporting currency.

attributes.name: current_receipt_date
attributes.description: The currently scheduled receipt date for the supply order (purchase order, production order, or transfer order) related to this exception. Null if exception is demand-driven shortage with no existing supply order.

attributes.name: customer_name
attributes.description: The name of the customer affected by this exception, if the demand source is a sales order. Used by planners to assess business priority and communicate potential delivery impacts.

attributes.name: demand_order_number
attributes.description: The sales order, service order, or project number that is the source of demand causing the exception. Used to trace exception back to customer commitment and assess business impact of shortage or delay.

attributes.name: demand_source
attributes.description: The origin of the demand that triggered the exception. Sales_order indicates firm customer commitment; forecast indicates statistical projection; safety_stock indicates buffer replenishment; dependent_requirement indicates BOM-driven demand from higher-level assembly.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) whether this exception has been escalated to management or cross-functional team due to complexity, business impact, or aging. True indicates escalation required or in progress.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the exception was escalated (e.g., supplier cannot expedite, customer will not accept delay, cross-plant transfer required, management approval needed for cost impact).

attributes.name: estimated_cost_impact
attributes.description: The estimated financial cost impact of the exception in local currency (e.g., expedite freight cost, premium supplier pricing, production downtime cost, customer penalty). Used for cost-benefit analysis of resolution options.

attributes.name: exception_date
attributes.description: The date when the supply-demand imbalance occurs or is projected to occur. This is the key date planners use to prioritize exception resolution by urgency.

attributes.name: exception_detected_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the exception was first detected and created by the MRP or APS system. Used to calculate exception aging and track planner response time.

attributes.name: exception_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the exception, typically auto-generated by MRP or APS system. Used by planners to reference and track exceptions in daily workflow.

attributes.name: exception_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material involved in the exception (shortage amount, excess amount, or quantity to reschedule). Expressed in base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: exception_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the exception. Open indicates new exception requiring planner action; in_progress indicates planner is working resolution; resolved indicates action completed; cancelled indicates exception no longer valid; deferred indicates postponed to future planning cycle.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planning exception: shortage (demand exceeds supply), excess (supply exceeds demand), reschedule_in (move receipt earlier), reschedule_out (move receipt later), expedite (urgent acceleration needed), cancel (order no longer needed), lead_time_violation (supplier lead time exceeded). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shortage|excess|reschedule_in|reschedule_out|expedite|cancel|lead_time_violation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this exception record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for change tracking and incremental processing.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The standard procurement or production lead time for the material in days. Used to assess feasibility of recommended receipt date and expedite requirements.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The material or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) affected by this planning exception. References the material master record in SAP MM or Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: The MRP controller code or planner ID responsible for resolving this exception. Used for workload assignment and accountability tracking in exception-based planning workflow.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or distribution center where the exception occurred. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA plant master organizational structure.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: The system-recommended action to resolve the exception. Planners review this recommendation and decide whether to accept, modify, or override based on business judgment and constraints not visible to the planning system. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: create_order|expedite_order|reschedule_order|cancel_order|increase_quantity|decrease_quantity|transfer_stock|no_action — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recommended_receipt_date
attributes.description: The MRP or APS system-recommended new receipt date to resolve the exception. Used for reschedule-in and reschedule-out exception types.

attributes.name: resolution_action_taken
attributes.description: Free-text description of the actual action taken by the planner to resolve the exception. May differ from recommended_action if planner used business judgment to override system recommendation.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the planner documenting resolution rationale, coordination with suppliers or customers, constraints considered, or escalations required. Provides audit trail and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the exception was marked as resolved by the planner. Used to calculate resolution cycle time and planner productivity metrics.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The safety stock level defined for the material at this plant. Used to assess whether exception breaches safety stock buffer and requires urgent action.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Business priority of the exception. Critical indicates production stoppage risk; high indicates customer order impact; medium indicates buffer stock impact; low indicates minor planning adjustment.

attributes.name: source_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order, production order, or planned order number that is the source of the exception (e.g., the order that needs to be rescheduled, expedited, or cancelled). Null for shortage exceptions with no existing supply order.

attributes.name: source_order_type
attributes.description: The type of supply order related to this exception. Used to route exception resolution to appropriate procurement, production, or logistics team.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The operational system that generated this exception record (SAP_PP for SAP Production Planning, SAP_MM for SAP Materials Management, DYNAMICS_SCM for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, OPCENTER_APS for Siemens Opcenter Advanced Planning and Scheduling).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the exception quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, M for meter, L for liter). Aligns with material master base UOM.

products.name: inventory_position
products.description: Point-in-time snapshot of the supply planning inventory position for each material-plant combination, capturing on-hand stock, open purchase orders, open planned orders, safety stock target, reorder point, sales order demand, forecast demand, available-to-promise (ATP) quantity, and days of supply. This is the supply planning view used for MRP net requirement calculations and supply/demand balancing — distinct from the inventory domain's physical stock and warehouse location records.
products.reference: SAP MM - Stock/Requirements List (MD04) / Dynamics 365 SCM On-hand

attributes.name: inventory_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory position snapshot record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Inventory Valuation by Cost Center report allocates on‑hand stock value to the owning cost center.

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice_line. Business justification: Financial reporting: Map inventory snapshot to invoiced line items for accurate COGS calculation and audit trails; a standard practice in manufacturing finance.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.mrp_run. Business justification: Inventory position snapshot is generated after an MRP run; linking to mrp_run provides provenance of the snapshot.

attributes.name: service_warranty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_warranty. Business justification: Inventory position is used to manage stock for warranty replacements (Warranty Inventory Management process).

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Inventory snapshots are tied to the SKU master for accurate stock valuation and reporting.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: The ABC classification of the material based on value or consumption volume. A items are high-value/high-volume, B items are medium, C items are low-value/low-volume.

attributes.name: available_to_promise_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material available to promise to new customer orders. Calculated as on-hand plus scheduled receipts minus existing commitments. This is the key metric for order promising and customer service.

attributes.name: average_daily_demand
attributes.description: The average daily consumption or demand rate for the material, used for days-of-supply calculations and replenishment planning.

attributes.name: blocked_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material that is blocked for use due to quality issues, damage, or other restrictions. This stock cannot be used for production or sales.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory position record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: The number of days the current on-hand inventory will last based on average daily demand. Calculated as on-hand quantity divided by average daily consumption rate.

attributes.name: excess_stock_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the material has excess inventory above normal levels. True if on-hand quantity significantly exceeds safety stock plus near-term demand.

attributes.name: forecast_demand_quantity
attributes.description: Total forecasted demand quantity for the material within the planning horizon. This is the statistical forecast used for supply planning when firm sales orders are not yet available.

attributes.name: in_quality_inspection_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently in quality inspection status and not yet released for unrestricted use. This stock is physically available but not yet approved for consumption.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory position record was last updated in the lakehouse. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: last_mrp_run_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Run Date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent MRP run that calculated this inventory position. Used to track data freshness and planning cycle frequency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Material Requirements Planning

attributes.name: lot_size_quantity
attributes.description: The standard lot size or batch quantity used for replenishment orders. This is the fixed order quantity or economic order quantity (EOQ) used in lot-sizing calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Material Requirements Planning

attributes.name: manufacturing_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days required to manufacture the material from raw materials to finished goods. This is the production lead time used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) in the ERP system. This is the business key for the material master record.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered from the supplier or produced in a manufacturing run. MRP respects this constraint when generating planned orders.

attributes.name: mrp_controller_code
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the MRP controller or planner responsible for managing this material. Used for workload distribution and accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Material Requirements Planning

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: The MRP type code that determines how the material is planned. PD = MRP, VB = consumption-based planning, ND = no planning, X0 = no MRP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Material Requirements Planning

attributes.name: net_requirement_quantity
attributes.description: The net material requirement calculated by MRP as total demand minus available supply. A positive value indicates a shortage that requires replenishment action.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Material Requirements Planning

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Physical stock quantity currently available in the warehouse or storage location. This is the unrestricted-use stock available for consumption or sale.

attributes.name: open_planned_order_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material on planned orders generated by MRP but not yet converted to firm production or purchase orders. These are MRP-generated supply recommendations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Material Requirements Planning

attributes.name: open_production_order_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material on open production orders (manufacturing orders) that are in progress or scheduled but not yet completed and received into stock.

attributes.name: open_purchase_order_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material on open purchase orders that have been released to suppliers but not yet received. This represents inbound supply in transit or scheduled for delivery.

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which a planned or open order is scheduled to be received into stock. This is the next expected supply arrival date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Material Requirements Planning

attributes.name: planning_strategy_group
attributes.description: Two-character code defining the planning strategy for the material (e.g., make-to-stock, make-to-order, engineer-to-order). Determines how demand and supply are matched.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or distribution center where the inventory is held.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the material is procured. E = in-house production (manufactured), F = external procurement (purchased), X = both.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered. When on-hand stock falls to or below this level, MRP (Material Requirements Planning) generates a planned order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Material Requirements Planning

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of on-hand stock that has been reserved or allocated for specific production orders, projects, or customer orders and is not available for general consumption.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The target safety stock level maintained to buffer against demand variability and supply uncertainty. This is the minimum inventory level the planner aims to maintain.

attributes.name: sales_order_demand_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material committed to open sales orders. This represents firm customer demand that must be fulfilled.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales and Distribution

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The date for which this inventory position snapshot was calculated. This is the business event date representing the point-in-time view of supply and demand.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this inventory position data was extracted (e.g., SAP, D365 for Dynamics 365, MES for Manufacturing Execution System).

attributes.name: stock_out_risk_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the material is at risk of stock-out based on current inventory position and demand forecast. True if ATP is below safety stock or net requirement is positive.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM Supply Risk Management

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific storage location within the plant where the material is stored.

attributes.name: supplier_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days required from order placement to receipt of material from the supplier. This is the procurement lead time used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the material quantity is measured (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter, M for meter).

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: The XYZ classification of the material based on demand variability. X items have stable demand, Y items have moderate variability, Z items have highly variable or sporadic demand.

products.name: moq_constraint
products.description: Captures Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) and lot-sizing constraints for each material-supplier combination, including MOQ value, order quantity rounding value, maximum order quantity, fixed lot size, and the business justification for the constraint. Tracks MOQ negotiation history and exceptions approved by supply planners. These constraints directly influence MRP lot-size calculations and procurement cost optimization.
products.reference: SAP MM - Purchasing Info Record / Material Master MRP Data

attributes.name: moq_constraint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the MOQ constraint record. Primary key for the moq_constraint product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supply planner or procurement specialist who negotiated this MOQ constraint with the supplier.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this MOQ constraint record.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the material subject to this MOQ constraint. Links to the material master record in the inventory domain.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: MOQ constraints are defined per SKU to enforce minimum order quantities in procurement.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier imposing this MOQ constraint. Links to the supplier master record.

attributes.name: apply_to_forecast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MOQ constraint should be applied to forecast-driven planned orders in addition to customer order-driven requirements.

attributes.name: apply_to_safety_stock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MOQ constraint should be applied when MRP generates planned orders to replenish safety stock levels.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale for this MOQ constraint, including supplier requirements, cost optimization considerations, logistics constraints, or contractual obligations.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Reason for the most recent change to this MOQ constraint, documenting supplier negotiations, market conditions, or business strategy shifts.

attributes.name: constraint_source
attributes.description: Origin or driver of this MOQ constraint, indicating whether it stems from supplier requirements, logistics limitations, cost considerations, or other factors.

attributes.name: constraint_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MOQ constraint. Only active constraints are applied by MRP during planning runs.

attributes.name: constraint_type
attributes.description: Type of lot-sizing constraint applied to this material-supplier combination. Determines how MRP calculates procurement quantities.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the purchasing contract or supplier agreement that defines this MOQ constraint.

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost impact value.

attributes.name: cost_impact_per_unit
attributes.description: Estimated cost impact per unit when ordering below the MOQ threshold. Used for cost-benefit analysis of MOQ exceptions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MOQ constraint record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this MOQ constraint is no longer effective. Null indicates an open-ended constraint with no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this MOQ constraint becomes effective and is applied by MRP planning logic.

attributes.name: exception_approval_authority
attributes.description: Role or position authorized to approve exceptions to this MOQ constraint (e.g., Supply Planning Manager, Procurement Director).

attributes.name: exception_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether exceptions to this MOQ constraint can be approved by supply planners on a case-by-case basis.

attributes.name: fixed_lot_size
attributes.description: Fixed lot size for procurement. When set, MRP generates planned orders in exact multiples of this quantity regardless of net requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MOQ constraint record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this MOQ constraint was last reviewed and validated by supply planning or procurement teams.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum order quantity allowed per purchase order for this material-supplier combination. MRP will split requirements exceeding this limit into multiple planned orders.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the MOQ value (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters). Must align with material base unit or order unit.

attributes.name: moq_value
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity that must be purchased from this supplier for this material. MRP will not generate planned orders below this threshold.

attributes.name: mrp_lot_sizing_procedure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Lot-Sizing Procedure Code
attributes.description: SAP MRP lot-sizing procedure code that incorporates this MOQ constraint (e.g., EX for lot-for-lot with rounding, HB for replenish to maximum stock level).

attributes.name: negotiation_date
attributes.description: Date when this MOQ constraint was negotiated and agreed upon with the supplier.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this MOQ constraint to ensure it remains aligned with business needs and supplier capabilities.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding this MOQ constraint, including special handling instructions, exception history, or supplier communication details.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center code where this MOQ constraint applies. May be null if constraint applies globally across all plants.

attributes.name: previous_moq_value
attributes.description: Previous minimum order quantity value before the most recent change. Used to track MOQ negotiation history and trends.

attributes.name: priority_ranking
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this constraint when multiple MOQ constraints exist for the same material from different suppliers. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization_code
attributes.description: Purchasing organization responsible for negotiating and managing this MOQ constraint.

attributes.name: rounding_value
attributes.description: Rounding increment for order quantities. MRP rounds planned order quantities up to the nearest multiple of this value (e.g., rounding value of 10 means orders in multiples of 10).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this MOQ constraint record originated (e.g., SAP_MM, ARIBA, D365_SCM).

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this MOQ constraint record in the source system, enabling traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: supplier_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from this supplier for this material, associated with orders meeting the MOQ constraint.

attributes.name: supplier_package_quantity
attributes.description: Standard package or container quantity defined by the supplier. Orders must be placed in multiples of this package size.

products.name: demand_plan_version
products.description: Manages versioned demand plan records enabling scenario comparison and consensus planning. Captures plan version identifier, version type (baseline statistical, sales-adjusted, consensus, approved), creation date, planning horizon, total planned demand quantity, and version approval workflow status. Supports S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) processes by maintaining multiple demand scenarios for supply planning sensitivity analysis in Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.
products.reference: Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM - Demand Planning Versions

attributes.name: demand_plan_version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the demand plan version record. Primary key for the demand plan version entity.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent demand plan that this version belongs to. Links to the master demand plan entity.

attributes.name: primary_demand_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who granted final approval for this demand plan version. Links to the user or employee master for audit trail and accountability in the S&OP approval workflow.

attributes.name: superseded_by_version_demand_plan_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer demand plan version that replaces this version. Null if this is the current active version. Maintains version lineage and audit trail for plan evolution tracking.

attributes.name: tertiary_demand_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who most recently modified this demand plan version record. Links to the user or employee master for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this demand plan version was formally approved by authorized stakeholders. Null if version has not yet been approved. Marks the transition to executable plan status.

attributes.name: approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this demand plan version has received formal approval through the S&OP governance process. True if approved for execution, false if still in draft or review.

attributes.name: baseline_version_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this version serves as the baseline reference for variance analysis and scenario comparison. True if this is the authoritative baseline, false for alternative scenarios or working versions.

attributes.name: bias_percentage
attributes.description: Systematic tendency of this demand plan version to over-forecast (positive bias) or under-forecast (negative bias) actual demand. Calculated as the sum of forecast errors divided by sum of actuals, used to detect and correct persistent forecasting errors.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percentage
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level associated with the demand forecast in this version. Represents the probability that actual demand will fall within the forecasted range, typically 80%, 90%, or 95% confidence intervals used for safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this demand plan version record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: demand_time_fence_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the current date within which demand changes are frozen or restricted. Defines the period where MRP (Material Requirements Planning) will not automatically adjust planned orders based on forecast changes, protecting near-term production stability.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Measured accuracy of this demand plan version compared to actual demand realization. Calculated as 100 minus the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), used for continuous improvement of forecasting methods and model selection.

attributes.name: forecast_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the statistical or algorithmic model used to generate demand forecasts in this version (e.g., ARIMA, exponential smoothing, machine learning model). Applicable when planning method is statistical or APS.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM - Demand Forecasting Models

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this demand plan version record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: material_group_code
attributes.description: Product family or material group classification for demand aggregation. Used to organize demand planning at the product category level before disaggregation to individual SKUs (Stock Keeping Units).

attributes.name: planning_horizon_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days covered by this demand plan version. Calculated as the difference between planning horizon end and start dates, used for capacity planning and lead time analysis.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the planning period covered by this demand plan version. Defines the end of the forecast window, typically aligned with fiscal quarters or annual planning cycles.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the planning period covered by this demand plan version. Defines the beginning of the forecast window for supply planning and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) execution.

attributes.name: planning_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to generate this demand plan version. Statistical uses algorithmic forecasting, collaborative incorporates cross-functional input, consensus reflects S&OP agreement, APS (Advanced Planning and Scheduling) uses optimization engines, and manual indicates planner-driven creation.

attributes.name: planning_time_fence_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the current date within which supply planning changes require manual approval. Defines the period where automated MRP adjustments are restricted to prevent disruption to committed production schedules.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center code for which this demand plan version applies. Links to the plant master in SAP PP or Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM for location-specific demand planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Plant Master Data

attributes.name: scenario_name
attributes.description: Business name for the planning scenario represented by this version. Used for what-if analysis and sensitivity testing in S&OP processes (e.g., Optimistic Growth, Conservative Base, Supply Constrained).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the operational system that created or owns this demand plan version record. Typically Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM, SAP APO (Advanced Planning and Optimization), or specialized demand planning applications for data lineage and integration traceability.

attributes.name: total_planned_demand_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate demand quantity across all materials and time buckets within this plan version. Represents the total forecasted demand volume for supply network capacity planning and scenario comparison.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the total planned demand quantity. Typically base inventory unit (EA, KG, L, M) aligned with material master UOM definitions in SAP MM or Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.

attributes.name: version_notes
attributes.description: Free-text commentary and business context for this demand plan version. Captures assumptions, market conditions, promotional events, supply constraints, or other factors influencing the forecast that are relevant for scenario interpretation and decision-making.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the demand plan version. Human-readable version code used for tracking and referencing specific plan iterations (e.g., V1.0, V2.1, BASELINE-2024Q1).

attributes.name: version_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the demand plan version. Tracks the approval workflow state from initial draft through review, approval, and eventual archival or supersession by newer versions.

attributes.name: version_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand plan version indicating its purpose and stage in the S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) process. Baseline represents initial statistical forecast, sales-adjusted includes sales team input, consensus reflects cross-functional agreement, approved is the final authorized plan, and working is an in-progress draft.

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date when this demand plan version was created. Represents the business event timestamp for version instantiation in the S&OP cycle.

products.name: sop_cycle
products.description: Represents a Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle record for the industrial manufacturing business, capturing the monthly integrated business planning process execution. Records planning cycle period, participating business units (automation, electrification, smart infrastructure), demand review status, supply review status, pre-S&OP meeting outcomes, executive S&OP decisions, approved supply plan version, approved demand forecast version, key supply/demand gap resolutions, and financial reconciliation status. Serves as the governance audit record linking demand consensus to supply commitment for each planning period. Managed through Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM integrated business planning.

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the S&OP cycle record. Primary key.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: primary_sop_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user responsible for orchestrating and managing this S&OP cycle. Typically the S&OP manager or demand planning manager.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the S&OP cycle was formally approved by executive leadership, marking the transition to execution phase.

attributes.name: approved_demand_forecast_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the demand forecast approved during this S&OP cycle. Links to the demand forecast master data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management - Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: approved_supply_plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the supply plan approved during this S&OP cycle. Links to the supply plan master data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM and SAP PP/MM.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management - Master Planning

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary business unit participating in this S&OP cycle (e.g., AUTO for Automation, ELEC for Electrification, INFRA for Smart Infrastructure).

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target capacity utilization percentage for manufacturing plants during the planning period. Used to assess supply plan feasibility and identify capacity constraints.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: cost_plan_amount
attributes.description: Total planned cost of goods sold (COGS) for the planning period based on the approved supply plan and material/labor cost assumptions. Used for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this S&OP cycle record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the S&OP cycle, often including the planning period and business context (e.g., 'January 2024 S&OP Cycle - Automation Division').

attributes.name: cycle_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special circumstances, or important observations related to this S&OP cycle.

attributes.name: cycle_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the S&OP cycle, typically formatted as SOP-YYYY-MM representing the planning period.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the S&OP cycle. Tracks progression through demand review, supply review, pre-S&OP meeting, executive S&OP decision, approval, and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|demand_review|supply_review|pre_sop|executive_sop|approved|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: demand_review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the demand review phase was completed and demand consensus was achieved.

attributes.name: demand_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the demand review phase within this S&OP cycle. Tracks completion of demand consensus building across sales, marketing, and product management.

attributes.name: demand_supply_gap_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity gap between demand forecast and supply plan across all materials and time periods within this S&OP cycle. Positive values indicate demand exceeds supply; negative values indicate supply exceeds demand.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: demand_supply_gap_value
attributes.description: Aggregate financial value of the demand-supply gap in base currency. Represents revenue at risk (if demand exceeds supply) or excess inventory exposure (if supply exceeds demand).

attributes.name: executive_sop_decision
attributes.description: Summary of executive decisions made during the executive S&OP meeting, including strategic trade-offs, investment approvals, and final plan authorization.

attributes.name: executive_sop_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date when the executive S&OP meeting was held for final decision-making and plan approval by senior leadership.

attributes.name: financial_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when financial reconciliation was completed and the S&OP plan was aligned with the financial budget.

attributes.name: financial_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of financial reconciliation between the approved S&OP plan and the financial budget. Ensures alignment between operational plans and financial commitments.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year, typically 1-12, used for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
