attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this S&OP cycle belongs, used for financial reconciliation and annual planning alignment.

attributes.name: gap_resolution_strategy
attributes.description: Description of the strategy approved to resolve demand-supply gaps, including capacity expansion, supplier escalation, demand shaping, inventory build, or customer allocation decisions.

attributes.name: inventory_plan_value
attributes.description: Target inventory value at the end of the planning period based on the approved supply plan. Used for working capital planning and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: key_assumptions
attributes.description: Critical assumptions underlying the S&OP plan, including market conditions, customer demand drivers, supplier performance, capacity availability, and economic factors.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this S&OP cycle record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_months
attributes.description: Number of months into the future covered by this S&OP cycle planning horizon. Typically 12-18 months for industrial manufacturing.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning horizon covered by this S&OP cycle. Typically the last day of the month for monthly S&OP cycles.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning horizon covered by this S&OP cycle. Typically the first day of the month for monthly S&OP cycles.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Primary manufacturing plant code for which this S&OP cycle is executed. Links to SAP S/4HANA plant master data.

attributes.name: pre_sop_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date when the pre-S&OP meeting was held to reconcile demand and supply plans and prepare recommendations for executive review.

attributes.name: pre_sop_meeting_outcome
attributes.description: Summary of key decisions, gap resolutions, and recommendations from the pre-S&OP meeting. Captures consensus on demand-supply balance and escalation items for executive S&OP.

attributes.name: revenue_plan_amount
attributes.description: Total planned revenue for the planning period based on the approved demand forecast and pricing assumptions. Used for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this S&OP cycle record originated. Typically Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM integrated business planning module.

attributes.name: supply_review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply review phase was completed and supply commitment was established.

attributes.name: supply_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the supply review phase within this S&OP cycle. Tracks completion of supply capability assessment across manufacturing, procurement, and logistics.

attributes.name: supply_risk_level
attributes.description: Overall supply risk assessment for this S&OP cycle, considering supplier lead times, capacity constraints, material availability, and geopolitical factors.

attributes.name: supply_risk_mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Description of actions planned to mitigate identified supply risks, including supplier diversification, safety stock increases, or alternative sourcing strategies.

products.name: allocation
products.description: Records supply allocation decisions made when available supply is insufficient to meet total demand across the industrial manufacturing portfolio. Specifies how constrained supply of automation components, electrification modules, or smart infrastructure products is distributed across OEM customers, regional distribution centers, plants, or product lines. Captures allocation quantity, allocation priority, allocation method (proportional, priority-based, customer-tier, contractual commitment), allocation period, demand requests being fulfilled or partially fulfilled, and the constraining supply plan reference. Critical for managing semiconductor shortages, long-lead-time component constraints, and force majeure events in industrial manufacturing supply chains.
products.reference: SAP ATP - Supply Allocation / Dynamics 365 SCM Allocation

attributes.name: allocation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for allocation

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account receiving the allocation when allocation_recipient_type is customer or oem_partner.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain manager or executive who approved this allocation decision.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Allocation of supply to specific sales order lines is required for the 'Order Fulfillment Allocation' process, ensuring each line's quantity is matched to available supply.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the automation component, electrification module, or smart infrastructure product being allocated.

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_contract. Business justification: Allocation of supply quantities to fulfill obligations under specific service contracts (Contract Allocation dashboard).

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Allocation records allocate available supply to specific SKUs for order fulfillment.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier whose capacity or delivery constraints triggered the allocation decision.

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the constrained supply plan that triggered this allocation decision.

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material allocated to the recipient entity (customer, plant, distribution center, or product line).

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Algorithm or business rule used to distribute constrained supply across competing demand requests.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique allocation identifier used for tracking and reference in supply chain communications.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the allocation decision in the supply chain workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|proposed|approved|active|partially_fulfilled|fulfilled|cancelled|superseded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the allocation decision was formally approved for execution.

attributes.name: available_supply_quantity
attributes.description: Total constrained supply quantity available for allocation across all competing demand requests.

attributes.name: communication_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether allocation notification has been sent to the affected customer or recipient entity.

attributes.name: communication_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when allocation notification was sent to the recipient.

attributes.name: constraint_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the supply constraint circumstances, including supplier names, affected components, and expected resolution timeline.

attributes.name: constraint_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the supply constraint that necessitated this allocation decision.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the supply contract or SLA that mandates this allocation when contractual_commitment_flag is true.

attributes.name: contractual_commitment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation fulfills a contractual supply commitment or service level agreement (SLA) obligation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_tier
attributes.description: Customer segmentation tier used in priority-based or customer-tier allocation methods to determine allocation preference.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the allocation decision was made by the supply planning team or automated allocation engine.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation decision required executive escalation due to high business impact or customer sensitivity.

attributes.name: expected_resolution_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the supply constraint will be resolved and normal supply levels restored.

attributes.name: fulfillment_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of requested quantity that was allocated, calculated as (allocated_quantity / requested_quantity) * 100.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation record was last updated or revised.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special considerations, exceptions, or business rationale for the allocation decision.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the time period for which this allocation decision is effective.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the time period for which this allocation decision is effective.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or distribution center where the constrained supply originates.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking assigned to this allocation decision, where lower numbers indicate higher priority in fulfillment sequencing.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the product line receiving the allocation when allocation_recipient_type is product_line.

attributes.name: recipient_distribution_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regional distribution center receiving the allocation when allocation_recipient_type is distribution_center.

attributes.name: recipient_plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the recipient plant when allocation_recipient_type is plant.

attributes.name: recipient_type
attributes.description: Type of entity receiving the allocated supply, used to determine the appropriate recipient identifier field.

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Original quantity requested by the recipient before allocation constraints were applied.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that created this allocation record (e.g., D365_SCM for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, SAP_PP for SAP Production Planning).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the allocated quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, M for meter).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the allocation decision, incremented when allocation is revised or rebalanced.

products.name: replenishment_proposal
products.description: Consolidates MRP-generated replenishment proposals for buyer/planner review before conversion to purchase orders or production orders. Captures proposal type (purchase requisition, planned production order, stock transfer), proposed quantity, proposed dates, supplying source, proposal status (open, firmed, converted, rejected), and planner override details. Represents the actionable output of MRP runs requiring human review in SAP MM/PP.

attributes.name: replenishment_proposal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the replenishment proposal record. Primary key.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for which replenishment is proposed.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MRP run that generated this replenishment proposal.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Replenishment proposals are triggered by individual sales orders; linking to order_header enables the 'Replenishment Proposal Generation' report.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.plant

attributes.name: primary_replenishment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who firmed this proposal, locking it from automatic MRP adjustments.

attributes.name: quote_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote_line. Business justification: Replenishment proposals are derived from quoted line items to ensure stock for quoted sales.

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.request. Business justification: Replenishment proposals are generated from field service requests for spare parts (Service‑Driven Replenishment process).

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Replenishment proposals are generated per SKU to trigger purchase orders or production.

attributes.name: source_plant_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.plant

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preferred or proposed supplier for external procurement proposals. Null for in-house production proposals.

attributes.name: converted_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the purchase order, production order, or stock transport order created from this proposal. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: converted_document_type
attributes.description: Type of execution document created when the proposal was converted: purchase_order, production_order, stock_transport_order, or subcontract_order. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: converted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the proposal was converted into a purchase order, production order, or stock transport order.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment proposal record was first created in the system, typically during MRP run execution.

attributes.name: exception_message_code
attributes.description: MRP exception or warning code associated with this proposal (e.g., reschedule in, reschedule out, cancel, increase quantity, decrease quantity). Alerts planner to abnormal conditions.

attributes.name: exception_message_text
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the MRP exception or planning situation requiring planner attention.

attributes.name: firmed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proposal has been firmed by the planner. Firmed proposals are protected from automatic MRP changes in subsequent runs.

attributes.name: firmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the proposal was firmed by the planner.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment proposal record was last updated, capturing planner actions, status changes, or subsequent MRP run adjustments.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total procurement or production lead time in days used to calculate the proposed order date from the requirement date. Includes processing, manufacturing, and transit time.

attributes.name: lot_sizing_procedure
attributes.description: Algorithm used by MRP to determine the proposed quantity: lot_for_lot (exact requirement), fixed_lot_size (standard batch), economic_order_quantity (EOQ optimization), period_lot_size (aggregate period demand), or replenish_to_max (fill to maximum stock level).

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity constraint applied during MRP calculation, typically driven by supplier requirements or production batch minimums.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master MRP View

attributes.name: mrp_controller_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP controller or buyer/planner responsible for reviewing and actioning this proposal.

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the planner documenting decisions, overrides, or special handling instructions for this proposal.

attributes.name: planner_override_date
attributes.description: Manually adjusted delivery date entered by the planner, overriding the MRP-calculated proposed delivery date. Null if no override applied.

attributes.name: planner_override_quantity
attributes.description: Manually adjusted quantity entered by the planner, overriding the MRP-calculated proposed quantity. Null if no override applied.

attributes.name: planning_time_fence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this proposal falls within the planning time fence period where automatic MRP changes are restricted and planner approval is required for modifications.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Urgency level assigned to the proposal: critical (immediate action required), high (expedited processing), normal (standard lead time), or low (can be delayed if needed).

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Method of procurement for the material: external (purchased from supplier), in_house (manufactured internally), or both (mixed procurement strategy).
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Procurement View

attributes.name: proposal_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the replenishment proposal, typically system-generated or following organizational numbering convention.

attributes.name: proposal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment proposal: open (awaiting planner review), firmed (approved by planner but not yet converted), converted (transformed into purchase order or production order), rejected (declined by planner), cancelled (voided due to changed requirements), or on_hold (temporarily suspended).

attributes.name: proposal_type
attributes.description: Type of replenishment action proposed by MRP: purchase requisition for external procurement, planned production order for in-house manufacturing, stock transfer request for inter-plant movement, subcontract order for external processing, or external procurement for direct vendor shipment.

attributes.name: proposed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the material should be available to meet demand requirements, calculated by MRP based on lead time and requirement date.

attributes.name: proposed_order_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition or production order should be created to meet the proposed delivery date, accounting for procurement or manufacturing lead time.

attributes.name: proposed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material recommended by MRP for replenishment, calculated based on net requirements, lot sizing rules, and safety stock policies.

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities for this material category. Used for purchase requisition routing.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the planner rejected this proposal (e.g., obsolete material, demand cancelled, alternative source selected). Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_text
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the proposal was rejected by the planner. Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers replenishment proposal generation in reorder point planning scenarios.

attributes.name: requirement_date
attributes.description: Original date when the material is needed to satisfy customer orders, production schedules, or safety stock targets. Drives the MRP calculation.

attributes.name: rounding_value
attributes.description: Rounding increment applied to the proposed quantity to align with packaging, pallet, or container standards (e.g., round to nearest 10, 50, or 100 units).
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master MRP View

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Safety stock level maintained for this material at this location. MRP generates proposals to maintain this buffer against demand variability.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master MRP View

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that generated this replenishment proposal (e.g., SAP_PP, D365_SCM, APS_SYSTEM).

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Specific storage location within the plant where the replenished material will be received and stored.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the proposed quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter, M for meter).

products.name: planning_parameter
products.description: Stores the configurable planning parameters that govern MRP and APS behavior for each material-plant combination, including planning strategy (make-to-stock, make-to-order, assemble-to-order), planning horizon, time fence (firm zone, trade-off zone, planning zone), lot-sizing procedure, planning calendar, and MRP controller assignment. These parameters directly control how the supply planning engine generates planned orders and requirements.
products.reference: SAP MM - Material Master MRP1/MRP2/MRP3 Views

attributes.name: planning_parameter_id
attributes.description: Primary key for planning_parameter

attributes.name: planning_calendar_id
attributes.description: Factory calendar identifier that defines working days, holidays, and shifts used to schedule planned order dates and calculate lead times.

attributes.name: primary_planning_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the planner or administrator who created this planning parameter configuration record.

attributes.name: primary_planning_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for which these planning parameters apply.

attributes.name: process_parameter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.process_parameter. Business justification: Connects planning parameters to defined process parameters, enabling the Production Planning‑Execution Alignment report that validates parameter consistency.

attributes.name: sku_master_id

domains.name: logistics
domains.description: Inbound and outbound logistics domain managing shipment planning, carrier selection, LTL/FTL routing, freight cost, customs documentation, TMS execution, delivery tracking, route optimization, and distribution network management. Coordinates material flow from suppliers to plants and finished goods from plants to customers.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Core transactional entity representing an individual shipment of goods — inbound (supplier to plant) or outbound (plant to customer/DC). Tracks shipment number, direction (inbound/outbound), mode (LTL/FTL/parcel/rail/air/ocean), origin and destination locations, scheduled and actual departure/arrival dates, total weight, total volume, freight class, hazmat flag, shipment status (planned/tendered/in-transit/delivered/exception), TMS reference number, carrier SCAC code, PRO number, BOL number, service level (standard/expedited/priority), and consolidation group for load planning. Includes embedded multi-leg routing structure: leg sequence, leg origin/destination nodes, per-leg carrier assignment, per-leg transport mode, intermodal transfer points, leg distances (km/miles), per-leg scheduled/actual timestamps, leg status, per-leg freight costs, and cross-dock/transshipment/relay indicators. Serves as the central transactional entity and SSOT for all transport execution within the logistics domain, linking freight orders, tracking events, delivery documents, customs declarations, and carrier contracts.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shipment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier_contract. Business justification: Associate each shipment with the carrier contract that governs rates and terms.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Link shipment to carrier for authoritative carrier data; carrier_scac_code and carrier_name become redundant.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Shipments incur costs that must be charged to a cost center. Adding cost_center_id (FK → finance.cost_center.cost_center_id) provides the necessary financial linkage.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Shipment Creation Audit requires recording which employee created the shipment record for compliance and traceability.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Required for outbound shipping confirmation and customer billing report linking each shipment to the billed customer.

attributes.name: engineering_revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.revision. Business justification: Shipment Traceability Report requires linking each shipment to the engineering revision of the component shipped for compliance and recall tracking.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Shipment execution is driven by a sales order; linking enables order fulfillment tracking and status reporting.

attributes.name: origin_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.node. Business justification: Replace raw origin address fields with a foreign key to node, enabling reuse of node master data.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability reporting per shipment requires linking each shipment to its profit_center for margin analysis.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Project Delivery Tracking report requires each shipment to be assigned to its project for status and cost aggregation.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Required for shipment manifest and product traceability; enables recall, compliance, and cost allocation reports linking each shipment to the shipped SKU.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: INBOUND_SHIPMENT_REPORT requires linking each shipment to its originating supplier for performance tracking and inbound logistics KPI reporting.

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.plan. Business justification: Shipment creation is driven by an approved supply plan; linking enables the 'Supply Plan to Shipment' execution traceability report.

products.name: delivery_note
products.description: Delivery document serving as the SSOT for all inbound and outbound physical goods movement authorization and tracking within the logistics domain. For outbound: delivery note number, sales order reference, ship-to party, delivery date, picking status, goods issue status, packing list details, incoterms, and export control classification. For inbound: inbound delivery number, purchase order reference, supplier ID, plant/storage location destination, expected and actual goods receipt dates, quantity ordered vs. received, over/under delivery tolerance, GR status, and material document number. Captures direction discriminator (inbound/outbound), total net/gross weight, packing contents, and MRP integration for inventory replenishment. products.name: carrier
products.description: Master record for approved transportation carriers (trucking companies, freight forwarders, rail operators, ocean carriers, air cargo carriers, parcel couriers). Captures carrier SCAC code, carrier name, carrier type, DOT/MC number, IATA/ICAO code, insurance certificate expiry, safety rating, contract status, preferred lanes, payment terms, EDI capability flag, and TMS integration status. Serves as the SSOT for carrier identity within the logistics domain.

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date

attributes.name: contract_status

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: dot_number

attributes.name: iata_code

products.name: carrier_contract
products.description: Negotiated rate and service agreement between Manufacturing and a carrier, serving as the single source of truth (SSOT) for ALL carrier pricing within the logistics domain — including contract rates, spot rates, and benchmark rates. Captures contract-level terms (effective/expiry dates, volume commitments, service level guarantees, penalty clauses, payment terms) and granular lane-level rate records (per cwt, per mile, per shipment, per pallet by origin-destination zone/postal code range, freight class, weight break, and service level). Includes fuel surcharge schedules, accessorial charge tables, rate basis (weight break/flat/distance), rate currency, rate effective date ranges, rate source classification (contract/spot/benchmark), minimum volume thresholds, and rate validity periods. Used by TMS for automated carrier selection, freight cost calculation, spot rate benchmarking, and freight invoice audit. No other entity in this domain stores rate data.

products.name: freight_invoice
products.description: Carrier-issued freight invoice submitted for payment of transportation services rendered. attributes.name: invoice_number

attributes.name: invoiced_amount

attributes.name: line_haul_charge

attributes.name: pickup_date

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of transportation service provided: Less Than Truckload (LTL), Full Truckload (FTL), parcel, intermodal, air freight, ocean freight, or rail. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LTL|FTL|parcel|intermodal|air|ocean|rail — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the shipment in kilograms as recorded on the freight invoice. Used for rate validation and freight class determination.

products.name: transport_route
products.description: Defined transportation route or lane between an origin node (plant, DC, supplier) and a destination node (customer, DC, port), capturing route code, origin and destination location codes, primary transport mode, standard transit time (days), distance (km), preferred carrier, alternate carriers, route type (direct/relay/intermodal), seasonal restrictions, and route optimization parameters. Used by TMS for automated routing and load planning.

attributes.name: transport_route_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transport route. Primary key for the transport route entity.

attributes.name: preferred_carrier_id

attributes.name: alternate_carrier_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of alternate carrier codes that can be used for this route if the preferred carrier is unavailable or for load balancing.

attributes.name: carbon_emission_factor_kg_per_km

attributes.name: cost_currency_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customs_clearance_required

attributes.name: destination_country_code

attributes.name: destination_location_code

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_applicable

attributes.name: hazmat_approved

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transport route record was last updated, used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this route was last reviewed for performance, cost, and optimization opportunities.

attributes.name: load_type
attributes.description: Classification of shipment load type for this route: FTL (Full Truckload), LTL (Less Than Truckload), parcel (small package), container (ocean/rail), or bulk (loose cargo).

attributes.name: maximum_transit_time_days

attributes.name: minimum_transit_time_days

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.name: optimization_priority

attributes.name: origin_country_code

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the origin node (plant, distribution center, supplier facility, or port) where the shipment begins. Aligns with internal location master or UN/LOCODE for ports.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: origin_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the origin location for reporting and operational visibility.

attributes.name: primary_transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used for this route: road (truck), rail, air (cargo flight), ocean (container ship), inland waterway (barge), or pipeline.

attributes.name: route_capacity_constraint

attributes.name: route_name

products.name: node
products.description: Master record for all physical nodes in the distribution network — manufacturing plants, distribution centers, cross-dock facilities, ports of entry, customs bonded warehouses, customer delivery points, and supplier pickup locations. Captures node code, node type, address, GPS coordinates, operating hours, dock door count, handling equipment available, customs bonded status, free trade zone flag, TMS location ID, and yard capacity. Serves as the SSOT for network location data within the logistics domain and the reference entity for transport route origin/destination definitions and delivery appointment scheduling.

products.name: customs_declaration
products.description: Customs and trade compliance master document for cross-border shipments, serving as the SSOT for ALL customs declarations AND trade compliance screening within the logistics domain. Captures declaration number, declaration type (import/export/transit), shipment reference, country of origin, country of destination, HS tariff codes, declared value, currency, incoterms, customs broker ID, entry date, customs clearance status, duty amount, VAT amount, bond number, export license number, regulatory hold flags. Embeds full compliance screening workflow: denied party screening results, export control classification (ECCN), applicable regulations (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual-Use), screening outcome (cleared/flagged/blocked), compliance officer ID, resolution notes, license type and number, embargo check results, and dual-use classification determinations. No other entity in this domain stores trade compliance or export control screening data.
products.reference: CBP Entry / AES Filing / SAD (Single Administrative Document)
