products.name: load_plan
products.description: Load planning record created during shipment consolidation and load building, capturing load plan number, planned load date, origin facility, transport mode, vehicle/container type, planned carrier, total planned weight, total planned volume, utilization percentage, number of shipments consolidated, load sequence, and load plan status (draft/confirmed/executed). Supports LTL consolidation, FTL optimization, and cube utilization management.

attributes.name: load_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the load plan record. Primary key for the load plan entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Load planning expenses are charged to a cost center for OPEX tracking.

attributes.name: destination_facility_logistics_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, plant, distribution center, or customer site to which the load is destined.

attributes.name: planned_carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the carrier or logistics service provider selected to execute this load plan.

attributes.name: primary_load_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this load plan record, used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_load_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, plant, or distribution center from which the load originates.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Load Planning for a project’s equipment shipment must reference the project to coordinate schedules and resources.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Tie a load plan to the shipment it is planning, enabling direct navigation from load plan to shipment.

attributes.name: transport_route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the planned transportation route associated with this load plan, linking to route optimization and network planning.

attributes.name: actual_load_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the load was physically assembled and loaded, used for performance tracking against planned date.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the bill of lading document issued for this load, serving as the legal contract of carriage and receipt.

attributes.name: carrier_service_level
attributes.description: The service level agreement tier selected for this load, determining transit time commitments and handling requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this load plan record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: customs_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this load requires customs clearance due to cross-border transportation, triggering documentation and compliance workflows.

attributes.name: dock_door_assignment
attributes.description: The specific dock door or loading bay assigned for loading this shipment at the origin facility, used for warehouse execution coordination.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: The estimated date when the load is expected to arrive at the destination facility, calculated from planned departure and transit time.

attributes.name: estimated_freight_cost
attributes.description: The estimated total freight cost for this load plan based on carrier rates, distance, weight, and service level. Used for cost planning and budget tracking.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: estimated_transit_time_hours
attributes.description: The estimated total transit time from origin to destination in hours, used for delivery promise calculation and customer communication.

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated freight cost, supporting multi-currency logistics operations.

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: The UN hazard class code for hazardous materials in this load, used for regulatory compliance and carrier certification requirements.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The Incoterms code defining the division of costs and responsibilities between buyer and seller for international shipments in this load. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this load plan record was last modified, used for audit trail and data currency tracking.

attributes.name: load_optimization_method
attributes.description: The method used to build and optimize this load plan, indicating the level of automation and sophistication in load planning.

attributes.name: load_plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the load plan, externally visible and used for tracking and communication with carriers and warehouse teams.

attributes.name: load_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the load plan indicating its progression through planning, execution, and completion stages.

attributes.name: load_sequence_number
attributes.description: The sequential order in which this load plan is scheduled within a batch of loads for the same route or time window, used for dock scheduling.

attributes.name: loading_end_time
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual timestamp when loading operations were completed for this load plan, used for cycle time analysis and efficiency tracking.

attributes.name: loading_start_time
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual timestamp when loading operations began for this load plan, used for labor tracking and performance measurement.

attributes.name: number_of_handling_units
attributes.description: The total count of handling units (cartons, crates, drums, etc.) included in this load plan, used for labor planning and tracking.

attributes.name: number_of_pallets
attributes.description: The total count of pallets included in this load plan, used for loading sequence planning and warehouse space allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 6780 Flat Pallets for Intercontinental Materials Handling

attributes.name: number_of_shipments
attributes.description: The count of individual shipment records consolidated into this load plan, used for LTL consolidation tracking and load complexity assessment.

attributes.name: planned_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: The scheduled date and time when the loaded vehicle or container is planned to depart from the origin facility.

attributes.name: planned_load_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date when the load is planned to be assembled and loaded onto the transport vehicle or container.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The business priority assigned to this load plan, influencing carrier selection, routing decisions, and resource allocation.

attributes.name: requires_hazmat_handling
attributes.description: Indicates whether this load contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, documentation, and certified carriers.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: requires_temperature_control
attributes.description: Indicates whether this load requires temperature-controlled transportation (refrigerated or heated) to maintain product integrity.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the security seal applied to the loaded container or trailer, used for tamper detection and chain of custody.

attributes.name: shipment_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Shipment Type (Less Than Truckload (LTL) / Full Truckload (FTL))
attributes.description: Classification of the shipment based on load size and carrier service type. LTL indicates consolidated shipments sharing vehicle space; FTL indicates exclusive use of vehicle capacity.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling, loading, or delivery instructions that must be communicated to warehouse staff and carriers.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable temperature in Celsius for temperature-controlled loads, used for carrier selection and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable temperature in Celsius for temperature-controlled loads, used for carrier selection and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: total_planned_volume_m3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Planned Volume in Cubic Meters (m³)
attributes.description: The total planned volume of all shipments and materials consolidated into this load, measured in cubic meters, used for cube utilization optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: total_planned_weight_kg
attributes.description: The total planned weight of all shipments and materials consolidated into this load, measured in kilograms, used for capacity planning and compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The primary mode of transportation used for this load plan, determining routing and carrier selection strategies.

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: The type of vehicle or container required for this load, based on cargo characteristics and transportation requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dry_van|refrigerated|flatbed|tanker|container_20ft|container_40ft|box_truck — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: volume_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of vehicle or container volume capacity utilized by this load plan, calculated as (total planned volume / vehicle volume capacity) * 100. Also known as cube utilization.

attributes.name: weight_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of vehicle or container weight capacity utilized by this load plan, calculated as (total planned weight / vehicle weight capacity) * 100.

products.name: delivery_appointment
products.description: Scheduled delivery or pickup appointment at a logistics node (plant dock, DC, customer facility), capturing appointment number, appointment type (inbound/outbound), scheduled date and time window, dock door assignment, carrier and driver details, vehicle type and license plate, appointment status (scheduled/confirmed/checked-in/completed/missed/cancelled), actual arrival and departure times, and wait time. Supports dock scheduling and yard management.

attributes.name: delivery_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery appointment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation carrier or logistics service provider responsible for the shipment. Links to carrier master data for performance tracking and contract compliance.

attributes.name: driver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Delivery Appointment Management assigns an internal driver (employee) to each appointment, needed for dispatch planning and labor costing.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Delivery appointments are scheduled based on a sales order; linking supports SLA monitoring and order‑to‑appointment traceability.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Delivery Appointment scheduling reports tie appointments to the project to monitor on‑site delivery performance.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Delivery appointments are scheduled for PO deliveries; linking supports dock scheduling and PO fulfillment status.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record associated with this appointment. Links the dock appointment to the broader transportation execution and order fulfillment process.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse, distribution center, or plant facility where the appointment is scheduled. Links to facility master data for location-specific dock scheduling rules.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the carrier vehicle arrived at the facility gate or dock area. Used to calculate wait time, on-time performance, and dock utilization metrics.

attributes.name: actual_departure_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the carrier vehicle departed the facility after completing loading or unloading operations. Used to calculate dwell time and dock turnaround efficiency.

attributes.name: appointment_created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person or system that created the appointment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: appointment_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the appointment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and appointment lead time analysis.

attributes.name: appointment_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person or system that last modified the appointment record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: appointment_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the appointment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and tracking appointment changes or rescheduling.

attributes.name: appointment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique appointment number used for scheduling and tracking. Externally visible identifier for dock scheduling systems and carrier communications.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery appointment. Scheduled when initially created, confirmed when carrier acknowledges, checked-in when vehicle arrives at gate, in-progress during loading/unloading, completed when finished, missed if carrier no-show, cancelled if appointment voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|confirmed|checked_in|in_progress|completed|missed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the appointment direction and purpose. Inbound for receiving materials from suppliers, outbound for shipping finished goods to customers, cross-dock for direct transfer, return for RMA processing, transfer for inter-facility movement, pickup for carrier collection.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the bill of lading document associated with this appointment. Legal document serving as receipt of goods and contract of carriage.
attributes.references: UCC Article 7 - Warehouse Receipts and Bills of Lading

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the appointment was cancelled. Used for root cause analysis of scheduling disruptions and carrier performance issues.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management System - Corrective Action

attributes.name: check_in_time
attributes.description: Date and time when the carrier checked in at the facility reception or guard gate. Marks the official start of the appointment process and triggers dock assignment workflow.

attributes.name: customs_entry_number
attributes.description: Customs entry or declaration number for international shipments. Required for import/export compliance and duty payment tracking.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System and Customs Procedures

attributes.name: customs_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment requires customs clearance for international trade. True for cross-border shipments, false for domestic movements.
attributes.references: WCO World Customs Organization Framework of Standards

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Physical dock door or bay identifier assigned to this appointment. Used by warehouse management systems and yard management systems to direct carriers to the correct loading/unloading location.

attributes.name: driver_license_number
attributes.description: Government-issued driver license number of the vehicle operator. Required for facility access control, insurance verification, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FMCSA Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration Regulations

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the driver operating the vehicle for this appointment. Captured for security, safety compliance, and delivery verification purposes.

attributes.name: driver_phone_number
attributes.description: Contact phone number for the driver. Used for real-time communication regarding appointment changes, dock assignments, or delivery issues.

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes the vehicle spent at the facility from arrival to departure. Used to measure dock turnaround efficiency and identify bottlenecks in loading/unloading operations.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: facility_location_code
attributes.description: Business location code identifying the specific plant, distribution center, or warehouse site. Used for multi-site logistics network management and reporting.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: load_type
attributes.description: Method of loading or unloading operation. Live load/unload means driver waits while cargo is handled, drop trailer means trailer is left for later processing, drop-and-hook means simultaneous trailer exchange.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text field for additional comments, observations, or instructions related to the appointment. Used for operational communication and issue documentation.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority classification for the appointment. Urgent for expedited shipments, high for time-sensitive deliveries, normal for standard operations, low for flexible scheduling.

attributes.name: requires_hazmat_handling_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, documentation, and safety protocols per DOT and OSHA regulations.

attributes.name: requires_refrigeration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment requires temperature-controlled handling. True for cold chain logistics, false for ambient temperature cargo.

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Sales order number for outbound appointments shipping finished goods to customers. Links the delivery to order management and accounts receivable processes.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales and Distribution Module

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the delivery or pickup appointment is scheduled to occur. Used for day-level dock capacity planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the appointment window closes. Defines the latest time by which loading or unloading operations should be completed to maintain dock schedule integrity.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the appointment window begins. Defines the earliest time the carrier should arrive at the dock door for loading or unloading operations.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the security seal applied to the trailer or container. Used for cargo security, customs compliance, and tamper detection.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special requirements or instructions for the appointment such as hazardous materials handling, temperature control, security protocols, or equipment needs.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the trailer or container being loaded or unloaded. Used for yard spotting, asset tracking, and cross-docking operations.

attributes.name: vehicle_license_plate
attributes.description: Government-issued license plate number of the vehicle. Used for yard management, security tracking, and facility access control.
attributes.references: ISO 3166 Country Codes for Vehicle Registration

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transportation vehicle used for the delivery or pickup. FTL (Full Truckload) for dedicated loads, LTL (Less Than Truckload) for consolidated shipments, specialized types for specific cargo requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ftl_truck|ltl_truck|box_truck|flatbed|tanker|refrigerated|intermodal_container|van — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wait_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes between carrier arrival and start of loading/unloading operations. Key performance indicator for dock efficiency and carrier service level agreements.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

products.name: dangerous_goods_declaration
products.description: Hazardous materials / dangerous goods declaration required for shipments containing regulated substances (chemicals, batteries, compressed gases). Captures DG declaration number, UN number, proper shipping name, hazard class and packing group, net quantity, gross quantity, packaging type, emergency contact information, shipper certification, transport mode-specific compliance (IATA DGR for air, IMDG for ocean, DOT 49 CFR for road), and special provisions. Ensures regulatory compliance for hazmat transport.
products.reference: IATA DGR / IMDG / DOT 49 CFR Hazmat Declaration

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_declaration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dangerous goods declaration record.

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: DG Declaration Preparation must be signed off by a qualified employee, required for regulatory compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment containing the dangerous goods.

attributes.name: applicable_regulation
attributes.description: Primary regulatory framework governing this dangerous goods shipment (IATA DGR for air, IMDG for ocean, DOT 49 CFR for US road, ADR for European road, RID for rail).
attributes.references: IATA DGR, IMDG Code, 49 CFR, ADR, RID

attributes.name: authorization_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any special authorization, approval, or exemption granted by the competent authority for this dangerous goods shipment.

attributes.name: cargo_aircraft_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dangerous goods are restricted to cargo aircraft only and prohibited on passenger aircraft per IATA DGR.

attributes.name: competent_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority that issued any special authorization or approval for this dangerous goods shipment.

attributes.name: consignee_address
attributes.description: Full address of the consignee receiving the dangerous goods.

attributes.name: consignee_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the organization or individual receiving the dangerous goods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dangerous goods declaration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: declaration_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized person who approved the dangerous goods declaration for shipment.

attributes.name: declaration_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dangerous goods declaration was approved.

attributes.name: declaration_number
attributes.description: Unique externally-known dangerous goods declaration number issued for regulatory tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: declaration_prepared_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who prepared the dangerous goods declaration.

attributes.name: declaration_prepared_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dangerous goods declaration was prepared.

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dangerous goods declaration.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the person or organization to contact in case of emergency during transport of dangerous goods.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency response telephone number for incidents involving the dangerous goods.

attributes.name: excepted_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dangerous goods qualify for excepted quantity provisions allowing further regulatory relief.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dangerous goods declaration expires and is no longer valid for shipment.

attributes.name: flash_point_celsius
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors of the substance will ignite when exposed to an ignition source, measured in degrees Celsius. Required for flammable liquids.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the dangerous goods including packaging, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Primary hazard classification of the dangerous goods (e.g., explosives, flammable liquids, toxic substances, corrosives). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|1.1|1.2|1.3|1.4|1.5|1.6|2.1|2.2|2.3|3|4.1|4.2|4.3|5.1|5.2|6.1|6.2|7|8|9 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA DGR, IMDG Code, 49 CFR Part 173

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dangerous goods declaration record was last modified.

attributes.name: limited_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dangerous goods qualify for limited quantity exemptions allowing relaxed packaging and labeling requirements.

attributes.name: marine_pollutant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dangerous goods are classified as a marine pollutant per IMDG Code.

attributes.name: net_quantity
attributes.description: Net quantity of the dangerous goods excluding packaging weight.

attributes.name: net_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the net quantity (kilograms, liters, grams, etc.).

attributes.name: number_of_packages
attributes.description: Total count of packages containing the dangerous goods in this declaration.

attributes.name: packaging_instruction
attributes.description: Specific packaging instruction code from the applicable dangerous goods regulation (e.g., P001, IBC02, LP02).

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging used for the dangerous goods (e.g., drum, box, cylinder, IBC).
attributes.references: IATA DGR, IMDG Code, 49 CFR Part 178

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: Degree of danger presented by the substance: I (high danger), II (medium danger), III (low danger).

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: Official technical name of the dangerous goods as specified in regulatory dangerous goods lists (IATA, IMDG, DOT).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional remarks, handling instructions, or special notes related to the dangerous goods declaration.

attributes.name: shipper_address
attributes.description: Full address of the shipper of the dangerous goods.

attributes.name: shipper_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shipper certified the dangerous goods declaration.

attributes.name: shipper_certification_signature
attributes.description: Digital signature or name of the authorized person who certified the dangerous goods declaration on behalf of the shipper.

attributes.name: shipper_certification_statement
attributes.description: Regulatory-required certification statement signed by the shipper attesting that the dangerous goods are properly classified, packaged, marked, and labeled.

attributes.name: shipper_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the organization or individual shipping the dangerous goods.

attributes.name: special_provisions
attributes.description: Special provision codes or exemptions applicable to this dangerous goods shipment as specified in the regulation.

attributes.name: subsidiary_hazard_class
attributes.description: Secondary hazard classification if the dangerous goods exhibit multiple hazardous properties.

attributes.name: technical_name
attributes.description: Chemical or technical name of the dangerous goods constituent, required when the proper shipping name is a generic N.O.S. (not otherwise specified) entry.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation for which this dangerous goods declaration is prepared (air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal).

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number assigned to the hazardous substance per UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

products.name: freight_claim
products.description: Formal claim filed against a carrier for loss, damage, shortage, or delay of goods in transit. Captures claim number, claim type (loss/damage/shortage/delay), filing date, carrier ID, shipment and BOL reference, claimed amount, supporting documentation list, carrier response date, settlement offer, settlement amount, claim status (filed/acknowledged/under-review/settled/denied/escalated), and subrogation flag. Manages the full freight claims lifecycle.

attributes.name: freight_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the freight claim record. Primary key.

attributes.name: adjuster_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Freight Claim processing assigns an adjuster employee, needed for claim tracking, accountability, and cost analysis.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier against whom the claim is filed.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Freight claim settlements need cost center allocation for expense reconciliation.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Enables claim processing to attribute liability and settlements to the correct customer account.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Freight claim processing references the original sales order to determine liability, compensation, and financial impact.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Freight Claim settlement process allocates claim amounts to the responsible project for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Freight claim is filed against a shipment generated for a PO; linking enables claim processing and PO cost variance reporting.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record associated with this freight claim.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Connects freight damage claims to the affected SKU; enables claim analysis, warranty cost tracking, and root‑cause reporting.

attributes.name: assigned_adjuster_email
attributes.description: Email address of the carrier claims adjuster handling this claim.

attributes.name: assigned_adjuster_name
attributes.description: Name of the claims adjuster or handler assigned by the carrier to review and process this claim.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number that serves as the contract of carriage and receipt for the goods. Critical document reference for claim substantiation.

attributes.name: carrier_response_date
attributes.description: Date when the carrier formally acknowledged or responded to the freight claim. Used to track carrier compliance with response time requirements.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique claim reference number assigned by the claimant or carrier for tracking and correspondence.

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the freight claim in the resolution workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filed|acknowledged|under_review|pending_documentation|settled|denied|escalated|withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the freight claim based on the nature of the incident: loss (goods missing), damage (goods harmed), shortage (quantity discrepancy), delay (late delivery), concealed damage (damage discovered after delivery), or refused shipment.

attributes.name: claimant_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual contact person representing the claimant organization for this claim.

attributes.name: claimant_email
attributes.description: Email address of the claimant contact for claim correspondence and updates.

attributes.name: claimant_name
attributes.description: Name of the party filing the freight claim, typically the shipper, consignee, or beneficial owner of the goods.

attributes.name: claimant_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number of the claimant contact for claim follow-up.

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value claimed by the shipper for loss, damage, shortage, or delay, including product value, freight charges, and consequential damages where applicable.

attributes.name: claimed_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the claimed amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight claim record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: declared_value
attributes.description: Value of the goods declared on the Bill of Lading (BOL) at the time of shipment. Establishes the maximum carrier liability under Carmack Amendment.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for claim denial (e.g., insufficient documentation, pre-existing damage, act of God, shipper packaging fault).

attributes.name: denial_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the carrier for denying the freight claim.

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: Date when the claimant first discovered the loss, damage, or shortage. May differ from incident date for concealed damage claims.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation tier of the claim if it has moved beyond standard resolution process.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the freight claim was formally filed with the carrier. Critical for statute of limitations tracking (typically 9 months under Carmack Amendment).

attributes.name: filing_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the freight claim was submitted, used for audit trail and SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking.

attributes.name: freight_class
attributes.description: National Motor Freight Classification (NMFC) class of the goods, used to determine liability limits and freight rates.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Date when the loss, damage, shortage, or delay incident occurred or was discovered.

attributes.name: inspection_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the third-party or carrier inspection report documenting the damage or loss.

attributes.name: insurance_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company involved in subrogation or cargo insurance coverage for this claim.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the cargo insurance covering the shipment, relevant for subrogation claims.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight claim record was last modified, used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: liability_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount the carrier is liable for under the terms of the Bill of Lading (BOL) and applicable regulations. May be based on declared value, weight, or tariff provisions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, correspondence summary, or internal notes related to the claim lifecycle and resolution.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the settlement payment was received by the claimant.

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned progressive or tracking number for the shipment, used for tracing and claim correlation.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Description of the goods that were lost, damaged, or delayed, including material type, SKU (Stock Keeping Unit), and quantity.

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final agreed-upon monetary amount paid to resolve the claim. Populated when claim status reaches settled.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the settlement amount.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the claim was officially settled and payment terms agreed upon.

attributes.name: settlement_offer_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount offered by the carrier to settle the claim. May be less than, equal to, or (rarely) greater than the claimed amount.

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim involves subrogation rights, where an insurance company has paid the claimant and is pursuing recovery from the carrier.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured reference to supporting documents submitted with the claim (e.g., delivery receipt, inspection report, photos, invoice, packing list, weight certificate). Critical for claim substantiation.

products.name: trade_compliance_record
products.description: Record of trade compliance checks and export control screening performed on a shipment or delivery, capturing compliance check type (export license, denied party screening, embargo check, dual-use classification), check date, screening result (cleared/flagged/blocked), export control classification number (ECCN), applicable regulations (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual-Use), license type and number, compliance officer ID, and resolution notes. Supports regulatory compliance with export control authorities.

attributes.name: trade_compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trade compliance record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: customs_broker_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customs broker or freight forwarder involved in the compliance process. Links to partner or vendor master data.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the compliance officer or trade compliance specialist who performed or reviewed the screening. Links to employee or user master data.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment or delivery that underwent compliance screening. Links this compliance record to the specific shipment being evaluated.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Links trade compliance checks to specific SKUs for embargo, dual‑use, and licensing decisions; supports compliance audit reports.

attributes.name: applicable_regulations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of applicable export control regulations governing this shipment. May include EAR, ITAR, EU Dual-Use Regulation, OFAC sanctions, or other jurisdiction-specific rules.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations), EU Dual-Use Regulation

attributes.name: audit_trail
attributes.description: Comprehensive audit trail capturing all actions, decisions, and system interactions related to this compliance check. Supports regulatory audit and internal compliance reviews.

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade compliance check was performed. Principal business event timestamp for the screening activity.

attributes.name: check_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance check. Indicates the state of the screening process and whether the shipment can proceed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_progress|cleared|flagged|blocked|escalated|resolved — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: check_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the compliance screening was initiated. Provides exact timing for audit trail and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: check_type
attributes.description: Type of trade compliance check performed. Categorizes the nature of the screening activity conducted on the shipment.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)

attributes.name: compliance_check_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the trade compliance check. Externally-known reference number used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: compliance_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the compliance officer responsible for this trade compliance check. Provides accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: customs_broker_name
attributes.description: Name of the customs broker or freight forwarder assisting with trade compliance and export documentation.

attributes.name: denied_party_list_name
attributes.description: Name of the denied party or restricted entity list where a match was found. Examples include OFAC SDN, BIS Entity List, EU Consolidated List.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions, BIS Denied Persons List, EU Consolidated List

attributes.name: denied_party_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the end user, consignee, or any party in the transaction matched a denied party list or restricted entity list.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions, BIS Denied Persons List, EU Consolidated List

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for the destination country of the shipment. Critical for determining applicable export control restrictions and embargo status.

attributes.name: documentation_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required export control documentation, licenses, and certificates have been obtained and are complete.

attributes.name: dual_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the goods are classified as dual-use items that have both civilian and military applications, requiring special export controls.
attributes.references: EU Dual-Use Regulation, EAR (Export Administration Regulations)

attributes.name: eccn
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned to the goods. Alphanumeric code used to classify items for export control purposes under EAR.

attributes.name: embargo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination country or end user is subject to a trade embargo or comprehensive sanctions program.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions, UN Security Council Resolutions

attributes.name: end_user_name
attributes.description: Name of the ultimate end user or consignee of the goods. Subject to denied party screening and restricted entity checks.

attributes.name: end_user_type
attributes.description: Classification of the end user entity type. Certain user types may trigger additional scrutiny or licensing requirements.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance issue was escalated for higher-level review or decision-making.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the compliance issue requires escalation to senior management, legal counsel, or external trade compliance advisors.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the export license expires. Shipments must be completed before this date to remain compliant.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: Official license number issued by the export control authority. Unique identifier for the export authorization granted.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)

attributes.name: license_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an export license is required for this shipment based on the compliance screening results.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Type of export license applicable to this shipment. Examples include individual license, general license, license exception, or specific authorization type.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)

attributes.name: military_end_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the goods are intended for military end use, which may trigger additional licensing requirements or restrictions.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this compliance record. Provides accountability for data entry.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade compliance record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated this compliance record. Tracks modification responsibility.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade compliance record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance check was resolved and a final clearance or blocking decision was made.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting the resolution of flagged issues, manual review findings, or justification for clearance decisions. Critical for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Categorical risk level classification based on the screening results. Used to prioritize manual review and escalation.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk score assigned by the screening system indicating the level of compliance risk. Higher scores indicate greater risk requiring manual review.

attributes.name: schedule_b_number
attributes.description: 10-digit Schedule B classification number for export statistics. Used by U.S. Census Bureau for tracking exports.

attributes.name: screening_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the compliance screening process. Indicates whether the shipment passed, failed, or requires additional review or licensing.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)

attributes.name: screening_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the automated screening system or tool used to perform the compliance check. Examples include TMS, customs broker system, or dedicated trade compliance software.

products.name: carrier_certification

Conversely, each regulatory requirement applies to many carriers. The business records the certification status and effective date for every carrier‑requirement pair, creating a managed many‑to‑many relationship.

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Customer identity and account management domain serving as the SSOT for all B2B industrial customers, OEM accounts, distributors, and end-user organizations. Manages customer profiles, contacts, account hierarchies, segmentation, credit terms, relationship history, and SLA agreements via Salesforce CRM.

products.name: customer_account
products.description: Master record for all B2B industrial customers, OEM accounts, distributors, and end-user organizations. Serves as the SSOT for customer identity in Salesforce CRM (Account object) and SAP Business Partner. Captures legal entity name, industry classification (SIC/NAICS), account type (OEM, distributor, system integrator, end-user, EPC contractor), account status with full lifecycle history, annual revenue, employee count, DUNS number, tax ID, VAT registration, credit rating, assigned account manager, parent account reference, and strategic account flag. Foundation entity referenced by all other products in this domain and cross-referenced by sales, service, order, and billing domains. Corporate hierarchy and commercial relationships are managed in account_relationship.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer account record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the customer_account master data product. Serves as the SSOT reference key for all downstream domains including sales, service, order, and billing.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Required for linking each customer account to its billing account for invoice generation and financial reporting, a core process in manufacturing finance.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Legal‑entity invoicing and tax reporting assign each customer to a company code for statutory compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost Allocation Report requires mapping each customer account to a cost center for internal expense tracking per strategic account.

attributes.name: parent_account_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent customer_account record in the corporate hierarchy. Enables multi-level account hierarchy modeling (e.g., subsidiary → division → global parent). Null for top-level accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Hierarchy; Informatica MDM — Corporate Hierarchy

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_term. Business justification: Needed to assign a default payment term to each customer account, used in billing cycle setup and compliance with payment‑term policies.

attributes.name: price_book_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SAP S/4HANA pricing condition group or price list assigned to this customer. Determines applicable pricing, discounts, and surcharges during sales order creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — SD Pricing Conditions; Condition Technique

attributes.name: primary_customer_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal sales or account manager responsible for managing the customer relationship. References the Salesforce CRM User or Workday HCM employee record. Used for territory management and performance reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud Owner; Workday HCM

attributes.name: primary_sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.rep. Business justification: Primary sales rep on an account drives quota allocation, forecasting, and territory performance metrics in industrial manufacturing.

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_account_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the topmost entity in the corporate hierarchy for this customer account. Supports global account consolidation, enterprise-level revenue reporting, and strategic account management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Hierarchy; Dun & Bradstreet Corporate Linkage

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability analysis per customer uses profit_center_id on the account to attribute revenue and margin to the correct profit center.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Direct FK to sales territory replaces the denormalized code, supporting territory‑based reporting and incentive calculations.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Linking account to its segment enables normalization of segment data and removes redundant string field.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Procurement planning and supplier performance dashboards require each account to designate a primary supplier.

attributes.name: account_source
attributes.description: Channel or method through which this customer account was originally acquired. Used for marketing attribution, channel effectiveness analysis, and sales pipeline reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct_sales|referral|trade_show|inbound_marketing|partner|acquisition|existing_relationship — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Source; Marketing Attribution Framework

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer account. Controls whether transactions, orders, and service requests can be processed against this account. Managed in Salesforce CRM and synchronized to SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD — Customer Master Status

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer's commercial role in the industrial supply chain. Drives pricing tiers, contract templates, and service entitlements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OEM|distributor|system_integrator|end_user|EPC_contractor|reseller|value_added_reseller|direct — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud Account Type; Industrial Manufacturing Commercial Segmentation

attributes.name: annual_revenue
attributes.description: Customer organization's most recently reported annual revenue in the account's local currency. Used for customer segmentation, credit risk assessment, and strategic account classification. Currency indicated by revenue_currency_code.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Annual Revenue; IFRS/GAAP — Revenue Reporting

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the customer's primary billing address. Used for geographic segmentation, logistics planning, and tax jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the customer's primary billing address country. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regulatory compliance, and geographic segmentation.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the customer's primary billing address. Used for tax jurisdiction mapping, logistics routing, and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Billing Address; Universal Postal Union (UPU)

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the customer's primary billing address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, sales territory assignment, and regional reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Billing Address; ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer account was formally closed or terminated. Null for active accounts. Used for churn analysis, lifecycle reporting, and regulatory record retention.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer account record was first created in the source system of record (Salesforce CRM). Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time; ISO 9001 — Record Management; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance permitted for this customer account, denominated in the account's billing currency. Enforced in SAP S/4HANA SD order processing and credit management workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — SD/FI Credit Management; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: credit_limit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the credit_limit field. Ensures correct interpretation of the credit limit in multi-currency environments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating assigned to the customer by an internal credit team or external agency (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Moody's). Used to determine credit limits, payment terms, and order approval workflows in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — FI Credit Management; Dun & Bradstreet; Moody's

attributes.name: crm_account_code
attributes.description: Native Account record ID from Salesforce CRM (Account object). Used to cross-reference the master record back to the operational source system for reconciliation and lineage tracing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud Account Object

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the completeness and accuracy of the customer account record as assessed by Informatica MDM data quality rules. Used to prioritize data stewardship activities and MDM enrichment workflows.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Data Quality; ISO 8000 — Data Quality

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA distribution channel code indicating how products are sold to this customer (e.g., direct sales, wholesale, OEM channel). Part of the SAP SD organizational assignment.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number uniquely identifying the customer's legal entity globally. Used for credit risk assessment, supplier/customer verification, and corporate hierarchy resolution.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; SAP S/4HANA — Business Partner

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Total number of employees at the customer organization as reported or estimated. Used for customer segmentation (SMB vs. enterprise), credit risk scoring, and market sizing analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Number of Employees; Dun & Bradstreet

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: ICC Incoterms code defining the agreed delivery and risk transfer conditions for shipments to this customer. attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA — SD Delivery Terms

attributes.name: industry_naics_code

attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code identifying the customer's primary industry sector per North American classification standards. Complements SIC code for more granular industry segmentation and analytics.

attributes.name: industry_sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit Standard Industrial Classification code identifying the customer's primary industry sector. Used for market segmentation, regulatory reporting, and credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: is_global_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer operates across multiple countries and is managed under a global account management program with consolidated commercial terms and cross-regional coordination.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud; Global Account Management Framework

attributes.name: is_strategic_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer is designated as a strategic account requiring executive-level relationship management and customized service agreements. Strategic accounts receive dedicated account teams and priority support.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud; Key Account Management Framework

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent commercial activity (order, service request, or interaction) recorded against this customer account. Used for account health monitoring, dormancy detection, and re-engagement campaigns.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the customer account record in the source system of record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time; ISO 9001 — Record Management; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: legal_name

attributes.name: mdm_golden_record_flag

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer account was formally opened and activated in the system of record. Marks the start of the commercial relationship. Used for customer tenure calculations and cohort analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Created Date; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: phone

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 region suffix) indicating the customer's preferred language for communications, documents, and correspondence (e.g., en-US, de-DE, fr-FR).

attributes.name: revenue_currency_code

attributes.name: sales_organization_code

attributes.name: sap_business_partner_code

attributes.description: Indicates the go-to-market channel model applicable to this segment: Direct (manufacturer sells directly to end customer), Indirect (sales through distributors or channel partners), or Hybrid (combination of direct and indirect). Drives commercial policy and commission structures.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel

attributes.name: contract_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal master supply agreement or framework contract is mandatory for customer accounts in this segment before order processing can commence. Enforced in SAP S/4HANA SD order entry validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and governance tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Standard credit limit in USD applied to customer accounts assigned to this segment. Used as the default credit exposure ceiling in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR credit management for new account onboarding within the segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: criteria
attributes.description: Structured definition of the qualifying rules and thresholds used to assign a customer account to this segment (e.g., annual revenue > $10M, OEM classification, multi-site deployment). Supports automated segmentation logic in Salesforce CRM and Informatica MDM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: crm_segment_record_code
attributes.description: Native Salesforce CRM record identifier for the corresponding segment or account group object in Salesforce Sales Cloud. Used for bi-directional synchronization between the Databricks Silver Layer and the CRM system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: customer_account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer relationship type that this segment targets. OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) accounts receive differentiated pricing and co-development support; Distributors receive channel margin structures; End Users receive direct service SLAs; System Integrators and EPCs (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) receive project-based commercial terms.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Account Group

attributes.name: dedicated_account_manager_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer accounts in this segment require a dedicated named account manager assignment in Salesforce CRM. Strategic and Key Account segments typically require dedicated coverage; Transactional segments may use pooled inside sales resources.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; ISO 9001 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: discount_rate_pct
attributes.description: Standard discount percentage applied to list prices for customers in this segment, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.50 = 12.5%). Confidential as it reflects commercial pricing strategy. Used in SAP S/4HANA SD pricing condition records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this segment definition became commercially active and applicable to account assignments. Supports temporal validity tracking for segment versioning and historical analysis of commercial strategy changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; ISO/IEC 11179

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment definition ceases to be commercially active. Null indicates the segment is open-ended with no planned expiry. Used for segment versioning, sunset planning, and historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; ISO/IEC 11179

attributes.name: erp_customer_group_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) Customer Group Code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD customer group code (Kundengruppe) mapped to this segment. Used to apply segment-specific pricing conditions, output determination, and reporting groupings in the ERP system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Group; ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic sales region associated with this segment definition (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC, LATAM). Used to align segment management responsibilities with regional sales organizations and territory planning in Salesforce CRM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: North America|EMEA|APAC|LATAM|Greater China|South Asia|Middle East & Africa — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The primary industry vertical classification of customers within this segment (e.g., Automotive OEM, Aerospace & Defense, Food & Beverage, Energy & Utilities, Building Automation, Transportation). Aligns with NAICS/SIC industry classification and Salesforce CRM account industry field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Automotive OEM|Aerospace & Defense|Food & Beverage|Energy & Utilities|Building Automation|Transportation|Semiconductor|Pharmaceuticals|Oil & Gas|General Manufacturing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAICS Industry Classification; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; ISO 9001 Clause 4.1

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal review of this segment's criteria, account assignments, and commercial performance was completed. Used to trigger the next review cycle and track governance compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 9.1; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: max_account_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of customer accounts permitted in this segment before a split or restructuring review is triggered. Ensures segment managers maintain adequate coverage quality. Null indicates no upper cap.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: mdm_segment_code
attributes.description: Informatica MDM golden record identifier for this segment definition. Ensures cross-system consistency of segment master data across Salesforce CRM, SAP S/4HANA, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.

attributes.name: min_account_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of customer accounts that should be assigned to this segment to maintain commercial viability and justify dedicated segment management resources. Used in segment health monitoring and portfolio planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: moq_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) policy applies to customer accounts in this segment. When True, the MOQ defined in SAP S/4HANA SD condition records is enforced during order entry for accounts in this segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Order Management; MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity)

attributes.name: nda_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is required for customer accounts in this segment before sharing product roadmaps, engineering specifications, or pricing strategies. Relevant for Strategic and OEM segments involved in co-development programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this segment definition. Calculated from last_review_date plus review_cycle_months. Used by the segment manager and commercial governance team to plan review activities.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 9.1; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the assigned segment manager. Used for automated notifications, review cycle reminders, and escalation routing in Salesforce CRM workflows. Classified confidential as it is an internal business contact.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA payment terms code (e.g., NT30, NT60, 2/10NT30) assigned as the default for customer accounts in this segment. Defines invoice due dates, early payment discount eligibility, and cash flow planning inputs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Payment Terms; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: pricing_tier_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the applicable pricing tier in SAP S/4HANA SD condition records for customers assigned to this segment. Drives list price, discount matrix, and rebate eligibility. Confidential as it encodes commercial pricing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions; IFRS 15

attributes.name: rebate_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer accounts in this segment are eligible for volume-based rebate programs. When True, rebate agreements are activated in SAP S/4HANA SD rebate processing for qualifying accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Management; IFRS 15

attributes.name: revenue_band_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the revenue band thresholds (revenue_band_min and revenue_band_max) are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent multi-currency interpretation across global sales regions.

attributes.name: revenue_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum annual revenue threshold (in USD) that defines the upper boundary of the revenue band for this segment. Null indicates an open-ended upper bound (e.g., for the Strategic tier). Used in pricing tier assignment and SLA prioritization.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: revenue_band_min
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue threshold (in USD) that a customer account must meet to qualify for this segment. Used in conjunction with revenue_band_max to define the revenue band boundary for segmentation scoring.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: review_cycle_months
attributes.description: Frequency in months at which the segment definition, criteria, and account assignments are formally reviewed and validated by the segment manager and commercial leadership (e.g., 3 = quarterly, 6 = semi-annual, 12 = annual).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 9.1 Monitoring and Measurement; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the segment across systems (e.g., STRAT-001, KEY-002). Used as the business key in Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA SD module for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the segment's commercial purpose, qualifying criteria, and strategic intent. Used by sales managers and account teams to understand segment boundaries and apply correct commercial policies.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the customer segment (e.g., Strategic, Key Account, Growth, Transactional). Used in sales strategy, pricing tier assignment, and service prioritization workflows.

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the segment definition. Active segments are applied in commercial operations; Under Review segments are being reassessed during periodic review cycles; Archived segments are retired and no longer assigned to new accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; ISO 9001 Clause 9.1

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segment into one of the four standard commercial tiers used by the industrial manufacturing sales organization: Strategic (top-tier OEM/enterprise accounts), Key Account (high-value recurring customers), Growth (emerging or expanding accounts), Transactional (low-frequency, price-driven buyers).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; ISO 9001 Customer Focus Clause 5.1.2

attributes.name: service_priority_level
attributes.description: Service prioritization level for after-sales support and field service dispatch for customers in this segment. Critical and High priority segments receive preferential scheduling in Salesforce Service Cloud and Maximo work order queues.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; Maximo Asset Management; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: sla_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the SLA tier assigned to customers in this segment, referencing the SLA agreement product. Determines response time commitments, field service priority, spare parts availability guarantees, and escalation paths in Salesforce Service Cloud and Maximo Asset Management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; Maximo Asset Management; ISO 9001 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: strategic_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is classified as a strategic segment requiring executive sponsorship, board-level visibility, and dedicated cross-functional account teams. Drives escalation routing and executive review cadence in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; ISO 9001 Clause 5.1.2

attributes.name: target_gross_margin_pct
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for the segment, used in pricing strategy and commercial deal approval thresholds. Deals below this margin threshold require escalated approval for accounts in this segment. Confidential as it encodes commercial profitability strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA; IFRS/GAAP; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: target_revenue_usd
attributes.description: Annual revenue target in USD for the aggregate of all customer accounts assigned to this segment. Used in commercial planning, sales quota allocation, and KPI tracking against actual segment revenue performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Profitability Analysis; IFRS 15; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this segment record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number tracking revisions to the segment definition, criteria, or commercial parameters. Supports audit trail and change history for governance and compliance reviews.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 7.5 Documented Information; Informatica MDM

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing address records for customer accounts and contacts, including headquarters, billing address, shipping/delivery address, and plant site addresses. Captures address type, street lines, city, state/province, postal code, country, geocoordinates, validated flag, and primary address indicator. Supports logistics, invoicing, and field service dispatch.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each address record in the customer domain. Serves as the primary key for the address data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
