attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that owns this address record. Links the address to the parent B2B industrial customer, OEM account, distributor, or end-user organization in the customer master.

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual contact person associated with this address, when the address belongs to a specific contact rather than the account-level organization. Nullable for account-level addresses.

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active addresses are in current use; inactive addresses are no longer used but retained for historical reference; pending addresses are awaiting validation or approval; archived addresses are soft-deleted for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Record Status; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master Lifecycle

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the address indicating its business purpose. Billing addresses are used for invoicing (SAP SD), shipping/delivery addresses for logistics dispatch (SAP WM/TMS), headquarters for corporate correspondence, plant_site for manufacturing facility locations, mailing for postal communications, and field_service for on-site service dispatch. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing|shipping|headquarters|plant_site|mailing|field_service|registered|returns — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master Address; Salesforce CRM - Address Type

attributes.name: attention_line
attributes.description: Addressee attention line specifying the department, role, or individual to whom correspondence or deliveries should be directed at this address (e.g., 'Attn: Procurement Department', 'Attn: Receiving Dock'). Common in B2B industrial shipping.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 - Attention Line; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Address

attributes.name: building_name
attributes.description: Name of the building or facility at this address (e.g., 'Tower A', 'Building 7 - Final Assembly', 'North Warehouse'). Common in large industrial campuses and multi-building manufacturing complexes. Supplements street address for precise delivery and field service dispatch.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City, municipality, or locality name of the address. Used for logistics routing, tax jurisdiction determination, and field service territory assignment.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 country code for the address (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN, GBR). Used for international logistics, customs documentation, export compliance, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; SAP S/4HANA - Country Field (LAND1 mapped to Alpha-3)

attributes.name: county_district
attributes.description: County, district, or sub-regional administrative unit of the address. Used for local tax jurisdiction determination, permit compliance, and field service territory mapping in industrial manufacturing contexts.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing; SAP S/4HANA - District Field (BEZEI)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and compliance with ISO 9001 quality management record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Quality Management Records; SAP S/4HANA - Created On (ERDAT); Salesforce CRM - CreatedDate

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text special instructions for deliveries to this address, such as dock access hours, security clearance requirements, forklift availability, hazardous material handling notes, or contact person for receiving. Critical for industrial manufacturing shipments to plant sites.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Delivery Note Text; WMS Receiving Instructions

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this address record is valid and in effect for business operations. Supports bi-temporal address management for customers who relocate or open new facilities, ensuring correct address is used for historical invoicing and logistics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Address Validity Start (DATE_FROM); ISO 8601 Date

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date until which this address record is valid. Null indicates the address is open-ended and currently active. Used for managing address changes over time, particularly for plant site relocations and facility closures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Address Validity End (DATE_TO); ISO 8601 Date

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: Floor or level number within a building at this address. Used for precise field service dispatch and delivery routing within multi-story industrial facilities, office buildings, and distribution centers.

attributes.name: geocoding_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoordinates assigned to this address. Rooftop indicates exact building-level precision; range_interpolated is street-level; geometric_center is centroid of a region; approximate is low-precision; ungeocoded means no coordinates assigned. Informs reliability of geospatial analytics.
attributes.references: Google Maps Geocoding API - Location Type; HERE Geocoding API

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address/facility is certified to receive hazardous materials shipments. Relevant for industrial manufacturing customers receiving chemicals, electrification components, or other regulated materials. Supports EPA and OSHA compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 - Process Safety Management; EPA RCRA; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the primary address for the associated customer account or contact. Only one address per customer per address_type should be marked as primary. Used to determine the default address for invoicing, shipping, and correspondence.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Primary Address Flag; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master

attributes.name: is_validated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been validated against a postal authority or address verification service (e.g., USPS CASS, Informatica MDM address cleansing). Validated addresses reduce delivery failures and logistics errors.
attributes.references: USPS CASS (Coding Accuracy Support System); Informatica MDM - Address Validation

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive label or nickname for the address record (e.g., 'Stuttgart HQ', 'Chicago Distribution Center', 'Plant 3 - Assembly Line'). Facilitates quick identification in Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA user interfaces.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Address Label; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the preferred communication language at this address (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'zh-CN', 'fr'). Used to determine document language for invoices, shipping labels, and field service work orders dispatched to this location.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; SAP S/4HANA - Language Key (SPRAS)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last updated in the source system. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental data loading, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 - Quality Management Records; SAP S/4HANA - Changed On (AEDAT); Salesforce CRM - LastModifiedDate

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Precision to 7 decimal places (~1 cm accuracy). Used for field service dispatch routing, logistics optimization, and geospatial analytics in industrial manufacturing.
attributes.references: WGS 84 (World Geodetic System 1984); ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including building number, street name, and any directional qualifiers. This is the first and mandatory line of the physical or mailing address as captured in Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA customer master.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards; ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, unit, building name, mail stop, or additional location qualifier. Optional field used when the primary address line is insufficient to fully identify the location.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards; ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for additional location details such as industrial park name, campus identifier, or zone designation. Used primarily for complex plant site and industrial facility addresses common in manufacturing environments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Customer Master Address (ADRC); ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: loading_dock_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a loading dock is available at this address for receiving industrial equipment, automation systems, and bulk material shipments. Affects carrier selection (LTL vs FTL) and delivery scheduling in the Transportation Management System (TMS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Delivery Conditions; TMS Facility Attributes

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Precision to 7 decimal places (~1 cm accuracy). Used alongside latitude for geospatial analytics, field service routing, and logistics network optimization.
attributes.references: WGS 84 (World Geodetic System 1984); ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: mdm_address_key
attributes.description: Unique address identifier assigned by Informatica MDM during master data consolidation and deduplication. Enables cross-system address matching and golden record linkage across SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce CRM, and other operational systems.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM - Master Data Management; ISO/IEC 11179 Metadata Registry

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant code associated with this address when the address represents a customer's manufacturing plant or production facility. Enables direct linkage between customer delivery addresses and SAP plant master data for production planning (MRP/MRP II) and goods receipt processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Plant Master (T001W); SAP PP - Production Planning

attributes.name: po_box
attributes.description: Post Office (PO) Box number for mailing addresses where physical street delivery is not applicable. Used for billing correspondence and formal legal notices to corporate customers. Stored separately from street address lines.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 - PO Box Addressing; SAP S/4HANA - PO Box (PFACH)

attributes.name: po_box_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code specific to the PO Box address, which may differ from the street address postal code. Required for accurate mail routing when a PO Box is used for billing or correspondence.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; SAP S/4HANA - PO Box Postal Code (PSTL2)

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit US ZIP, alphanumeric UK postcode). Used for mail delivery, logistics carrier routing (LTL/FTL), and geographic segmentation.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Standard

attributes.name: postal_code_extension
attributes.description: Extended postal code suffix providing finer delivery point precision (e.g., ZIP+4 in the US). Improves mail delivery accuracy and carrier routing for industrial shipments.

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: Room, suite, or unit number within a building at this address. Provides the most granular level of location detail for field service technician dispatch and internal mail routing at customer facilities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Room Number (ROOMNUMBER); ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: Sales region or territory code associated with this address, used for sales force assignment, revenue reporting, and quota management. Derived from geographic location and aligned with SAP S/4HANA SD sales organization structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Sales Region (REGIO); Salesforce CRM - Sales Territory

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Field service territory code assigned to this address, used to route field service engineers and technicians for equipment maintenance, installation, and after-sales support. Aligns with Salesforce Service Cloud territory management and Maximo Asset Management work order dispatch.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Service Cloud Territory Management; Maximo Asset Management - Service Territory

attributes.name: shipping_condition
attributes.description: Default shipping condition or delivery method applicable to this address, indicating the preferred logistics mode. LTL (Less Than Truckload) and FTL (Full Truckload) are standard industrial shipping terms. Drives carrier selection and Transportation Management System (TMS) routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Shipping Conditions (VSBED); TMS Routing Rules

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this address record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution during MDM consolidation across Salesforce CRM, SAP S/4HANA, and Informatica MDM.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM - Data Lineage; DAMA DMBOK Data Governance

attributes.name: source_system_address_code
attributes.description: The native address identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce CRM Address ID, SAP ADRC ADDRNUMBER). Enables reverse lookup and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and operational systems during ETL and data quality processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Address Number (ADRNR/ADDRNUMBER in ADRC table); Salesforce CRM - Address ID

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional administrative division of the address. Stored as ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g., US-CA, DE-BY). Used for tax jurisdiction, regulatory compliance (OSHA, EPA), and logistics zone determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; SAP S/4HANA - Region Field (REGIO)

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction identifier for the address location, used to determine applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST rates for invoicing. Typically derived from postal code and state/province. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA tax determination and IFRS/GAAP revenue recognition requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Tax Jurisdiction Code (TXJCD); IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'Europe/Berlin', 'Asia/Shanghai'). Used for scheduling field service visits, coordinating production planning across global manufacturing sites, and SLA response time calculations.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database (TZDB); SAP S/4HANA - Time Zone (TZONE)

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: The system or method used to validate the address. Tracks whether validation was performed by USPS CASS certification, a geocoding API (Google Maps, HERE), Informatica MDM address cleansing, manual review, or not yet validated. Supports data quality governance.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM - Data Quality; USPS CASS Certification

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address was last validated against a postal authority or address verification service. Used to determine if re-validation is required based on data quality policies.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM - Data Quality; ISO 8601 Timestamp

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: Value Added Tax (VAT) registration number associated with this address, particularly for EU and international billing addresses. Required for cross-border B2B invoicing compliance and VAT reclaim processes in industrial manufacturing.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; SAP S/4HANA - VAT Registration Number (STCEG); IFRS/GAAP

products.name: credit_profile
products.description: Customer credit assessment and terms management record. Captures credit limit, credit rating, payment terms (Net 30, Net 60, Net 90), currency, credit hold status, credit hold reason, last credit review date, next review date, credit insurance policy reference, outstanding balance, and days sales outstanding (DSO). Managed in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR and synchronized with Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer credit profile record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: credit_analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Credit analysis is executed by a designated employee; needed for credit review decisions and audit logs.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the B2B industrial customer, OEM account, distributor, or end-user organization for whom this credit profile is maintained. Links to the customer master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current credit limit and terms were formally approved by the authorized credit manager. Part of the credit governance audit trail required for SOX and IFRS compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX; IFRS/GAAP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the credit manager or authorized approver who approved the current credit limit and terms. Required for segregation of duties (SoD) compliance and audit trail in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; ISO 9001; IFRS/GAAP; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: bad_debt_provision_amount
attributes.description: Amount provisioned for potential bad debt loss on this customer's receivables under the IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) model or GAAP ASC 310 allowance method. Maintained in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9 ECL; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: bank_account_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's bank account details on file have been verified through the company's bank account validation process. True = verified; False = unverified. Required for direct debit and bank transfer payment methods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS/GAAP; Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance

attributes.name: collection_strategy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the dunning and collections strategy assigned to this customer in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR (e.g., standard dunning, escalated collections, legal action track). Drives automated dunning notice generation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and IFRS/GAAP record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS/GAAP; ISO 9001; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: credit_account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit account based on the nature of the customer relationship. Determines applicable credit policies and risk frameworks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: domestic|export|intercompany|distributor|oem|government — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit (credit control area code) responsible for managing and monitoring this customer's credit. Defines the credit management scope and currency for credit limit enforcement in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SAP Credit Management (FIN-FSCM-CR)

attributes.name: credit_hold_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit hold was applied to the customer account. Used for aging analysis of credit holds and SLA compliance tracking for credit resolution processes.

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is currently placed on credit hold, blocking new order processing in SAP S/4HANA SD and Siemens Opcenter MES. True = credit hold active; False = no hold. Synchronized with Salesforce CRM account status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SAP S/4HANA SD; ISO 9001

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the customer account has been placed on credit hold. Required for audit trail and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) processes. Null when credit_hold_flag is False.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; ISO 9001 CAPA; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: credit_hold_released_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit hold was lifted and normal order processing was reinstated. Null if the credit hold is still active. Used for credit resolution cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_coverage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum insured amount under the trade credit insurance policy for this customer, in the account currency. Represents the maximum receivable amount recoverable in case of customer default.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the trade credit insurance policy for this customer expires. Triggers renewal workflow alerts to prevent uninsured credit exposure.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the trade credit insurance policy (e.g., Euler Hermes, Coface, Atradius) covering this customer's receivables. Null if no credit insurance is in place. Used for insurance claim processing and risk mitigation reporting.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the trade credit insurance provider covering this customer's receivables (e.g., Euler Hermes, Coface, Atradius, Credendo). Null if no credit insurance is in place.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure (in the account currency) that can be extended to the customer at any point in time. Set during credit review and enforced in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR credit management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: credit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credit analyst notes, special conditions, exceptions, or contextual information relevant to this customer's credit profile. Supports credit review documentation and exception management.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal or external credit risk rating assigned to the customer (e.g., A, B, C, D or numeric score). Used to classify credit risk tier and determine applicable credit terms, insurance requirements, and collection priority. May align with Dun & Bradstreet or internal scoring models.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: Source or agency that issued the credit rating for this customer. Distinguishes between internally-derived ratings and third-party agency assessments used for credit risk management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal|dun_bradstreet|moody|sp|fitch|coface|euler_hermes — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: credit_review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which formal credit reviews are scheduled for this customer. Determined by credit risk tier and customer segment. Higher-risk customers require more frequent reviews.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; Basel III

attributes.name: credit_segment
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA credit segment identifier that groups customers under a common credit management policy and credit limit pool. Enables multi-segment credit management for customers operating across multiple business units or regions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SAP Credit Management (FIN-FSCM-CR)

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer credit profile. Drives order release decisions in SAP S/4HANA SD and MES order management. 'on_hold' and 'blocked' prevent new order processing until resolved.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SAP S/4HANA SD; ISO 9001

attributes.name: credit_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the approved credit limit currently consumed by the outstanding balance (outstanding_balance / credit_limit × 100). Triggers credit hold alerts when threshold is breached. Synchronized from SAP S/4HANA FI-AR credit exposure calculation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit, outstanding balance, and financial terms are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the customer's billing currency in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: dso_days
attributes.description: Days Sales Outstanding — the average number of days it takes the customer to pay invoices, calculated as (outstanding_balance / total_credit_sales) × number_of_days. A key KPI for accounts receivable performance and cash flow management per IFRS/GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS/GAAP; EBITDA reporting

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning level (1–4) indicating the escalation stage of overdue payment notices sent to the customer. Level 1 = first reminder; Level 4 = final notice before legal action. Managed in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR dunning program.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which the customer must pay to qualify for the early payment discount. Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered to the customer for early payment within the discount period defined in the payment terms (e.g., 2.00 for a 2% early payment discount). Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current credit terms, credit limit, and risk classification became effective for this customer. Supports temporal credit management and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current credit terms and credit limit are scheduled to expire and require renewal or re-assessment. Null for open-ended credit agreements. Triggers next_credit_review_date workflow.

attributes.name: last_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal credit assessment was completed for this customer. Triggers next review scheduling and is used for credit governance compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; Basel III

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent dunning notice was issued to the customer for overdue invoices. Used to track collections activity and enforce dunning intervals in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this credit profile record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in Databricks Silver Layer ingestion and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Informatica MDM; IFRS/GAAP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: next_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal credit review of this customer. Drives workflow alerts in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR and Salesforce CRM for proactive credit management.

attributes.name: oldest_overdue_days
attributes.description: Number of days since the oldest unpaid overdue invoice became due. Used for collections aging bucket analysis and bad debt provisioning triggers in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Total open accounts receivable balance currently owed by the customer in the account currency, as synchronized from SAP S/4HANA FI-AR. Includes all open invoices, debit memos, and unapplied credits. Used for credit utilization monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: overdue_amount
attributes.description: Total value of invoices that have exceeded their due date and remain unpaid, in the account currency. A subset of outstanding_balance. Used for collections prioritization and bad debt provisioning per IFRS 9 expected credit loss model.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: payment_behavior_score
attributes.description: Internal scoring metric (0–100) reflecting the customer's historical payment behavior, including on-time payment rate, frequency of late payments, and average days late. Inputs into credit rating and risk category determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Agreed payment instrument used by the customer for settling invoices (e.g., bank transfer, letter of credit for export customers, direct debit). Configured in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR payment method settings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SAP S/4HANA SD; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key defining the agreed payment schedule for this customer (e.g., NT30 = Net 30, NT60 = Net 60, NT90 = Net 90, 2/10NT30 = 2% discount if paid within 10 days, net 30). Drives invoice due date calculation in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SAP S/4HANA SD; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from invoice date within which payment is due under the agreed payment terms (e.g., 30 for Net 30, 60 for Net 60, 90 for Net 90). Used for DSO calculation and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Categorical risk classification assigned to the customer based on credit rating, payment history, and financial health assessment. Drives credit limit setting, insurance requirements, and collection strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: salesforce_account_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM Account record ID for this customer, used for bi-directional synchronization of credit status and credit hold flags between SAP S/4HANA FI-AR and Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: sap_customer_account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP S/4HANA FI-AR customer account number (debtor number) used to uniquely identify the customer in the ERP system. Serves as the business identifier for cross-system reconciliation.

products.name: sla_agreement
products.description: Service Level Agreement records defining contractual service commitments to industrial customers, including response time SLAs, uptime guarantees, on-time delivery targets, and support tier entitlements. Captures SLA type, tier (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze), response time thresholds, resolution time thresholds, penalty clauses, effective date, expiry date, and associated account. Managed via Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: sla_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the SLA agreement record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the B2B industrial customer, OEM account, distributor, or end-user organization account to which this SLA agreement applies. Links to the customer account master in the customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Object; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated customer contact person who receives escalation notifications when SLA thresholds are at risk of breach or have been breached. Links to the contact master in the customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Contact; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: customer_entitlement_id
attributes.description: The native record identifier of the corresponding Entitlement object in Salesforce Service Cloud. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the Databricks Silver Layer and the Salesforce source system.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement Object; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal account manager or customer success manager responsible for managing this SLA agreement and the customer relationship. Links to the workforce/employee master.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Owner; Workday HCM

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the SLA agreement as displayed in Salesforce Service Cloud and customer-facing documents (e.g., 'Platinum Support SLA — Acme Automation 2024'). Used for identification and reporting.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number for the SLA agreement as assigned in Salesforce Service Cloud (e.g., SLA-2024-00123). Used in customer communications, contract documents, and cross-system references.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement Object; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA agreement: draft (under negotiation), active (in force), suspended (temporarily paused), expired (past end date without renewal), or terminated (cancelled before end date). Governs whether SLA commitments are enforceable.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement Status; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent amendment or revision to the SLA agreement was executed and became effective. Null for the original version. Supports change management and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement

attributes.name: annual_fee
attributes.description: The recurring annual fee charged to the customer for the SLA agreement, in the agreement currency. Used for revenue recognition, billing scheduling in SAP S/4HANA SD, and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA agreement automatically renews upon expiry without requiring a new contract signature. True = auto-renews; False = requires explicit renewal action. Drives renewal workflow automation in Salesforce Service Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the customer is invoiced for the SLA agreement fee (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annual). Drives billing schedule creation in SAP S/4HANA SD and revenue recognition cadence.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: contract_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the signed SLA contract document stored in the document management system (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter PLM or SharePoint). Enables traceability to the original legal document.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Document Management; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the SLA agreement over its full term, expressed in the agreement currency. Used for financial reporting, revenue recognition under IFRS 15/ASC 606, and penalty cap calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: covered_asset_count
attributes.description: The number of individual equipment units, machines, or installed assets covered under this SLA agreement. Used for capacity planning of field service resources and Maximo Asset Management integration.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the SLA agreement record was first created in the source system (Salesforce Service Cloud). Represents the record audit creation time in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; Salesforce Service Cloud

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value and penalty amounts in this SLA agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency financial reporting and consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the SLA agreement becomes contractually binding and service commitments begin. Corresponds to the contract start date in Salesforce Service Cloud Entitlement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement Start Date; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; IFRS 15

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the SLA agreement ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended agreements. Used to trigger renewal workflows and compliance reporting in Salesforce Service Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement End Date; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; IFRS 15

attributes.name: field_service_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether on-site field service visits are included in the SLA agreement. True = field service dispatches are covered; False = remote support only. Drives field service scheduling and resource allocation in Salesforce Field Service.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this SLA agreement (e.g., USA, DEU). Determines applicable legal and regulatory frameworks for dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: initial_response_time_hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which the service team must provide an initial acknowledgment or response to a customer-reported incident or service request under this SLA. A core contractual KPI metric tracked in Salesforce Service Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Milestone; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; ANSI/ASQ Q9001

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the SLA agreement record was most recently updated in the source system (Salesforce Service Cloud). Used for incremental data ingestion, change detection, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; Salesforce Service Cloud; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: max_annual_service_visits
attributes.description: The maximum number of on-site service visits (preventive or corrective) included per year under this SLA agreement. Null if unlimited or not applicable. Used for field service capacity planning and entitlement consumption tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional contractual terms, special conditions, exclusions, or operational notes associated with the SLA agreement that are not captured in structured fields. Sourced from Salesforce Service Cloud Entitlement description.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_target_pct
attributes.description: The contractually committed minimum percentage of orders or shipments that must be delivered on or before the promised delivery date under this SLA. Applicable for on_time_delivery SLA types. Tracked against SAP S/4HANA SD delivery performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; ANSI/ASQ Q9001

attributes.name: parent_contract_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the master or parent commercial contract (e.g., Master Service Agreement or Framework Agreement) under which this SLA agreement is issued. Enables hierarchical contract traceability in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; IFRS 15

attributes.name: penalty_cap_pct
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative penalty or service credit that can be applied over the agreement period, expressed as a percentage of the total contract value. Limits the company's financial liability exposure from SLA breaches.

attributes.name: penalty_clause_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial or service credit penalties apply to this SLA agreement when contractual thresholds are breached. True = penalty clauses are active; False = no penalty provisions. Drives financial exposure tracking and CAPA processes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; IFRS 15; Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement

attributes.name: penalty_credit_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the contracted service fee or invoice value that is credited or refunded to the customer for each SLA breach event, as defined in the penalty clause. Null when penalty_clause_applicable is False.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue Recognition; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; Salesforce Service Cloud

attributes.name: preventive_maintenance_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether scheduled preventive maintenance visits are included as part of the SLA agreement entitlement. True = preventive maintenance is covered; False = corrective/reactive only. Linked to TPM programs managed in Maximo.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; ISO 45001

attributes.name: product_line_scope
attributes.description: Description of the specific product lines, equipment categories, or automation system families covered under this SLA agreement (e.g., 'CNC Machining Centers', 'PLC Control Systems', 'Electrification Solutions'). Defines the boundary of service coverage.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: remote_monitoring_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether IIoT-based remote monitoring and diagnostics of covered assets is included in the SLA agreement. True = remote monitoring via Aveva SCADA or IIoT platform is active; False = not included.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days before the expiry date by which either party must provide written notice of intent to renew or terminate the SLA agreement. Triggers automated renewal alerts in Salesforce Service Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: resolution_time_hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which a reported incident or service request must be fully resolved under this SLA agreement. Drives escalation rules and penalty clause triggers in Salesforce Service Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Milestone; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; ANSI/ASQ Q9001

attributes.name: service_region
attributes.description: The primary geographic region where the SLA service commitments apply, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR). Determines applicable regulatory requirements, support staffing, and logistics SLA parameters.

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: The contractual service tier level assigned to this SLA agreement, determining the priority, response speed, and entitlements available to the customer. Platinum is the highest tier; Bronze is the base tier. Drives case prioritization in Salesforce Service Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA agreement by the primary service commitment it governs: response_time (initial response to incidents), uptime_guarantee (system/equipment availability), on_time_delivery (order fulfillment punctuality), support_entitlement (support tier access), or maintenance_coverage (preventive/corrective maintenance). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: response_time|uptime_guarantee|on_time_delivery|support_entitlement|maintenance_coverage|field_service — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement Type; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; ANSI/ASQ Q9001

attributes.name: spare_parts_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost of spare parts and replacement components is covered under this SLA agreement. True = parts included; False = parts billed separately. Impacts inventory planning in SAP S/4HANA MM and WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Maximo Asset Management; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: support_hours_coverage
attributes.description: The contracted support availability window defining hours per day and days per week during which the service team is obligated to respond (e.g., 8x5 = 8 hours/day, 5 days/week; 24x7 = round-the-clock). Determines staffing and escalation routing in Salesforce Service Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Business Hours; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the SLA agreement was terminated prior to its scheduled expiry date. Null for agreements that are active or expired naturally. Required for financial accrual reversal and CAPA closure in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for early termination of the SLA agreement. Null when the agreement is active or expired naturally. Used for churn analysis, CAPA processes, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; Salesforce CRM — Churn Analysis; IFRS 15

attributes.name: uptime_target_pct
attributes.description: The contractually committed minimum system or equipment availability expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.5 for 99.5% uptime). Applicable for uptime_guarantee SLA types. Used in OEE and availability reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2; IEC 62443; Salesforce Service Cloud — Entitlement

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the SLA agreement, incremented each time the agreement is amended or renegotiated. Version 1 is the original agreement. Supports audit trail and change history tracking per ISO 9001 document control requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5 — Document Control; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

products.name: account_relationship
products.description: Single source of truth for all formal relationships between customer accounts, encompassing both corporate hierarchy structures (parent-child ownership, subsidiaries, divisions, affiliates, joint ventures with hierarchy level and depth for roll-up reporting) and commercial partnerships (OEM licensing, distributor agreements, reseller arrangements, preferred supplier status, EPC contractor relationships). Captures relationship type (hierarchy vs commercial — discriminator field), parent/child or source/target account references, hierarchy level and depth for corporate structures, start date, end date, relationship owner, strategic importance rating, relationship health score, and effective date. Supports global enterprise account roll-up reporting across subsidiaries and divisions, as well as commercial relationship tracking between independent entities in industrial automation and electrification markets.

attributes.name: account_relationship_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each account relationship record in the industrial customer domain. Serves as the primary key for the account_relationship data product.

attributes.name: child_account_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the child, target, or subordinate account in the relationship. For corporate hierarchy relationships, this is the subsidiary, division, or affiliate. For commercial relationships, this is the receiving/target account (e.g., OEM licensee, distributor, reseller).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: primary_account_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee or sales representative responsible for managing and maintaining this account relationship. Maps to the Salesforce CRM relationship owner user record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — User Object; Workday HCM

attributes.name: primary_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent, source, or owning account in the relationship. For corporate hierarchy relationships, this is the parent company or holding entity. For commercial relationships, this is the originating/source account (e.g., OEM licensor, distributor principal).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: agreement_reference_number
attributes.description: External contract or agreement number associated with a commercial relationship (e.g., OEM licensing agreement number, distributor contract ID, reseller agreement reference). Links to the formal legal document in the contract management system. Applicable for commercial relationship types.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba — Contract Management; Salesforce CRM — Contract Object

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the account relationship was formally approved by the authorized approver. Part of the relationship governance and audit trail.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Approval Process; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the account relationship record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and bi-temporal data management in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum credit exposure authorized for the child account within this relationship, expressed in the primary currency. Used for credit risk management and order approval workflows in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; IFRS/GAAP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: crm_relationship_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier of this account relationship in Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage, and integration with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP Distribution Channel code indicating how products and services are delivered to the child account within this relationship (e.g., direct sales, distributor, OEM channel). Drives pricing and order management rules.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the current version of the relationship record is considered authoritative and effective for reporting and roll-up purposes. Supports bi-temporal data management and point-in-time analytics.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Effective Dating; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the account relationship formally ends or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended or perpetual relationships. For commercial agreements, aligns with contract expiry date.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: erp_customer_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA customer hierarchy node identifier corresponding to this account relationship. Used for price determination, rebate processing, and financial roll-up in SAP SD and FI modules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Customer Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commercial relationship includes an exclusivity clause, preventing either party from entering into similar arrangements with competitors within a defined territory or product category.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba — Contract Terms; Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the commercial relationship agreement (e.g., DEU for Germany, USA for United States). Relevant for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IFRS/GAAP; SAP Ariba Contract Management

attributes.name: hierarchy_depth
attributes.description: Total number of levels in the corporate hierarchy tree beneath the root parent account. Enables determination of the full depth of the organizational structure for roll-up reporting and consolidation. Applicable only when relationship_type = hierarchy.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of the child account within the corporate hierarchy tree, where level 1 represents the ultimate parent/holding company. Used for enterprise account roll-up reporting across subsidiaries and divisions. Applicable only when relationship_type = hierarchy.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path string representing the full ancestry chain from the root parent to the current child account (e.g., '/1001/1045/1078'). Enables efficient subtree queries and roll-up aggregations without recursive joins in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Hierarchy; Informatica MDM Hierarchy Management

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: Industry vertical or market segment classification of the account relationship, used for market analysis and targeted commercial strategies (e.g., automotive, energy, building_automation, transportation, process_industry). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|energy|building_automation|transportation|process_industry|discrete_manufacturing|infrastructure|data_center — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Industry; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: is_global_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account relationship is part of a global enterprise account program, requiring coordinated management across multiple geographies and business units. True for multinational OEM and enterprise accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Global Account Management; Internal KPI Framework

attributes.name: is_strategic_partner
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account relationship is classified as a strategic partnership requiring executive sponsorship and dedicated resources. True for key OEM partners, major distributors, and preferred EPC contractors.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; Internal Partnership Framework

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the account relationship record. Used for change tracking, incremental data loading, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal business review conducted for this account relationship. Used to track review cadence compliance and identify relationships overdue for review.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Plan; ISO 9001 Customer Communication

attributes.name: mdm_relationship_code
attributes.description: Informatica MDM golden record identifier for this account relationship. Serves as the cross-system master identifier for data quality, deduplication, and governance processes.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Master Data Management; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal business review of this account relationship. Automatically calculated based on last_review_date and review_frequency. Used for account management planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Plan; ISO 9001 Customer Communication

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of equity ownership held by the parent account in the child account for corporate hierarchy relationships (e.g., 100.00 for wholly-owned subsidiary, 51.00 for majority-owned affiliate). Null for non-equity commercial relationships. Relevant for financial consolidation under IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; GAAP ASC 810; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code defining the agreed payment conditions for the commercial relationship (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD customer master payment terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Payment Terms; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for managing this account relationship, as agreed with the customer. Guides account managers on how to engage with the relationship counterpart for reviews, escalations, and business development.

attributes.name: primary_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the primary transactional currency of the commercial relationship (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for financial roll-up reporting and revenue attribution across the account hierarchy.

attributes.name: relationship_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature, context, and business purpose of the account relationship. Captures nuances not represented by structured fields, such as historical context, strategic rationale, or special commercial terms.

attributes.name: relationship_health_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the overall health and strength of the account relationship, derived from engagement metrics, satisfaction surveys, payment behavior, and commercial activity. Used by account managers to prioritize relationship interventions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Health Scoring; Internal KPI Framework

attributes.name: relationship_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the account relationship, typically combining the parent and child account names with the relationship subtype (e.g., 'Siemens AG — Siemens Energy GmbH (Subsidiary)'). Used in reports and CRM displays.

attributes.name: relationship_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the account relationship, used in correspondence, reporting, and cross-system reference. Sourced from Salesforce CRM relationship record number.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: relationship_source
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this account relationship record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and master data governance in Informatica MDM.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Data Lineage; Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the account relationship. Active indicates the relationship is in force; pending indicates awaiting approval or activation; suspended indicates temporarily paused; terminated indicates formally ended.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; ISO 9001 Customer Management

attributes.name: relationship_subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification of the relationship within its type. For hierarchy relationships: parent_subsidiary, division, affiliate, joint_venture, holding_company. For commercial relationships: oem_licensing, distributor_agreement, reseller_arrangement, preferred_supplier, epc_contractor, value_added_reseller. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent_subsidiary|division|affiliate|joint_venture|oem_licensing|distributor_agreement|reseller_arrangement|preferred_supplier|epc_contractor|value_added_reseller — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Partner Functions

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Discriminator field classifying the relationship as either a corporate hierarchy structure (parent-child ownership, subsidiaries, divisions, affiliates, joint ventures) or a commercial partnership (OEM licensing, distributor agreements, reseller arrangements, preferred supplier, EPC contractor). Drives downstream roll-up logic and commercial analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Contractually agreed percentage of revenue shared between the parent and child accounts under a commercial relationship (e.g., OEM royalty rate, distributor margin percentage). Applicable for commercial relationship types with revenue-sharing arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba — Contract Terms; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Agreed frequency of formal business review meetings between the manufacturing company and the account relationship counterpart. Drives scheduling of Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive account reviews.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Plan; ISO 9001 Customer Communication

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: SAP Sales Organization code responsible for managing the commercial aspects of this account relationship. Determines pricing, order processing, and revenue booking rules applicable to the relationship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales Organization; IFRS/GAAP Segment Reporting

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA tier assigned to this account relationship, determining the level of service, response times, and support entitlements applicable to the child account. Platinum and gold tiers receive priority support and dedicated account management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Service Cloud SLA; ISO 9001 Customer Satisfaction

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the account relationship formally commenced. For hierarchy relationships, this is the date the corporate structure was established. For commercial relationships, this is the agreement or contract start date.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: strategic_importance_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the strategic importance of this account relationship to the manufacturing business. Critical indicates top-tier global accounts; high indicates major regional accounts; medium indicates standard commercial accounts; low indicates transactional or minor accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; Internal KPI Framework

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the account relationship was terminated or ended. Populated only when relationship_status = terminated. Used for churn analysis and relationship lifecycle reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Relationship Object; ISO 9001 Customer Feedback

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Sales territory or geographic region code assigned to this account relationship, used for territory management, revenue attribution, and sales performance reporting. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA SD sales territory configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales Territory; Salesforce CRM — Territory Management

products.name: interaction
products.description: Records of all customer-facing business interactions and touchpoints including sales calls, site visits, product demonstrations, technical consultations, trade show meetings, executive briefings, and customer satisfaction survey responses (NPS). Maps to Salesforce CRM Activity (Task/Event). Captures interaction type, channel (phone, email, in-person, virtual, survey), date, duration, participants, outcome, satisfaction score (where applicable), verbatim feedback, follow-up actions, and associated opportunity or account. Supports relationship health monitoring and customer experience tracking.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer interaction record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the interaction data product.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the B2B customer account (OEM, distributor, or end-user organization) associated with this interaction. Maps to Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual customer contact (person) who participated in this interaction. Maps to Salesforce CRM Contact object.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales opportunity associated with this interaction, if applicable. Links interaction to active deal pipeline in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee (sales rep, account manager, field engineer, or service agent) who owns and logged this interaction. Maps to Workday HCM worker record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Object; Salesforce CRM User Object

attributes.name: request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service case or support ticket associated with this interaction, if applicable. Links interaction to after-sales support and CAPA processes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud Case Object; ISO 9001 CAPA

attributes.name: sla_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SLA agreement governing the response and service standards applicable to this customer interaction. Enables SLA compliance monitoring for after-sales and service interactions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud SLA; ISO 9001 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that originated or is associated with this interaction (e.g., trade show campaign, email nurture campaign). Links interaction to campaign ROI analysis.

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the CAPA record initiated as a result of this interaction, if applicable. Links customer feedback to the formal quality management corrective action process.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 10.2 Nonconformity and Corrective Action; SAP QM CAPA

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication medium or channel through which the interaction was conducted. Supports omnichannel relationship health analysis and customer experience tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Channel; ISO 9001 Clause 8.2.1 Customer Communication

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the interaction took place. Supports regional sales performance analysis and compliance with export control regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data governance and lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CreatedDate; ISO 9001 Records Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: crm_activity_code
attributes.description: External identifier of the corresponding Task or Event record in Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system traceability and delta-load reconciliation from the source system of record.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual elapsed duration of the interaction in minutes as recorded by the interaction owner. Supports engagement depth analysis and SLA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the customer interaction concluded. Combined with start timestamp to derive actual interaction duration.

attributes.name: external_participants
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer-side participant names and roles who attended the interaction (e.g., 'John Smith - VP Engineering, Jane Doe - Procurement Manager'). Classified confidential as it contains customer personnel information.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Invitees; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: follow_up_action
attributes.description: Description of the specific follow-up action to be taken after this interaction (e.g., 'Send product specification sheet', 'Schedule site visit', 'Prepare PPAP documentation').
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Task Description; ISO 9001 CAPA Process

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the follow-up action resulting from this interaction must be completed. Used for account manager task management and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Task Due Date; ISO 9001 Clause 8.2.1

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up action or subsequent interaction is required as a result of this interaction. Drives task creation and account manager workflow.

attributes.name: interaction_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer interaction took place. Used for day-level scheduling, reporting, and relationship cadence analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Date; ISO 9001 Customer Communication Records

attributes.name: interaction_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the interaction content, topics discussed, key decisions made, and context. Supports relationship history review and account management continuity.

attributes.name: interaction_source
attributes.description: System or method through which this interaction record was created or ingested. Supports data lineage tracking and source system reconciliation in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM Data Lineage; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: interaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the interaction record. Tracks whether the interaction has been planned, is underway, has been completed, or was cancelled or deferred.

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the customer interaction. Distinguishes between sales-driven, technical, executive, and survey touchpoints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales_call|site_visit|product_demo|technical_consultation|executive_briefing|trade_show_meeting|nps_survey|email_outreach — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Type; ISO 9001 Customer Communication

attributes.name: internal_participants
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of internal employee names or IDs who participated in the interaction (e.g., account manager, field application engineer, product specialist, executive sponsor). Supports multi-stakeholder engagement tracking.

attributes.name: is_customer_complaint
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction involved a formal or informal customer complaint. Triggers CAPA workflow and quality management escalation per ISO 9001 requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.2.1 Customer Communication; ISO 9001 Clause 10.2 Nonconformity and Corrective Action

attributes.name: is_executive_sponsor_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether an executive sponsor (C-level or VP-level) from the company participated in this interaction. Flags high-touch executive engagement for strategic account management reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity; Key Account Management Best Practice

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was last updated or modified. Supports delta-load processing in the lakehouse pipeline and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate; ISO 9001 Records Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Specific name or address of the location where the interaction occurred (e.g., 'Customer HQ - Detroit Plant 3', 'Hannover Messe Hall 9', 'Microsoft Teams'). Supports geographic analysis of customer engagement.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical or virtual location where the interaction took place. Distinguishes between customer-site visits, company-hosted meetings, trade show engagements, and virtual sessions.

attributes.name: next_interaction_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next scheduled customer interaction as agreed during this interaction. Supports proactive account management cadence and relationship continuity planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Next Step Date

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score captured during customer satisfaction survey interactions. Integer value on a 0–10 scale where 0–6 = Detractor, 7–8 = Passive, 9–10 = Promoter. Null for non-survey interaction types.
attributes.references: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Methodology; ISO 9001 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: High-level result or outcome classification of the interaction. Indicates whether the interaction advanced the relationship, was neutral, resulted in escalation, or outcome is still pending.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Result; ISO 9001 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction

attributes.name: outcome_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes elaborating on the interaction outcome, including specific commitments made, objections raised, or next steps agreed upon with the customer.

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: Total number of participants (internal and external combined) who attended the interaction. Used for engagement scale analysis and resource planning.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the interaction, reflecting the strategic importance of the customer or the urgency of the topic discussed. Drives account manager workload prioritization.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The primary product line or solution portfolio discussed during the interaction (e.g., 'Automation Systems', 'Electrification Solutions', 'Smart Infrastructure'). Supports product-level engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Product Line; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Product Classification

attributes.name: relationship_health_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–100) representing the assessed health of the customer relationship at the time of this interaction, as rated by the account manager. Distinct from NPS — this is an internal assessment, not a customer-provided score.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Health Score; Key Account Management Best Practice

attributes.name: satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction rating on a 1–5 scale collected at the end of the interaction (1 = Very Dissatisfied, 5 = Very Satisfied). Applicable to service calls, technical consultations, and post-delivery reviews.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction; Salesforce CRM Survey Response

attributes.name: sentiment_category
attributes.description: Categorized sentiment of the interaction as assessed by the interaction owner or derived from verbatim feedback analysis. Supports relationship health scoring and early warning detection for at-risk accounts.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction; Salesforce CRM Einstein Sentiment

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the customer interaction began. Used for duration calculation, scheduling conflict detection, and time-zone-aware reporting.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Short descriptive title or subject line summarizing the purpose of the interaction (e.g., 'Q3 Automation System Review', 'PLC Upgrade Technical Demo'). Maps to Salesforce CRM Activity Subject field.

attributes.name: verbatim_feedback
attributes.description: Unstructured, verbatim text feedback provided by the customer during or after the interaction. Captured for voice-of-customer (VoC) analysis, sentiment analysis, and continuous improvement programs. Classified confidential as it contains customer-specific business opinions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction; Salesforce CRM Survey Verbatim

products.name: customer_lead
products.description: Prospective customer records representing unqualified inbound or outbound sales leads for industrial automation, electrification, and smart infrastructure products. Maps to Salesforce CRM Lead object.
