Captures onboarding stage, checklist completion status, credit setup status, EDI/portal setup status, assigned onboarding coordinator, target completion date, actual completion date, and blockers. Ensures new OEM and distributor accounts are fully operational.

attributes.name: customer_onboarding_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the customer onboarding record. Primary key for the onboarding data product in the customer domain.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account being onboarded. Links this onboarding record to the master customer entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee assigned as the onboarding coordinator responsible for managing the activation workflow.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; Workday HCM

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the signed contract that triggered the onboarding workflow. Onboarding begins upon contract signature.

attributes.name: account_segment
attributes.description: Business segment classification of the customer account, used to prioritize onboarding resources and apply segment-specific SLA targets.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer account being onboarded. Determines the onboarding workflow template and requirements applied. OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), distributor, end-user, reseller, or strategic account.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the customer onboarding was fully completed and the account achieved first-order readiness. Null if onboarding is still in progress.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: assigned_sales_region
attributes.description: The sales region to which the customer account is assigned, used for coordinator assignment, reporting, and regional SLA management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: blocker_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the onboarding blocker type, enabling root cause analysis and process improvement reporting across the onboarding program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit|compliance|edi_technical|erp_setup|customer_response|internal_process|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; ISO 9001 CAPA

attributes.name: blocker_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any current impediment or blocker preventing the onboarding from progressing. Captures the nature of the issue for escalation and resolution tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; ISO 9001 CAPA

attributes.name: checklist_completion_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of onboarding checklist items that have been marked as completed. Provides a quantitative measure of onboarding progress (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: completed_checklist_items
attributes.description: The number of onboarding checklist items that have been completed and verified. Numerator for checklist completion percentage.

attributes.name: compliance_check_status
attributes.description: Status of mandatory regulatory and trade compliance screening for the new customer, including export control, sanctions screening, and anti-bribery checks.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; OSHA; EPA; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: contract_signature_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer signed the contract, marking the official start trigger for the onboarding workflow.

attributes.name: credit_limit_approved
attributes.description: The approved credit limit amount (in base currency) assigned to the customer account during onboarding. Established by the finance team as part of credit setup.

attributes.name: credit_setup_status
attributes.description: Current status of the credit limit and payment terms setup for the new customer account in SAP S/4HANA FI. A prerequisite for first order processing.

attributes.name: customer_primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the customer organization for onboarding communications and coordination.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: customer_primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the customer organization responsible for coordinating the onboarding process on the customer side.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: edi_setup_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integration setup for the customer. Tracks configuration, testing, and go-live of EDI order transmission channels.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; ANSI X12 EDI Standards

attributes.name: erp_account_created_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Account Created Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer master record has been successfully created in SAP S/4HANA. A mandatory prerequisite for order processing and invoicing.

attributes.name: erp_customer_number
attributes.description: The customer account number assigned in SAP S/4HANA upon master data creation. Used to link the onboarding record to the ERP customer master.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the onboarding case was formally escalated. Null if no escalation has occurred.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the onboarding case has been formally escalated to management due to a blocker, SLA risk, or customer dissatisfaction.

attributes.name: export_control_classification

domains.name: product
domains.description: Product catalog and offering management domain serving as the SSOT for all manufactured products, automation systems, electrification solutions, and smart infrastructure components. Manages SKU master data, product families, configurations, pricing structures, product lifecycle stages from NPI to end-of-life, and product portfolio management.

products.name: sku_master
products.description: Single source of truth for all Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) across the manufactured product portfolio. Captures the authoritative SKU identifier, description, unit of measure, weight, dimensions, hazardous material classification (UN number, hazard class, packing group, SDS reference), export control classification (ECCN), and lifecycle status. Serves as the foundational master record referenced by BOM, MES, ERP (SAP S/4HANA MM), and PLM (Siemens Teamcenter) systems. Every manufactured item, automation system component, electrification solution, and smart infrastructure element is registered here before it can be produced, sold, or shipped. Includes base/sales/production UoM with conversion factors and multi-language commercial descriptions. Note: product pricing structures are owned by the sales domain; this domain owns product identity, structure, and commercial catalog definition only.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU master record. Primary key for the SKU master data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Regulatory compliance matrix links each SKU to its primary regulatory requirement for catalog compliance reporting.

attributes.name: revenue_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Financial reporting of sales per SKU needs a dedicated revenue GL account for posting invoices.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Primary Supplier Assignment report requires each SKU to reference its main vendor for cost, lead‑time, and compliance decisions.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and consumption: A (high value, tight control), B (moderate value), C (low value, relaxed control). Used for inventory policy and cycle counting frequency.

attributes.name: base_uom

attributes.name: commercial_description

attributes.name: cost_currency

attributes.name: country_of_origin

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SKU master record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: dimension_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for length, width, and height dimensions. Standardized for consistent warehouse and logistics operations.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator

attributes.name: height

attributes.name: hts_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: make_or_buy_code
