attributes.references: IEC 61508 Functional Safety, ISO 14224 Reliability Data, CMMS Best Practices

attributes.name: plm_category
attributes.description: Classification code or category assigned in the PLM system (Siemens Teamcenter). Used for document management, BOM (Bill of Materials) structure, and engineering change control (ECO/ECN).
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, ISO 10303 STEP (Product Data Representation)

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this family are manufactured in-house, purchased from suppliers, or a combination of both. Drives sourcing strategy and supply chain planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM), SAP Ariba Procurement

attributes.name: product_line_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the product manager or product line owner responsible for this family. Accountable for portfolio strategy, pricing, and lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Product Management Best Practices, SAP S/4HANA User Assignment

attributes.name: product_portfolio_strategy
attributes.description: Strategic classification of the product family in the corporate portfolio. Invest families receive R&D funding and growth initiatives. Maintain families sustain current market position. Harvest families maximize cash flow with minimal investment. Divest families are candidates for discontinuation or sale.
attributes.references: BCG Growth-Share Matrix, Product Portfolio Management Best Practices

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Administrative status of this master data record. Active records are current and in use. Inactive records are deprecated but retained for historical reference. Pending approval records await governance review. Archived records are retained for compliance but not operational use.
attributes.references: Data Governance Best Practices, Informatica MDM (Master Data Management)

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: Primary sales organization code responsible for selling products in this family. Defines sales territory, pricing authority, and revenue attribution in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) Organizational Structure

attributes.name: service_level_tier
attributes.description: Default service level tier for products in this family. Defines response time commitments, spare parts availability, and support escalation paths. Influences service pricing and customer expectations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Service Management, SLA (Service Level Agreement) Best Practices

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Average standard cost per unit for products in this family, used for financial planning and margin analysis. Expressed in the company's base currency. Aggregated from individual SKU costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO), IFRS/GAAP Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer segment or persona targeted by this product family (e.g., large industrial OEMs, mid-size system integrators, building owners, utilities). Guides marketing campaigns and sales territory planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Customer Segmentation, Market Segmentation Best Practices

attributes.name: target_margin_percent
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for products in this family, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 35.50 for 35.5%). Used for pricing strategy, product mix optimization, and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO), Financial Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: technology_platform
attributes.description: Underlying technology platform or architecture shared by products in this family (e.g., SIMATIC Platform, SINAMICS Drive Platform, Desigo Building Automation Platform). Enables commonality analysis and platform lifecycle planning.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM (Platform Management), ISO 10303 STEP

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Standard warranty period in months offered for products in this family. Defines the baseline service commitment and influences pricing and service revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Service Management, ISO 9001 Quality Management

products.name: catalog_entry
products.description: The commercial product catalog representing all individually orderable products, automation systems, electrification solutions, and smart infrastructure components available for sale. Captures catalog entry status, effective date ranges, sales channels (direct, distributor, OEM), regional availability, list price reference, OEM vs. standard offering flags, and catalog version. Acts as the bridge between the engineering SKU master and the commercial sales offering — not all SKUs are orderable, and catalog_entry defines which ones are. Managed in SAP S/4HANA SD and synchronized with Salesforce CRM product catalog.

attributes.name: catalog_entry_id
attributes.description: Primary key for catalog_entry

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product manager responsible for this catalog entry. Supports product ownership and accountability.

attributes.name: replacement_catalog_catalog_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catalog entry that replaces this product when it is discontinued or superseded. Supports product transition management and customer migration.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering SKU master data. Links the commercial catalog entry to the underlying product master record managed in SAP S/4HANA MM and Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: catalog_description
attributes.description: Detailed commercial description of the product offering including key features, benefits, and applications. Used in sales literature and customer communications.

attributes.name: catalog_image_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the primary product image for this catalog entry. Used in online catalogs, e-commerce platforms, and sales presentations.

attributes.name: catalog_name
attributes.description: The commercial product name as it appears in sales catalogs, quotations, and customer-facing documentation. May differ from the engineering product name.

attributes.name: catalog_number
attributes.description: The externally-facing commercial catalog identifier used in sales orders, quotations, and customer communications. This is the orderable product code visible to customers and distributors.

attributes.name: catalog_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the catalog entry indicating whether the product is available for sale, pending launch, or being phased out.

attributes.name: catalog_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the product catalog publication (e.g., 2024.1, 2024.2). Supports catalog change management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: certification_marks
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of certification marks and compliance logos applicable to this catalog entry (e.g., UL, CE, CSA, IEC). Used for regulatory compliance and customer requirements.
attributes.references: UL (Underwriters Laboratories), CE Marking (European Conformity), IEC Standards

attributes.name: configurable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog entry supports customer-specific configuration or customization (e.g., programmable controllers, modular systems with selectable options).

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the country where this product is manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs declarations and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this catalog entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the list price (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: distribution_chain
attributes.description: The distribution chain identifier combining sales organization, distribution channel, and division. Used for SAP SD integration and order processing.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this catalog entry is no longer available for new orders. Null for products with indefinite availability. Used for planned product discontinuations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this catalog entry becomes available for sale and order entry. Supports time-based product launches and regional rollouts.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance
attributes.description: Environmental compliance certifications and declarations for this catalog entry (e.g., RoHS, REACH, WEEE). Required for sales in regulated markets.
attributes.references: EU RoHS Directive, EU REACH Regulation, WEEE Directive

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification for this catalog entry under applicable trade regulations (e.g., US ECCN, EU dual-use codes). Required for international sales compliance.
attributes.references: US Export Administration Regulations (EAR), EU Dual-Use Regulation

attributes.name: harmonized_tariff_code
attributes.description: International harmonized commodity code for customs and tariff classification. Used for import/export documentation and duty calculation.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog entry contains or is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling, shipping, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard, UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this catalog entry record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_price_update_date
attributes.description: The date when the list price for this catalog entry was last updated. Used for price change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle from New Product Introduction (NPI) through end-of-life. Used for portfolio management and strategic planning.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: The standard list price for this catalog entry in the base currency. Actual transaction prices may vary based on customer agreements, volume discounts, and promotions.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered for this catalog entry. Used to enforce business rules for small-volume orders and manufacturing lot sizes.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who last modified this catalog entry record. Used for audit trails and accountability.

attributes.name: oem_offering_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog entry is an OEM product sold to other manufacturers for integration into their systems, as opposed to a standard commercial offering.

attributes.name: orderable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog entry can be directly ordered by customers. Not all SKUs are orderable; some are components or service parts only.

attributes.name: price_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for pricing (each, piece, set, kilogram, meter, square meter, cubic meter, liter, hour). Defines the quantity basis for the list price. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|SET|KG|M|M2|M3|L|HR — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level product category classification aligning with the business strategic product portfolio segments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automation_systems|electrification_solutions|smart_infrastructure|industrial_controls|power_distribution|building_automation|process_automation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_family_code
attributes.description: Classification code identifying the product family or product line to which this catalog entry belongs (e.g., automation controllers, motor drives, circuit breakers).

attributes.name: regional_availability
attributes.description: Geographic regions or countries where this catalog entry is available for sale. Supports regional product portfolio management and compliance with local regulations.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel through which this catalog entry is sold (direct sales force, distributor network, OEM partnerships, online store, or channel partners).

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: The SAP sales organization responsible for this catalog entry. Supports multi-org catalog management and sales territory alignment.

attributes.name: service_level_tier
attributes.description: The default service level tier associated with this catalog entry, determining response times and support coverage for after-sales service.

attributes.name: standard_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The standard number of days from order receipt to shipment for this catalog entry under normal conditions. Used for customer delivery commitments and order promising.

attributes.name: technical_datasheet_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the technical datasheet or specification document for this catalog entry. Provides detailed technical information for customers and sales teams.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Standard warranty period in months offered for this catalog entry. Used for customer communications and service planning.

products.name: configuration
products.description: Manages configurable product variants and option sets for make-to-order and engineer-to-order automation systems and electrification solutions. Captures configuration rules, valid option combinations, constraint logic, base model references, and configured variant codes. Supports CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) workflows in Salesforce CRM and variant configuration in SAP S/4HANA. Tracks which configuration options are available per product family, regional market, and customer segment.

attributes.name: configuration_id
attributes.description: Primary key for configuration

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials (BOM) that defines the components and assemblies required to manufacture this configuration.

attributes.name: option_set_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the collection of configuration options and rules that define valid combinations for this configuration.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Configuration Ownership Accountability Report needs to link configuration_owner to employee for audit trail.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the manufacturing routing or process plan used to produce this configuration. Defines the sequence of operations.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the base product or product family that this configuration is derived from. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: superseded_by_configuration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the configuration that replaces this one when it becomes obsolete. Supports product migration and upgrade paths.

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Intended application or use case for this configuration. Describes the operational context where the product will be deployed.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this configuration was formally approved for use in quoting and order fulfillment. Part of the configuration governance process.

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: Starting price for the base product before configuration options are applied. Expressed in the default currency.

attributes.name: certification_requirements
attributes.description: List of required certifications and compliance standards for this configuration, such as CE, UL, ISO certifications. Varies by market and application.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, CE Marking, UL Certification Standards

attributes.name: configuration_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the configured product variant. Used in CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) workflows and order processing systems.

attributes.name: configuration_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the configured product variant, including key features, options selected, and intended use case.

attributes.name: configuration_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title for the configured product variant. Describes the specific configuration in business terms.

attributes.name: configuration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product configuration. Indicates whether the configuration is available for quoting and ordering. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|active|inactive|obsolete|pending_approval|approved|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: configuration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the configuration approach. Standard configurations are pre-defined, custom configurations are unique to customer requirements, engineer-to-order requires design work, make-to-order uses existing designs with custom parameters, configure-to-order selects from predefined options, and assemble-to-order combines standard modules.

attributes.name: constraint_rules
attributes.description: Business rules and constraints that govern valid option combinations for this configuration. Defines incompatibilities, dependencies, and mandatory selections.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for pricing fields. Indicates the currency in which prices are expressed.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment or industry vertical for this configuration. Examples include automotive, energy, infrastructure, building automation.

attributes.name: dimensions_height_mm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the configured product in millimeters. Critical for packaging, shipping, and installation planning.

attributes.name: dimensions_length_mm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the configured product in millimeters. Critical for packaging, shipping, and installation planning.

attributes.name: dimensions_width_mm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the configured product in millimeters. Critical for packaging, shipping, and installation planning.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this configuration is no longer available for new orders. Supports product phase-out and end-of-life management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this configuration becomes available for quoting and ordering. Supports phased product launches and market introductions.

attributes.name: is_orderable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this configuration can currently be ordered. Used to control availability in CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) and order management systems.

attributes.name: is_quotable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this configuration can be included in customer quotes. May be quotable but not yet orderable during pre-launch phases.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard manufacturing and delivery lead time for this configuration in days. Used for order promising and scheduling.
attributes.references: MRP (Material Requirements Planning) Lead Time Standard

attributes.name: manufacturing_complexity
attributes.description: Assessment of the manufacturing complexity for this configuration. Impacts production planning, resource allocation, and lead time.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be ordered for this configuration. Used to enforce economic order quantities and production efficiency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this configuration. Used for internal communication and documentation.

attributes.name: power_rating_kw
attributes.description: Electrical power rating of the configured product in kilowatts. Relevant for electrification solutions and automation systems.

attributes.name: price_adjustment
attributes.description: Total price adjustment resulting from selected configuration options. Can be positive (upcharge) or negative (discount).

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: Pricing approach used for this configuration. Determines how the final price is calculated based on base product and selected options.

attributes.name: product_family_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the product family or product line to which this configuration belongs. Used for portfolio management and reporting.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Product Family Taxonomy

attributes.name: regional_availability
attributes.description: Geographic regions or markets where this configuration is available for sale. Comma-separated list of region codes or market identifiers.

attributes.name: requires_engineering_review
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether orders for this configuration require engineering review and approval before production. Common for engineer-to-order configurations.

attributes.name: selected_options
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of specific option codes selected for this configuration variant. Represents the actual choices made from the available option set.

attributes.name: technical_specification_document
attributes.description: Reference to the technical specification document or datasheet that provides detailed engineering specifications for this configuration.

attributes.name: total_configuration_price
attributes.description: Final calculated price for the configured product variant, including base price and all option adjustments.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this configuration. Supports configuration change management and revision control.

attributes.name: voltage_rating
attributes.description: Operating voltage specification for the configured product. Critical for electrical compatibility and safety compliance.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the configured product in kilograms. Used for shipping, logistics planning, and installation requirements.

products.name: bom_header
products.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) header record defining the top-level assembly structure for manufactured products, automation systems, and electrification solutions. Captures BOM type (engineering BOM, manufacturing BOM, sales BOM), BOM status, effective date range, plant assignment, base quantity, and revision level. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and synchronized to SAP S/4HANA PP for production planning. The BOM header is the authoritative structural definition of a manufactured product.
products.reference: SAP BOM Header (CS01/MM01), Siemens Teamcenter BOM

attributes.name: bom_header_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM header record. Primary key for the BOM header entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Engineering cost allocation tracks BOM creation expenses against the responsible cost center.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the most recent cost estimate calculated for this BOM. Links to costing records that roll up material, labor, and overhead costs from BOM components.

attributes.name: plant_data_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production facility where this BOM is valid and used. BOMs can be plant-specific to accommodate local manufacturing processes and material availability.

attributes.name: primary_bom_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the design engineer or engineering team responsible for maintaining this BOM. Primary contact for BOM-related questions and change requests.

attributes.name: product_family_id
attributes.description: FK to product.family

attributes.name: quaternary_bom_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this BOM header record. Immutable audit field for accountability and traceability.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufactured product, automation system, or electrification solution that this BOM defines. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: tertiary_bom_last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this BOM header record. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: alternative_bom_indicator
attributes.description: Identifier for alternative BOM versions for the same product. Allows multiple valid BOMs for a product to support different manufacturing methods, material substitutions, or regional variations.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this BOM version was formally approved for production use. Marks the completion of engineering review and quality validation processes.

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The reference quantity for which the BOM is defined. All component quantities in the BOM lines are specified relative to this base quantity. Typically 1 unit of the finished product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM Base Quantity

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base quantity. Defines the measurement unit (EA, KG, M, L, etc.) for the finished product quantity.

attributes.name: bom_category
attributes.description: Structural classification of the BOM. Standard for fixed structures, Configurable for variant BOMs, Phantom for transient assemblies, Reference for documentation, Kit for bundled items.

attributes.name: bom_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the BOM purpose, scope, or special characteristics. Provides context for the BOM structure and its intended application.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the BOM. Externally-known unique code used across PLM and ERP systems for referencing the BOM structure.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM header. Tracks progression from draft through approval to active production use and eventual obsolescence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|active|frozen|obsolete|archived — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended use. Engineering BOM for design, Manufacturing BOM for production, Sales BOM for customer-facing configurations, Service BOM for maintenance, Planning BOM for MRP, Costing BOM for financial analysis.

attributes.name: bom_usage
attributes.description: Intended application context for this BOM. Defines whether the BOM is used for production runs, prototyping, spare parts management, rework operations, simulation, or testing purposes.

attributes.name: configuration_profile
attributes.description: Reference to the variant configuration profile for configurable products. Links the BOM to the product configurator rules and constraints.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM header record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM version becomes valid and can be used for production planning and manufacturing execution. Supports phased rollout of engineering changes.

attributes.name: engineering_change_notice_number
attributes.description: Reference to the ECN that communicated the engineering change. ECNs notify stakeholders of approved changes before implementation.

attributes.name: engineering_change_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the ECO that authorized the creation or modification of this BOM version. Provides traceability to the engineering change management process.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM must comply with environmental regulations (RoHS, REACH, WEEE, ISO 14001). Used to enforce material restrictions and sustainability requirements.

attributes.name: erp_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this BOM in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA PP). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this BOM version is no longer valid for production use. Nullable for BOMs without a planned end date. Used to phase out obsolete BOM structures.

attributes.name: explosion_type
attributes.description: Defines how the BOM structure is expanded in planning and costing. Single-level shows immediate components, Multi-level shows full hierarchy, Summarized aggregates across levels.

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM supports variant configuration. True for BOMs with configurable components or optional features that can be selected during order entry.

attributes.name: is_critical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM is for a critical product requiring special handling, quality controls, or regulatory compliance. Used to trigger enhanced review and approval workflows.

attributes.name: is_phantom
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a phantom BOM. Phantom BOMs represent transient assemblies that are not stocked but are consumed immediately in the parent assembly.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this BOM header record. Used for change tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: lot_size
attributes.description: Standard production batch size for which this BOM is optimized. Used in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and production scheduling to determine component requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the BOM. Used for manufacturing notes, quality alerts, or design rationale.

attributes.name: plm_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this BOM in the source PLM system (Siemens Teamcenter). Used for synchronization and traceability between PLM and ERP systems.

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Identifier linking the BOM to a specific production process and routing. Enables multiple production methods for the same product with different BOM and routing combinations.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM is subject to regulatory compliance requirements (CE marking, UL certification, IEC standards, etc.). Triggers additional documentation and validation workflows.
attributes.references: IEC 61131 PLC Programming, CE Marking, UL Product Safety

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Version identifier for the BOM structure. Incremented with each Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Engineering Change Notice (ECN) that modifies the BOM.

products.name: product_bom_line
products.description: Individual component line items within a Bill of Materials (BOM), representing the parent-child assembly relationships for manufactured products. Captures component SKU reference, quantity per assembly, unit of measure, item category (stock, non-stock, phantom), scrap factor, lead time offset, alternative item group, and engineering change order (ECO) reference. Supports multi-level BOM explosion for MRP runs in SAP S/4HANA PP and production routing in Siemens Opcenter MES. Each bom_line belongs to exactly one bom_header and references exactly one component from sku_master.
products.reference: SAP BOM Item (CS01), Siemens Teamcenter BOM Line

attributes.name: product_bom_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Bill of Materials (BOM) Line ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM line item. Primary key for the product_bom_line entity.

attributes.name: bom_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent BOM header that this line belongs to. Each BOM line must belong to exactly one BOM header.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Production planning reports require each BOM line to reference the engineering component master to ensure design consistency and cost roll‑up.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.drawing. Business justification: Manufacturing execution system uses the drawing ID per BOM line to fetch exact assembly drawings for work orders and quality inspections.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: BOM validation checks that each component complies with the required regulation (e.g., RoHS).

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the component material or part from the SKU master data that is required for this assembly. Each BOM line references exactly one component SKU.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: BOM Supplier Allocation process tracks which vendor supplies each component, essential for production scheduling and quality audits.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center or production resource where this component is consumed. Used for shop floor material staging and kitting.
attributes.references: Siemens Opcenter MES Shop Floor Control

attributes.name: alternative_item_group
attributes.description: Identifier for a group of interchangeable components that can substitute for each other in the assembly. Used for flexible BOM structures and supply chain resilience.

attributes.name: alternative_item_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this component within its alternative item group. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for material selection during MRP and production execution.

attributes.name: assembly_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this component in the multi-level BOM structure. Level 0 is the finished product, level 1 is direct sub-assembly, level 2 is sub-sub-assembly, etc. Used for BOM explosion and implosion.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is consumed automatically via backflushing when the operation is confirmed (True) or requires manual goods issue (False). Used in lean manufacturing and MES integration.

attributes.name: bulk_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is a bulk material (liquids, powders, gases) that requires special handling, storage, and measurement during production.

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: Internal change control number tracking modifications to this BOM line. Used for audit trail and version control in engineering change management.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Engineering Change Management

attributes.name: component_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the component part or material used in the assembly, providing additional context beyond the SKU reference.

attributes.name: component_height_mm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the component in millimeters. Used for variable-size materials and spatial planning in assembly.

attributes.name: component_length_mm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the component in millimeters. Used for variable-size materials and spatial planning in assembly.

attributes.name: component_origin
attributes.description: Procurement strategy for this component: make (manufactured in-house), buy (purchased from supplier), make_or_buy (flexible sourcing), subcontract (outsourced manufacturing).

attributes.name: component_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the component in kilograms. Used for calculating total assembly weight, shipping weight, and material handling requirements.

attributes.name: component_width_mm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the component in millimeters. Used for variable-size materials and spatial planning in assembly.

attributes.name: cost_relevance_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component should be included in product costing calculations. Text items and phantom assemblies are typically not cost-relevant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Product Cost Controlling

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this BOM line record. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is critical for production and requires special attention in material planning, procurement, and availability checking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Material Requirements Planning (MRP)

attributes.name: ecn_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Notice that authorized this BOM line change. Provides traceability to engineering change documentation.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Engineering Change Management

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Order that introduced or modified this BOM line. Links BOM changes to formal engineering change management processes.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Engineering Change Management

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this BOM line is no longer active and should not be used in new production orders. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line becomes active and should be used in production planning and execution. Supports date-effectivity for phased component changes.

attributes.name: fixed_quantity_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of parent assembly batch size (True) or scales proportionally with batch size (False). Used for setup materials and consumables.

attributes.name: installation_point
attributes.description: Physical location or position identifier where this component is installed in the parent assembly. Used for assembly instructions and service documentation.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM line item type: stock (regular inventory item), non_stock (direct procurement), phantom (pass-through assembly with no inventory), text (documentation only), variable_size (length/weight variable), co_product (joint output), by_product (secondary output). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stock|non_stock|phantom|text|variable_size|co_product|by_product — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the parent assembly start date that this component must be available. Used for backward scheduling in production planning and MRP runs.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the BOM header, used for ordering and referencing specific components in the assembly structure.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this BOM line record. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, comments, or special handling requirements for this component in the assembly process.

attributes.name: operation_sequence
attributes.description: The routing operation number at which this component is consumed or installed in the manufacturing process. Links BOM to routing for integrated production planning.

attributes.name: product_bom_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM line: active (in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), pending (awaiting approval), obsolete (phased out), blocked (quality hold), released (approved for production).

attributes.name: quantity_per_assembly
attributes.description: The required quantity of this component needed to produce one unit of the parent assembly. Supports up to 6 decimal places for precision in chemical, pharmaceutical, and electronics manufacturing.

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Engineering revision level or version of this BOM line. Tracks design iterations and ensures correct component versions are used in production.

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percent
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage for this component during the manufacturing process. Used by MRP to calculate additional material requirements. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Material Requirements Planning (MRP)

attributes.name: spare_part_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is also available as a spare part for after-sales service and maintenance. Used for service parts planning and documentation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the component quantity (e.g., EA=Each, PC=Piece, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter, M=Meter). Must align with the component SKU base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|G|L|ML|M|CM|FT|IN|LB|OZ|SET|BOX|ROLL|SHEET — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: lifecycle_stage
products.description: Tracks the lifecycle stage of each product from New Product Introduction (NPI) through active production, phase-down, and end-of-life (EOL). Captures lifecycle stage code, stage entry date, planned EOL date, last-time-buy date, last-time-ship date, replacement product reference, and lifecycle decision rationale. Supports portfolio rationalization, supply chain wind-down planning, and customer communication for discontinued automation and electrification products. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.
products.reference: PLM Lifecycle Management, APQP Phase Gates

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lifecycle_stage

attributes.name: lifecycle_sku_master_id
attributes.description: FK to product.sku_master

attributes.name: primary_lifecycle_sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product in the product master catalog. Links this lifecycle stage record to the specific manufactured product, automation system, electrification solution, or smart infrastructure component.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: EOL and phase‑out decisions depend on regulatory deadlines; linking each lifecycle stage to its governing regulation.

attributes.name: actual_eol_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the product reached end-of-life status. May differ from planned EOL date due to market conditions, inventory levels, or strategic decisions.
attributes.references: Product Lifecycle Management Best Practices; Siemens Teamcenter PLM EOL Tracking

attributes.name: customer_communication_status
attributes.description: Status of customer notification and communication activities regarding the lifecycle stage change. Ensures timely and coordinated customer outreach for product discontinuations and transitions.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when customers were officially notified of the lifecycle stage change, particularly for phase-down and end-of-life transitions. Critical for customer relationship management and contractual obligations.

attributes.name: eco_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Engineering Change Order that authorized or documented the lifecycle stage transition, if applicable. Links lifecycle decisions to formal engineering change management processes.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Change Management; ISO 9001 Configuration Management

attributes.name: financial_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Summary of the financial implications of the lifecycle stage transition, including revenue impact, inventory write-offs, cost savings, and investment requirements. Business-confidential information for portfolio management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Accounting; Financial Planning and Analysis

attributes.name: internal_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when internal stakeholders (sales, service, manufacturing, engineering) were notified of the lifecycle stage change to align cross-functional activities.

attributes.name: inventory_wind_down_plan
attributes.description: Summary of the inventory management strategy for phasing out the product, including target inventory levels, sell-through timelines, and disposition plans for excess stock.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active lifecycle stage record for the product. Supports lifecycle history tracking with multiple stage records per product over time.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date by which customers can place orders for the product before it is discontinued. Critical milestone for customer communication and order management during product phase-out.
attributes.references: Product Discontinuation Management; Siemens Teamcenter PLM EOL Process

attributes.name: last_time_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date by which the product will be shipped to customers. Represents the absolute end of product availability and delivery.
attributes.references: Product Discontinuation Management; Siemens Teamcenter PLM EOL Process

attributes.name: lifecycle_decision_authority
attributes.description: Name or role of the person or committee that authorized the lifecycle stage transition. Supports governance and accountability for product portfolio decisions.
attributes.references: Product Lifecycle Management Governance; ISO 9001 Management Responsibility

attributes.name: lifecycle_decision_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification and reasoning for the lifecycle stage transition. Documents strategic, market, technical, or regulatory factors driving the lifecycle decision for portfolio rationalization and governance.
attributes.references: Product Lifecycle Management Governance; ISO 9001 Management Review

attributes.name: lifecycle_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent lifecycle stage review or assessment. Ensures regular evaluation of product portfolio health and lifecycle progression.
attributes.references: Product Lifecycle Management Best Practices; ISO 9001 Management Review

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage_code
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the product. NPI = New Product Introduction (pre-production or early launch), ACTIVE = Full production and sales, MATURE = Established product with stable demand, PHASE_DOWN = Planned reduction in production, EOL = End of Life (discontinued), OBSOLETE = No longer supported or available.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Product Lifecycle Management; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Lifecycle States

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the lifecycle stage for reporting and communication purposes.

attributes.name: manufacturing_discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when manufacturing and production of the product will cease. Drives supply chain wind-down, capacity reallocation, and inventory planning.
attributes.references: Siemens Opcenter MES Manufacturing Execution; SAP S/4HANA PP Production Planning

attributes.name: market_demand_trend
attributes.description: Current market demand trend for the product. GROWING = increasing sales and market share, STABLE = consistent demand, DECLINING = decreasing sales, VOLATILE = unpredictable fluctuations, UNKNOWN = insufficient data. Informs lifecycle stage decisions and portfolio strategy.
attributes.references: Market Analysis and Product Portfolio Management

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next lifecycle stage review. Supports proactive lifecycle management and timely decision-making for product portfolio optimization.

attributes.name: planned_eol_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the product will reach end-of-life status and be discontinued from active production and sales. Critical for supply chain wind-down planning and customer communication.
attributes.references: Product Lifecycle Management Best Practices; Siemens Teamcenter PLM EOL Planning

attributes.name: previous_lifecycle_stage_code
attributes.description: The lifecycle stage code that preceded the current stage. Enables lifecycle transition analysis and stage progression tracking.

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this lifecycle stage record. Supports accountability and audit trail for lifecycle decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management System; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle stage record was created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage for lifecycle management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management System; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this lifecycle stage record. Supports accountability and audit trail for lifecycle changes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management System; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this lifecycle stage record. Enables change tracking and audit trail for lifecycle management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management System; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_impact
attributes.description: Description of any regulatory or compliance factors influencing the lifecycle stage decision, such as safety standards updates, environmental regulations, or certification requirements for industrial automation and electrification products.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Regulatory Compliance; IEC 62443 Industrial Cybersecurity; CE Marking; UL Certification

attributes.name: sales_discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when active sales and marketing efforts for the product will cease. May differ from last-time-buy date to allow for inventory sell-through.
attributes.references: Sales and Marketing Management; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: service_support_end_date
attributes.description: Date when after-sales service, technical support, and spare parts availability will cease for the product. Critical for customer service planning and SLA management.
attributes.references: After-Sales Service Management; Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; ISO 9001 Customer Service

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this lifecycle stage record originated, typically Siemens Teamcenter PLM. Supports data lineage and integration traceability.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this lifecycle stage record in the source system. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.
attributes.references: Data Integration and Master Data Management Standards

attributes.name: spare_parts_availability_end_date
attributes.description: Date when spare parts for the product will no longer be available for purchase. Important for maintenance planning and customer communication for automation and electrification systems.
attributes.references: After-Sales Service Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Management

attributes.name: stage_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the lifecycle stage transition became effective in the system. Supports audit trail and change tracking for lifecycle decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management System; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Change Management

attributes.name: stage_entry_date
attributes.description: Date when the product entered the current lifecycle stage. Used to track time-in-stage and lifecycle progression analytics.

attributes.name: supplier_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when suppliers and supply chain partners were notified of the lifecycle stage change to coordinate material procurement wind-down and component availability.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Supplier Management; Supply Chain Management

attributes.name: warranty_support_end_date
attributes.description: Date when warranty coverage for newly sold units of this product will cease. Affects sales terms and customer commitments during product phase-out.
attributes.references: Warranty Management; Salesforce CRM Service Cloud

products.name: product_revision
products.description: Manages engineering revision history for manufactured products, tracking each revision level, Engineering Change Order (ECO) and Engineering Change Notice (ECN) references, revision description, effectivity date, and approval status. Captures the delta between revisions including affected BOM lines, drawing changes, and specification updates. Ensures traceability from product design through manufacturing execution per ISO 9001 document control requirements. Sourced from Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: product_revision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product revision record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Revision approval logs approved_by_employee_id to capture the engineer authorizing the product revision.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product for which this revision applies. Links to the product master record.

attributes.name: superseded_revision_product_revision_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous product revision that this revision replaces. Maintains revision lineage and traceability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this revision was formally approved for release to manufacturing.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the revision within the engineering change control workflow.

attributes.name: bom_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision includes changes to the product Bill of Materials structure or component list.
attributes.references: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Best Practices, MRP (Material Requirements Planning)

attributes.name: change_impact_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the magnitude and scope of impact this revision has on form, fit, function, manufacturing process, or supply chain.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorization of the primary business reason or driver for this engineering revision.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revision record was first created in the source system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers must be formally notified of this revision due to impact on form, fit, function, or regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: drawing_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision includes changes to engineering drawings, CAD (Computer-Aided Design) models, or technical documentation.

attributes.name: ecn_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Engineering Change Notice that communicated this revision to stakeholders. Documents the notification of the approved change.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Engineering Change Order that authorized this revision. Provides traceability to the formal change request and approval process.

attributes.name: effectivity_date
attributes.description: Date when this revision becomes effective for manufacturing and procurement. Determines when the new revision must be used in production.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, MRP (Material Requirements Planning) Standards

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_end
attributes.description: Ending serial number through which this revision is effective, when effectivity is controlled by serial number range.

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_start
attributes.description: Starting serial number from which this revision is effective, when effectivity is controlled by serial number.

attributes.name: effectivity_type
attributes.description: Method by which the revision effectivity is controlled (by date, serial number range, lot/batch, or immediate implementation).
attributes.references: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Best Practices, ISO 9001

attributes.name: interchangeability_code
attributes.description: Defines whether this revision can be substituted for previous revisions in existing assemblies or field installations.
attributes.references: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Best Practices, ISO 9001

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revision record was last updated in the source system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, comments, or instructions related to this revision for engineering, manufacturing, or quality teams.

attributes.name: obsolete_date
attributes.description: Date when this revision was marked as obsolete and no longer valid for new production orders.

attributes.name: ppap_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires a new Production Part Approval Process submission to customers.
attributes.references: PPAP (Production Part Approval Process), APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning)

attributes.name: process_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires changes to manufacturing processes, work instructions, or shop floor procedures.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires re-certification or approval from regulatory bodies (UL, CE, OSHA, EPA, etc.).
attributes.references: ISO 9001, UL Standards, CE Marking Directive

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when this revision was officially released to production and made available for use in manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Best Practices

attributes.name: revision_code
attributes.description: Engineering revision level identifier (e.g., A, B, C, 01, 02). Represents the sequential version of the product design.

attributes.name: revision_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the changes introduced in this revision, including design modifications, material changes, or process improvements.

attributes.name: revision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product revision indicating its approval and release state.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) or ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system from which this revision record originated.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this revision record in the source PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) system for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: specification_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision includes changes to product specifications, performance requirements, or acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: testing_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires changes to quality testing procedures, inspection plans, or validation protocols.

attributes.name: tooling_affected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision requires changes to manufacturing tooling, fixtures, jigs, or molds.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning), DFM (Design for Manufacturability)

products.name: product_specification
products.description: Technical and commercial specifications for manufactured products, automation systems, and electrification solutions. Captures electrical ratings, mechanical dimensions, environmental ratings (IP class, NEMA class), operating temperature range, performance parameters, and application suitability. Includes references to associated technical documentation (datasheets, installation manuals, safety data sheets) managed in the engineering domain's document management system. Serves as the authoritative technical specification record referenced by engineering, quality, and sales teams. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and SAP S/4HANA. Note: certification records (UL, CE, IEC, ATEX, RoHS/REACH) are tracked separately in the certification product.
products.reference: PLM Product Specification, IEC/UL/CE Technical Standards

attributes.name: product_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product specification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Specification approval workflow tracks which engineer approved each spec via approved_by_employee_id.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Specification approval workflow requires linking each specification to the governing regulatory standard.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product in the product catalog. Links this specification to the master product record.

attributes.name: altitude_rating_meters
attributes.description: Maximum operating altitude in meters above sea level. Defines altitude limitations for product operation due to air pressure and cooling considerations.

attributes.name: application_suitability
attributes.description: Intended application areas and use cases. Describes the industrial applications, environments, or processes for which the product is designed and suitable.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification version was formally approved. Tracks the approval milestone in the specification lifecycle.

attributes.name: color_finish
attributes.description: Product color and surface finish. Describes the external appearance and coating (e.g., RAL 7035 light grey, powder coated, anodized aluminum).

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Supported communication protocols for data exchange. Lists the industrial communication standards the product supports (e.g., PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, OPC UA).

attributes.name: connection_type
attributes.description: Electrical connection or terminal type. Describes the method for connecting wires or cables to the product (e.g., screw terminals, spring clamp, plug connector).

attributes.name: current_rating_amperes
attributes.description: Maximum continuous current rating in amperes. Defines the electrical current capacity of the product.

attributes.name: datasheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the associated product datasheet. Links to the detailed technical datasheet managed in the engineering document management system.

attributes.name: dimensions_height_mm
attributes.description: Product height dimension in millimeters. Defines the physical height for installation planning and space requirements.

attributes.name: dimensions_length_mm
attributes.description: Product length dimension in millimeters. Defines the physical length for installation planning and space requirements.

attributes.name: dimensions_width_mm
attributes.description: Product width dimension in millimeters. Defines the physical width for installation planning and space requirements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification version becomes effective and applicable for use in engineering, manufacturing, and sales processes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification version is no longer valid or has been superseded by a newer revision. Null for active specifications without planned obsolescence.

attributes.name: frequency_rating_hz
attributes.description: Operating frequency rating in Hertz. Specifies the electrical frequency the product is designed for (e.g., 50Hz, 60Hz, 50/60Hz).

attributes.name: humidity_rating_percent
attributes.description: Relative humidity rating or range for product operation. Specifies the acceptable humidity conditions (e.g., 5-95% RH non-condensing).

attributes.name: installation_manual_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the installation manual. Links to the installation instructions managed in the engineering document management system.

attributes.name: ip_rating
attributes.description: Ingress Protection rating per IEC 60529 standard. Defines the level of protection against solid objects and liquids (e.g., IP65, IP67, IP20).

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: Primary materials used in product construction. Lists the key materials and their properties (e.g., stainless steel housing, polycarbonate cover, copper conductors).

attributes.name: mounting_type
attributes.description: Physical mounting method for the product. Specifies how the product is installed (e.g., DIN rail, panel mount, wall mount).

attributes.name: nema_rating
attributes.description: NEMA enclosure rating for North American markets. Defines environmental protection level (e.g., NEMA1, NEMA4, NEMA4X, NEMA12).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the specification. Captures supplementary information for engineering, quality, or sales teams.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum operating ambient temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the upper temperature limit for safe and reliable product operation.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum operating ambient temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the lower temperature limit for safe and reliable product operation.

attributes.name: performance_parameter
attributes.description: Key performance parameters and metrics. Describes critical performance characteristics such as response time, accuracy, throughput, or efficiency ratings specific to the product type.

attributes.name: power_rating_watts
attributes.description: Electrical power rating in watts. Specifies the maximum power consumption or output capacity of the product.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification record was first created in the system. Tracks the initial capture of the specification data.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to any field in the specification record.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier for the specification document. Tracks changes and updates over time.

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Safety Data Sheet. Links to the SDS document for products containing hazardous materials, managed in the engineering document management system.

attributes.name: shock_resistance
attributes.description: Mechanical shock resistance specification. Describes the products ability to withstand mechanical shock per applicable test standards (e.g., IEC 60068-2-27).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record where this specification was originally created or is mastered. Identifies whether the specification originates from Siemens Teamcenter PLM, SAP S/4HANA, or manual entry.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this specification record in the source system. Enables traceability back to the originating system for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: specification_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the product specification. Provides comprehensive technical and commercial details not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: specification_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the product specification. Describes the specification purpose or scope.

attributes.name: specification_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the product specification document. Used for external reference and traceability across engineering, quality, and sales teams.

attributes.name: specification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product specification. Tracks the approval and active state of the specification document.

attributes.name: specification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specification document type. Indicates whether the specification covers technical parameters, commercial terms, or a combination.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the upper temperature limit for product storage when not in operation.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the lower temperature limit for product storage when not in operation.

attributes.name: technical_drawing_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for associated technical drawings. Links to CAD drawings, dimensional drawings, or assembly drawings managed in the PLM system.

attributes.name: vibration_resistance
attributes.description: Vibration resistance specification. Describes the products ability to withstand mechanical vibration per applicable test standards (e.g., IEC 60068-2-6).

attributes.name: voltage_rating
attributes.description: Electrical voltage rating or range for the product. Specifies the nominal operating voltage and acceptable voltage range (e.g., 24VDC, 110-240VAC, 400V 3-phase).

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Product weight in kilograms. Defines the mass for shipping, handling, and installation planning.

products.name: product_certification

Captures certifying body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, applicable markets/regions, product scope, and renewal status. Critical for market access compliance and customer-facing documentation. Supports ISO 9001 quality records and regulatory reporting to UL, CE, and OSHA.
products.reference: UL Listing, CE Marking, IEC 61131, RoHS/REACH

attributes.name: product_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Certification management assigns responsible_engineer_employee_id to record accountability for each certification.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufactured product, automation system, electrification solution, or smart infrastructure component that holds this certification.

attributes.name: applicable_markets
attributes.description: Geographic markets, regions, or countries where this certification enables product sale and distribution (e.g., European Union, North America, APAC). Pipe-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region identifiers.
