attributes.name: applicable_standards
attributes.description: Technical standards, regulations, or directives against which the product was certified (e.g., IEC 61131-2, EN 60204-1, UL 508). Pipe-separated list of standard identifiers.
attributes.references: IEC Standards Catalog, ANSI Standards, ISO Standards

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent audit or inspection conducted by the certifying body to verify ongoing compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Internal Audit, UL Follow-Up Service

attributes.name: certificate_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the certification certificate document stored in the document management system.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, Siemens Teamcenter PLM Document Management

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Classification or rating level assigned by the certification (e.g., ATEX Zone 1, IP67, Safety Integrity Level SIL 2, Performance Level PLd).
attributes.references: IEC 61508 SIL Levels, ISO 13849 Performance Levels, IEC 60529 IP Ratings

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number or listing identifier issued by the certifying body (e.g., UL file number, CE declaration number, IEC certificate ID).
attributes.references: UL Certification Database, CE Marking Directive 2006/42/EC

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification indicating whether it is valid, expired, pending renewal, or revoked.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory or safety certification obtained. Indicates the certification standard or framework under which the product was evaluated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UL Listing|CE Marking|IEC Compliance|ATEX Rating|RoHS Declaration|REACH Declaration|ECCN Classification|FCC Certification|CSA Approval|TUV Certification — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001, IEC 61131, UL Standards, CE Marking Directive

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or authority that issued the certification (e.g., Underwriters Laboratories, TUV Rheinland, Notified Body, National Standards Authority).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17065 Conformity Assessment, UL, CE Notified Bodies

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred to obtain and maintain this certification, including testing fees, audit fees, and certification body charges.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the certification cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, Informatica MDM Data Governance

attributes.name: cybersecurity_certification
attributes.description: Cybersecurity certification or compliance level achieved by the product (e.g., IEC 62443-4-1, IEC 62443-4-2, NIST Cybersecurity Framework).
attributes.references: IEC 62443 Industrial Cybersecurity, NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: declaration_of_conformity_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturer's Declaration of Conformity document associated with this certification, particularly for CE marking.
attributes.references: CE Marking Directive 2006/42/EC, ISO 17050 Supplier's Declaration of Conformity

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned under the U.S. Commerce Control List for dual-use items subject to export regulations.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), Commerce Control List

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the certification becomes valid and the product is authorized for market access under the certification scope.
attributes.references: CE Marking Directive, UL Listing Requirements

attributes.name: energy_efficiency_rating
attributes.description: Energy efficiency classification or rating assigned to the product (e.g., Energy Star, EU Energy Label class A+++, IEC 60034-30-1 efficiency class IE3).
attributes.references: ISO 50001 Energy Management, IEC 60034-30-1 Motor Efficiency Classes

attributes.name: environmental_certification
attributes.description: Environmental management or sustainability certification obtained (e.g., ISO 14001, LEED, BREEAM, Cradle to Cradle).
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, EPA Environmental Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification expires and requires renewal. Null for certifications with indefinite validity subject to ongoing compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Records, UL Follow-Up Service

attributes.name: functional_safety_certification
attributes.description: Functional safety certification level achieved by the product (e.g., IEC 61508 SIL 2, ISO 13849 PLd, IEC 61511).
attributes.references: IEC 61508 Functional Safety, ISO 13849 Safety of Machinery

attributes.name: is_customer_facing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is typically disclosed to customers in product documentation, datasheets, or sales materials as a market differentiator.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was officially issued or granted by the certifying body.

attributes.name: mandatory_for_markets
attributes.description: List of markets or regions where this certification is legally mandatory for product sale (as opposed to voluntary). Pipe-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.
attributes.references: CE Marking Directive, OSHA Regulations, EPA Regulations

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was last modified or updated in the system.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, Informatica MDM Data Governance

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next surveillance audit or re-certification assessment by the certifying body.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Audit Schedule, UL Follow-Up Service Schedule

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: Description of the product models, configurations, or variants covered under this certification. Defines the boundary of what is certified.
attributes.references: UL Certification Scope, CE Declaration of Conformity

attributes.name: quality_certification
attributes.description: Quality management system certification under which the product was manufactured (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AS9100).

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product complies with REACH regulation for chemical substance registration and restriction in the European Union.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, conditions, limitations, or special requirements associated with the certification. May include restrictions on use, environmental conditions, or configuration dependencies.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Target or scheduled date for certification renewal or re-assessment to maintain continuous compliance.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product complies with RoHS Directive restricting the use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment.

attributes.name: test_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the test report or assessment documentation that supports the certification issuance.

attributes.name: weee_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product complies with WEEE Directive for proper disposal and recycling of electronic waste.

products.name: substitution
products.description: Defines approved substitute and alternate products for SKUs that are discontinued, on allocation, or unavailable. Captures the primary SKU, substitute SKU, substitution type (direct replacement, functional equivalent, upward compatible), effective date, approval status, and any application restrictions. Supports order management fallback logic in SAP S/4HANA SD, MRP alternative item processing, and customer service resolution for end-of-life product transitions.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Alternate Item Group

attributes.name: substitution_id
attributes.description: Primary key for substitution

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Substitution approval process logs approved_by_employee_id to capture who authorized a substitution.

attributes.name: primary_sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Link primary SKU to master record for substitution; removes free‑form primary_sku column

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Substituted parts must satisfy the same regulatory requirement as the original part for compliance approval.

attributes.name: application_restriction
attributes.description: Free-text description of any limitations or restrictions on where the substitute can be used. May reference specific customer segments, geographic regions, or application types.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the substitution was formally approved by engineering, quality, or product management.

attributes.name: automatic_substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitution can be applied automatically by MRP or order management systems (true) or requires manual approval (false).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales and Distribution

attributes.name: compliance_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute product requires additional compliance certifications (UL, CE, IEC) before it can be used in regulated applications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the substitution record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer approval or notification is required before applying the substitution in order fulfillment.

attributes.name: customer_segment_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer segment codes where this substitution is restricted or not recommended.

attributes.name: eco_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Order that authorized or documented this substitution. Links to PLM system ECO records.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the substitution becomes valid and can be used in order management, MRP, and customer service processes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the substitution is no longer valid. Null indicates indefinite validity.

attributes.name: form_fit_function_match
attributes.description: Indicates the degree of form-fit-function equivalence between primary and substitute. Exact means identical in all dimensions; partial means some differences exist; none means significant differences.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this substitution is NOT permitted due to regulatory, certification, or business policy reasons.

attributes.name: interchangeable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitution is bidirectional (true) or unidirectional (false). When true, both SKUs can substitute for each other.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user or system that last modified the substitution record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the substitution record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when this substitution was applied in a business transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales and Distribution

attributes.name: lead_time_variance_days
attributes.description: Difference in standard lead time between substitute and primary SKU, measured in days. Positive values indicate longer lead time for substitute.

attributes.name: price_variance_percent
attributes.description: Percentage difference in list price between the substitute and primary SKU. Positive values indicate the substitute is more expensive; negative values indicate cost savings.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating preference order when multiple substitutes exist for the same primary SKU. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by MRP and order management fallback logic.

attributes.name: quality_equivalence_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quality assurance has verified that the substitute meets the same quality standards as the primary SKU through testing or certification.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Business reason for establishing the substitution relationship. Captures why the primary SKU requires a substitute. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discontinued|end_of_life|allocation|supply_shortage|obsolete|cost_reduction|quality_improvement|design_change — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record where the substitution relationship was originally created or maintained.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this substitution record in the source system of record.

attributes.name: substitute_sku
attributes.description: The replacement or substitute SKU that can be used in place of the primary SKU.

attributes.name: substitution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the substitution record. Active indicates the substitution is in effect; pending approval awaits engineering or quality review; approved is authorized but not yet effective; rejected was not approved; expired is no longer valid; suspended is temporarily inactive.

attributes.name: substitution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the substitution relationship. Direct replacement indicates identical form-fit-function; functional equivalent provides same capability with potential differences; upward compatible offers enhanced features; temporary substitute is short-term solution; cross-reference indicates OEM equivalence; alternate is approved alternative.

attributes.name: technical_notes
attributes.description: Engineering or technical notes describing differences between primary and substitute SKUs, installation considerations, or compatibility information.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of times this substitution has been applied in order management or MRP processes. Used for analytics and substitution effectiveness tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales and Distribution

products.name: bundle
products.description: Defines commercial product bundles, solution packages, and system kits that combine multiple SKUs into a single orderable offering (e.g., a complete automation cell bundle including PLC, HMI, drives, and cabling). Captures bundle code, bundle type (fixed, configurable, promotional), component SKU list with quantities, bundle pricing method (sum-of-parts, fixed, discounted), availability period, and minimum order quantity. Supports solution selling for industrial automation and electrification systems in Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA SD. Distinct from catalog_entry which represents individual orderable items; bundle represents composite offerings.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales BOM / Bundle

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Primary key for bundle

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved By User Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Bundle approval tracking uses approved_by_user_employee_id to identify the employee approving the bundle.

attributes.name: product_family_id
attributes.description: FK to product.family

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Bundle profitability analysis aggregates revenue and cost under a dedicated profit center.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status for new or modified bundles requiring management or product committee approval before activation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bundle was approved for sale. Null if approval_status is not 'approved'.

attributes.name: assembly_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bundle requires factory assembly or integration before shipment (True) or is shipped as separate components (False).

attributes.name: availability_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this bundle is no longer available for new orders. Null for ongoing offerings. Used for promotional bundles and product phase-out planning.

attributes.name: availability_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this bundle becomes available for sale. Used for new product introduction (NPI) and promotional campaign timing.

attributes.name: bundle_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the bundle, used in sales orders and quotations. Typically follows company SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) pattern for composite offerings.

attributes.name: bundle_description
attributes.description: Detailed commercial description of the bundle, including key features, benefits, and typical use cases. Used in catalogs, quotations, and sales documentation.

attributes.name: bundle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the bundle as presented to customers and used in sales materials (e.g., 'Automation Cell Starter Kit', 'Smart Factory Solution Package').

attributes.name: bundle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bundle: draft (under development), active (available for sale), inactive (temporarily unavailable), discontinued (no longer sold but supported), obsolete (end-of-life).

attributes.name: bundle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bundle structure: fixed (pre-defined components, no substitution), configurable (customer can select options), promotional (time-limited marketing offer), solution (engineered system package), service (includes maintenance/support).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Material Type Classification

attributes.name: certification_requirements
attributes.description: List of industry certifications or compliance standards the bundle meets (e.g., 'CE', 'UL', 'IEC 61508', 'ATEX'). Critical for regulated industries and export compliance.

attributes.name: component_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) components included in this bundle. Used for complexity assessment and inventory planning.

attributes.name: configuration_rules
attributes.description: Business rules governing component selection and substitution for configurable bundles. Describes constraints, dependencies, and valid option combinations.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the primary country of manufacture or assembly for the bundle. Used for customs, tariffs, and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this bundle record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bundle record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the list price (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Standard discount percentage applied to the sum-of-parts price when pricing_method is 'discounted'. Null for other pricing methods.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the distribution channel through which this bundle is sold (e.g., direct sales, distributor, OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), e-commerce).

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned to the bundle for U.S. export control compliance. Determines licensing requirements for international shipments.

attributes.name: energy_efficiency_rating
attributes.description: Energy efficiency classification or rating for the bundle if applicable (e.g., 'A+++', 'Energy Star', 'IE4'). Used for sustainability reporting and customer decision-making.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance
attributes.description: Environmental compliance certifications and declarations for the bundle (e.g., 'RoHS', 'REACH', 'WEEE', 'ISO 14001'). Critical for EU and global environmental regulations.

attributes.name: hazmat_classification
attributes.description: Hazardous material classification code if the bundle contains components subject to dangerous goods regulations. Used for shipping and handling compliance.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System tariff classification code for the bundle. Used for international trade, customs declarations, and duty calculation.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL to the primary product image or rendering of the bundle. Used in e-commerce, catalogs, and sales presentations.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this bundle record. Used for change management and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bundle record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from order placement to delivery for this bundle. Accounts for component availability, assembly, and logistics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Planning Lead Time

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Standard list price for the bundle in the base currency. Represents the published price before any customer-specific discounts or negotiations.

attributes.name: marketing_description
attributes.description: Extended marketing copy and value proposition for the bundle, used in promotional materials, web catalogs, and sales presentations. Distinct from technical bundle_description.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of bundle units that must be ordered in a single transaction. Used to enforce volume thresholds for bundled offerings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master MOQ

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Description of the standard packaging method for the bundle (e.g., 'Wooden Crate', 'Cardboard Box', 'Pallet', 'Custom Container'). Impacts shipping and handling requirements.

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate bundle price: sum_of_parts (total of component prices), fixed_price (single bundle price regardless of components), discounted (percentage off sum-of-parts), tiered (volume-based pricing), custom (negotiated per deal).

attributes.name: replacement_bundle_code
attributes.description: Bundle code of the successor or replacement bundle when this bundle is discontinued. Used for product transition planning and customer migration.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the sales organization responsible for this bundle. Used in multi-division enterprises to segment product portfolios by business unit or geography.

attributes.name: service_level_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard service level or SLA (Service Level Agreement) tier included with the bundle (e.g., 'BASIC', 'PREMIUM', '24x7').

attributes.name: target_market_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment or industry vertical this bundle is designed for (e.g., 'Automotive Manufacturing', 'Food & Beverage', 'Pharmaceutical', 'Discrete Manufacturing').

attributes.name: technical_documentation_url
attributes.description: URL or document reference to the technical documentation, installation guides, and specifications for the bundle. Used by sales engineering and customer support.

attributes.name: volume_m3
attributes.description: Total shipping volume of the complete bundle in cubic meters, including packaging. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Standard warranty period in months provided with the bundle. Covers all included components under a unified warranty policy.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total shipping weight of the complete bundle in kilograms, including all components and packaging. Used for logistics planning and freight cost calculation.

products.name: plant_data
products.description: Plant-specific master data extensions for each SKU, capturing manufacturing plant assignment, MRP type, lot size procedure, safety stock level, reorder point, planned delivery time, production storage location, and quality inspection type. Represents the SAP S/4HANA MM/PP plant view of the material master, enabling plant-level production planning, MRP runs, and inventory management. Each SKU may have different plant data records per manufacturing facility.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Plant View (MRP1/MRP2/MRP3)

attributes.name: plant_data_id
attributes.description: Primary key for plant_data

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Plant‑level cost reporting requires linking plant data to the plant's cost center.

attributes.name: production_scheduler_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Production scheduling assigns production_scheduler_employee_id to link the scheduler employee for labor planning.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Associate plant‑specific data with the SKU it describes; enables plant‑level planning per SKU

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: ABC classification for inventory management prioritization. A=High-value items requiring tight control, B=Medium-value items, C=Low-value items with relaxed control.
attributes.references: ABC Analysis - Inventory Management Best Practice

attributes.name: availability_check_group
attributes.description: Two-character key that controls which stock types are included in ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks for sales orders and production orders.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether components are backflushed (automatically issued) when production order confirmations are posted. True=Backflush enabled, False=Manual goods issue required.

attributes.name: batch_management_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether batch/lot tracking is required for this material at this plant. True=Batch management active, False=No batch tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this plant data record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_counting_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code that determines the frequency of cycle counting for this material. Used to schedule physical inventory counts.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this material will be discontinued at this plant. Used for phase-out planning and last-time-buy notifications.

attributes.name: effective_out_date
attributes.description: Date from which this plant data record becomes inactive. Used to manage time-dependent plant data changes.

attributes.name: fixed_lot_size
attributes.description: Fixed order quantity used when lot size procedure is set to fixed lot size. MRP will always propose this quantity.

attributes.name: gr_processing_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for goods receipt processing, quality inspection, and stock placement after physical delivery.

attributes.name: in_house_production_time_days
attributes.description: Number of working days required to manufacture this material from raw materials to finished goods at this plant. Used in production scheduling and MRP.

attributes.name: inspection_setup_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quality inspection setup (inspection lot creation) is required for goods receipts of this material at this plant. True=Inspection required, False=No inspection.

attributes.name: issue_storage_location
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the default storage location from which materials are issued to production orders or sales orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this plant data record was last updated.

attributes.name: lot_size_procedure
attributes.description: Lot-sizing procedure used in MRP to determine order quantities. EX=Lot-for-lot, HB=Replenish to maximum stock level, FX=Fixed lot size, WB=Weekly lot size, PK=Period lot size, LS=Lot size key.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique material identifier (SKU) from the material master. Links this plant data record to the global material master.

attributes.name: maximum_lot_size
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered or produced in a single lot for this material at this plant. Used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Target maximum inventory level for this material at this plant. Used in replenishment planning to determine order quantities.

attributes.name: minimum_lot_size
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered or produced in a single lot for this material at this plant. Used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required for goods receipt acceptance. Batches with less remaining shelf life are rejected.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this plant data record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the person or group responsible for MRP and procurement activities for this material at this plant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Master Data

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: MRP procedure that controls how material requirements are planned. PD=MRP, VB=Manual reorder point, VM=Forecast-based planning, VV=Time-phased planning, ND=No planning, R1=Reorder point planning, R2=Replenishment planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PD|VB|VM|VV|ND|R1|R2 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: negative_stock_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether negative stock balances are permitted for this material at this plant. True=Negative stock allowed, False=System blocks transactions that would create negative stock.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from order placement to goods receipt. Used by MRP to schedule procurement proposals and calculate reorder points.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or facility where this material is produced or stocked. Each plant has its own plant data record for a given material.

attributes.name: plant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this material at this plant. Active=Normal production/sales, Blocked=Temporarily unavailable, Discontinued=End-of-life, Phase_out=Being phased out, New_product_introduction=NPI stage.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the material is procured at this plant. E=In-house production, F=External procurement (purchasing), X=Both production and external procurement.

attributes.name: production_storage_location
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the default storage location within the plant where finished goods from production are received.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Ten-character code identifying the profit center responsible for this material at this plant. Used for internal profitability analysis.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_type
attributes.description: QM inspection type that determines when quality inspections are triggered. 01=Goods receipt from vendor, 02=Goods receipt from production, 03=Goods issue to customer, 04=Stock transfer, 05=Physical inventory, 08=Recurring inspection, 09=Audit inspection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|02|03|04|05|08|09 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Stock level at which MRP triggers a procurement proposal. Calculated based on lead time demand plus safety stock.

attributes.name: rounding_value
attributes.description: Rounding value for lot sizes. MRP rounds proposed order quantities up to the nearest multiple of this value.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum stock level maintained as buffer against demand fluctuations and supply disruptions. MRP triggers procurement when stock falls below this level plus reorder point.

attributes.name: scheduling_margin_key
attributes.description: Key that defines float times (opening period, float before production, float after production) used in production scheduling to add buffer time.

attributes.name: serialization_level
attributes.description: Controls serial number management for this material at this plant. 0=No serial numbers, 1=Serial number at goods receipt, 2=Serial number at goods issue, 3=Serial number at goods receipt and issue, 4=Serial number at production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiration_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life period in days from production date to expiration date. Used for batch management and FEFO (First Expired First Out) logic.

attributes.name: special_procurement_type
attributes.description: Special procurement key for subcontracting, consignment, stock transfer, or other special procurement scenarios. 10=Withdrawal from warehouse, 20=Production in another plant, 30=External procurement, 40=Subcontracting, 50=Phantom assembly, 51=Phantom assembly with lead time, 52=Collective order, 70=Stock transfer, 80=Consignment, 90=Pipeline. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 10|20|30|40|50|51|52|70|80|90 — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Four-digit code that determines the general ledger accounts to which inventory movements are posted. Links material movements to financial accounting.

products.name: classification
products.description: Assigns products to standardized classification schemes including industry taxonomy codes (UNSPSC, eCl@ss, ETIM), internal product category hierarchy, and customs tariff/HS codes for export compliance. Captures classification scheme, class code, class description, and assignment validity. Supports procurement catalog integration via SAP Ariba, customs documentation in logistics, and product search/filtering in the commercial catalog. Managed in SAP S/4HANA MM classification system.
products.reference: UNSPSC, eCl@ss, ETIM, SAP Classification System

attributes.name: classification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for classification

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product being classified. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: application_area
attributes.description: The functional application area or use case for the product (e.g., Process Automation, Building Management, Motion Control, Power Distribution).

attributes.name: assigned_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that assigned this classification. Supports audit trail and data quality accountability.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: The date when this classification was originally assigned to the product. Distinct from effective start date; tracks data lineage.

attributes.name: auto_classified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this classification was assigned automatically by a system or AI/ML model (true) or manually by a human user (false). Supports data quality monitoring and exception handling.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or division responsible for the product. Supports P&L reporting and organizational accountability.

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: The specific classification code or identifier within the chosen scheme. For example, UNSPSC segment-family-class-commodity code, eCl@ss class ID, or HS tariff code.
attributes.references: UNSPSC Code Structure, eCl@ss Standard, WCO HS Nomenclature

attributes.name: class_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the classification class. Provides business context for the class code.

attributes.name: class_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the classification within the scheme. For example, in UNSPSC: 1=Segment, 2=Family, 3=Class, 4=Commodity. Enables drill-down and roll-up reporting.

attributes.name: classification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the classification assignment. Active classifications are used for procurement, catalog, and export documentation. Deprecated classifications are retained for historical reporting.

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Internal or industry-specific commodity code used for procurement categorization, spend analysis, and supplier management. Often aligned with SAP Ariba commodity taxonomy.

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: A confidence score (0-100) indicating the certainty or quality of the classification assignment. Used when classifications are assigned by automated systems or AI/ML models.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product is manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs documentation and trade compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, WCO Rules of Origin

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this classification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customs_tariff_code
attributes.description: The Harmonized System tariff classification code used for customs declarations, import/export documentation, and duty calculation. Critical for international trade compliance.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System, ISO 3166 Country Codes

attributes.name: data_quality_status
attributes.description: The data quality status of this classification record. Indicates whether the classification has been verified, requires review, or has quality issues. Supports data stewardship workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Master Data Quality, Internal Data Quality Framework

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date until which this classification assignment is valid. Null indicates an open-ended assignment. Used for managing classification transitions and product reclassifications.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this classification assignment is valid and should be used for business processes. Supports time-based classification changes for product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification number assigned under export control regulations (e.g., US EAR, EU Dual-Use Regulation). Determines licensing requirements for international shipments of controlled goods.
attributes.references: US Export Administration Regulations (EAR), EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: The primary industry segment or vertical market for which the product is designed (e.g., Automotive, Food & Beverage, Pharmaceuticals, Energy, Infrastructure).
attributes.references: NAICS Industry Classification, Internal Market Segmentation

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this classification record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this classification record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when this classification was last reviewed for accuracy and relevance. Supports data quality management and periodic classification audits.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: SAP material group code used for grouping materials with similar characteristics for procurement, inventory management, and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group Configuration

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: SAP material type classification (e.g., FERT=Finished Product, HALB=Semi-Finished Product, ROH=Raw Material, HAWA=Trading Goods). Determines procurement and inventory handling rules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Type Configuration

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next classification review. Enables proactive data quality management and compliance with classification governance policies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the classification assignment. May include rationale for classification decisions, special handling instructions, or data quality observations.

attributes.name: parent_class_code
attributes.description: The classification code of the parent node in the hierarchy. Enables navigation of multi-level taxonomies.

attributes.name: primary_classification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary classification for the product. A product may have multiple classifications across different schemes, but only one primary classification per scheme.

attributes.name: product_category_l1
attributes.description: Top-level product category in the internal product hierarchy. Represents the broadest product grouping (e.g., Automation Systems, Electrification Solutions, Smart Infrastructure).

attributes.name: product_category_l2
attributes.description: Second-level product category in the internal product hierarchy. Provides more granular segmentation within L1 categories.

attributes.name: product_category_l3
attributes.description: Third-level product category in the internal product hierarchy. Provides detailed product family classification.

attributes.name: product_category_l4
attributes.description: Fourth-level product category in the internal product hierarchy. Represents the most granular product classification level.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The product line or brand family to which the product belongs. Used for portfolio management, marketing segmentation, and sales reporting.

attributes.name: record_source
attributes.description: The source system or data feed from which this classification record originated. Supports data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this classification is required for regulatory compliance purposes (e.g., customs, export control, environmental reporting). True if the classification is mandatory for legal/regulatory reasons.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, REACH Regulation, RoHS Directive

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: The standardized classification system or taxonomy used to categorize the product. Common schemes include UNSPSC (United Nations Standard Products and Services Code), eCl@ss (international product classification standard), ETIM (electro-technical information model), HS Code (Harmonized System for customs), and internal category hierarchies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UNSPSC|eCl@ss|ETIM|HS_CODE|INTERNAL_CATEGORY|NAICS|SIC|GTIN — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 8000-110 Master Data Quality, UNSPSC, eCl@ss, ETIM, WCO Harmonized System

attributes.name: search_keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of search keywords or tags associated with this classification. Enhances product discoverability in e-commerce catalogs, procurement systems, and internal search applications.
attributes.references: SEO Best Practices, SAP Ariba Catalog Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The source system or application that assigned or maintains this classification (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Teamcenter PLM, SAP Ariba, MDM).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version of the classification scheme standard being used. Classification schemes are periodically updated; tracking version ensures correct interpretation of codes.
attributes.references: UNSPSC Version Control, eCl@ss Release Management

products.name: change_order
products.description: Engineering Change Order (ECO) and Engineering Change Notice (ECN) records governing approved changes to product designs, BOMs, specifications, and manufacturing processes as they affect the product master record. Captures change request number, change type (design, process, documentation), affected SKUs and BOM levels, change reason, impact assessment (cost, lead time, inventory), approval workflow status, effectivity date, and implementing plant. This product owns the product-facing change governance; the engineering domain owns the broader design change workflow and CAD/drawing changes. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM change management module per ISO 9001 change control requirements.
products.reference: ECO/ECN (Engineering Change Order/Notice), Siemens Teamcenter Change Management

attributes.name: change_order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for change_order

attributes.name: initiator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Change order initiation logs initiator_employee_id to identify the employee who raised the change.

attributes.name: product_revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_revision. Business justification: Change orders often target a specific product revision; linking change_order to product_revision captures this ownership.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Tie each change order to the primary SKU it affects; removes unstructured affected_sku_list column

attributes.name: affected_bom_level
attributes.description: Indicates which level(s) of the BOM hierarchy are impacted by the change: top-level finished goods, sub-assemblies, individual components, raw materials, or all levels.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Planning BOM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the change order received final approval from all required approvers and was authorized for implementation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Overall approval decision status across all required approvers. Conditional indicates approval with stipulations; escalated indicates management review required.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the multi-level approval workflow. Indicates which functional area is currently reviewing the change order. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engineering|quality|manufacturing|procurement|finance|executive|complete — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Change Management Workflow; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the proposed change, detailing what is being modified, the scope of the change, and the technical nature of the modification.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Change Management; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: change_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the person assigned as the change owner responsible for driving the change through approval and implementation. Accountable for successful execution.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Change Management; Change Management Best Practices

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary business driver for the change: quality improvement, cost reduction, regulatory compliance, component obsolescence, customer request, or safety enhancement.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2 Nonconformity and Corrective Action; CAPA Corrective and Preventive Action

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the change is being requested, including background context, problem statement, and business justification.

attributes.name: change_request_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Engineering Change Order (ECO) / Engineering Change Notice (ECN) Request Number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique identifier for the change order, typically formatted as ECO-NNNNNN or ECN-NNNNNN. This is the business identifier used across PLM, ERP, and MES systems.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Change Management; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.6

attributes.name: change_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the change order in the approval and implementation workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through review, approval, implementation, and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|implemented|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Change Management Workflow; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the change order by the nature of the modification: design (product design changes), process (manufacturing process changes), documentation (drawing/spec updates), material (material substitution), specification (technical spec changes), or BOM (bill of materials structure changes).
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.6; APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the change order was formally closed after successful implementation and validation. Marks the end of the change lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the change order record was first created in the PLM system. Marks the beginning of the change request lifecycle.

attributes.name: customer_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of customer approval for the change, if customer notification is required. Tracks whether the customer has reviewed and approved the proposed modification.
attributes.references: PPAP Production Part Approval Process; Customer Change Management

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer notification is required for this change. True for changes that affect form, fit, function, or regulatory compliance requiring customer approval or notification.
attributes.references: PPAP Production Part Approval Process; Customer Change Management

attributes.name: effectivity_date
attributes.description: The date on which the change becomes effective and must be implemented in production. This is the cutover date for transitioning from old to new specifications.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Effectivity Management; SAP S/4HANA PP Production Planning

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_number
attributes.description: Optional serial number or production lot number at which the change becomes effective. Used for mid-production changes where effectivity is tied to specific units rather than a date.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Effectivity Management; Serialized Unit Tracking

attributes.name: impact_assessment_cost
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of implementing the change, including tooling, material, labor, and rework costs. Used for cost-benefit analysis and approval decision-making.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.6; CapEx Capital Expenditure / OpEx Operational Expenditure

attributes.name: impact_assessment_inventory
attributes.description: Assessment of the impact on existing inventory, including obsolete stock quantities, rework requirements, scrap decisions, and transition inventory management strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: impact_assessment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Estimated impact on product lead time resulting from the change, measured in days. Positive values indicate lead time increase; negative values indicate reduction.
attributes.references: MRP Material Requirements Planning; Lead Time Analysis

attributes.name: impact_assessment_quality
attributes.description: Assessment of quality implications, including changes to inspection requirements, test procedures, quality control points, and expected quality improvements or risks.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.6; SPC Statistical Process Control; APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning

attributes.name: implementation_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the change was fully implemented in production and the new specifications became active.

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Status of the physical implementation of the change in production. Tracks execution progress after approval has been granted.
attributes.references: Siemens Opcenter MES Manufacturing Execution; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: implementing_plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing plant or facility responsible for implementing the change. May be a single plant or multiple plants for multi-site rollout.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Plant Master Data; Manufacturing Site Identification

attributes.name: initiator_department
attributes.description: Department or functional area of the change initiator (e.g., Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Procurement).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the change order record. Tracks the latest modification for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, implementation notes, lessons learned, or other relevant information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: plm_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this change order in the source PLM system (Siemens Teamcenter). Used for system integration and traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: previous_revision_level
attributes.description: The product revision level that existed before this change order. Provides traceability to the prior design state.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Revision Management; Engineering Change Management

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level for processing and implementing the change. Critical priority indicates safety or regulatory urgency requiring immediate action.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.6; Change Management Best Practices

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or certification body whose requirements are impacted by this change (e.g., UL, IEC, OSHA, EPA, CE). Applicable when regulatory_impact_flag is true.
attributes.references: UL Underwriters Laboratories; IEC International Electrotechnical Commission; OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration; EPA Environmental Protection Agency; CE Marking

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change has regulatory compliance implications requiring additional review, testing, or certification updates (e.g., UL, CE, safety certifications).
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; UL Underwriters Laboratories; CE Marking European Conformity

attributes.name: related_capa_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Related Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Number
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPA record associated with this change order. Links the change to corrective or preventive action initiatives.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; CAPA Corrective and Preventive Action

attributes.name: related_ncr_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Non-Conformance Report that triggered this change order, if applicable. Links the change to quality issues or defects that necessitated the modification.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; NCR Non-Conformance Report Process

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: The new product revision level resulting from this change order. Tracks version progression of the product design (e.g., Rev A, Rev B, Rev 01, Rev 02).
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Revision Management; Engineering Change Management

attributes.name: urgency_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator for expedited processing requirements. True indicates the change requires fast-track approval and implementation due to safety, regulatory, or critical business needs.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; CAPA Corrective and Preventive Action

attributes.name: validation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when validation testing was completed and results were documented. Marks the final verification of the change implementation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; PPAP Production Part Approval Process

attributes.name: validation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether post-implementation validation testing is required to verify the change achieved its intended results without introducing new issues.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.6; APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning; PPAP Production Part Approval Process

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of post-implementation validation activities. Tracks whether the change has been verified to meet requirements and quality standards.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; APQP Advanced Product Quality Planning; PPAP Production Part Approval Process

products.name: order_line
products.description: Represents the line item linking a SKU to a sales order, capturing quantity, price, discount, and delivery status for each product in an order.. Existence Justification: A SKU (product) can be sold on many sales orders, and each sales order can contain many SKUs. The line item that links a SKU to an order is created and maintained by order entry staff and carries quantity, price, discount, and delivery status, which are attributes of the relationship itself.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the order_line association

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bundle. Business justification: Orders can be for a bundle; adding bundle_id to order_line creates the needed parent relationship without a cycle.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sales order header

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the SKU master record

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current delivery status of the SKU for this order line

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount amount applied to the SKU on the order line

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Net unit price of the SKU on the order line after discounts

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU requested on the order line

products.name: supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual relationship between a SKU master record and a procurement contract. It captures contract‑specific details that apply to each SKU‑contract pairing, such as the effective date of the agreement, the negotiated price, and the lead time for delivery.. Existence Justification: A SKU can be covered by multiple procurement contracts (e.g., different suppliers, time‑bound agreements) and a single procurement contract typically includes many SKUs. The business actively creates and maintains these links, tracking contract‑specific terms such as price, effective date, and lead time for each SKU‑contract pair.

attributes.description: Primary key for the supply_agreement association

attributes.description: Lead time in days for delivery of the SKU under this contract

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: Negotiated price for the SKU under this contract

domains.name: sales
domains.description: Sales and commercial domain managing the revenue pipeline including opportunities, quotes, proposals, contracts, order intake, sales pipeline tracking, territory management, and commercial KPIs for industrial automation and electrification products via Salesforce Sales Cloud.

products.name: opportunity
products.description: Core sales opportunity record representing a potential deal for industrial automation, electrification, or smart infrastructure products. Tracks the full revenue pipeline from initial identification through close, including estimated value, probability, stage progression, expected close date, product lines of interest, competitive landscape, win/loss outcome, and primary loss reason. Sourced from Salesforce Sales Cloud Opportunity object. SSOT for all pipeline, forecast, and win/loss analysis data.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales opportunity record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that influenced or generated this opportunity.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the resulting contract or order if the opportunity was won and converted.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Pipeline forecasting allocates expected costs to cost centers for budgeting purposes.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this opportunity.

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary contact person at the customer account for this opportunity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or user who owns and is responsible for this opportunity.

attributes.name: engineering_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_project. Business justification: New product opportunities trigger an engineering project; linking enables tracking of project initiation and status.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: Enables Opportunity Management to record the exact equipment to be sold, required for quote generation and project planning.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Opportunity tracking of a specific material enables demand forecasting and aligns inventory planning.

attributes.name: opportunity_territory_id

attributes.name: product_family_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id

products.name: quote
products.description: Commercial quotation issued to a prospective or existing industrial customer for automation systems, electrification solutions, or smart infrastructure components. Captures quoted price, discount structure (including approved non-standard discounts), validity period, payment terms, delivery lead time, configuration details, and approval status. Linked to an opportunity and may progress to a formal proposal or order. Sourced from Salesforce CPQ / Sales Cloud Quote object.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commercial quotation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: compliance_product_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.product_certification. Business justification: Quote generation validates that the quoted SKU holds the necessary product certification (e.g., CE, UL) before pricing is presented.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal contract record created when the quote is accepted and converted to an order.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Quote budgeting ties estimated costs to a cost center for cost‑control before order conversion.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (prospective or existing) to whom this quote is issued.

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary customer contact person to whom the quote is addressed.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (sales manager, director, or executive) who approved the quote.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: Links Quote to the specific asset being quoted, supporting price calculation, warranty terms, and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: previous_quote_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior version of this quote if this is a revision or amendment.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Quote profitability analysis requires profit center linkage to calculate expected margin.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Quote-to-Project conversion: links a quote to the project that will deliver the quoted solution, required for downstream execution.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative responsible for creating and managing this quote.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory to which this quote is assigned for pipeline tracking and commission purposes.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.supplier. Business justification: Quotes are generated based on a designated supplier's pricing; linking supports price validation, supplier cost analysis, and compliance with approved supplier lists.

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the document template used to generate the customer-facing quote document.

attributes.name: accepted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer formally accepted the quote, triggering order creation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quote received final internal approval.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Status of internal approval workflow for the quote, particularly for non-standard pricing or terms.

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary competitor identified in the sales opportunity for this quote.

attributes.name: configuration_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the product configuration details included in the quote (e.g., system specifications, key components, customization notes).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the quote record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the quote is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of days from order confirmation to delivery of the quoted products.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all discounts applied to the quote (standard and non-standard).

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Overall discount rate applied to the quote, expressed as a percentage of the subtotal.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, insurance, and risk transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the quote record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: non_standard_discount_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quote includes discounts that exceed standard approval thresholds and require special authorization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments related to the quote, including negotiation history, customer feedback, and special considerations.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms offered to the customer (e.g., 'Net 30', '50% upfront / 50% on delivery', 'Letter of Credit').

attributes.name: presented_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quote was formally presented to the customer.

attributes.name: quote_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quote was formally issued to the customer.

attributes.name: quote_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the quote, typically reflecting the project or product scope (e.g., 'Factory Automation System - Plant 5').

attributes.name: quote_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the quote. Used in customer communications and contract references.

attributes.name: quote_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quote in the sales workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|presented|accepted|rejected|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quote_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quote based on the nature of the commercial transaction.

attributes.name: rejected_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer formally rejected or declined the quote.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason provided by the customer for rejecting the quote (e.g., 'Price too high', 'Lead time unacceptable', 'Competitor selected').

attributes.name: service_level_agreement
attributes.description: Service level commitments included in the quote (e.g., response time, uptime guarantees, maintenance windows).

attributes.name: shipping_handling_amount
attributes.description: Estimated cost for shipping and handling of the quoted products to the customer site.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Planned method of shipment for the quoted products (e.g., 'Air Freight', 'Ocean Freight', 'Ground Transport', 'Courier').

attributes.name: special_terms_conditions
attributes.description: Additional contractual terms, conditions, or clauses specific to this quote that deviate from standard terms.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Total value of all quoted line items before discounts, taxes, and adjustments.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount calculated on the quote based on applicable tax jurisdictions and rates.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total value of the quote including all line items, discounts, taxes, and fees.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the quoted prices and terms become effective.

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: Expiration date after which the quote is no longer valid and prices/terms may change.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the quote, incremented when revisions are made to pricing, terms, or configuration.

attributes.name: warranty_terms
attributes.description: Description of warranty coverage included with the quoted products (duration, scope, exclusions).

attributes.name: win_probability_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated probability (0-100%) that this quote will be accepted and converted to an order, based on sales assessment.

products.name: quote_line
products.description: Individual line item within a commercial quotation, representing a specific SKU, product configuration, or service offering with its own quantity, unit price, discount, and extended amount. Supports multi-line complex industrial system quotes including hardware, software, installation, and commissioning services. Sourced from Salesforce CPQ Quote Line object.

attributes.name: quote_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quote line item. Primary key.

attributes.name: bundle_parent_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent quote line if this line is part of a product bundle. Enables hierarchical quote structures for complex system quotes.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Quote creation requires exact component master data for pricing, lead time, and compliance; linking ensures accurate component reference.

attributes.name: configuration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product configuration record for complex configurable products. Links to CPQ (Configure Price Quote) configuration details.

attributes.name: device_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.device_registry. Business justification: Quote line for hardware must be tied to the future device record for tracking warranty and configuration.

attributes.name: engineering_revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.revision. Business justification: Quotes must specify the component revision being sold to guarantee correct version delivery and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Quote line must reference internal material master for cost, inventory availability, and production planning.

attributes.name: primary_quote_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this quote line record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: primary_quote_sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product master record. Identifies the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit), product configuration, or service offering being quoted.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering or implementation project associated with this quote line. Links sales to project execution.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent commercial quotation header. Links this line item to its containing quote document.

attributes.name: quote_sku_master_id
attributes.description: FK to product.sku_master

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative responsible for this line item. Used for commission calculation and territory management.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preferred supplier or vendor for this line item. Used for procurement planning and supply chain management.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The approval authority level required for this line item based on discount depth or special terms. Escalates based on business rules.

attributes.name: commission_percent
attributes.description: The commission rate applicable to this line item for sales compensation. Business confidential.

attributes.name: committed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date committed by the manufacturer for this line item. Based on production schedule and capacity planning.

attributes.name: configuration_summary
attributes.description: Human-readable summary of the product configuration options selected. Describes customizations, options, and specifications for this line item.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: The total cost to manufacture or procure the items on this line. Used for margin analysis and profitability calculations. Business confidential.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when this quote line record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary discount amount applied to this line item. Alternative to percentage-based discounts.

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the list price. Represents negotiated price concessions or promotional discounts.

attributes.name: is_bundle_parent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a parent bundle that contains child line items. True for bundle headers, false for standalone or child items.

attributes.name: is_optional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is optional or required. Optional items may be removed by the customer without affecting the core quote.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when this quote line record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
