attributes.name: minimum_price
attributes.description: The floor price below which this product cannot be sold. Used to enforce pricing policies and protect margin thresholds in Configure Price Quote (CPQ) processes.

attributes.name: price_book_entry_description
attributes.description: Additional notes or description providing context about this pricing entry, such as special terms, conditions, or the rationale for custom pricing.

attributes.name: price_book_entry_name
attributes.description: A descriptive name or label for this price book entry, typically combining product name, price book name, and currency for easy identification in reports and user interfaces.

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: The type or nature of the price (e.g., list price, negotiated price, promotional price, contract price, spot price). Indicates the pricing strategy applied.

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine the price (e.g., fixed, cost-plus, market-based, value-based). Supports pricing strategy analysis and governance.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: The product family or category to which this product belongs (e.g., Automation Controllers, Electrification Components, SCADA Systems). Used for reporting and segmentation.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The business product line or division responsible for this product (e.g., Industrial Automation, Building Technologies, Mobility Solutions).

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which this pricing is applicable (e.g., direct sales, distributor, partner, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), online).

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax classification code that determines applicable sales tax, Value Added Tax (VAT), or Goods and Services Tax (GST) rates for this product in the specified geography.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for pricing (e.g., Each, Box, Pallet, Kilogram, Meter). Defines the quantity basis for the unit price.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The effective selling price per unit for this product in the price book. May differ from list price due to volume discounts, promotions, or regional adjustments.

attributes.name: use_standard_price
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entry uses the standard price book price or a custom price. True means standard pricing applies; false indicates custom or negotiated pricing.

products.name: forecast
products.description: Periodic sales forecast record capturing the committed, best-case, and pipeline revenue projections submitted by sales reps, managers, and regional leaders for a given forecast period. Tracks forecast category, submitted amount, manager-adjusted amount, product line breakdown, and variance to quota. Supports S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) and executive revenue visibility for industrial automation business units.

attributes.name: forecast_id
attributes.description: Primary key for forecast

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Sales forecasts feed cost center budgets; linking ensures accurate cost planning.

attributes.name: forecast_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Forecast contains a free‑text territory field; adding forecast_territory_id creates a normalized link to sales.territory and eliminates the duplicate string column.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Sales forecast per material drives production scheduling and inventory replenishment decisions.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales opportunity this forecast is associated with.

attributes.name: previous_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior version of this forecast if this is a revision.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Forecasted profit per profit center is required for quarterly performance dashboards.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Sales representative, manager, or regional leader who submitted this forecast.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the forecast was approved by management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Manager or executive who approved this forecast submission.

attributes.name: best_case_amount
attributes.description: Optimistic revenue projection if all opportunities close favorably.
attributes.references: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: closed_amount
attributes.description: Actual revenue from deals already closed and won during the forecast period.
attributes.references: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: High-confidence revenue projection that the sales team commits to achieving.
attributes.references: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary market of this forecast.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the forecast record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all forecast amounts.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: End date of the forecast period being projected.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter designation (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) for the forecast period.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for the forecast period.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: forecast_category
attributes.description: Classification of forecast confidence level: pipeline (early stage), best_case (optimistic), commit (high confidence), closed (won deals).

attributes.name: forecast_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the forecast record, typically system-generated.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the forecast record.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: Target industry vertical for the forecasted opportunities (e.g., Automotive, Energy, Pharmaceuticals).

attributes.name: is_latest_version
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the most current version of the forecast for this period and owner.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User who last modified this forecast record.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the forecast record was last updated.

attributes.name: manager_adjusted_amount
attributes.description: Revenue amount after manager review and adjustment, may differ from submitted amount based on pipeline scrutiny.
attributes.references: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: manager_notes
attributes.description: Commentary from the reviewing manager explaining adjustments or concerns.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text commentary from the sales representative explaining assumptions, risks, or opportunities in the forecast.

attributes.name: opportunity_count
attributes.description: Number of opportunities included in this forecast submission.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Time granularity of the forecast period: monthly, quarterly, or annual.

attributes.name: pipeline_amount
attributes.description: Total pipeline revenue including early-stage opportunities with lower probability.
attributes.references: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Primary product line or business unit for this forecast (e.g., Industrial Automation, Electrification, Smart Infrastructure).

attributes.name: quota_amount
attributes.description: Assigned sales quota target for the forecast owner during this period.

attributes.name: quota_attainment_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of quota achieved based on committed forecast amount.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Broader geographic region grouping multiple territories (e.g., EMEA, Americas, APAC).

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when a forecast is rejected by management, requiring revision.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the forecast period being projected.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the forecast was submitted by the sales representative or manager.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the forecast was submitted into the system.

attributes.name: submitted_amount
attributes.description: Revenue amount submitted by the sales representative for this forecast period and category.
attributes.references: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: variance_to_quota
attributes.description: Difference between committed forecast amount and quota target, can be positive or negative.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking revisions to the forecast for the same period.

attributes.name: weighted_pipeline_amount
attributes.description: Pipeline amount adjusted by probability weighting based on opportunity stages.

products.name: channel_partner
products.description: Authorized channel partner record representing distributors, system integrators, value-added resellers (VARs), and OEM partners who sell or embed the company's industrial automation and electrification products. Captures partner tier (platinum, gold, silver), authorized product lines, geographic coverage, certification status, annual revenue target, partner program enrollment, deal registration rules, and opportunity involvement role (reseller, referral, co-sell). Distinct from the supplier domain — this is the sales-side commercial partner. SSOT for partner identity, authorization level, and commercial terms in the sales domain.
products.reference: Salesforce Partner Account / Channel Partner Management

attributes.name: channel_partner_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the channel partner record. Primary key.

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this partner record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee (partner account manager or channel manager) responsible for managing the relationship with this partner.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this partner record.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales territory to which this partner is assigned for reporting and commission purposes.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_target
attributes.description: The annual revenue target or quota assigned to the partner for the current fiscal year, in the partner's operating currency.

attributes.name: authorized_product_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product lines or business units the partner is authorized to sell or integrate. Examples: Industrial Automation, Electrification, Building Technologies, Motion Control, Process Instrumentation.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner's current certification expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the partner's technical or sales certification. Certified (all required certifications current), In Progress (certification training underway), Expired (certifications lapsed), Not Certified (no certifications obtained).

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration or renewal date of the current partner agreement or contract.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current partner agreement or contract.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum credit limit extended to the partner for outstanding receivables, in the partner's operating currency.

attributes.name: deal_registration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner is authorized to register deals for protection and special pricing. True if deal registration is enabled, False otherwise.

attributes.name: discount_tier
attributes.description: Discount tier assigned to the partner based on volume commitments and tier status. Determines the standard discount percentage the partner receives on product pricing.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number uniquely identifying the partner organization globally.

attributes.name: employee_count_range
attributes.description: Size classification of the partner organization by number of employees.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Geographic territories or regions where the partner is authorized to operate and sell. May include country codes, state/province lists, or named territories.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the street address for the partner's headquarters or principal place of business.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the partner's headquarters is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the partner's headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the partner's headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the partner's headquarters is located.

attributes.name: industry_focus
attributes.description: Primary industry verticals or market segments the partner specializes in serving. Examples: Automotive, Food & Beverage, Pharmaceuticals, Oil & Gas, Water & Wastewater.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal business review or performance evaluation conducted with the partner.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The official registered legal name of the channel partner organization as it appears on incorporation documents and contracts.

attributes.name: mdf_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner is eligible to receive Market Development Funds for co-marketing activities. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or comments about the partner relationship.

attributes.name: partner_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the channel partner, typically assigned by the partner management system. Used in contracts, deal registrations, and commercial correspondence.

attributes.name: partner_program_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner was enrolled in the channel partner program and the relationship was established.

attributes.name: partner_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the partner relationship. Active (authorized to transact), Inactive (temporarily not transacting), Suspended (authorization revoked pending review), Pending Approval (application under review), Terminated (relationship ended).

attributes.name: partner_tier
attributes.description: Partner program tier indicating authorization level, benefits, and performance status. Platinum (top tier, highest revenue and certification), Gold (high performance), Silver (standard), Bronze (entry level), Registered (basic enrollment).

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the channel partner by business model: distributor (bulk stock and resell), system integrator (solution design and implementation), VAR (Value-Added Reseller - customize and resell), OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer - embed products), reseller (direct resale), consultant (advisory and referral).

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard payment terms extended to the partner, expressed in number of days (e.g., 30, 60, 90 days net).

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the main business contact at the partner organization. Used for operational communications, deal notifications, and program updates.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the main business contact at the partner organization.

attributes.name: target_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the annual revenue target.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number, VAT number, or equivalent government-issued business tax identifier for the partner organization.

attributes.name: technical_capability_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the partner's technical capability and expertise. Advanced (complex system integration, custom engineering), Intermediate (standard configuration and deployment), Basic (product resale with limited technical support).

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Trade Name or Doing Business As (DBA)
attributes.description: The commercial trading name or DBA name under which the partner operates in the market, if different from legal name.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL for the partner organization.

products.name: order_intake
products.description: Sales order intake record capturing the commercial handoff from a won opportunity or accepted quote to the order management domain. Records the intake date, confirmed order value, customer PO reference, requested delivery date, payment terms confirmed, and handoff status. This is NOT the SSOT for order fulfillment data — the authoritative order record lives in the order domain. The sales domain retains this record solely for order intake KPI tracking, sales-to-fulfillment cycle time measurement, and booking recognition against quota.
products.reference: SAP SD Order Intake / Salesforce Closed-Won to Order

attributes.name: order_intake_id
attributes.description: Primary key for order_intake

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue allocation to cost center for cost accounting on each order intake (required for statutory cost reporting).

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account placing the order. Links to the master customer account record.

attributes.name: device_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.device_registry. Business justification: Order intake must reference the physical device to be commissioned; required for asset handoff and installation scheduling.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: Allows Order Intake to reference the exact equipment to be delivered, essential for logistics, installation planning, and invoicing.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Order intake records the exact material to be delivered, linking to inventory for allocation and picking.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the won sales opportunity that generated this order intake. Links to the originating opportunity record in Salesforce Sales Cloud.

attributes.name: order_intake_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Order intake records a sales territory as text; adding order_intake_territory_id creates a proper FK to sales.territory and removes the ambiguous string column.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Order intake for equipment installation must reference the required permit to ensure legal installation and tracking.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id

attributes.name: sku_master_id

attributes.name: committed_delivery_date

attributes.name: credit_approval_date

attributes.name: credit_check_status

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: customer_po_date

attributes.name: customer_po_number

attributes.name: delivery_location

products.name: opportunity_component
products.description: Represents the association between a component and a sales opportunity. Each record captures the sales interest, quantity estimate, and planned delivery date for a component within a specific opportunity.. Existence Justification: Sales representatives add multiple engineered components to a single sales opportunity, and each component can appear in many different opportunities across customers. The association captures interest level, estimated quantity, and target delivery date, which are specific to the component‑opportunity pairing.

products.name: project_rep_assignment
products.description: This association captures the assignment of sales representatives to capital or engineering projects. Each record links one sales_rep_id to one project_header_id and stores the role, allocation percentage, and the effective start and end dates of the assignment.. Existence Justification: A sales representative can be assigned to multiple capital or engineering projects, and each project can have multiple sales representatives contributing with defined roles and allocation percentages. The assignment is actively managed, with start/end dates, role definitions, and allocation percentages recorded for each rep‑project pairing.

products.name: device_contract_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the contractual coverage relationship between a sales contract and an automation device. It captures the period during which a device is covered by a contract and the service level agreed for that coverage.. Existence Justification: A sales contract can cover multiple automation devices, and a single device may be covered under multiple contracts over its lifecycle (e.g., initial sale, later service extensions). The business actively creates, updates, and deletes these links, tracking start/end dates and service levels for each contract‑device pairing.

domains.name: order
domains.description: Order management and fulfillment domain governing the end-to-end order lifecycle from customer purchase orders through production scheduling, shipment, and delivery confirmation. Manages order headers, line items, delivery schedules, RMAs, fulfillment SLAs, and customer order lifecycle via SAP SD.

products.name: order_header
products.description: Core master record for customer purchase orders representing the full order commitment in the order-to-cash lifecycle. Captures customer reference, order type (standard, rush, blanket, consignment), requested delivery date, incoterms, payment terms, pricing date, total net value, currency, sales organization, distribution channel, division, and overall order status. Serves as the SSOT for all customer order commitments in the industrial manufacturing order lifecycle, driving downstream delivery, billing, and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the sales order header.

attributes.name: account_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account_site. Business justification: Industrial equipment orders need an installation site for field service planning; site details are in customer.account_site.

attributes.name: automation_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to automation.automation_project. Business justification: Order‑Project Tracking links a sales order to the automation engineering project delivering the solution, needed for project budgeting and status reporting.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Links sales orders to the 'Contractual Compliance Obligation' record that defines mandatory regulatory actions the order must satisfy.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Overall order budgeting: assigning a sales order to a cost center supports order‑level expense allocation and budgeting reports.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the customer who placed the order.

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Order processing uses a sold‑to contact for invoicing and communication; this contact is stored in customer.contact.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Project linkage: whole sales orders are tied to internal orders for project cost settlement and tracking.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Revenue attribution: linking orders to the originating sales opportunity enables pipeline‑to‑revenue reporting and commission calculations.

attributes.name: order_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_intake. Business justification: Order Management traceability: each order must reference the intake record that created it for audit and fulfillment reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue attribution: linking the order to a profit center enables consolidated profit‑and‑loss reporting per sales order.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Project Management Report requires linking each sales order to its implementation project for schedule and cost tracking.

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: Contract compliance: orders are executed under a sales contract; linking ensures legal and pricing terms are enforced per order.

attributes.name: sales_rep_employee_id

attributes.name: sales_rep_id

attributes.name: sales_territory_id

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Billing and revenue domain serving as the SSOT for all customer invoices, billing cycles, payment processing, revenue recognition, credit management, collections, payment terms, accounts receivable, and billing dispute resolution across product sales, service contracts, and project-based engagements.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a formal demand for payment issued to a customer for product sales, service contracts, or project-based engagements. Captures invoice number, issue date, due date, billing period, total amount, tax amount, discount amount, currency, invoice status (draft, issued, partially_paid, paid, overdue, cancelled, disputed, written_off), invoice type (standard, credit_note, debit_note, proforma, self_billing), payment terms code, billing address, PO reference, contract reference, and source transaction reference. Serves as the SSOT for credit notes (returns, pricing corrections, quality disputes, volume rebate settlements) and debit notes (price adjustments, surcharges, underbilling corrections) via the invoice_type discriminator. Also supports self-billing/evaluated receipt settlement (ERS) for consignment and VMI arrangements. Managed in SAP S/4HANA SD/FI billing document types (VF01/VF04).

products.description: Record of a payment transaction received from a customer against one or more invoices, serving as the SSOT for all incoming customer payments, cash application, and payment-to-invoice allocation in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR. products.name: collections
products.description: Collections management record serving as the unified SSOT for the full receivables collections lifecycle — from initial overdue detection through escalation to legal action or write-off referral. At the case level: captures collections case ID, collections strategy (standard, intensive, legal, write_off_candidate), assigned collections agent, customer promise-to-pay date, promised amount, case status (open, in_progress, escalated, resolved, closed), case open date, and total case exposure amount. At the communication level: captures dunning level (1=reminder through 4=legal_action), dunning date, total overdue amount, dunning charges, communication method (email, letter, phone, legal), customer response status, response date, and next action date. Tracks the full collections escalation lifecycle per SAP S/4HANA FI-AR dunning procedures (FBMP/F150) and supports structured collections management for industrial B2B receivables with typical 30-90 day payment cycles.

domains.name: service
domains.description: After-sales service and field service management domain covering service request tracking, warranty management, RMA processing, service contract administration, technical support, customer service case management, and post-sale support for installed automation systems and equipment via Salesforce Service Cloud.

products.name: request
products.description: Core transactional entity representing a customer-initiated after-sales service request or support ticket for installed automation systems and equipment. Captures request type (technical support, field service, warranty claim, RMA, complaint), priority, SLA tier, originating channel (phone, email, portal, field), reported symptom or issue description, affected installed base asset, site location, and full lifecycle status (open, in-progress, pending-customer, resolved, closed). Maps to Salesforce Service Cloud Case object. SSOT for all post-sale support interactions.

products.name: service_contract
products.description: Master entity representing a formal after-sales service agreement between Manufacturing and a customer organization covering installed automation systems or equipment. Captures contract header: type (preventive maintenance, full-service, time-and-material, extended warranty), coverage scope, SLA commitments (response time, resolution time, uptime guarantee), start/end dates, renewal terms, billing frequency, and contract value. Includes contract line items: each line covering a specific installed asset or product family with line-level coverage type, SLA tier, pricing, coverage dates, and renewal flag. Serves as the SSOT for all service entitlement, coverage data, and contract profitability analysis at both header and line-item granularity.

products.name: service_entitlement
products.description: Master entity defining specific service entitlement rules, coverage levels, and SLA milestone tracking associated with a service contract or warranty. Specifies which service types, response/resolution time SLAs, and support channels a customer is entitled to for a given installed asset or product family. Captures entitlement name, type (warranty, contract, complimentary), SLA response time target, SLA resolution time target, business hours coverage, and active status. Includes milestone compliance tracking: each SLA milestone event (first response, acknowledgment, resolution) with target timestamp, actual completion timestamp, breach flag, breach reason, and elapsed time. Enables automated SLA enforcement during service request intake, SLA performance monitoring, and breach root-cause analysis. Maps to Salesforce Service Cloud Entitlement and Milestone objects.

attributes.name: order_date

attributes.name: order_urgency

attributes.name: warranty_coverage_flag

products.name: contract_line
products.description: Represents the association between equipment_register and service_contract, capturing coverage details, SLA tier, pricing, and effective dates for each equipment covered by a contract.. Existence Justification: An equipment asset can be covered by multiple service contracts over its lifecycle, and a single service contract can cover many equipment assets. Each equipment‑contract pairing is managed as a contract line item that stores coverage type, SLA tier, pricing, and effective dates. The relationship is actively created, updated, and deleted by contract administrators.

attributes.name: contract_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for contract_line

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_contract. Business justification: Contract line must reference its parent service contract; adding service_contract_id creates the required parent‑child relationship within the service domain.

products.name: engineer_assignment
products.description: Represents the assignment of a field service engineer to a control system. Each record captures the engineer's role on the system and the period of the assignment, enabling tracking of maintenance responsibilities and compliance.. Existence Justification: Field service engineers are actively assigned to one or more control systems for maintenance, commissioning, and support. Each control system can have multiple engineers assigned, with each assignment capturing the engineer's role and the start/end dates of the assignment. The assignment is a managed business entity that is created, updated, and retired as operational needs change.

attributes.name: engineer_assignment_id

attributes.name: control_system_id

attributes.name: service_engineer_id

attributes.name: assignment_end_date

attributes.name: assignment_role

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the engineer's assignment to the control system begins

products.name: task_checklist

attributes.name: task_checklist_id

attributes.name: applicable_equipment_type

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the checklist across enterprise systems.

attributes.name: compliance_required
attributes.description: True when the checklist must satisfy industry or safety regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: is_mandatory

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when the checklist was last examined for relevance and compliance.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the checklist used by service technicians and planners.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Supplementary information, comments, or special instructions related to the checklist.

attributes.name: owner_role
attributes.description: Organizational role (e.g., Field Engineer, Service Manager) that maintains the checklist.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the checklist is currently in use, retired, or under development.

attributes.name: task_count
attributes.description: Total count of tasks that belong to this checklist.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the checklist based on service activity.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the latest modification to the checklist metadata.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier used to track revisions of the checklist.

attributes.name: parent_task_checklist_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on task_checklist (parent_task_checklist_id)

products.name: service_center
products.description: Master reference table for service_center. Referenced by service_center_id.

attributes.name: service_center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for service_center

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the service center.

attributes.name: address_line2

attributes.name: average_resolution_time_minutes
attributes.description: Mean time from request receipt to case closure.

attributes.name: average_response_time_minutes
attributes.description: Mean time from service request receipt to first response.

attributes.name: center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier or code assigned to the service center.

attributes.name: center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service center based on its operational scope.

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: closing_date

attributes.name: compliance_certifications

attributes.name: contract_number

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO country code of the service center location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service center record was first created.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary contact email address for the service center.

attributes.name: external_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the service center in an external ERP or CRM system.

attributes.name: inspection_status

attributes.name: is_primary_center

attributes.name: last_inspection_date

attributes.name: latitude

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: manager_email

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: operating_hours

attributes.name: phone_number

attributes.name: postal_code

attributes.name: region

attributes.name: rma_processing_enabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating if Return‑Material Authorization processing is supported.

attributes.name: service_capacity

attributes.name: service_level_agreement
attributes.description: Code referencing the SLA governing response and resolution times.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the service center location.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service center.

attributes.name: supported_equipment
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of equipment categories the center can service.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time‑zone identifier for the center (e.g., America/New_York).

attributes.name: total_rma_cases_last_year
attributes.description: Number of Return‑Material Authorization cases processed last year.

attributes.name: total_service_requests_last_year
attributes.description: Count of all service requests handled in the previous calendar year.

attributes.name: total_warranty_cases_last_year
attributes.description: Number of warranty‑covered service cases processed last year.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the service center record.

attributes.name: warranty_service_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the center provides warranty‑covered service.

attributes.name: parent_service_center_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on service_center (parent_service_center_id)

products.name: holiday_calendar
products.description: Master reference table for holiday_calendar. Referenced by holiday_calendar_id.

attributes.name: holiday_calendar_id

attributes.name: calendar_year

attributes.name: base_holiday_calendar_id

domains.name: supplier
domains.description: Supplier relationship and performance management domain tracking supplier profiles, qualification status, scorecards, audit results, certifications, risk ratings, and long-term relationship data. Distinct from procurement transactions — this domain owns the supplier identity and master data used across procurement, quality, and supply chain.

products.name: supplier
products.description: Core master entity representing the authoritative supplier identity record (SSOT) for all vendors, sub-contractors, and raw material suppliers engaged by Manufacturing. Captures legal entity name, DUNS number, tax ID, SAP vendor master number (from SAP Ariba/S4HANA MM), business type (OEM, distributor, raw material, MRO), incorporation country, headquarters address, primary contact, preferred currency, payment terms, incoterms, and active status. This is the golden record used across procurement, quality, supply chain, and logistics domains.
products.reference: SAP Vendor Master (LFA1/LFB1), SAP Ariba Supplier Profile

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Primary key for supplier

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: PROCUREMENT: Assigns an internal account manager to each supplier for relationship management; required for supplier performance dashboards and contract negotiations.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for allocating supplier spend to internal cost centers (Procurement Cost Allocation Report).

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Default GL account for posting supplier invoices (AP posting rules).

attributes.name: business_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supplier based on the type of goods or services provided. OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) supplies finished components, distributor resells products, raw_material provides base materials, MRO (Maintenance Repair Operations) supplies consumables, subcontractor provides manufacturing services, service_provider delivers non-manufacturing services.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and master data governance.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to identify business entities globally. Used for supplier credit checks, risk assessment, and compliance verification.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the supplier's corporate headquarters. Used for legal correspondence, audit notices, and official communications.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or floor information at the supplier's headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the supplier's headquarters is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the supplier's headquarters location. May differ from incorporation country for multinational organizations.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the supplier's headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region for the supplier's headquarters address.

attributes.name: incorporation_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the supplier is legally incorporated and registered. Used for trade compliance, tax jurisdiction, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard three-letter Incoterms code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller in international trade (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Published by International Chamber of Commerce. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: iso14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds valid ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. True if certified, False if not certified or certification expired.

attributes.name: iso45001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds valid ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification. True if certified, False if not certified or certification expired.

attributes.name: iso9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds valid ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. True if certified, False if not certified or certification expired.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supplier audit conducted by Manufacturing's quality or procurement team. Used to track audit frequency and schedule next audit per supplier management policy.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this supplier master record. Used for change accountability, audit trails, and data governance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier master record was last updated. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_scorecard_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supplier scorecard evaluation. Scorecards typically assess quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness on a quarterly or annual basis.

attributes.name: minority_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise. Used for diversity supplier programs and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier audit based on risk rating, performance, and audit frequency policy. Used for audit planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on or before the requested delivery date over the evaluation period. Key performance indicator (KPI) for supplier scorecard and performance management. Expressed as percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: overall_scorecard_rating
attributes.description: Composite supplier performance score from the most recent scorecard evaluation, typically on a scale of 0.0 to 10.0 or 0.0 to 100.0. Aggregates quality, delivery, cost, and service metrics into a single performance indicator.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Defines the payment due date and any early payment discounts available.

attributes.name: preferred_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the supplier's preferred currency for invoicing and payment transactions (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary supplier contact for business communications, purchase orders, and quality notifications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the supplier organization for procurement, quality, and supply chain coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number for the primary supplier contact including country code and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Quality and compliance qualification status indicating whether the supplier has passed required audits, certifications, and capability assessments. Qualified suppliers meet all requirements, conditional suppliers have minor gaps, not_qualified suppliers failed assessment, under_review suppliers are being evaluated.

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of received materials that passed incoming quality inspection without rejection or rework over the evaluation period. Key performance indicator (KPI) for supplier quality performance. Expressed as percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this supplier was terminated or the vendor record was deactivated. Null for active suppliers. Used for supplier lifecycle tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this supplier was established and the vendor record was first activated. Used for relationship tenure analysis and supplier lifecycle reporting.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment for the supplier based on financial stability, geopolitical factors, quality performance, delivery reliability, and compliance history. Used for supply chain risk management and contingency planning.

attributes.name: sap_vendor_number
attributes.description: Vendor master number from SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management) or SAP Ariba. This is the authoritative supplier identifier in the ERP system used for procurement transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Master Data Standards

attributes.name: small_business
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier qualifies as a small business based on revenue, employee count, or regulatory definitions. Used for small business procurement programs and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: supplier_category
attributes.description: Strategic classification indicating the supplier's relationship tier and procurement priority. Strategic suppliers are critical long-term partners, preferred suppliers have favorable terms, approved suppliers meet minimum standards, conditional suppliers are under review, blocked suppliers are prohibited from new business.

attributes.name: supplier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supplier relationship. Active suppliers are approved for procurement, inactive suppliers are no longer used, suspended suppliers are temporarily restricted, pending_approval suppliers are under qualification review, blocked suppliers are prohibited from new transactions.

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the supplier (e.g., EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, GST number in India). Used for tax reporting, invoice validation, and compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code assigned to the supplier for identification across procurement, quality, and supply chain systems. Often synchronized with SAP vendor master number.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the supplier organization as registered with incorporation authorities. Used for contracts, purchase orders, and legal documentation.

attributes.name: woman_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is certified as a woman-owned business enterprise. Used for diversity supplier programs and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this supplier master record. Used for accountability, audit trails, and data governance.

products.name: site
products.description: Represents a specific physical manufacturing, warehouse, or service site belonging to a vendor. A single vendor legal entity may operate multiple sites with distinct capabilities, certifications, and risk profiles. Captures site address, site type (manufacturing, distribution, R&D), production capacity, geographic region, ISO certification scope, and site-level contact. Used by procurement and quality to route sourcing decisions to the correct facility.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Supplier Site, ISO 9001 Site Scope

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Primary key for site

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SITE PERFORMANCE: Links a responsible procurement employee to each supplier site; used in site audit scheduling and capacity monitoring reports.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor legal entity that owns this site. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: active_from_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor site became active and eligible for procurement transactions.

attributes.name: active_to_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor site was deactivated or disqualified. Null for currently active sites.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the vendor site facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building, suite, or floor number. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: approved_for_new_business
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site is approved to receive new purchase orders and sourcing awards.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the production capacity metric such as units, tons, liters, or square meters.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the primary quality management certification expires. Used to trigger recertification workflows.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the vendor site is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor site location. Used for trade compliance, tariff calculation, and regional risk assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor site record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for transactions with this vendor site.

attributes.name: delivery_performance_score
attributes.description: On-time delivery performance score for the vendor site. Scale 0-100.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun and Bradstreet Universal Numbering System identifier for the vendor site. Used for credit assessment and supplier verification.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Macro-geographic region classification for supply chain planning and regional sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: iatf_16949_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site holds IATF 16949 automotive quality management certification. Required for automotive supply chain participation.

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site holds ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification.

attributes.name: iso_45001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site holds ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor site holds ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Critical for supplier qualification.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality or compliance audit conducted at the vendor site.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor site record was last updated.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the vendor site. Used for logistics optimization and distance calculations.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from purchase order placement to delivery for this vendor site.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the vendor site. Used for logistics optimization and distance calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the vendor site for purchase orders.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity such as pieces, kilograms, or pallets.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next quality or compliance audit at the vendor site.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or site-specific considerations relevant to procurement and quality teams.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms applicable to this vendor site such as Net 30, Net 60, or 2/10 Net 30.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the vendor site address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor site has preferred supplier status for strategic sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary site contact. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the vendor site for procurement and quality coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the vendor site contact. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: production_capacity_annual
attributes.description: Annual production capacity of the site in units relevant to the site type. Used for capacity planning and sourcing allocation decisions.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Composite quality performance score for the vendor site based on defect rates, audit results, and corrective action responsiveness. Scale 0-100.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk classification of the vendor site based on quality performance, financial stability, geopolitical factors, and compliance history.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the vendor site. Used for procurement routing and supplier qualification tracking.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Business name or designation of the vendor site facility.

attributes.name: site_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor site. Controls whether the site is eligible for new purchase orders and sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: site_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor site by primary function. Determines sourcing eligibility and capability matching.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the vendor site. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Tax identification or VAT registration number for the vendor site. Used for tax compliance and invoice validation.

products.name: supplier_contact
products.description: Tracks individual contacts associated with a vendor organization, including account managers, quality engineers, logistics coordinators, and executive sponsors. Captures full name, job title, department, email, phone, preferred language, contact role (commercial, technical, quality, logistics), and active status. Supports multi-threaded supplier relationship management across procurement, quality, and after-sales functions.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Contact Management, Salesforce Account Contact

attributes.name: supplier_contact_id
attributes.description: Primary key for contact

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Supplier contacts serve as project points of contact; linking allows communication and escalation tracking per project.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor organization this contact belongs to. Links to the supplier master record.

attributes.name: certification_held
attributes.description: Professional certifications or qualifications held by the contact relevant to their role (e.g., Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, ISO Lead Auditor, APICS CPIM). Multiple certifications separated by semicolon.

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method of communication for reaching this contact for routine supplier relationship activities.

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: Primary functional role of the contact in the supplier relationship. Determines routing of communications and escalations.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor contact. Inactive or terminated contacts should not receive communications.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact based on their priority and purpose in the supplier relationship hierarchy.

products.name: qualification
products.description: Records the formal supplier qualification lifecycle for each vendor, tracking whether a vendor has been approved or disqualified for specific commodity categories or part families. Captures qualification status (prospective, under evaluation, approved, conditional, disqualified), qualification type (new supplier, re-qualification, commodity extension, disqualification), evaluation start/end dates, approving engineer, qualification basis (PPAP, APQP, audit, sample approval), expiry date, and for disqualification events: disqualification reason, affected commodities, transition plan reference, and re-qualification eligibility. Managed in SAP Ariba and aligned with PPAP/APQP standards.
products.reference: PPAP (Production Part Approval Process), APQP, SAP Ariba Supplier Qualification

attributes.name: qualification_approving_engineer_employee_id

attributes.name: disqualification_date

attributes.name: disqualification_reason

attributes.name: evaluation_end_date

attributes.name: evaluation_start_date

attributes.name: ppap_level

attributes.name: qualification_number

attributes.name: qualification_status

attributes.name: re_qualification_conditions

attributes.name: transition_plan_reference

products.name: scorecard
products.description: Periodic supplier performance scorecard capturing aggregated KPI results across quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness dimensions for a defined evaluation period (monthly, quarterly, annual). Stores overall score, individual pillar scores (OTD — On-Time Delivery, PPM — Parts Per Million defect rate, cost variance, responsiveness index), scorecard period, rating tier (preferred, approved, conditional, development), and issuing buyer. Drives strategic sourcing decisions and supplier development programs.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Supplier Performance Management, AIAG Supplier Scorecard

attributes.name: previous_rating_tier

attributes.name: published_date
attributes.description: The date when the scorecard was officially published and communicated to the supplier.

attributes.name: quality_score

attributes.name: quality_weight_percentage

attributes.name: scorecard_status

products.name: supplier_audit
products.description: Records formal supplier audits conducted at vendor sites, including quality system audits (ISO 9001, IATF 16949), process audits, environmental audits (ISO 14001), cybersecurity audits (IEC 62443), and social compliance audits. Captures audit type, audit date, lead auditor, audit scope, findings count by severity (critical, major, minor), overall audit result (pass, conditional pass, fail), and next scheduled audit date. Linked to CAPA records for finding remediation tracking.

attributes.name: severity

attributes.name: supplier_response

products.name: supplier_certification
products.description: Tracks all regulatory, quality, and industry certifications held by a vendor or vendor site, including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, IEC 62443, UL, CE Marking, IATF 16949, AS9100, and RoHS compliance. Captures certification standard, issuing body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, scope of certification, and renewal status. Drives automated alerts for expiring certifications and gates procurement decisions for regulated commodity categories.
products.reference: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IEC 62443, UL, CE Marking, IATF 16949

attributes.name: supplier_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier certification record. Primary key for the supplier certification entity.

attributes.name: certifying_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: CERTIFICATION OVERSIGHT: Tracks which internal employee manages each supplier certification; required for compliance audit traceability.

attributes.name: project_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_header. Business justification: Projects require specific supplier certifications; linking enables per‑project certification compliance reporting and risk assessment.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Required for tracking which regulatory requirement each supplier certification satisfies; essential for compliance reporting and audit readiness.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who holds this certification. Links to the supplier master data entity.

attributes.name: vendor_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific supplier site or facility where this certification applies. Nullable if certification applies to the entire supplier organization rather than a specific site.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: The name of the accreditation body that accredits the issuing certification body. Examples include ANAB (ANSI National Accreditation Board), UKAS (United Kingdom Accreditation Service), DAkkS (German Accreditation Body), or other national accreditation authorities.

attributes.name: alert_threshold_days
attributes.description: The number of days before expiry at which automated alerts should be triggered to notify stakeholders of the upcoming certification expiration. Typical values range from 30 to 180 days.

attributes.name: audit_report_url
attributes.description: The URL or file path to the most recent audit report document stored in the document management system or cloud storage.

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the most recent audit. Passed indicates full compliance. Passed with observations indicates minor non-conformances that do not affect certification. Failed indicates major non-conformances. Conditional indicates certification granted pending corrective actions. Deferred indicates the audit decision is postponed.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: The type of audit that resulted in this certification or its most recent validation. Initial audit is the first certification audit. Surveillance audits are periodic checks. Recertification audits occur at the end of the certification cycle. Special audits address specific issues. Transfer audits occur when changing certification bodies.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether automatic renewal workflows and alerts are enabled for this certification. True if the system should automatically trigger renewal processes and notifications. False if renewal is managed manually.

attributes.name: business_criticality
attributes.description: The importance of this certification to the business relationship with the supplier. Critical certifications are mandatory for continued business. High criticality certifications are strongly preferred. Medium and low criticality certifications are informational or nice-to-have.

attributes.name: certificate_document_url
attributes.description: The URL or file path to the digital copy of the certification certificate document stored in the document management system or cloud storage.

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: The tier, grade, or level of certification achieved, if the standard defines multiple levels. Examples include Level 1, Level 2, Level 3 for IEC 62443, or Gold, Silver, Bronze for tiered certification programs.

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number or registration number issued by the certifying body. This is the externally-known identifier for the certification.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the certification. Active indicates the certification is valid and in good standing. Expired indicates the certification has passed its expiry date. Suspended indicates temporary suspension by the issuing body. Revoked indicates permanent withdrawal. Pending renewal indicates the certification is in the renewal process. Under review indicates the certification is being audited or reassessed.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: The category or domain of the certification. Classifies certifications into quality management, environmental management, health and safety, energy management, cybersecurity, product safety, industry-specific standards, or regulatory compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: quality|environmental|health_safety|energy|cybersecurity|product_safety|industry_specific|regulatory_compliance — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: certified_processes
attributes.description: A comma-separated or structured list of specific manufacturing processes, production lines, or operational activities that are covered under this certification. Examples include welding, machining, assembly, testing, or packaging.

attributes.name: certified_products
attributes.description: A comma-separated or structured list of specific product categories, product families, or SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) that are covered under this certification. Used to gate procurement decisions for regulated commodity categories.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context about this certification. May include information about special conditions, limitations, or historical context.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which all required corrective actions must be completed and verified. Failure to meet this date may result in certification suspension or revocation.

attributes.name: corrective_actions_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corrective actions are required to address audit findings. True if corrective actions are pending or in progress. False if no corrective actions are needed or all have been completed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the certification becomes effective and valid for business use. May differ from issue date if there is a grace period or transition period.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid. Critical for triggering renewal workflows and procurement gating decisions.

attributes.name: gated_commodity_categories
attributes.description: A comma-separated list of commodity categories or material groups for which this certification is mandatory. Procurement of these commodities from this supplier is blocked if the certification is not active and valid.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic regions, countries, or markets where this certification is recognized and valid. Examples include USA, EU, China, or Global. Uses 3-letter ISO country codes where applicable.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was originally issued by the certifying body. Represents the start of the certification validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: The name of the certification body, registrar, or regulatory authority that issued the certification. Examples include TUV, BSI, DNV, SGS, UL, Intertek, Bureau Veritas, LRQA, or government agencies.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent surveillance audit or recertification audit conducted by the certifying body to verify ongoing compliance with the certification standard.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that most recently modified this certification record. Audit trail field for accountability and data lineage.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was most recently modified. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: major_nonconformance_count
attributes.description: The number of major non-conformances identified during the most recent audit. Major non-conformances are serious violations that can lead to certification suspension or revocation.

attributes.name: minor_nonconformance_count
attributes.description: The number of minor non-conformances identified during the most recent audit. Minor non-conformances are less serious violations that require corrective action but do not immediately threaten certification status.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next surveillance audit or recertification audit. Used for planning and ensuring continuous compliance.

attributes.name: nonconformance_count
attributes.description: The total number of non-conformances (major and minor) identified during the most recent audit. Used to assess the supplier's compliance maturity and risk level.

attributes.name: procurement_gate_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certification is used to gate procurement decisions. True if suppliers without valid certification in this standard cannot be selected for certain commodity categories. False if the certification is informational only.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the certification renewal process must be completed to avoid expiration. Typically occurs before the expiry date to allow for processing time.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: The current status of the certification renewal process. Not due indicates renewal is not yet required. Renewal initiated indicates the renewal process has started. Renewal in progress indicates active renewal activities. Renewal completed indicates successful renewal. Renewal overdue indicates the renewal deadline has passed.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: The risk level associated with this certification based on its status, expiry proximity, audit findings, and business criticality. Low indicates minimal risk. Medium indicates moderate risk requiring monitoring. High indicates significant risk requiring action. Critical indicates immediate risk requiring urgent intervention.

attributes.name: scope_of_certification
attributes.description: A detailed description of the scope, activities, products, services, or processes covered by this certification. Defines the boundaries and applicability of the certification within the supplier's operations.

attributes.name: standard
attributes.description: The regulatory, quality, or industry standard that this certification represents. Examples include ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety), ISO 50001 (Energy Management), IEC 62443 (Industrial Cybersecurity), IATF 16949 (Automotive Quality), AS9100 (Aerospace Quality), UL (Product Safety), CE Marking (European Conformity), RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances), and REACH (Chemical Safety). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ISO 9001|ISO 14001|ISO 45001|ISO 50001|IEC 62443|IATF 16949|AS9100|UL|CE Marking|RoHS|REACH|ISO 27001|ISO 13485|OHSAS 18001 — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO, IEC, UL, CE, EPA, OSHA Standards

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified by internal quality assurance or procurement teams. Verification includes confirming the certificate is authentic, current, and matches the supplier's claims.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the certification. Document review indicates verification by examining the certificate document. Certifying body confirmation indicates direct verification with the issuing body. On-site inspection indicates physical verification during a supplier visit. Third-party verification indicates verification by an external auditor. Supplier declaration indicates acceptance of supplier-provided documentation without independent verification.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the internal employee or quality assurance team member who verified the authenticity and validity of this certification with the issuing body.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that created this certification record. Audit trail field for accountability and data lineage.

products.name: risk_rating
products.description: Periodic supplier risk assessment record capturing multi-dimensional risk exposure for a vendor across financial (D&B rating, credit score, liquidity), geopolitical (country risk, sanctions, trade restrictions), operational (single-source dependency, capacity utilization, lead time volatility), quality (PPM trends, audit history, certification gaps), cybersecurity (IEC 62443 maturity, incident history), and ESG (environmental compliance, labor practices, conflict minerals) dimensions. Stores overall risk tier (critical, high, medium, low), individual dimension scores, risk assessment date, assessment methodology (quantitative model, qualitative review, third-party feed), data sources (Dun & Bradstreet, RapidRatings, EcoVadis, internal), key risk drivers, mitigation actions in place, residual risk level, and next review date. Feeds supply chain risk management, business continuity planning, and dual-sourcing trigger decisions.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Risk Management, ISO 31000 Risk Management

attributes.name: assessment_status

attributes.name: ecovadis_score

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_status
