attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Each invoice line must map to a GL account for correct posting in the general ledger.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent supplier invoice header. Links this line item to the overall invoice document.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the product or material being invoiced. Links to the material catalog for direct materials, indirect materials, or MRO supplies.

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order line item that this invoice line corresponds to. Used for three-way matching between PO, goods receipt, and invoice.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability analysis requires linking invoice lines to profit centers for revenue/expense attribution.

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service entry sheet if this line item corresponds to a service rather than a material. Used for service procurement verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Service Entry Sheet

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Line‑item verification is performed by an employee; capturing the verifier supports three‑way match audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The baseline date from which payment terms are calculated for this line item. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date depending on payment term configuration.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number for the material being invoiced. Critical for traceability, quality management, and recall management in regulated industries.

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or description explaining why this invoice line is blocked from payment. Examples include price variance exceeds tolerance, quantity mismatch, missing goods receipt, or quality hold.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the line amount and unit price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY). Must match the invoice header currency.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The supplier delivery note or packing slip number referenced on this invoice line. Used for traceability and shipment reconciliation.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Any discount amount applied at the line level. Reduces the line amount before tax calculation. May represent early payment discounts, volume discounts, or promotional discounts.

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: The discount percentage applied to this line item. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5% discount).

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number that this invoice line is matched against. Critical for three-way matching in logistics invoice verification.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity recorded on the goods receipt document. Used to compare against invoiced quantity for quantity variance detection.

attributes.name: invoiced_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material or service units being invoiced on this line. Used for three-way match verification against PO quantity and goods receipt quantity.

attributes.name: line_amount
attributes.description: The total amount for this invoice line before taxes. Typically calculated as invoiced quantity multiplied by unit price, adjusted for any line-level discounts or surcharges.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the invoice. Determines the ordering and position of this line item on the invoice document.

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice line item type. Distinguishes between material purchases, services, freight charges, handling fees, taxes, discounts, surcharges, and other cost elements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: material|service|freight|handling|tax|discount|surcharge|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: The three-way match status of this invoice line. Indicates whether the line passed matching validation or has variances requiring resolution. Blocked status prevents payment until resolved.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Logistics Invoice Verification

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the material, service, or item being invoiced. Provides human-readable detail about what was purchased.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The material number or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) as specified on the invoice line. May differ from internal material master number in case of supplier-specific identifiers.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net amount for this invoice line after applying discounts and adding taxes. Represents the final cost impact of this line item.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this invoice line. May contain variance explanations, special handling instructions, or resolution details.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms applicable to this invoice line if different from header-level terms. May specify early payment discounts or extended payment periods.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or facility code where the material or service is consumed or delivered. Used for multi-site cost allocation.

attributes.name: po_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity specified on the original purchase order line. Used as the baseline for three-way match verification.

attributes.name: po_unit_price
attributes.description: The unit price specified on the original purchase order line. Used as the baseline for price variance detection during invoice verification.

attributes.name: price_variance
attributes.description: The difference between invoiced unit price and PO unit price, multiplied by invoiced quantity. Indicates pricing discrepancies requiring review.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: The difference between invoiced quantity and goods receipt quantity. Positive values indicate over-invoicing, negative values indicate under-invoicing.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The serial number for serialized materials or equipment. Enables individual unit tracking for warranty, maintenance, and asset management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The storage location within the plant where the material is received or stored. Used for inventory management and warehouse assignment.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount for this invoice line based on the tax code and line amount. Added to line amount to determine total line cost.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to this invoice line. Determines the tax rate and tax jurisdiction for calculating line-level tax amounts.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percent
attributes.description: The tax rate percentage applied to this line item. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 7.50 for 7.5% tax rate).

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: The tolerance group that defines acceptable variance thresholds for this line item. Different tolerance groups may apply to different material categories or supplier relationships.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification Configuration

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the invoiced quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters, HR for hours). Must align with PO and material master UOM for proper matching.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The price per unit of measure as stated on the invoice line. Used to calculate line amount and compared against PO price for variance detection.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The valuation type for split valuation scenarios where the same material is valued differently based on procurement source, quality grade, or other criteria.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date when this invoice line was verified and approved for payment. Critical for tracking invoice processing cycle time and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: The current verification status of this invoice line in the approval workflow. Tracks progress through invoice verification and approval process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification Workflow

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The WBS element for project-related procurement. Links invoice line to specific project phases or deliverables for project cost tracking.

products.name: spend_record
products.description: Normalized spend transaction record representing actual procurement expenditure at the line-item level, enriched with commodity classification (UNSPSC L1-L4), supplier segmentation, and cost object allocation. Captures spend amount, currency, spend category (direct, indirect, MRO, CapEx), cost center, profit center, plant, fiscal period, payment date, and PO/invoice reference. Serves as the foundational fact table for spend cube analytics, category management dashboards, maverick spend detection, and savings validation across all procurement channels including P-card, PO-based, and non-PO spend.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Spend Analysis / SAP S/4HANA CO Spend Record

attributes.name: spend_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the spend transaction record. Primary key for the spend_record data product.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved the purchase order. Used for approval audit trail and delegation of authority compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Approver

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Spend records are aggregated by cost center for budgeting and spend analysis reports.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Associating spend records with GL accounts supports financial statement reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material or service procured. Links to material master data in SAP S/4HANA MM or Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: primary_spend_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who initiated the purchase requisition. Used for spend accountability and approval workflow tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Requisition Creator

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement contract under which this spend was executed. Links to contract master data for compliance tracking and savings validation.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Linking spend to profit centers enables profitability tracking of procurement spend.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order that authorized this spend transaction. Links to the purchase order master record in SAP Ariba or SAP S/4HANA MM module.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Spend analysis reports track expenditures against regulatory requirements for spend compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Provides product‑level spend analysis, required for the 'Product Spend Reporting' dashboard used by finance and supply chain.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier who provided the goods or services. Links to supplier master data in SAP Ariba or SAP S/4HANA MM.

attributes.name: commodity_code_l1
attributes.description: Top-level commodity classification code from the United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC) taxonomy. Enables high-level category spend aggregation.

attributes.name: commodity_code_l2
attributes.description: Second-level commodity classification code from UNSPSC taxonomy. Provides family-level categorization for spend cube analytics.

attributes.name: commodity_code_l3
attributes.description: Third-level commodity classification code from UNSPSC taxonomy. Provides class-level categorization for detailed spend analysis.

attributes.name: commodity_code_l4
attributes.description: Fourth-level commodity classification code from UNSPSC taxonomy. Provides commodity-level categorization for granular spend analysis and category management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the spend transaction. Used for multi-currency spend analysis and currency conversion.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Date the goods or services were delivered. Used for supplier on-time delivery performance measurement and lead time analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt Date

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate used to convert transaction currency to USD. Captured for audit trail and variance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the spend was posted. Supports monthly spend tracking and period-over-period analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the spend transaction was posted. Enables year-over-year spend trend analysis and budget variance reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the spend is posted. Used for financial reporting and chart of accounts reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI General Ledger Account

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, insurance, and risk transfer (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP).

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the supplier invoice was issued. Used for payment terms calculation and aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Invoice Document Date

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Supplier invoice number associated with this spend transaction. Used for payment reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material or service procured. Denormalized for reporting and spend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Description

attributes.name: maverick_spend_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this spend transaction was executed outside of established contracts or preferred suppliers. True indicates non-compliant spend requiring corrective action.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was made to the supplier. Used for cash flow analysis and Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Document Date

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to pay the supplier. Used for payment channel analysis and transaction cost optimization.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms agreed with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Used for cash flow forecasting and early payment discount analysis.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code where the material or service is consumed. Used for site-level spend analysis and supply chain optimization.

attributes.name: po_line_item_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the purchase order that corresponds to this spend transaction. Enables drill-down to specific material or service line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date the spend transaction was posted to the financial ledger. Determines the fiscal period for spend recognition and accrual accounting.

attributes.name: procurement_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the procurement was executed. Used for maverick spend detection and procurement compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team responsible for this purchase. Used for buyer performance evaluation and workload distribution analysis.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Used for procurement performance tracking and organizational spend analysis.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service units procured in this transaction. Used for unit price calculation and volume-based spend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Quantity

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this spend record was first created in the data lakehouse. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this spend record was last updated in the data lakehouse. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: savings_amount
attributes.description: Documented cost savings achieved on this transaction compared to baseline or previous pricing. Used for procurement performance measurement and ROI calculation.

attributes.name: spend_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the spend transaction in the transaction currency. Represents the actual expenditure at line-item level before currency conversion.

attributes.name: spend_amount_usd
attributes.description: Spend amount converted to US Dollars using the exchange rate at posting date. Enables consolidated spend reporting across global operations.
attributes.references: IFRS 21 Foreign Exchange - Spot Rate Conversion

attributes.name: spend_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of spend type: direct materials (production inputs), indirect materials (non-production goods), MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations supplies), or CapEx (Capital Expenditure for fixed assets).

attributes.name: supplier_segment
attributes.description: Strategic classification of the supplier based on spend volume, criticality, and performance. Used for supplier relationship management and sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount included in the spend transaction. Used for tax reporting and compliance with local tax regulations.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code or tax type applied to this transaction. Used for tax compliance reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, M for meter). Follows ISO 80000 or industry-specific UOM standards.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of measure in the transaction currency. Calculated as spend_amount divided by quantity. Used for price variance analysis and benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Net Price per Unit

products.name: approval_workflow
products.description: Approval workflow record tracking the multi-level authorization process for purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and sourcing events. Captures approval document reference, approval level, approver role, approver identity, approval action (approved, rejected, escalated, delegated), approval timestamp, approval threshold amount, and comments. Supports procurement governance, delegation of authority (DoA) compliance, and audit trail requirements.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Approval Workflow / SAP S/4HANA Release Strategy

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Primary key for approval_workflow

attributes.name: approval_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the document being approved (purchase requisition, purchase order, or sourcing event). Links to the source document requiring approval.

attributes.name: primary_approval_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the individual who performed the approval action. Links to employee or user master data.

attributes.name: requester_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee who initiated the procurement request. Links to employee or user master data.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the supplier or vendor associated with the procurement document being approved. Links to supplier master data.

attributes.name: approval_action
attributes.description: Action taken by the approver on the document. Approved indicates authorization granted, rejected indicates denial, escalated indicates forwarding to higher authority, delegated indicates reassignment to another approver, returned indicates sent back for revision.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Procurement, ISO 9001 Quality Management System

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the approver explaining the approval decision, conditions, or reasons for rejection. Supports audit trail and communication.

attributes.name: approval_document_number
attributes.description: Business identifier of the document being approved. Human-readable reference number such as PR number, PO number, or RFQ number.

attributes.name: approval_document_type
attributes.description: Type of procurement document being approved. Indicates whether the approval is for a purchase requisition, purchase order, RFQ (Request for Quotation), RFP (Request for Proposal), contract, or other sourcing event.

attributes.name: approval_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the approval action should be completed. Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking and escalation triggers.

attributes.name: approval_duration_hours
attributes.description: Time elapsed in hours between approval request and approval action completion. Used for cycle time analysis and process optimization.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Sequential level in the multi-tier approval hierarchy. Level 1 represents first-line approval, with higher numbers indicating escalation through management layers.

attributes.name: approval_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approval request notification was successfully sent to the approver. True indicates notification sent, false indicates pending or failed.

attributes.name: approval_reminder_count
attributes.description: Number of reminder notifications sent to the approver for this pending approval. Used to track follow-up communications and escalation triggers.

attributes.name: approval_request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approval request was submitted to this approver. Marks the start of the approval cycle for this level.

attributes.name: approval_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order number of this approval step within the overall workflow for the document. Used to track the progression through the approval chain.

attributes.name: approval_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application from which the approval workflow originated. Examples include SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, custom procurement portal.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this approval step. Pending indicates awaiting action, in progress indicates under review, approved indicates completed successfully, rejected indicates denied, cancelled indicates workflow terminated, expired indicates approval deadline passed.

attributes.name: approval_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Monetary threshold amount that defines the approval authority limit for this approver role at this level. Part of Delegation of Authority (DoA) matrix.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Procurement, IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: approval_threshold_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the approval threshold amount. Defines the currency in which the approval authority is denominated.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approval action was performed by the approver. Represents the business event time of the authorization decision.

attributes.name: approver_email
attributes.description: Email address of the approver. Used for notification and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who performed the approval action. Captured for audit trail and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, ISO 9001 Quality Management System

attributes.name: approver_role
attributes.description: Functional role or job title of the approver responsible for this approval level. Examples include Purchasing Manager, Plant Manager, Finance Director, VP Procurement, CFO.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code within the enterprise structure. Represents the financial accounting entity for which the procurement is being executed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module, IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: compliance_check_status
attributes.description: Status of automated compliance checks performed during the approval process. Indicates whether the document passed policy validation, supplier screening, budget checks, and regulatory compliance rules.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management System, OSHA Compliance

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center to which the procurement expense will be charged. Used for internal cost allocation and management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module, IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this approval workflow record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail start point for this approval step.

attributes.name: delegation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for delegating the approval to another approver. Examples include out of office, conflict of interest, workload balancing, temporary reassignment.

attributes.name: document_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the document total amount. Indicates the currency in which the procurement document is denominated.

attributes.name: document_total_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the document being approved. Used to determine routing through approval hierarchy based on DoA (Delegation of Authority) thresholds.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Procurement, IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for escalating the approval to a higher authority level. Examples include exceeds_authority, requires_executive_review, policy_exception, risk_assessment.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Procurement, ISO 9001 Quality Management System

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this approval workflow record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: mandatory_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval step is mandatory or optional in the workflow. True indicates required approval, false indicates advisory or optional review.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Procurement, ISO 9001 Quality Management System

attributes.name: material_category
attributes.description: Classification of the materials or services being procured. Examples include direct materials, indirect materials, MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) supplies, capital equipment, services.

attributes.name: parallel_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval step is part of a parallel approval process where multiple approvers at the same level must approve simultaneously. True indicates parallel, false indicates sequential.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code where the procured materials or services will be delivered or consumed. Represents the physical location in the supply chain.

attributes.name: policy_violation_description
attributes.description: Description of the specific procurement policy or business rule that was violated. Populated when policy violation flag is true.

attributes.name: policy_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the procurement document violates any procurement policies or business rules. True indicates policy violation detected, false indicates compliant.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer group or team responsible for specific categories of materials or suppliers. Represents the operational procurement team handling the transaction.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Represents the procurement entity within the enterprise structure (e.g., regional purchasing office, plant purchasing group).

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for rejection if the approval action was rejected. Examples include budget_exceeded, supplier_not_approved, specification_incomplete, pricing_issue.

products.name: service_entry_sheet
products.description: Service entry sheet (SES) document created to confirm the acceptance of services rendered by a supplier against a service purchase order. Captures SES number, service PO reference, service line descriptions, accepted service quantity, acceptance date, acceptor identity, and SES status (created, accepted, rejected). Triggers invoice verification for service-based procurement and is mandatory for service PO three-way match.
products.reference: SAP MM Service Entry Sheet (ML81N / ESSR)

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service entry sheet record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Object

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the approval workflow instance used to review and approve this service entry sheet.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who accepted and confirmed the services in this service entry sheet.

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: SERVICE ENTRY: Service records must link to the equipment register to track maintenance history and warranty compliance.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service purchase order against which services were rendered and accepted.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who rendered the services being accepted in this service entry sheet.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the services were formally accepted by the receiving organization.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Acceptance

attributes.name: acceptance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the acceptor regarding the service acceptance, quality observations, or deviations.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Comments

attributes.name: accepted_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of service units accepted and confirmed through this service entry sheet.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Quantity

attributes.name: acceptor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who accepted the services for business reference and audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the service entry sheet received final approval through the workflow process.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the legal entity receiving and accepting the services.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center to which the accepted service costs are allocated for financial accounting and controlling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service entry sheet record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the service entry sheet monetary values.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period within the fiscal year in which the service entry sheet was posted.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the service entry sheet was posted for financial reporting and period closing.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the service entry sheet value is posted for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: gross_value
attributes.description: Total gross monetary value of the accepted services including taxes and all adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Valuation

attributes.name: invoice_verification_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this service entry sheet has been used for invoice verification and payment processing.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who last modified the service entry sheet record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service entry sheet record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: net_value
attributes.description: Total net monetary value of the accepted services before taxes and adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Valuation

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Original quantity of service units ordered on the purchase order line item for comparison with accepted quantity.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or facility code where the services were rendered or consumed.

attributes.name: po_line_number
attributes.description: Line item number on the purchase order to which this service entry sheet applies.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the service entry sheet was posted to financial accounting for cost recognition.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer group or team within the purchasing organization responsible for managing this service procurement.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for the procurement of the services covered by this service entry sheet.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the accepted service quantity such as hours, days, pieces, or service-specific units.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the service entry sheet was rejected, if applicable.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Rejection

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Classification category of the service type for spend analysis and procurement reporting.

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the services rendered by the supplier and accepted through this service entry sheet.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Line Item

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier completed rendering the services covered by this service entry sheet.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Service Period

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier began rendering the services covered by this service entry sheet.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Service Period

attributes.name: ses_number
attributes.description: Business document number assigned to the service entry sheet. Externally visible identifier used for tracking and reference in procurement workflows.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Document

attributes.name: ses_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service entry sheet indicating its approval and posting state.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Workflow

attributes.name: ses_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service entry sheet based on the procurement scenario and service delivery model.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba Service Entry Sheet Classification

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the accepted services based on tax jurisdiction and service category.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match process comparing service entry sheet, purchase order, and supplier invoice for payment approval.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Project work breakdown structure element for project-related service procurement cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who created the service entry sheet record.

products.name: commodity_category
products.description: Commodity and spend category taxonomy used to classify all purchased materials and services into a hierarchical structure aligned with UNSPSC or internal category codes. Captures category code, category name, category level (L1/L2/L3), parent category, spend type (direct/indirect/MRO/CapEx), category owner, preferred supplier flag, and strategic sourcing priority. Enables category management, spend cube construction, and sourcing strategy alignment.
products.reference: UNSPSC Commodity Classification / SAP Ariba Category Hierarchy

attributes.name: commodity_category_id
attributes.description: Primary key for commodity_category

attributes.name: parent_category_commodity_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent category in the hierarchy. Null for top-level (L1) categories.

attributes.name: primary_commodity_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or procurement specialist responsible for managing this commodity category and its sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: tertiary_commodity_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this commodity category record.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the commodity category. May align with UNSPSC (United Nations Standard Products and Services Code) or internal taxonomy.

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the commodity category scope, including typical materials, services, or products classified under this category.

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the category within the taxonomy structure. L1 represents top-level, L2 sub-category, L3 detailed category, etc.

attributes.name: category_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the category manager responsible for strategic sourcing and supplier relationships within this category.

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the commodity category (e.g., Electrical Components, Raw Steel, MRO Supplies).

attributes.name: category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the commodity category within the procurement taxonomy.

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category has specific regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals, ISO certifications).

attributes.name: contract_coverage_flag

attributes.name: cost_reduction_target_pct

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity category record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category requires environmental compliance certifications such as ISO 14001, RoHS, REACH, or conflict minerals reporting.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this commodity category classification expires or is scheduled for review. Null for active categories without planned expiration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity category record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this category was last reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and alignment with business needs.

attributes.name: lead_time_days_avg
attributes.description: Average procurement lead time in days for materials and services within this category, from requisition to delivery.

attributes.name: moq_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether suppliers in this category typically enforce minimum order quantity requirements.

attributes.name: negotiation_frequency
attributes.description: Typical frequency of contract negotiations and RFx events for this commodity category.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this commodity category classification and sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_count
attributes.description: Number of preferred suppliers currently approved and active for this commodity category.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category has designated preferred suppliers with negotiated contracts or framework agreements.

attributes.name: price_volatility_index
attributes.description: Classification of price volatility for commodities in this category based on historical price fluctuations and market dynamics.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing group (buyer team) responsible for operational procurement within this category.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing organization responsible for procurement activities within this category. Aligns with SAP organizational structure.

attributes.name: quality_certification_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required quality certifications for suppliers in this category (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AS9100).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this commodity category.

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Risk classification based on supply chain vulnerability, supplier concentration, geopolitical factors, and material criticality.

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy
attributes.description: Defined sourcing strategy for this category: single-source, dual-source, multi-source, global sourcing, or local sourcing approach.

attributes.name: spend_type
attributes.description: Classification of spend type: direct materials (production inputs), indirect materials (non-production), MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations), CapEx (Capital Expenditure), or services.

attributes.name: strategic_sourcing_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this category for strategic sourcing initiatives based on spend volume, supply risk, and business impact.

attributes.name: unspsc_class
attributes.description: Third-level UNSPSC class name within the family (e.g., Cutting and Forming Machines).

attributes.name: unspsc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC)
attributes.description: Eight-digit UNSPSC classification code for global commodity standardization and cross-industry spend analysis.

attributes.name: unspsc_commodity
attributes.description: Fourth-level UNSPSC commodity name, the most granular classification level (e.g., CNC Milling Machines).

attributes.name: unspsc_family
attributes.description: Second-level UNSPSC family name within the segment (e.g., Metalworking Machinery and Equipment).

attributes.name: unspsc_segment
attributes.description: Top-level UNSPSC segment name (e.g., Industrial Manufacturing and Processing Machinery and Accessories).

products.name: sourcing_strategy
products.description: Category-level sourcing strategy document defining the procurement approach for a commodity or spend category over a planning horizon. Captures strategy name, target category, strategy type (single source, dual source, multi-source, global sourcing, local sourcing), make-vs-buy decision, risk rating, savings target, preferred supplier list, contract coverage target, and review cycle. Supports strategic procurement planning and category management governance.
products.reference: SAP Ariba Category Management / Strategic Sourcing Plan

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the sourcing strategy record.

attributes.name: commodity_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.commodity_category. Business justification: Sourcing strategy must be linked to the commodity category it governs; adding procurement_category_id creates this essential relationship and eliminates the silo.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the strategy was approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the strategy.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the strategy with internal policies and external regulations.

attributes.name: contract_coverage_target_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount representing the desired contract coverage for the category.

attributes.name: contract_coverage_target_percent
attributes.description: Desired percentage of spend covered by contracts under this strategy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sourcing strategy record was first created.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for monetary fields.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing strategy becomes effective.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing strategy expires or is superseded (nullable for open‑ended).

attributes.name: expected_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Anticipated lead time for sourcing items under this strategy.

attributes.name: is_global_strategy
attributes.description: Indicates whether the strategy applies globally across all sites.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent strategic review.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name of the person who performed the most recent review.

attributes.name: make_vs_buy
attributes.description: Decision whether the organization will make the item internally or buy it from external suppliers.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form comments or observations about the strategy.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_ids
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of internal supplier identifiers preferred for this strategy.

attributes.name: review_cycle_months
attributes.description: Number of months between formal reviews of the sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score quantifying the risk level of the strategy (0‑100 scale).

attributes.name: risk_mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Brief description of actions to mitigate identified risks.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk rating assigned to the sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: savings_target_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of cost savings the strategy aims to achieve.

attributes.name: savings_target_currency
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 currency code for the savings target amount.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system of record (e.g., SAP Ariba).

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy_category
attributes.description: Spend category or commodity to which the strategy applies.

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: strategic_owner
attributes.description: Internal stakeholder responsible for the strategy's execution.

attributes.name: strategy_code
attributes.description: External code used to reference the sourcing strategy in procurement systems.

attributes.name: strategy_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Approach used for sourcing the category (e.g., single source, dual source, multi‑source, global, local).

attributes.name: target_savings_percent
attributes.description: Target savings expressed as a percentage of total spend.

attributes.name: total_spend_last_year
attributes.description: Aggregate spend for the category in the most recent fiscal year.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the sourcing strategy record.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version of the sourcing strategy document.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the sourcing strategy record.

products.name: purchase_info_record
products.description: Approved source master record linking a material or service to a qualified supplier, storing the negotiated price, standard order quantity, planned delivery time, tolerance limits, validity period, and plant-level sourcing assignments. Captures info record type (standard, subcontracting, pipeline, consignment), net price, price unit, minimum order quantity, reminder lead times, approved source indicators, MRP relevance flags, fixed source flags, valid-from/to dates, and outline agreement references. Drives automatic price proposals during PO creation and ensures MRP-driven orders are directed to approved suppliers at the correct plant.

attributes.name: purchase_info_record_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the purchase info record.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba (Procurement) - Info Record Master Data

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Creating a purchase info record is an employee action; storing the creator ID enables accountability and change‑log reporting.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the material or service for which this info record is maintained.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the supplier linked to this info record.

attributes.name: approved_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is an approved source for the material (true = approved).

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference to an outline agreement or contract that governs this price.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the info record was initially created.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 code of the currency in which the net price is expressed.

attributes.name: fixed_source_flag
attributes.description: True if procurement must always source from this supplier for the material.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International commercial terms defining delivery responsibilities; limited to six most common values.

attributes.name: info_record_number
attributes.description: Business identifier assigned to the purchase info record, used for reference in procurement processes.
attributes.references: SAP Ariba (Procurement) - Info Record Master Data

attributes.name: info_record_type
attributes.description: Classification of the info record indicating the sourcing strategy (e.g., standard, subcontracting, pipeline, consignment).

attributes.name: last_price_update_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the price information was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Smallest quantity that can be ordered from the approved source.

attributes.name: mrp_relevant_flag
attributes.description: True if the info record should be considered during MRP runs.

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Negotiated net price for the material/service from the approved supplier.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑text field for additional comments or special instructions.

attributes.name: order_quantity_multiple
attributes.description: Quantity increment that must be respected when ordering (e.g., multiples of 10).

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of days from order creation to delivery for this source.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Code of the plant where the approved source is valid.

attributes.name: price_change_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent price change became effective.

attributes.name: price_change_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the price has increased, decreased, or remained unchanged since the previous version.

attributes.name: price_change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the latest price adjustment.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the net price (e.g., per piece, per kilogram).

attributes.name: purchase_info_record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the info record.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Group of buyers assigned to handle transactions for this info record.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities for this info record.

attributes.name: reminder_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the planned delivery date when a reminder is generated.

attributes.name: source_of_supply_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the source (e.g., internal, external, third‑party).

attributes.name: source_priority
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating preference order among multiple approved sources for the same material.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification applicable to the purchase price.

attributes.name: tolerance_limit_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowed deviation (percentage) from the negotiated price before a tolerance check is triggered.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the info record.

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the info record is no longer valid (nullable for open‑ended).

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the info record becomes effective.

attributes.name: vendor_material_number
attributes.description: Supplier's own material identifier for the supplied item.

attributes.name: vendor_price_list
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier's price list or catalogue containing this price.

products.name: source_list
products.description: Approved source record defining qualified suppliers for a material at a specific plant, including validity periods, fixed source indicators, and MRP relevance flags. Captures material, plant, supplier, agreement reference, valid-from/to dates, fixed source flag, MRP source indicator, and procurement type. Ensures purchase orders are automatically directed to approved suppliers.

attributes.name: source_list_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the source list record.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Maintaining a source list is performed by a responsible employee; the creator ID is required for governance and audit of sourcing data.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the material for which this source list applies.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing plant/location associated with the source list.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the underlying procurement contract or agreement governing the source.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Enables the 'Component Sourcing per Product' view, linking source‑list entries directly to the product SKU that uses the material.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the approved supplier for the material at the plant.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the source with internal or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the source list record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 currency code for the price fields.

attributes.name: fixed_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is a fixed (mandatory) source for the material.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the source list record.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in calendar days for the supplier to deliver the material.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered from the supplier for this material.

attributes.name: mrp_source_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator used by MRP planning to select this source (standard, alternative, or special).

attributes.name: price_per_unit
attributes.description: Unit price agreed with the supplier for the material.

attributes.name: price_valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the quoted unit price is effective.

attributes.name: price_valid_to
attributes.description: Date until which the quoted unit price remains valid.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority used to rank multiple approved sources for the same material.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Category of procurement for the source (e.g., direct, indirect, MRO, capital equipment).

attributes.name: source_list_description
attributes.description: Free‑form description or notes about the source list entry.

attributes.name: source_list_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the source list record.

attributes.name: source_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name or label for the source list entry.

attributes.name: source_rating
attributes.description: Rating (e.g., 0‑5) reflecting supplier performance for this material.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the source list entry indicating its sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the source list entry becomes effective.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which the source list entry expires (null if open‑ended).

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Human capital and workforce management domain covering employee master data, organizational structure, skills and certifications, shift scheduling, labor tracking, payroll, talent management, and HR administration via Workday HCM. Supports labor cost allocation and ISO 45001 occupational health compliance.

products.name: employee
products.description: Core master record for all employees in the manufacturing organization. Serves as the SSOT for employee identity, personal details, employment status, job classification, cost center assignment, and HR administrative data sourced from Workday HCM. Covers full-time, part-time, contract, and temporary workers on the shop floor and in corporate functions.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee record. Primary key sourced from Workday HCM. Serves as the single source of truth for employee identity across all manufacturing systems including SAP S/4HANA, Siemens Opcenter MES, and Maximo Asset Management.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Payroll tax reporting requires linking each employee to their legal entity (company code) for statutory compliance.

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the direct supervisor or manager. Establishes reporting hierarchy for organizational structure, approval workflows, and performance management.

attributes.name: annual_salary
attributes.description: Annual base salary for salaried employees. Used for budgeting, compensation analysis, and financial reporting. Null for hourly employees.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll, IFRS - Employee Compensation

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code for labor cost allocation and budgeting. Used in SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling) module for tracking labor expenses against departmental budgets and calculating manufacturing overhead.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Cost Center Accounting, IFRS - Cost Allocation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this employee record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with data governance policies.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Document Control, GDPR - Data Audit

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for compensation. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY. Used for multi-currency payroll processing and global workforce reporting.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the employee. Used for age verification, benefits eligibility, retirement planning, and compliance with labor laws.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, OSHA Age Requirements

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational department to which the employee is assigned. Used for labor cost allocation, reporting hierarchy, and organizational analytics. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA organizational structure.

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: Full name of the department. Examples: Assembly Line 1, Quality Control Lab, Maintenance Shop, Production Planning, Procurement. Provides human-readable context for organizational assignment.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary corporate email address for the employee. Used for system notifications, training communications, and business correspondence.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee's designated emergency contact person. Used for workplace incidents, medical emergencies, and ISO 45001 safety compliance.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the employee's emergency contact. Used for urgent notifications in case of workplace accidents or medical emergencies.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact to the employee. Examples: Spouse, Parent, Sibling, Friend. Used for emergency response protocols.

attributes.name: employee_number
attributes.description: Human-readable employee number assigned by HR system. Used for payroll, timekeeping, and shop floor identification. Displayed on employee badges and MES (Manufacturing Execution System) terminals.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment lifecycle status of the employee. Determines access rights, payroll processing, and system permissions. Active employees are eligible for work assignments and compensation.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of employment arrangement. Determines benefits eligibility, labor cost allocation, and compliance with labor regulations. Full-time and part-time are permanent positions; contract and temporary are fixed-term.
attributes.references: IFRS - Employee Classification, OSHA Employment Standards

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the employee as recorded in HR system. Used for official documentation, payroll processing, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the employee was originally hired by the organization. Used for seniority calculations, benefits eligibility, service awards, and tenure analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Employment History, IFRS - Employee Benefits

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: Hourly wage rate for hourly employees. Used for payroll calculation, labor cost allocation, and OpEx (Operational Expenditure) tracking. Null for salaried employees.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll, IFRS - Employee Compensation

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this employee record is currently active in the system. Used for filtering active workforce, system access control, and data retention policies.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized job classification code used for compensation planning, labor reporting, and workforce analytics. Maps to job families and pay grades in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad occupational category grouping similar roles. Examples: Production Operations, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Finance. Used for workforce planning and talent management.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title assigned to the employee. Reflects role, seniority, and functional responsibility. Examples: Production Operator, Quality Engineer, Maintenance Technician, Plant Manager.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname) of the employee as recorded in HR system. Used for official documentation, payroll processing, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review. Used for tracking review cycles and ensuring timely performance evaluations.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the employee. Optional field used for complete legal identification.

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number in USA, National Insurance Number in UK). Used for tax reporting, payroll processing, and legal compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, IRS Tax Reporting

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade level assigned to the employee. Determines salary range, bonus eligibility, and compensation structure. Used for pay equity analysis and compensation planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Compensation Management, IFRS - Employee Compensation

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent performance evaluation rating. Used for talent management, promotion decisions, compensation adjustments, and workforce development planning.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the employee. Used for emergency contact, shift scheduling notifications, and business communication.

attributes.name: safety_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's safety certification expires. Used for recertification scheduling and compliance tracking. Null if no certification required or status is not_required.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 - Occupational Health and Safety, OSHA - Safety Training

attributes.name: safety_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of required safety certifications for the employee's role. Used for ISO 45001 compliance, OSHA safety requirements, and work authorization on shop floor and hazardous areas.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 - Occupational Health and Safety, OSHA - Safety Training

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary shift assignment. Examples: 1ST, 2ND, 3RD, NIGHT, DAY. Used for production scheduling, labor tracking in MES (Manufacturing Execution System), and shift differential pay calculation.

attributes.name: skill_level
attributes.description: Overall skill proficiency level of the employee in their primary job function. Used for work assignment, training needs assessment, and workforce capability planning.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's employment ended. Null for active employees. Used for final payroll processing, benefits termination, system access revocation, and turnover analytics.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for employment termination. Used for turnover analysis, exit interview tracking, and workforce planning. Null for active employees. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|retirement|involuntary_termination|layoff|end_of_contract|deceased|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: training_hours_ytd
attributes.description: Total training hours completed by the employee in the current calendar year. Used for compliance with training requirements, skills development tracking, and ISO 9001 competency management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Competence and Training, Workday HCM - Learning Management

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union to which the employee belongs. Null for non-union employees. Used for contract administration and union reporting.

attributes.name: union_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is a member of a labor union. Used for collective bargaining compliance, union dues processing, and labor relations reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA - Labor Relations, NLRA - Union Membership

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this employee record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Document Control, GDPR - Data Audit

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary physical work location (plant, facility, office). Used for shift scheduling, safety compliance, and geographic labor reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 - Occupational Health and Safety, Workday HCM - Location Management

attributes.name: work_location_name
attributes.description: Full name of the work location. Examples: Springfield Manufacturing Plant, Chicago Distribution Center, Detroit Assembly Facility. Provides geographic context for workforce distribution.

attributes.name: work_permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's work permit or visa expires. Used for renewal tracking and compliance with immigration regulations. Null if no work permit required.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act - Work Authorization

attributes.name: work_permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee requires a work permit or visa to work in the current location. Used for immigration compliance and work authorization tracking.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act - Work Authorization

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Organizational hierarchy master representing departments, cost centers, business units, plants, and work centers within the manufacturing enterprise. Supports multi-level hierarchical structures (corporate → division → plant → department → work center) used for labor cost allocation, headcount reporting, and production scheduling.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organizational unit. Primary key for the organizational hierarchy master.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Org‑unit budgeting and cost allocation reports need a direct FK to the cost center, replacing the denormalized cost_center_code.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who manages this organizational unit. Used for organizational reporting lines and approval workflows.

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent organizational unit in the hierarchy. Null for top-level corporate entity. Enables multi-level hierarchical structures.

attributes.name: budget_amount_annual
attributes.description: Annual operating budget allocated to this organizational unit in base currency. Used for financial planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: business_function
attributes.description: Primary business function or operational area of this organizational unit. Used for functional reporting and cross-functional analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production|quality|maintenance|engineering|supply_chain|sales|finance|hr|it|r_and_d — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_target_pct
attributes.description: Target capacity utilization percentage for production organizational units. Used for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) tracking.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code in SAP FI for financial consolidation and statutory reporting. Links organizational unit to legal entity structure.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the organizational unit is located. Used for regulatory compliance and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for financial amounts associated with this organizational unit.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit ceased or will cease operations. Null for currently active units. Supports historical organizational structure analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit became or will become operational. Used for time-based organizational hierarchy reporting.

attributes.name: environmental_certification_iso14001
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit holds ISO 14001 environmental management system certification. Used for environmental compliance reporting.

attributes.name: external_code
attributes.description: Identifier used in external systems or legacy systems for data integration and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: headcount_actual
attributes.description: Current actual number of employees assigned to this organizational unit. Updated from employee assignment transactions.

attributes.name: headcount_planned
attributes.description: Planned or budgeted number of employees for this organizational unit. Used for workforce planning and budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the organizational hierarchy (1=corporate, 2=division, 3=business unit, etc.). Used for hierarchical rollup reporting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full hierarchical path from corporate root to this organizational unit (e.g., '/CORP/DIV01/PLANT05/DEPT20'). Enables efficient hierarchy traversal queries.

attributes.name: is_production_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is directly involved in manufacturing production activities. Used for production reporting and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) integration.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Physical location or site code where this organizational unit operates. Links to facility master data for geographic reporting.

products.name: job_profile

products.name: assignment
products.description: Transactional record of an employee's assignment to a specific position, org unit, job profile, compensation terms, and work location over a defined effective period. Captures primary and secondary assignments, supervisory relationships, cost center splits, assignment type (permanent, temporary, acting), base pay rate, pay frequency, shift premium eligibility, and bonus target percentage. Serves as the central employment terms record supporting labor cost allocation to production cost centers, pay equity analysis, workforce planning, and compensation history tracking.
